name: Prešovská hodinovka na tartane
organizer: BK ZasRun, Olympijský klub Prešov, AK TJ Slávia Prešovská univerzita
description: The Prešov Tartan Track Hour is a running race held at the Prešov University athletics stadium in Prešov. The competition is open to men and women in various age categories and offers a unique opportunity to test your endurance and speed on a tartan track. It is organized by BK ZasRun Šarišské Bohdanovce, Olympijský klub Prešov and AK TJ Slávia Prešovská univerzita. The race is suited to runners looking to experience a high-quality athletics atmosphere and compete in the pleasant surroundings of a university stadium.
course_highlights: The race takes place on the tartan track at the Prešov University athletics stadium
Categories are divided by age and gender (Men A, Men B, Women F, Women G)
The start and finish are on a high-quality athletics surface in Prešov
additional: The event also offers online registration and takes place on 15 October 2026 at the university athletics stadium in Prešov.

name: PANORÁMA TRAIL
description: The Panoráma Trail is a unique trail-running marathon in the Zemplén Mountains, linking the historic castles of Boldogkő, Regéc and Füzér. The 45-kilometre route follows varied, technical forest trails, where nature and history meet. The race is not about finishing times, but about the experience and challenge, and can be completed individually or as part of a three-person team. With premium organisation and an environmentally conscious approach, the event welcomes runners in October, when conditions are ideal for running.
course_highlights: A 45-kilometre route passing three historic castles
Varied, technical terrain with rocky trails and stream crossings
Several aid stations at Mogyoróska, Regéc, Telkibánya and Hollóháza
additional: Race-number pickup is available on Friday from 16:00 to 19:00 at the Füzér Race Centre, and on Saturday from 7:30 to 8:45 at the Boldogkővár Race Centre. Individual participants receive a green wristband for bag transport from the start to the finish. The race route is well marked, but the terrain is varied and technical. At the finish, runners receive a medal and free admission to all three castles. After the awards ceremony, a bus departs at 18:00 to return runners to the start. 45 km, three castles, forest and rocky sections, 1,800 m+ elevation gain, limit of 400 participants, online registration, team and individual categories

name: Stovka Považím - Považie ultra trail
description: Stovka Považím is a challenging long-distance hike and ultra trail in the beautiful Považie region, intended for experienced ultrarunners and walkers. Each year, it offers an original and extremely demanding course. Course A is part of the Czech-Slovak Ultratrail Cup and the first stage of the Extreme Ultra Trail Combination. The event takes place in Trenčín and the surrounding area, with several course options and luggage transport between the start and finish. Participants can stay overnight in the gym at ZŠ Predmier, adding to their comfort.
course_highlights: An extremely demanding and original course through the Považie region
Course A is part of the Czech-Slovak Ultratrail Cup (CSUT)
Luggage transport between the start and finish is available for all courses
additional: Participant check-in takes place on Friday evening in Trenčín and on Saturday morning in Ladce and Považská Bystrica. The finish-area facilities close on Sunday at 18:00 in Predmier. Participants on the shorter courses can stay overnight in the gym at ZŠ Predmier from Friday evening. Luggage must be securely closed; the organizer is not responsible for valuables. The 2026 edition is scheduled for 16–18 October, with a start at 23:00. Course A is part of the Czech-Slovak Ultratrail Cup and the first stage of the Extreme Ultra Trail Combination.

name: Azuga Trail Race

price_tiers.distance: Sorica Sunset Vertical iluminat de VARTA

description: Azuga Trail Race powered by JYSK is an annual mountain running event held in the town of Azuga and the Baiului Mountains, Romania. The event offers passionate runners a unique experience across four spectacular routes with views of the Bucegi, Postăvaru, and Piatra Mare mountains. Participants can enjoy nature, physical and mental challenges, and an atmosphere filled with adrenaline and competitive spirit. It is an opportunity to test your limits and meet people who share your passions.
course_highlights: Four mountain routes with views of the Bucegi, Postăvaru, and Piatra Mare mountains
Routes in the Baiului Mountains, with aid stations offering water, energy drinks, and fruit
Different start locations for the main races and children’s races, including special routes with gondola transport
additional: The race kit includes a personalized bib, personalized products, individual chip timing, aid stations with water and fruit, finisher medals, cash and sports equipment prizes, surprise prize draws, ITRA/UTMB points where applicable, and an official photo and video album. Gondola transport is included for the Family Walk & Run and Urechea Run. Awards ceremony at 17:00, SuperParty on Saturday evening with DJ Cătălin Sănătescu. Routes with significant elevation gain, impressive mountain scenery, a festive atmosphere, and activities for the whole family.

name: VII. Panoráma Trail 45
description: The Panoráma Trail is a 45-kilometre trail-running race in the Zemplén Mountains, linking the historic castles of Boldogkő, Regéc and Füzér. The race is not about finishing times, but about the experience and being close to nature, as runners make their way along rocky trails and through forests, crossing streams along the way. You can enter as an individual or in a team of three, so you can take on the challenge together. The event offers a premium experience in every detail, from the race pack to the finisher’s medal at the finish line.
course_highlights: A 45-kilometre course passing three historic castles
Varied, technical terrain with rocky trails and stream crossings
Several aid stations along the course (Mogyoróska, Regéc, Telkibánya, Hollóháza)
additional: Race-number collection is on Friday from 16:00 to 19:00 at the Füzér Race Centre, and on Saturday from 7:30 to 8:45 at the Boldogkővár Race Centre. Individual entrants receive a green wristband for bag transport. The course is well marked, but the terrain is varied and technical. At the finish, runners receive a finisher’s medal and free admission to all three castles. After the awards ceremony, a bus departs at 18:00 to return runners to the start. 45 km trail, 1,800 m+ elevation gain, 10% asphalt, linking three castles, close-to-nature terrain

name: Írottkő Hegyi Futóverseny
location: Kőszeg, Kincs pihenő, Kőszeg, Vas County, Hungary
description: The Írottkő Mountain Run is a unique trail-running event set in the rugged landscapes of the Kőszeg Mountains. Participants can choose from several distances, from a short 7 km introduction to a challenging 102 km ultra that also crosses into Austria. The race follows varied terrain, steep climbs and forest trails, offering runners an unforgettable experience close to nature, with panoramic views. A special feature is the ultra distance, which can be completed as a team and emphasizes shared experience and perseverance.
course_highlights: A 102 km ultra distance through the most scenic spots in the Kőszeg Mountains
The 23 km distance features 780 metres of elevation gain and panoramic views from the summit of Írottkő
Varied terrain with steep climbs, descents and technical sections
additional: The race is semi-self-sufficient, so runners need to bring their own equipment, such as a headlamp and a rain jacket. Two refreshment points are available on the 23 km course. The event is environmentally conscious, with a zero-waste program. Accommodation recommendations are available in Kőszeg and the surrounding area. An archive of photos from previous races is available on the website. Online registration is required to take part. The organizers also offer accommodation recommendations and environmentally friendly travel options.

name: Podvihorlatský kros
location: Futbalové ihrisko (amfiteáter), Poruba pod Vihorlatom, Slovakia
description: Podvihorlatský Cross-Country Run is a running event held at the football field (amphitheatre) in Poruba pod Vihorlatom. The race offers starts for children’s categories and the main category. The course runs mainly along field and forest roads, with 30% asphalt. It is organized by Mgr. Ján Podstavský with the support of the Municipality of Poruba pod Vihorlatom. The event is part of the Michalovce–Sobrance Running League 2025 and offers categories for various age groups, as well as Nordic walking.
course_highlights: 70% field and forest roads, 30% asphalt
The course passes through the natural surroundings of the Vihorlat Mountains
Start and finish at the football field (amphitheatre) in Poruba pod Vihorlatom
additional: The children’s categories start at 9:00, and the main category starts at 11:00. Categories are divided by age and gender, including Nordic walking. The event is supported by the Municipality of Poruba pod Vihorlatom and is part of the Michalovce–Sobrance Running League 2025. Course: forest and asphalt roads; online registration until 16.10.2025; start times at 9:00 and 11:00; categories for different age groups and ability levels; registration also includes a charitable contribution.

name: Extrém Maratón Oščadnica
organizer: Obec Oščadnica, Klub turistov Oščadnica, extremmaraton.sk
description: Extrém Maratón Oščadnica is a mountain marathon through the picturesque Kysuce countryside, mainly along mountain ridges with beautiful views of Veľká Rača. The 42-kilometre course, with nearly 1,700 metres of elevation gain, tests endurance, strength and a love of the mountains. This is not a race but a recreational running experience that celebrates the joy of movement, friendship and determination. The organisers provide full support, including refreshments, a T-shirt and a get-together after the run.
course_highlights: 42 km course with nearly 1,700 m of elevation gain
Mainly mountain ridges with views of Veľká Rača (1,236 m above sea level)
Refreshment stations approximately every 8 km
additional: Runner check-in is on 17.10.2026 from 06:30 to 08:30 at the Oščadnica Cultural Centre. The marathon time limit is 7 hours, with a 5-hour cut-off for reaching Veľká Rača; after that, the organisers do not guarantee refreshments. Registration is available online only, or on site if the start list is not full. Registration closes once the limit of 200 participants is reached. The entry fee includes a T-shirt, baggage storage, showers, refreshments on the course and at the finish, a medal and an after-party. Registration is available online, and the number of participants is limited to 200. The entry fee includes a T-shirt, refreshments, a medal and an after-party.

name: Rozhanovská dvanástka
organizer: Obec Rozhanovce, Občianske združenie KŠK Rozhanovce
price_range: 15 € online pred 9.10.2025, 20 € po tejto dátume a na mieste
description: Rozhanovská Dvanástka is a running race held in the amphitheatre grounds in Rozhanovce. It offers two main categories—a 6 km short course and a 12 km long course—for both men and women. The race is organised by the Municipality of Rozhanovce and the KŠK Rozhanovce civic association, and is suitable for runners of various abilities. The race is scheduled for 17 October 2026, with the children’s races starting at 10:45 and the main races at 11:00.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Rozhanovce amphitheatre grounds
Two categories: a 6 km short course and a 12 km long course
Races for men and women, with children’s races also available
additional: Children’s races start at 10:45. The entry fee can be paid online or on site. Organisers: Municipality of Rozhanovce and KŠK Rozhanovce civic association. Contact: Ing. Matúš Adamčík, tel.: +421 908 909 779. The event also includes a children’s race, starting at 10:45, and the course is probably outdoors in the area around Rozhanovce.

name: Šurianska desiatka
description: Šurianska desiatka is a running event held in the town of Šurany, with the start and finish in front of the Municipal Office. The course runs along the town’s streets and through part of Nitriansky Hrádok on asphalt roads. The event is open to the general public, including pupils, junior runners, recreational runners and Nordic Walking participants. It is organised by Gymnázium Bernolákova 37, Šurany, and has a limited number of participants in categories A to J. Refreshments and drinks are provided for runners. Winners receive diplomas, prizes and cash awards.
course_highlights: The course runs along the streets of Šurany and through part of Nitriansky Hrádok
The course surface is asphalt
The start and finish are in front of the Municipal Office in Šurany
additional: On-site registration is available from 9:00 in front of the Municipal Office in Šurany. The race is limited to 400 participants in categories A to J. Secondary school pupils at schools established by the Nitra Self-Governing Region (NSK) pay no entry fee when registering online; on-site registration costs €2. Every participant receives a finisher’s medal. Winners in men’s category A and women’s category D receive cash prizes of up to €100. The main races start at 13:00. Online registration closes on 15 October 2026 at 23:59 or when the capacity of 400 participants in categories A to J is reached. Entry is free for youth categories when registering online (€2 on site); adults and recreational runners pay €18 online or €24 when registering on site.

name: Psotkov memorial
description: Psotkov Memorial is a traditional mountain running race in the heart of the High Tatras, held near Štrbské Pleso. Runners can choose between two challenging routes: BASIC, 25.3 km long with 1,540 m of elevation gain, and EXTREME, 37.9 km long with 2,490 m of elevation gain. The route passes through picturesque mountain scenery, including a climb to just below the summit of Kriváň, a descent to Tri studničky, a stretch past Jamské pleso and through Furkotská dolina, and a finish at Chata pod Soliskom. The race is part of the Skyrunner® National Series Slovakia and offers a unique running experience in challenging mountain terrain.
course_highlights: Climb to just below the summit of the prominent Kriváň
Long descent to Tri studničky with a refreshment station
Pass by Jamské pleso and through the demanding Furkotská dolina
additional: Registration is limited to 400 participants (200 for BASIC and 200 for EXTREME). Members of the Slovak Mountaineering Association James are entitled to a discounted entry fee. The EXTREME route is run as a time trial. The start and finish are at the SNOW - Štrba cross-country skiing area, Štrbské Pleso. The time limit is 6 hours for BASIC and 8 hours for EXTREME. The event is limited to 400 participants.

description: Făget Tour GlobalLogic is a running race organized by Runners Club in Cluj-Napoca, offering participants the opportunity to run in nature during one of the most beautiful times of the year. The event includes two main races: a 7 km cross-country race and a 22 km half marathon, held on scenic routes in the Făget area. This competition is a cherished tradition among the local running community, now in its 15th edition, and promises an enjoyable and challenging experience for runners of all levels.
course_highlights: 7 km cross-country route in nature
22 km half marathon with scenic views
Routes marked and supported by Runners Club Cluj-Napoca
additional: The routes are marked, and a GPX file is available for the half marathon. The event is organized by Runners Club, which also offers free group training sessions in Cluj-Napoca. The race has official partners and supporters. The event also includes other trail races and related activities, offering an opportunity to discover the area's natural beauty and take part in a community sporting event.

name: Jesenji planinarski maraton na Fruškoj gori
description: The Autumn Hiking Marathon on Fruška Gora is a traditional sports and recreation event that brings runners together on challenging trails through the beautiful nature of Fruška Gora. The races cover a range of distances, from ultra-extreme to introductory trails, suited to different fitness levels. The event takes place in Popovica, near Sremska Kamenica, offering a unique blend of challenge and enjoyment of nature. The organizers also provide transport to the start and extensive support during the race.
course_highlights: Ultra-Extreme Marathon with 5 ITRA points
Middle Eastern Marathon with 3 ITRA points
Introductory trails with 1–2 ITRA points
additional: Transport from Novi Sad to the marathon start is organized for Saturday from 6:00. Registration is available for individuals and groups, as well as in “Sport” and “Fun” categories. Race packs are collected before the race. Races are scored under the ITRA system, with different difficulty categories. Terrain: forest and hilly paths. Registration is on the organizer’s website. The focus is on enjoying and promoting nature.

name: Jesenji planinarski maraton na Fruškoj gori 2026
description: The Autumn Hiking Marathon on Fruška Gora is a traditional competitive and recreational sporting event that brings together lovers of mountain running and nature. The races take place on challenging trails through the beautiful landscapes of Fruška Gora, with varying distances and levels of difficulty to suit different levels of participants. The event is known for its good organization, rich program, and support from numerous sponsors and friends of the marathon. Participants can expect challenging trails with significant climbs and descents, as well as unforgettable views of nature.
course_highlights: Trails pass through the forests and mountain peaks of Fruška Gora
Ultra Extreme Marathon with 5 ITRA points and Ultra Marathon with 4 ITRA points
Novice trails and a Trail of Joy and Enjoyment for less experienced runners
additional: Transportation from Novi Sad to the marathon start is organized for Saturday from 6:00. On-site registration for the FUN trails is available at Popovica on Saturday. Race packets are picked up immediately before the race. The trails are scored using the ITRA system, with different difficulty categories ranging from novice to Ultra Extreme Marathon. Participants can download GPX files of the routes, and the event is open to all healthy and physically capable people. The marathon takes place in autumn in the natural surroundings of Fruška Gora, with a special emphasis on enjoying nature and physical activity.

name: II. Dél-Balatoni Csillagó Trail
location: Gutman Borpince, Kötcse, Somogy County, Hungary
description: The 2nd South Balaton Csillagó Trail is a scenic running race taking place on October 18, 2026, in Kötcse, near the Gutman Wine Cellar. The race follows panoramic routes through the hills of Somogy, around Csillagó Hill, with a range of distances, including a half marathon and a pairs relay. Participants can run among beautiful autumn vineyards, forests, and historic sites, with a unique finisher’s medal and gifts awaiting them at the finish. The Csillagó Trail festival wine glass adds to the event’s atmosphere, giving runners a chance to sample local wines as well as enjoy the race.
course_highlights: Panoramic summit of Csillagó Hill, at 313.5 metres
Varied terrain among autumn vineyards and Somogy forests
The half-marathon route passes romantic Fehérkő Castle and the Scythian Golgotha in Nezde
additional: The race venue is the Gutman Wine Cellar, which stands on the site of an old brewery and offers beautiful views of Lake Balaton. Race packs include gifts, and participants also receive a Csillagó Trail festival wine glass. Several distances and age-group races are available, including mini and junior races for preschoolers and children aged 7–10, as well as a virtual participation option. Trail running and hiking, wines, cooking in a cauldron, a family-friendly atmosphere, and autumn views of Lake Balaton.

name: Veresegyház Futónap
description: The Veresegyház Running Day is a friendly, family-oriented running event held around Búcsú Square in Veresegyház. Participants can choose from several distances, from the mini run to the half marathon, and can enter individually or as part of a team. The event is also a points-collection station for the Ötpróba program, allowing participants to earn points and rewards. Team running is a separate category in which teams of three compete, but each team member must complete the distance individually. This friendly, community-focused event promotes the joy of running and an active lifestyle.
course_highlights: Distances: mini run (300 m), 3 km, 7 km, 14 km, 21 km
Team running with teams of three; not a relay
Race location: Búcsú Square, Veresegyház, a landscaped urban park
additional: Team entry is free, but only runners with a valid individual race entry may participate. Teams must register by email, providing the names of all three runners, the distance, and the team name. The event is a points-collection station for the Ötpróba program. Entries using a voucher are also possible; the voucher provides a discount of HUF 5,000 on all distances except the mini run. Participants can also look forward to support services, medical supervision, a health-screening bus, refreshment massages, a prize draw, and the opportunity to collect Ötpróba program points.

description: The Bratislava 2-Mile Run is a recurring race over a 2-mile (3.218 km) course, with categories for children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. The race takes place at Kuchajda in Bratislava and is organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team. The start is traditionally at 10:00, and the event also includes children’s races of approximately 200 metres. The Bratislava 2-Mile Run is part of a series of races held throughout the year, offering runners of different ages and ability levels an opportunity to take part.
course_highlights: 2-mile (3.218 km) course
Children run approximately 200 metres
The race takes place in the pleasant surroundings of Kuchajda in Bratislava
additional: Categories: children (13 and under), juniors, women, men, female veterans, male veterans. Organizer: Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team. Phone contacts: +421 2 444 542 61, +421 905 648 315. The race is held on a road surface at Kuchajda. Registration is available on site, and the start is scheduled for 10:00. Categories include children, juniors, women, men, and veterans.

name: Challenge Airport Run
location: Vojenská letecká základňa v Prešove, Prešov, Slovakia
organizer: Prešov Running, v spolupráci s Vojenskou leteckou základňou v Prešove
price_range: 22 € až 25 € v závislosti od termínu registrácie, 12 € pre detský beh
description: Challenge Airport Run is a unique running experience at the Prešov Military Air Base, combining sport with the atmosphere of military training. Runners can choose between 5 km and 10 km courses, with each participant carrying a symbolic weighted backpack to highlight courage and endurance. The event offers an unforgettable atmosphere among helicopters and military equipment, areas rarely accessible to the public. Alongside the athletic challenge, it is also a tribute to discipline and strength, with a varied programme and original race packs.
course_highlights: The course runs through the grounds of the Prešov Military Air Base
Runners carry a weighted backpack symbolising tradition and endurance
An army-style atmosphere among helicopters and military equipment
additional: Race bib with chip, dog-tag-shaped medal, military-design T-shirts, side programme with a raffle, children’s races available, refreshments provided, army-style race packs. The event includes asphalt and concrete-slab roads, categories with military equipment, a start window from 9:00 to 9:15, and the option to participate with military equipment or as a civilian runner.

name: Šamorínska bežecká liga 2026 – 6. kolo
organizer: 3klub Šamorín o.z. v spolupráci s mestom Šamorín
price_range: Detské behy zdarma; dospelí 6 € online alebo 8 € na mieste
description: The Šamorín Running League is a traditional running competition organized by 3klub Šamorín, held in the pleasant surroundings of Pomlé Forest Park in Šamorín. The league offers several rounds with different distances, suitable for the general public and running enthusiasts. Participants can expect high-quality organization and a pleasant atmosphere in the amphitheater and surrounding area. The league is part of the region’s active sporting life and promotes a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: The races take place in Pomlé Forest Park, offering a pleasant natural setting
The start and finish are in the amphitheater, creating a great atmosphere for spectators
The league’s various rounds offer different distances, such as 1500 m, 3 miles, 5 km, and 10 km
additional: The league consists of several rounds throughout the year, held at different locations around Šamorín. 3klub Šamorín also organizes running and cycling training sessions for the public. Check-in takes place from 9:00 to 10:00. The course is paved; toilets and a changing room are available. The adult entry fee includes a race number, timing, refreshments, and entry into a raffle.

description: Slaňaki CUP - Dubník Uphill Run is a traditional uphill race held in Zámutov, in the Vranov nad Topľou district. The course is 11.2 km long with 600 metres of elevation gain, and the finish is by Slovakia’s tallest structure, the Dubník transmitter, at an elevation of 318 metres. The race is part of the Slovak Uphill Running Cup and is open to a wide range of male and female runners of different ages. It is organized by Klub otužilcov Vranovské Vydry, Obecný úrad Zámutov and Penzión Kondor Zámutov. The race challenges runners to test their endurance and strength on demanding mountain terrain.
course_highlights: 11.2 km course with 600 m of elevation gain
Finish by Slovakia’s tallest structure, the Dubník transmitter (318 m)
Demanding mountain terrain suited to uphill running
additional: Runners are divided into categories by age and gender, including juniors and men’s and women’s age groups. The start is in front of the Zámutov Municipal Office. The organizers are Klub otužilcov Vranovské Vydry, Obecný úrad Zámutov and Penzión Kondor Zámutov. The race takes place in October 2026; online registration is available. Refreshments and a memorial run are also included.

name: Povlen Trail
description: Povlen Trail is part of the West Serbia Trails series, which connects the mountains, rivers, and valleys of western Serbia through unique trail races. This race gives runners the opportunity to explore unspoiled nature and enjoy the challenges of mountain trails. West Serbia Trails promotes the combination of sport, nature, and community, creating an unforgettable experience for all participants.
course_highlights: Mountain trails through the unspoiled nature of western Serbia
Varied terrain connecting mountains, rivers, and valleys
An authentic experience of nature and local culture
additional: West Serbia Trails is a series of trail races and hiking events that also includes races such as Divča Winter Trail, Jablanik Trail, Vidra Gradac Trail, and others. The races are known for their strong community, international ITRA points, and UTMB Index, motivating runners on an international level. The event is part of the Trail Liga Timova, a team competition scored based on kilometers completed, with the option to register early at a lower price.

description: Kamenica Trail 2026 is the first event in the Jug Trail Series. It takes place on October 18, 2026, at the Dabilo picnic area near Niš. The race offers two routes: a long course of 20.7 km with 810 meters of elevation gain and a short course of 5.6 km with 240 meters of elevation gain. Both start and finish at the same location. The routes pass along forest trails, gravel roads, and a section of paved road, offering a challenge and scenic views. The organizer is the Running club Niš Running and Mountaineering Association. Participants can expect good organization, refreshments, and prizes.
course_highlights: Forest trails and gravel roads, with around 450 meters on paved road
Long course: 20.7 km with 810 m of elevation gain
Short course: 5.6 km with 240 m of elevation gain
additional: Race packets will be distributed in Niš on Saturday, October 17. Mandatory equipment includes a charged phone with the organizer’s number, at least half a liter of water, and your own cup or bottle (there will be no plastic cups at refreshment stations). A wind- and rain-resistant jacket is recommended. Timing is manual, with no chip. At the finish, there will be portable toilets, a shower cabin (hot water is not guaranteed), a sound system, and first aid. Refreshments will include water, isotonic drinks, fruit, and salty snacks. All finishers receive medals; prizes are awarded for overall and age-group placings. Parking is limited, so carpooling and arriving early are recommended. The race is the first event in the Jug Trail Series. The start and finish are at the Dabilo picnic area.

name: SZÁDVÁR TRAIL
description: The Compressport Szádvár Trail is an exciting trail-running race that winds through the wild, rugged mountains and valleys of the Aggtelek Karst. Participants can discover deer hidden in the forest, a monastery ruin nestled among the trees, the grueling climb up Szádvár, panoramic views from Esztramos Hill, and the atmospheric wine-cellar row near Bódvaszilas. This challenging race welcomes adventure-seekers to Szögliget in October.
course_highlights: The wild, rugged mountains and valleys of the Aggtelek Karst
A monastery ruin nestled among the trees
Panoramic views from Esztramos Hill
additional: The race takes place in October 2026, on varied terrain featuring mountains, valleys, and forests. Participants can register online and enjoy the scenic landscape and challenging course.

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: The Törökbálint Handicap running race takes place in Dióskert, where participants can complete the half-marathon distance in four laps. Those who would prefer to run fewer laps may do so. The race has a voluntary entry fee of 500 HUF per lap, and registration takes place at the venue. After the race, runners are welcomed with apples, hot tea and mulled wine. Every participant receives a finisher’s medal, and the top three male and female finishers also receive a special medal. The awards ceremony takes place at 12:00.
course_highlights: The race route is four laps covering the half-marathon distance
Participants may complete fewer laps
Location: Törökbálint, Dióskert
additional: Registration takes place at the venue. The suggested voluntary entry fee is 500 HUF per lap. Participants are welcomed with apples, hot tea and mulled wine. The awards ceremony is at 12:00. The top three male and female finishers receive a special medal. Hilly terrain; four laps for a half marathon; options to run fewer laps; refreshments provided; medals for all; awards for top finishers.

name: Beh hrebeňom Čergova
description: The Run along the Čergov Ridge is the longest mountain race in the Čergov Mountains, intended for nature-running enthusiasts and trained runners. The course starts in the village of Kamenica and passes over the range’s highest peaks, including Minčol, Dvoriská, Solisko, Veľká Javorina, Čergov, Lysá and Sedlo Besná. It is 32 km long, with 1,413 metres of elevation gain. Runners can enjoy stunning panoramic views and challenging terrain on hiking trails. The race takes place on 24 October 2026, starting at 9:00 at Farma Kamenica and finishing at Sedlo Besná, near Hotel Šport Lysá.
course_highlights: 32 km mountain race with 1,413 m of elevation gain
Crosses the highest peaks of the Čergov Mountains: Minčol, Dvoriská, Solisko, Veľká Javorina, Čergov, Lysá and Sedlo Besná
The route follows hiking trails marked blue and green
additional: A large bus will be provided for all participants, taking them in the morning from the village of Drienica to Kamenica (departing at 7:15 from the car park by Hotel JAVORNÁ). The organisers will also transport participants’ personal belongings from the start to the finish. Race-day registration is open from 7:00 to 8:30 at Farma Kamenica. The awards ceremony and lunch will be held at Hotel Šport Lysá. The race takes place on 24 October 2026 and is open to men and women in various age categories, offering the chance to take part in a mountain trail race amid the beautiful scenery of the Čergov Mountains.

name: Rajecká 12-minútovka
location: Ihrisko pri ZŠ na Lipovej ulici, Rajec, Slovakia
description: The Rajecká 12-Minute Run is a dynamic running race organized by the Rajec Marathon Club, held on the sports field by the primary school on Lipová Street in Rajec. This short, intense run is ideal for runners of all levels who want to test their speed and endurance within a limited time. The event is part of the region’s running tradition and offers a pleasant atmosphere with support from the local community. The organizers ensure the course is well prepared and provide a welcoming environment for all participants.
course_highlights: Run on the sports field by the primary school on Lipová Street in Rajec
Intense 12-minute time limit
Pleasant atmosphere with support from the local community
additional: Registration is online, with the option to pay later for an additional fee. The event is suitable for all age groups and running levels. Refreshments are provided after the run, and results are announced at the venue. The race takes place on the sports field by the primary school on Lipová Street in Rajec, offering a chance to improve personal records in a friendly atmosphere.

description: The Run Through the Vineyards of Bojničky and Hlohovec is a running event organized by the Bojničky Athletics Club and the municipality of Bojničky. The race takes place at the cultural center by the church in Bojničky and offers categories for men, women, and Nordic walking on a 6 km course. Registration fees can be paid online or on-site, with a discount for students. The race is suitable for the general public and runners of various age groups.
course_highlights: The course runs through the vineyards of Bojničky and Hlohovec
Categories for men, women, and Nordic walking
Start at the cultural center by the church in Bojničky
additional: Categories: Men (M, M 40, M 50, M 60), Women (Ž, Ž 40, Ž 50), Nordic walking for men and women on the 6 km course. The registration fee can be paid online or on-site on race day. The event also includes Nordic walking; registration is available online, and the venue is the cultural center by the church in Bojničky.

description: Ružínska Desiatka is a running race organized by Športový klub Jaklovce in cooperation with the municipality of Jaklovce, held by the Ružín Reservoir. The course is mostly asphalt with a small proportion of gravel, making for a fast and enjoyable run. Men and women compete in various age categories over 10 km and 5 km, and children’s races are also held. The main categories start at 11:00, and the children’s categories begin at 10:00. The race is suitable for the general public and running enthusiasts of all levels.
course_highlights: 90% asphalt, 10% gravel (macadam)
The route runs around the Ružín Reservoir in Jaklovce
Categories for men, women, and children across various age groups
additional: The children’s categories start at 10:00, and the main categories at 11:00. Categories include various age groups for men and women, as well as overall rankings and special awards for the oldest, youngest, and best runners from Jaklovce. The course is mostly asphalt with a small proportion of gravel. The event includes 5 km and 10 km categories, children’s races, a raffle, and an inflatable bouncy castle.

description: The Craiova Half Marathon is a community-focused fundraising running event organized by the Romanian Association of Young People with Initiative (A.R.T.I.) in collaboration with SightRunning.ro. The event offers timed races for competitive runners over distances of 21 km, 14 km, and 7 km, as well as untimed races and activities for all ages and categories, including wheelchair users and pets. The urban course starts and finishes at the Ion Oblemenco Stadium Esplanade and consists of 7 km loops, with an elevation gain of 58 m. Participation supports charitable projects in education, health, and social inclusion, making the event an opportunity for solidarity and community involvement.
course_highlights: Urban course starting and finishing at the Ion Oblemenco Stadium Esplanade
7 km loops: 3 for the half marathon, 2 for the 14 km race, and 1 for the 7 km race
58 metres of elevation gain, with hydration and medical assistance points along the course
additional: Race kits can be collected at Electroputere Mall from October 10–16 and on event day at the Ion Oblemenco Stadium Esplanade between 08:30 and 09:30. The event includes special races for wheelchair users and adaptive sports, as well as untimed races and related activities. Safety measures include security personnel, volunteers, an ambulance with a doctor, and first-aid points. The event has a charitable component, supporting social and educational causes. The start is scheduled for 10:00, and registration is announced as open until October 10, 2026.

name: Viking Challenge Trail
location: Fruška Gora - Planinarski dom Jedinstvo, Fruška Gora, Serbia
description: Viking Challenge is a race held on Fruška Gora, with courses of varying distances suited to all ages and running abilities. Participants can choose courses from 1 km to 22 km, enjoying well-marked terrain and support from volunteers. The race offers electronic timing, medals, promotional T-shirts, as well as refreshments and a meal after the race. The atmosphere is friendly and motivating, with an emphasis on community and sporting spirit.
course_highlights: Courses of 1 km, 5.5 km, 11 km, and 22 km on Fruška Gora
Well-marked courses with support from volunteers and spectators
Electronic timing and GPX files available for navigation
additional: Starts are assigned in groups according to registration dates, with no option to change groups. Participants receive a medal, promotional T-shirt, race photos, water, juice, and energy drinks, as well as a meal after the race. Medical assistance is available in case of injury. Trail race, electronic timing, GPX route files available, post-race gathering

name: Ovčar 2026
description: Kablar Skyrace is a mountain race held in the spectacular Ovčar-Kablar Gorge, starting and finishing in Ovčar Banja. The 22.4 km race, with 1,600 metres of cumulative elevation gain, runs through forested terrain, technically challenging rocky sections and over two Kablar peaks, offering runners a challenge and beautiful panoramic views of the West Morava River and the surrounding mountains. The race is part of the Mountaineering Association of Serbia’s national series and is intended for both experienced runners and recreational runners who want to enjoy nature and test their abilities. It is organised by the “Kablar” Mountaineering Club of Čačak, which is celebrating its 75th anniversary this year and guarantees good organisation and safety during the race.
course_highlights: 22.4 km long with 1,600 m of cumulative elevation gain
Technically challenging rocky sections and two Kablar peaks (889 and 885 m)
Views of the West Morava River, Ovčar, Jelica and Debela Gora
additional: The race is certified and awards 1 ITRA point. The time limit is 4 hours for competitors in the Mountaineering Association of Serbia national series and 5 hours for others. The start and finish are at the Nature Centre in Ovčar Banja. The organiser provides clear course marking and safety on the route. The course is certified and counts toward the Mountaineering Association of Serbia series; appropriate equipment is mandatory, and prizes are provided for the top finishers. The race is part of the national mountain-running series and marks the 75th anniversary of the “Kablar” Mountaineering Club.

description: Garmin WTF BUDA is a special trail-running race in the Buda Hills, offering both road and trail distances. Runners can choose from trail distances of 7, 12, 21 and 32 km, or road distances of 10 and 18 km. The race is part of a unique hybrid event series where trail and road runners start together and celebrate their achievements together at the finish. The time limit is 5 hours for every distance, with intermediate cut-off times on the longer distances to help ensure a safe finish. The entry fee includes refreshments, timing, bag storage and unique medals.
course_highlights: 21 km trail half marathon with 726 m of elevation gain
32 km Trail XL with 1,037 m of elevation gain and a 5-hour time limit
Mixed trail and road routes around Szépjuhászné railway station in Budapest
additional: Refreshment stations, free event photos, bag storage, changing rooms and emergency medical services are provided for all distances. Runners who register during the first three days receive a running hydration vest as a gift. At the finish, entrants entitled to a medal can choose from the current selection of medals. Award ceremonies at 12:30 and 14:00, as well as a raffle, await participants. The races include various distances and categories; participation includes a medal, refreshment stations, photos and a race pack. Registration opens on August 29, 2025, and both early-bird and late prices are available.

description: Račiansky kros – autumn is a traditional running race held in Bratislava, in the Knižková dolina area of Bratislava-Rača. The race gives runners the opportunity to enjoy the autumn atmosphere in the pleasant surroundings of the amphitheatre and nearby area. The organisers, OZ PERUN, ensure thorough preparation and refreshments for participants. The event is suitable for the general public and running enthusiasts of all ages.
course_highlights: Race in the natural surroundings of Knižková dolina
Start and finish at the Bratislava-Rača amphitheatre
Autumn atmosphere and quality refreshments
additional: The registration form and consent of the data subject are available on the website. The organiser is OZ PERUN. IBAN for payments: SK09 8330 0000 0025 0082 7935. The course is 80% forest paths and 20% asphalt. The races are open to men, women and children. Registration is available online and on-site, with a limited number of starting places. The event also includes children’s races and post-race refreshments.

name: T1 Ring kros
location: Areál T1 ring, Vechec, Vranov nad Topľou, Slovakia
description: T1 Ring Cross is a running race held at the T1 Ring venue in Vechec, Vranov nad Topľou District. The race offers two main courses: 9 km with approximately 210 metres of elevation gain and a 4 km course. There is also a non-competitive Nordic Walking event. Men and women can compete in various age categories, and children have a separate start. The race is part of the Michalovce–Sobrance Running League 2025. The main race starts at 13:00 and the children’s race at 11:00.
course_highlights: 9 km course with approximately 210 metres of elevation gain
4 km hobby course and non-competitive Nordic Walking event
Race at the T1 Ring venue in Vechec
additional: Children start at 11:00. Men’s and women’s categories are divided by age. Part of the Michalovce–Sobrance Running League 2025. The race takes place at the T1 Ring venue, with registration available online and on site. Entry fees range from €8 to €20. Race starts are at 11:00 and 13:00.

name: Košickopolianska desiatka
description: The Košickopolianska Ten is a running event organized by the municipality of Košická Polianka and held in front of the cultural center in Košická Polianka. The main race starts at 1:00 p.m., while the children’s categories begin at 11:00 a.m. The race is divided into several age categories for men, women, and children, welcoming runners of all ages. The organizers welcome everyone who wants to enjoy a day of sport in the pleasant surroundings of the municipality.
course_highlights: Start and finish in front of the cultural center in Košická Polianka
Several age categories for men, women, and children
The pleasant surroundings of the municipality of Košická Polianka
additional: The children’s races start at 11:00 a.m. Categories are divided by age, from age 0 through seniors. The event is organized by the municipality of Košická Polianka; contact phone numbers and email addresses are available for those seeking information. The race is part of a series of editions and offers the opportunity to take part in a 10 km race, with various categories for all age groups, including children’s races.

name: Timișoara City Marathon
description: UVT Liberty Marathon is a running event held in Timișoara, offering races over a range of distances from 1 km to the full marathon of 42 km. The event promotes freedom and community spirit, inviting runners of all levels to take part and push their limits. With a strong tradition and dedicated training programs, the marathon is a motivating and energizing experience for all participants.
course_highlights: A range of distances: 1 km, 4 km, 10.5 km, 21 km, and 42 km
Event held in Timișoara, with urban courses
A strong community and personalized training programs
additional: Training programs are available for all the main distances (5 km, 10.5 km, 21 km, and 42 km), created by an experienced university coach. The event includes free children’s races over short distances. Relay races are also available for the marathon and half marathon. Participants can benefit from marathon training programs, including plans for beginners and intermediate runners, as well as advice on equipment and physical preparation.

name: RUN IASI
description: Run Iași is a running event that brings together students, teachers, and residents of the city of Iași to celebrate movement, education, and civic spirit. The race is a declaration of belonging and solidarity, turning every kilometer into a symbol of an active, healthy community. Participants enjoy an energetic, unifying sporting experience in a vibrant urban setting.
course_highlights: An urban route through the city of Iași
A 10 km race for runners of all levels
A community atmosphere and civic spirit
additional: The event includes 5 km and 10 km races, with online registration, and promotes health, education, and solidarity in Iași

name: TIMIȘOARA CITY MARATHON
description: Timișoara City Marathon is a sporting event for both amateurs and experienced runners, held in the heart of Timișoara. The 42.2 km marathon starts in Otelec and finishes in Victory Square, offering a unique experience inspired by the story of Eugeniu of Savoy’s arrival. The half marathon and fun runs offer varied routes through the city’s squares, parks, and historic neighborhoods, showcasing local beauty and heritage. The event also includes related activities such as workshops, a Pasta Party, and the special anniversary race “106 pentru POLI”.
course_highlights: The marathon starts outside the city, in Otelec, and finishes in Victory Square
The half marathon combines the squares and parks of the Fabric district along the banks of the Bega
The fun runs pass through the parks along the Bega Canal and the Fabric district
additional: Race packs are distributed at the UPT Rectorate in Victory Square. Marathon participants depart by coach for Otelec at 06:30 from Victory Square. Energy products (bar + gel) are included only for the 42 km and 21 km races. The technical T-shirt and cotton T-shirt can be purchased during registration. The event includes workshops, a Pasta Party, and the anniversary race “106 pentru POLI” on October 29, 2026, at Stadionul Știința. Participants can choose from several race categories, including workshops and a pasta party.

description: Sninský Cross is a traditional running race held at the Amphitheatre of RO Rybníky in Snina. Competitors can look forward to a well-prepared course with official measurement, which follows a city circuit and passes through woodland. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a great atmosphere, refreshments, and medals for all participants. Winners in the men’s and women’s categories receive medals and prizes. The race is organized by the ZasRun running club, which also provides timing and results services.
course_highlights: 3 × 2 km city circuit in the square in Snina
The course passes through woodland to Zelený dvor and along the old road in the direction of Budimír
Asphalt surface; the course has an official certificate confirming its measured distance
additional: A changing room is available in a tent, toilets are at Hotel Kamei, and bag storage is in the tent by registration. Every competitor must wear their bib visibly on their chest; without it, their time will not be recorded. The winners will be announced immediately after all runners have finished, at the venue. The race is held according to the rules of the Slovak Athletics Federation.

name: Beiuș Running Day
price_range: 10 km: 120 RON, Half Marathon: 150 RON, 2 km și cursa pentru copii: gratuit
description: Beiuș Running Day is an annual running event offering four races for all ages and experience levels, including free races for children and beginners. The routes include a 2 km race, a children’s race, a 10 km race, and a 21.1 km half marathon, on forest trails and paved streets in Beiuș, Bihor. The event emphasizes safety, an eco-friendly environment, and a competitive atmosphere, with podium prizes and surprises for participants. It’s a great opportunity for families and runners of all levels to enjoy sport and nature in an organized, welcoming setting.
course_highlights: Forest trails with natural paths for the 10 km race and half marathon
Children’s race on fully safe paved routes closed to vehicle traffic
Hydration stations and safety measures on all routes
additional: The children’s race is free and open to children aged 4 to 13, with age categories and distances ranging from 250m to 1000m, on fully safe routes closed to vehicle traffic. A parent or guardian must be present with participating children throughout the race. Medals, certificates, and product prizes are awarded to all participants, and the adult routes include hydration stations and are clearly marked. Registration deadline: October 26, 2025; event date: October 31, 2026; varied routes, including urban areas and parks; the event promotes health and physical activity in the community.

name: Hațeg Royal Trail
description: Hațeg Royal Trail is a mountain race held in the picturesque landscape of Hațeg, Hunedoara, offering varied courses for runners of all levels. The event includes a marathon, half marathon, 12 km cross-country race, 6 km race, children’s race, Family Run, and a race for people with special abilities, “I CAN TOO!” The courses pass through forests, hills, and historic sites such as the Royal Hațeg Fortress, offering a technical and spectacular experience. The event is praised for its clear course markings and friendly atmosphere, with attractive prizes and support from the local community.
course_highlights: Courses through forests and hills, with technical climbs and descents
Passage by the Royal Hațeg Fortress, an iconic historic site
Varied scenery including Lunca de Jos, Tronul Străbunilor, and the village of Covragiu
additional: Race kits can be collected between 18:00 and 20:00 on the day before the race. The 6 km cross-country race, 12 km cross-country race, and half marathon start at 10:00, while the Family Run and “I CAN TOO!” races start at 15:00. Registration for the children’s races and Family Run is also available on site, subject to availability. Due to manufacturing tolerances, runners are advised to choose a T-shirt size smaller than their usual size. The event offers cash prizes and gifts, totaling approximately 30,000 RON in 2025, and promotes ecotourism and outdoor activities in the Hațeg Country area.

name: Gledić Ultra trejl 2026
description: Gledić Ultra Trail is a mountain race held in the heart of Serbia, in the Gledić Mountains, offering runners a unique opportunity to experience unspoiled nature across forests, meadows, and mountain ridges. The race features three courses of different lengths and difficulty levels: Lane (12 km), Srna (22 km), and Jelen (ultra, 58 km). All courses are well marked and pass through beautiful natural scenery. This event is more than just a race; it is a gathering of people who share a passion for nature and adventure, with a comprehensive race package and on-course support. The start is scheduled for October 31, 2026, with time limits tailored to the course distances.
course_highlights: Mountain trails through the forests, meadows, and ridges of the Gledić Mountains
Three courses of different lengths: 12 km, 22 km, and 58 km, with significant elevation gain
Beautiful viewpoints and authentic natural landscapes
additional: The race package includes a race-logo T-shirt, medal, chip-timed bib, aid stations, professional photographs, sponsor gifts, and lunch for participants. The courses are marked and secured. The time limit for the longest course is 12 hours, and for the middle-distance course, 6 hours.

name: Băneasa Forest Run
description: Băneasa Forest Run is a 100% trail run in Băneasa Forest, Bucharest. It started in 2018 and has grown to more than 2,400 participants. The event offers four races: a half marathon, an 11 km cross-country race, a 6 km fast run, and a non-competitive 3 km Family Run, suitable for runners of all levels. The race focuses on the joy of running in nature and spending time with family, and is organized by a team passionate about running. Participants can join group training sessions at different paces, led by coaches, to prepare for race day.
course_highlights: A 100% trail route in Băneasa Forest
A range of races: half marathon, 11 km, 6 km, and 3 km Family Run
Training sessions organized in groups at different paces
additional: Training sessions are organized in groups at different paces and led by coordinators. The Family Run is a non-competitive race for families. The event supports social causes through partnerships with Asociația Magic and Asociația Zi de Bine. The event includes several race categories, route details and participant instructions, as well as support for social causes.

name: FUSS EGY NAPOT!
description: “Run for a Day!” is an ultrarunning event held at Benkó Zoltán Park in Kecskemét. The event aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and create a shared community sports experience. Runners can test their abilities over various distances in a friendly and supportive environment. The program includes a carnival atmosphere and the joy of exercising together.
course_highlights: Ultrarunning around Benkó Hill
Varied terrain close to nature
A community spirit and carnival atmosphere
additional: Participants can choose from several distances. The registration deadline is November 5, 2025. Options for changing clothes and equipment at the venue are limited, and access to the lake during the run is not guaranteed.

name: HALLOWEEN RUN
description: Halloween Run 2026 is a special, exciting running event in Budapest, held on the grounds and in the cellar system of the former Kőbánya Brewery. During the race, participants run along a dark, spooky course accompanied by frightening characters and eerie effects. Races are held over various distances, from short tours to longer multi-lap events, so everyone can find a suitable option. At the finish, music and celebrations await the brave participants who have overcome the challenges.
course_highlights: Course on the grounds and in the cellar system of the former Kőbánya Brewery
Dark, spooky visuals and frightening effects
A variety of distances, including a 21 km lap race and running through a tunnel
additional: The event takes place at Rottenbiller Park in Budapest's 10th district. It is easily accessible by public transport, but parking is limited. The program includes several races, from 2.5 km Halloween tours to a 21 km individual and relay race. On-site registration is available up to 45 minutes before the race start, provided online registration has not filled up. The awards ceremony begins at 15:40. Multiple races, a themed dark atmosphere, various distances, venue: Rottenbiller Park, Budapest, online and on-site registration, awards ceremonies.

name: VASKAPU TRAIL
organizer: Esztergomi Triatlon Kulturális és Szabadidősport Egyesület
description: The Vaskapu Trail is a nature-focused trail-running race in Esztergom, offering runners a challenge over three distances: 8 km, 16 km and 22 km. The course follows trails and marked hiking paths, with minimal road sections, allowing participants to enjoy the natural scenery and varied terrain. The event is environmentally conscious, with cup-free aid stations and support for the Green Forest program. The start and finish are at the Vaskapu Restaurant, at the Brilli Gyula shelter, where participants can also use changing rooms and bag storage.
course_highlights: Trail running on paths and marked hiking routes
Three distances: 8 km, 16 km and 22 km, with varied levels of difficulty
Minimal road sections for a nature-focused experience
additional: The race uses chip timing; chips are issued against a 2,000 HUF deposit. The event is cup-free, so participants must bring a hydration vest or their own cup. Race-pack collection takes place at the race center on race day; earlier collection is not available. Entries may be cancelled until 2026.10.15; after that, they can only be transferred to the following year. The race center has separate women’s and men’s changing rooms and a built-in toilet, but no washbasin. All finishers receive a finisher’s medal, and the top three women and men overall receive separate awards. Participants must bring the equipment needed for hydration. Changing rooms and bag storage are available on site, and environmentally friendly solutions are used to support participants.

description: IstritaXscape is a mountain running event organized by the Legendary Sports Sports Club Association, taking place on the hills, trails, and forest roads around Istrița Hill and the Sărata-Monteoru resort. The routes offer a unique experience, crossing natural and historic landscapes with traces of the Dacians, Romans, and prehistoric life. The event is for both amateur and professional runners, promoting outdoor activity and a passion for mountain running. Participants can choose from three different races, each with its own challenges and attractions.
course_highlights: Routes on the hills and trails around Istrița and Sărata-Monteoru
Scenic views of the Monteoru resort and the city of Buzău
Marked routes through forests, along forest roads, and through historic areas with traces of Dacian and Roman history
additional: The race pack includes a race bib, a medal for participants who finish within the specified time, refreshment points and support along the route, isotonic drinks at the start/finish and along the route, race results and an electronic certificate, and filming and audio/video editing. The Half Marathon and Marathon routes are for participants over 18, while Fun Run is also open to children aged 8 to 17, who must be accompanied by a parent registered for the same race. Routes of 3 km, 7.5 km, 12.5 km, and 20 km; a mountain running event in nature; the 2026 event is scheduled for November 7.

name: Feldwar Trail 1 / 5 / 10 / 17 / 23
description: Feldwar Trail is a friendly, family-oriented trail running race among the hills of Dunaföldvár, with stunning views and an impressive race headquarters at Ispánház. Runners can choose from several distances, from children’s races to the 23 km course, with women’s and men’s categories awarded separately. The courses run mostly on dirt roads, with minimal paved sections, allowing participants to enjoy being close to nature. The event is run as a green event, so the organisers ask runners to bring a reusable bottle or their own cup to the refreshment stations.
course_highlights: Trail routes among the hills of Dunaföldvár
Stunning views of the southern Danube Bend from Kálvária and the ridge along the Danube
Mostly dirt roads, with minimal paved sections
additional: On-site registration: Sunday, 2026.11.08, 9:00–10:00 (children: 9:45). An instant-run option is available within one year after November 10, 2025, by prior arrangement; the fee is 3,000 Ft. Chip timing with the Traxpace system and online split results. The race is limited to a maximum of 400 participants, including a maximum of 100 preschool and primary-school children. Disposable cups are not provided at the refreshment stations, so participants are asked to use their own bottle or cup. The time limit is advisory; finishers receive a medal even if they finish after the time limit. Distances: 1, 5, 10, 17 and 23 km; refreshment stations on the various distances; chip timing; instant-run option; children’s races; individual or group registration; awards by category.

name: Beh oslobodenia mesta Strážske
description: The Strážske Liberation Run is a traditional race held to mark the anniversary of the city’s liberation. This sporting celebration attracts runners of different age groups, including youth and adults, who compete over various distances. The event is organized by the City of Strážske in cooperation with the MBO Strážske running club and is known for its long history and strong community spirit. Runners can enjoy the city’s atmosphere while testing their abilities in a friendly yet competitive environment.
course_highlights: Several categories, including youth and adults
Start in front of the Strážske Municipal Office building
A traditional race with a long history and community support
additional: The event has a long-standing tradition, and in 2026 it will be held for the 49th time. Runners are divided into several age groups, including preschoolers, schoolchildren, and adults. After the race, the fastest runners in each category receive awards, and a raffle with valuable prizes is held. The course runs through the city of Strážske, with the finish in front of the Municipal Office building.

name: BUCHAREST 21K
description: Bucharest 21k is a running race that invites you to discover Romania’s capital in a unique way: by running. The course is flat, fast, and ideal for setting personal records, passing through green parks and combining old architecture with the city’s modern energy. The event is suitable for both elite runners and enthusiastic amateurs, offering a vibrant, dynamic atmosphere in the heart of Bucharest. It’s the perfect opportunity to explore a lively European city that remains undiscovered by the masses.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course, ideal for personal records
Green parks along the course
A unique blend of old architecture and modern energy
additional: The event is part of the YOLO Events series, which promotes an active, healthy lifestyle. Participants can support charitable causes through personal fundraising pages. The atmosphere is energizing, and the event is open to both elite runners and amateurs. The course includes hydration stations every 5 km and the energetic atmosphere characteristic of Romania’s capital.

name: Tanúhegyek Trail 7 / 21 / 42
description: The Tanúhegyek Trail is a trail-running race organized by the Terepfutó Műhely Sports Association in one of the most beautiful parts of the Balaton Uplands National Park, in Badacsonytomaj. Participants can choose from 7, 21, and 42 km distances, taking on 1, 3, or 5 witness hills, with wonderful views of Lake Balaton and the surrounding countryside. The start and finish are at Halászkert. The race also supports a charitable cause: participants can donate their timing chip deposit to the Üröm Animal Shelter. A dog race is also held over the shortest distance. Everyone is warmly welcome at the event on November 14, 2026.
course_highlights: Trail running in the Balaton Uplands National Park
Breathtaking views of Lake Balaton and the countryside in its autumn colors
Routes taking in 1, 3, or 5 witness hills
additional: Timing is electronic, using a chip. The chip deposit is 2,000 HUF, which is refundable or can be donated to charity. Unannounced checkpoints may be placed along the course. A dog race is also held over the shortest distance. The race does not close public roads, so traffic rules must be observed. Distances: 7 km, 21 km, 42 km; dog race over 7 km; charitable event supported through donations of timing chip deposits.

description: Zemplínsky extrém – Run in the Museum is an autumn running race held on the grounds of the Zemplín Museum in Michalovce on 14 November 2026. The race offers a unique experience in the museum’s cultural setting and the surrounding countryside. It is part of the Zemplínsky extrém series, which includes several events in the region. Runners can look forward to an interesting course with an autumn atmosphere and a sense of local history.
course_highlights: The course runs through the grounds of the Zemplín Museum in Michalovce
An autumn setting with a cultural touch
Part of the Zemplínsky extrém series, which includes several events
additional: The event takes place on 14 November 2026. It includes several categories, including children’s races, and is held on the grounds of the Zemplín Museum in Michalovce.

name: Beh na Minčol
description: The Minčol Run is a challenging uphill mountain race in the beautiful surroundings of the Višňovská Valley. The route follows a marked hiking trail with steep climbs all the way to the summit of Minčol at an elevation of 1,363 m, where runners can enjoy beautiful views of the Krivánska and Lúčanská parts of the Malá Fatra. The race is for bold runners who want to test their abilities on a demanding course with little room to rest. Refreshments are provided after the finish, followed by an awards ceremony with prizes for the best runners in each category.
course_highlights: Marked hiking trail with blue blazes
Steep climbs from the start to the finish
Finish at the summit of Minčol, with views of the Krivánska and Lúčanská parts of the Malá Fatra
additional: Race check-in is from 8:30 to 9:30. Results will be announced shortly after the last runner finishes, at approximately 12:30. There are refreshments on the course at approximately 2 km and at the finish; after the race, lunch is served (homemade kapustnica and a drink). Runners can use a drop bag, which will be transported to the facilities below the ski slope, where the prizes will be presented. The organizers arrange transport of runners’ belongings to the results ceremony venue. Refreshments are provided after the finish, followed by an awards ceremony with prizes for the best runners in each category.

description: The Hoia GlobalLogic Cross-Country Race is a running event held in Cluj-Napoca, offering participants the opportunity to run along the cool trails of Hoia Forest. The event includes several races over distances of 15 km, 7 km and 3 km, as well as a race for families, making it suitable for all ages and fitness levels. The organizers, Runners Club, promote a friendly atmosphere and support the local running community. Participants can enjoy a natural, scenic and healthy setting, away from paved roads.
course_highlights: Route along the cool trails of Hoia Forest
Various distances: 15 km, 7 km, 3 km and a family race
Event held in nature, away from paved roads
additional: The event includes a registration package with a T-shirt and race number. Races are held for all ages, including one dedicated to families. The route follows natural forest trails, offering a running experience in nature. The race starts in the evening, creating a special night-race atmosphere. The participation fee includes a medal, timing and medical assistance. Registration is exclusively online, with entries open until June 13, 2026.

name: CROSUL 15 NOIEMBRIE
description: The 15 November Run is an annual sporting event held in Brașov, commemorating the Anti-Communist Revolt of 15 November 1987 by workers at the Roman Truck Factory. The main event is a 5-kilometre road race along the historic route of the revolt, open to all running enthusiasts. There are also races for children, with distances adapted to their ages, promoting physical activity and team spirit. The event is organized by Brașov City Hall in partnership with the 15 November 1987 Brașov Association and the Together for Movement Sports Club.
course_highlights: A historic 5 km route along the streets associated with the 1987 Brașov Revolt
An urban road route through Brașov, including historic and cultural landmarks
Children’s races from 250 m to 1.2 km, adapted for different age groups
additional: Registration is free and limited to 1,800 participants (1,500 adults and 300 children). Race kits can be collected the day before at the Sport Guru Brașov store between 15:30 and 20:00. The race starts inside the SC Roman industrial park, right outside the former Section 440 of the Truck Factory, where the revolt began. Running on the streets of Brașov, a 5 km route, races for all ages, commemorative event, organized in November 2025

name: Beh jastrabskými vŕškami – 3. ročnik memoriálu Jána Dobáka
location: Šarišské Jastrabie, Obec Šarišské Jastrabie, Slovakia
organizer: Obec Šarišské Jastrabie, ZŠ s MŠ Šarišské Jastrabie
price_range: € (rôzne kategórie, niektoré zadarmo pre špecifické skupiny)
description: The Run through the Jastrabie Hills is the 3rd edition of the Ján Dobák Memorial, held in the village of Šarišské Jastrabie. The race offers categories for children and adults across various age groups and disciplines, including 10 km and 5 km runs for men and women, as well as Nordic walking. The children’s race starts at 12:30 and the adults’ race at 14:00. The organizers, the Municipality of Šarišské Jastrabie and the Šarišské Jastrabie Primary School and Kindergarten, welcome runners of all ages and abilities.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Jastrabie Hills in the village of Šarišské Jastrabie
Categories for various age groups and disciplines, including Nordic walking
Start at the Šarišské Jastrabie Municipal Office grounds
additional: On-site registration is possible only in exceptional cases, by arrangement with the organizer. Children’s categories, residents of Šarišské Jastrabie, men over 70, and women over 60 can enter for free. A discounted race bundle is available for Z Ľubotína na Hrad Plaveč + Run through the Jastrabie Hills. The event includes 5 km and 10 km courses; registration is available online and on-site, and prices vary by category and registration method. Categories are also offered for children, seniors, and Nordic walking.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 11. kolo
description: Beh 2 míle Bratislava is a regular 2-mile (3.218 km) running race held at the Kuchajda swimming pool complex in Bratislava. It is organised by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team and is part of a race series with points awarded by men’s and women’s categories. Registration takes place on site by the volleyball court from 9:30, with the race starting at 10:00. The categories are children, juniors, women, men and veterans. Runners can also earn points for improving their times during the year.
course_highlights: 2-mile (3.218 km) course
Registration and start by the volleyball court at the Kuchajda swimming pool complex
Categories for children, juniors, women, men and veterans
additional: Registration takes place on site by the volleyball court from 9:30. Competitors vie for the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team Perpetual Trophy, with points calculated using coefficients based on year of birth. In the event of a tie, the best time decides, followed by shoe size. At the end of the year, the two months with the fewest points are removed (amnesty). Registration is available on site; the event is held in several rounds throughout the year, with each race covering approximately 2 miles (3.218 km).

name: Beh na Husárik
location: Horské hoteli Husárik, Čadca, Žilina, Slovakia
description: The Beh na Husárik is a traditional running race organized by the Kysucký Marathon Club Čadca, the City of Čadca, and the Husárik Mountain Hotel. Held in honor of Students’ Day, the race gives runners the chance to test themselves in beautiful mountain surroundings. The start is always at 11:00, and the race is known for its friendly atmosphere and the Mayor of Čadca’s Cup awarded to the winners. The Beh na Husárik is suitable for the general public interested in sport and nature.
course_highlights: Mountain surroundings around the Husárik Mountain Hotel
Race held in honor of Students’ Day
Mayor of Čadca’s Cup for the winners
additional: Online registration is closed. You can also register on race day for the increased entry fee of 8 EUR. The race takes place on 15 November 2026, with a start at 11:00. Online registration is available; the course is hilly and trail-based. The race is held in Čadca near the Husárik Mountain Hotel.

description: Hermanovská desiatka is a running race organized by the Municipality of Hermanovce nad Topľou and the Hermanovce Running Club. The race takes place in front of the Municipal Office in Hermanovce nad Topľou and offers categories for children, youth, and adults. The children’s and youth races start at 12:00, and the adults’ race at 14:00. The race is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the region.
course_highlights: Competition for different age groups, including children, youth, and adults
Organized in the picturesque surroundings of Hermanovce nad Topľou
Registration available via QR code; low entry fee of €10
additional: The children’s and youth races start at 12:00, and the adults’ race at 14:00. Categories are divided by age and gender, including local categories. Registration is required by 10.11.2025 via QR code. The race is open to runners of all levels, with categories for children, youth, and adults. The event takes place on 15 November 2026, with the children’s race starting at 12:00 and the adults’ race at 14:00.

description: Ferčekovská desiatka is a running race held in the village of Ferčekovce near Spišská Nová Ves, offering courses for children, teenagers and adults. The race takes place on forest roads and undulating grassy terrain, creating a pleasant natural setting for runners of all ages. It is organised by Športový klub Ferčekovce in cooperation with the city of Spišská Nová Ves. The race is suitable for the general public, including families and running enthusiasts, who can choose from several categories and distances.
course_highlights: Surface: forest road and grass
Undulating terrain in a natural setting
Multiple categories by age and gender
additional: The children’s and teenagers’ races start at 11:00, the Prebehni sa s nami race starts at 12:15, and the adult 5 km and 10 km races start at 13:00. Categories are divided by age and gender, including special categories for seniors. The entry fee is lower with online registration; the on-site fee is a flat €15. The event includes refreshments, medals for all finishers, online registration, and various categories for all age groups.

name: Beh oslobodenia mesta Michalovce
organizer: Mesto Michalovce, Atletický klub Michalovce, ZŠ Pavla Horova Michalovce
description: The Michalovce Liberation Run is a traditional evening race held in the city center of Michalovce. Runners follow city streets over a course of approximately 5.8 km made up of several laps. After finishing, they receive refreshments and a participant medal. The race is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere, with the option to register in person on race day.
course_highlights: Evening run through the center of Michalovce
5.8 km course made up of 1,450 m laps
Refreshments and a participant medal after the finish
additional: In-person registration takes place in the lobby of the Town Hall from 16:30 to 17:45. Headlamps are recommended for safety. After finishing, runners return their race number and receive a medal. The results ceremony is at 19:30 in the gymnasium of P. Horov Elementary School No. 8. The course has been shortened to 5.8 km and runs on asphalt and stone surfaces. Registration is available online or in person. The entry fee is €20; a reduced fee applies to online registration by 19.11.2025.

name: Lesný beh priateľov Šemše
price_range: 12-18 € v závislosti od dĺžky trate a spôsobu registrácie
description: The Lesný beh priateľov Šemše is a running event in the municipality of Šemša, in the Košice-okolie District, offering three distances: 22 km, 11 km and 5.5 km. The course runs along paved forest roads and trails, country roads and asphalt, creating a pleasant and varied running environment. The race is open to all ages, with no age-group divisions, and is organised by the Šemša v pohybe civic association. The start is split into two waves: the longer distance starts at 10:00, and the shorter distances at 11:00. The event is suitable for runners looking for a forest run with a choice of distances and difficulty levels.
course_highlights: The course follows paved forest roads and trails
Includes country roads and asphalt sections
Three distances: 22 km, 11 km and 5.5 km
additional: The start is split into two waves: the 22 km race starts at 10:00, and the 5.5 km and 11 km races start at 11:00. Categories have no age restrictions and are intended for children, men and women. The event is organised by the Šemša v pohybe civic association. The course surface is varied, including forest roads, country roads and asphalt. The race takes place on terrain featuring forest roads, country roads and asphalt. Registration is available online or on site. Categories are available for children, men and women, with a choice of short and long distances.
