description: The Run to Kysacký Castle is a running event organized by the Kysak Orienteering Club and the municipality of Kysak. It takes place at the Cultural House in Kysak. The course runs mainly on forest roads (85%), with a smaller proportion on asphalt (15%). The race is open to various age groups, from youth to veterans, divided by age and gender. Entry fees vary by category and are paid during registration, with payment by bank transfer available until a specified deadline. The event offers a pleasant atmosphere and the chance to compete in beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: 85% forest roads, 15% asphalt
Start at the Cultural House in Kysak
Several age categories, from youth to veterans
additional: Categories are divided by age and gender: youth, juniors, men and women in various age groups. The start is at the Cultural House in Kysak. The race is held in the surroundings of historic Kysacký Castle. Registration is available through an online form, with payment by bank transfer until 18.11.2024. The event includes categories for various age groups and genders.

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: The Törökbálint Handicap is a friendly running race made up of optional laps in the Dióskert area of Törökbálint. The half-marathon distance is covered by completing four laps. Participants may run as many laps as they wish. The suggested entry fee is 500 Ft per lap to help cover the race costs. All participants are welcomed with apples, hot tea and mulled wine, and receive a commemorative medal; the top three men and women also receive a special medal. The awards ceremony takes place at 12:00. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, and registration takes place on site.
course_highlights: The course is in the Dióskert area of Törökbálint
The half-marathon distance is covered in 4 laps
Participants may run as many laps as they wish
additional: Registration is on site, with a suggested voluntary entry fee of 500 Ft per lap. All participants receive a commemorative medal, and the top three men and women also receive a special medal. The awards ceremony is at 12:00. After the race, participants are offered hot tea, mulled wine and apples. Four laps make up the half-marathon; participants may run fewer laps. On-site registration; refreshments included.

name: Zapad Fruške Gore 2026
description: The Fruška Gora Marathon is a competitive and recreational sporting event held on Fruška Gora, known for its historic trails and new challenges. The event features various courses, including an ultra-extreme marathon, an ultra marathon, and medium and short courses suited to runners of different abilities. It brings together nature and running enthusiasts, offering a unique experience amid the beautiful landscapes of Fruška Gora. The organizers aim to provide good organization and support for participants throughout the event.
course_highlights: Ultra Extreme Marathon with 5 ITRA points
Middle Eastern Marathon with 3 ITRA points
Apprentice Southern Marathon with 1 ITRA point
additional: Transport to the marathon start from Novi Sad is organized for Saturday from 6:00. On-site registration for the FUN courses is available at Popovica on Saturday. Race packets are collected before the race. The races are scored under the ITRA system across different courses. Participants can expect various race categories, including ultra, medium, and beginner courses, with online registration available. The event is part of a wider festival promoting sport and nature on Fruška Gora.

description: Cluj EcoTrail Ultramarathon is a mountain running event celebrating Romania on National Day, held in Cluj-Napoca. In its 9th edition in 2026, the event offers a variety of routes, including a 50 km ultramarathon, team races, a half marathon, a cross-country race, and children’s races. Participants can support one of Romania’s 9 historical regions while enjoying scenic landscapes and a friendly atmosphere. The main 50 km route passes through natural and urban areas, with well-organized hydration and refreshment stations. The event also includes a live broadcast, modern facilities, and prizes for the winners.
course_highlights: The Ultra 50k route passes through forests, urban areas, and ski slopes around Cluj
Hydration and refreshment stations offer water, isotonic drinks, fruit, and sweets
The final 12 km are predominantly downhill, with just one climb of more than 100 m
additional: The runner’s kit includes a race bib with timing chip, access to the LiveTrail app for GPS tracking and live rankings, a finisher’s medal, and access to hydration and refreshment stations offering sweet and savory products, still and sparkling water, isotonic drinks, supplements, and fruit. A refund policy is available if announced by November 9, 2026. Time limits are 9h for Ultra 50k, 5h for Half 25k, 3h for Cross 15k, and 1h30 for Mini EcoTrail 7k. The event also includes Play&Run children’s races and an awards ceremony at 15:00. Race distances include Ultra 50k, Half 25k, Cross 15k, Mini EcoTrail 7k, and children’s races; events take place from November 28 to December 1, 2026, with exhibitions, kit distribution, and awards ceremonies.

name: MARATON 1 DECEMBRIE
description: The 1 December Marathon is an annual competition held in IOR Park in Bucharest, open to runners of all levels. The event offers an enjoyable sporting experience, with well-organized courses and a friendly atmosphere. Participants can receive race kits and attentive organizational support, helping ensure a safe and motivating race. The marathon also supports charitable causes, bringing the community together for a worthy purpose.
course_highlights: Course held in IOR Park, Bucharest
Race kits handed directly to participants or to a representative with the required documents
Race kit collection available over the three days before the race
additional: Race kits can be collected over the three days before the race at locations in Bucharest: SportGuru Store (69 Unirii Boulevard) and ParkLake Shopping Center. Kits are handed only to the registered and validated participant, upon presentation of an identity document. Another person may collect a kit only with a signed copy of the participant’s identity document. For the teenagers’ race, the kit is handed only to the minor, accompanied by a parent or legal guardian who signs a declaration of physical and medical fitness. Participation includes races for different categories and supports charitable causes; the event has a tradition of promoting an active and healthy lifestyle.

description: Cluj EcoTrail Ultramarathon is a landmark event celebrating Romania on National Day, offering runners a unique trail-running experience in the picturesque landscapes around Cluj. Now in its 9th edition, the main Ultra 50k race is a favorite among trail runners for the challenge and beauty of its course, which includes forests and spectacular climbs and descents. Participants can support one of Romania’s 9 historical regions, and the atmosphere is friendly and festive, with well-stocked aid stations and personalized finisher medals. The event also includes races for all ages and levels, from Mini EcoTrail to team races.
course_highlights: A 50 km course with climbs and descents through the forests around Cluj
Checkpoints and hydration stations offering a variety of refreshments (water, isotonic drinks, fruit, sweets, and savory food)
Views above Cluj-Napoca and iconic areas such as Borhanci, the Poarta de su’ Feleac Museum, and the Feleacu ski slopes
additional: The race kit includes a race bib with a timing chip, access to the LiveTrail app for GPS tracking and live rankings, a personalized finisher medal, and access to aid stations serving sweet and savory foods, isotonic drinks, and fruit. There are children’s races and team races with special rules on the spacing between members. Cut-off times: 9h for Ultra 50k, 5h for Half 25k, 3h for Cross 15k, and 1h30 for Mini EcoTrail 7k. Refund insurance is included if announced by November 9. Participants can support various historical regions of Romania and enjoy varied routes, from trail to cross-country, with registration open and early-bird prices available.

name: ADVENTI JÓTÉKONY FUTÁS
description: The Advent Charity Run is a welcoming, family-friendly running event in Bölcske, where participants can test their abilities over 3 or 6 kilometers. Part of the entry fee goes to charity, making the event not only a sporting activity but also a chance to help others. It is ideal for both beginners and experienced runners looking to enjoy a pleasant winter running event.
course_highlights: Choose between 3 km and 6 km
A family-friendly running event supporting charity
Set in the natural surroundings of Bölcske
additional: HUF 500 from each entry fee goes to charity. Runners can choose whether to take part in the 3 km or 6 km event. Family registration is also available for the 2 km distance, for up to 4 participants. The event supports charitable causes, payment of the entry fee is mandatory, and participation is open to all ages. The run takes place at 1435/6 Csorda út, Bölcske.

name: ADVENTI KOCOGÓ
description: The Advent Jog is a charity running event held at the Benkó Zoltán Leisure Centre in Kecskemét. The aim is to raise donations for the NM Foundation for the Recovery of Muscles, supporting children with Duchenne muscular dystrophy, including Marci Nemes. The event offers participants a sense of community and an active experience while serving a worthy cause. The organizers thank all the runners and volunteers who contributed to its success.
course_highlights: The run takes place at the Benkó Zoltán Leisure Centre
A charity event supporting children with Duchenne muscular dystrophy
A community-focused sporting experience for families and runners
additional: Volunteers also help behind the scenes at the event. The run is organized for charity, supporting the local foundation and children with the condition. It is part of the Advent season; the run supports the recovery of sick children and is traditionally held every year to bring the community together.

name: OVB Charity RUN
description: OVB Charity Run is a charity race organized in Cluj-Napoca, dedicated to runners of all levels who want to support a worthy cause through sport. The event offers an enjoyable running experience in a friendly setting, promoting the local running community and social engagement. This is the first edition of the race, inviting participants to enjoy running and contribute to the common good.
course_highlights: 6 km course in Central Park, Cluj-Napoca
Supports the 'Saint Nectarios' Palliative Care Center for seriously ill children
Race options of 2 km (family, non-competitive) and 6 km (competitive)
additional: Participants can register until December 5, 2025; the event takes place in Central Park, Cluj-Napoca, and supports the pediatric cause through donations and sponsorships.

name: STOP-MIKULÁS FUTÁS
description: The Stop Santa Claus Run is a traditional, family-friendly running race in Tatabánya, held for the 33rd time in 2025. The event features three distances: 200 metres for young children, and 1,900 and 5,900 metres for adults and older runners. More than 200 people took part, each receiving a unique finisher’s medal, and Santa’s gifts await the youngest participants. The race has a welcoming, family atmosphere, with the organisers presenting numerous prizes and special awards. Participants can also celebrate those with December birthdays with cake and pastries.
course_highlights: Three distances: 200 m, 1,900 m and 5,900 m
Unique finisher’s medal for the 1,900 m and 5,900 m distances
Family-friendly atmosphere, with gifts from Santa for the children
additional: Runners over 70 are honoured with certificates, and the sportiest families receive a special award. The event’s main sponsors are Tatabányai SC and Stop Cukrászda, which treats participants to cake and pastries. The oldest participant completed the longest distance at the age of 87. Community support, an awards ceremony, gifts and a cheerful winter running celebration.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 12. kolo
description: Beh 2 míle Bratislava is a regular 2-mile (3.218 km) running race organized by Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team at the Kuchajda swimming pool grounds in Bratislava. The race is open to a wide range of categories, including children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. Registration takes place on site from 9:30, and the race starts at 10:00. The event is part of a series in which runners earn points toward the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team Challenge Cup, with finishing times adjusted using age coefficients based on year of birth.
course_highlights: Course length: 2 miles (3.218 km); children: approx. 200 m
Venue: Kuchajda swimming pool grounds, Bratislava
Check-in beside the volleyball court
additional: Registration takes place on site beside the volleyball court from 9:30. Categories are children (13 and under), juniors, women, men, female veterans, and male veterans. Competitors are awarded points based on the number of participants in their categories; junior men and junior women are scored separately. In the event of a tie, year of birth and the best time that year determine the result. An amnesty is granted for two participations, in which the two months with the lowest point totals are discarded. Races take place in several rounds throughout the year, including the 12th round in December. On-site registration is available; pricing details are not specified, and the course is mostly asphalt in an urban setting.

name: Mikulášsky nočný výbeh na rozhľadňu na Balážke
location: Základná škola Hviezdoslavova, Lipany, Prešov, Slovakia

tiers.label: tier_1

description: The Mikuláš Night Run to the Balážka Lookout Tower is an adrenaline-filled night race for participants over 15 years old. The event takes place on 6 December 2025, starting at 19:00 from Hviezdoslavova Elementary School in Lipany. Runners can look forward to a unique nighttime experience with views from the lookout tower. The entry fee is a minimum of €7, and participants must register by 5 December 2025.
course_highlights: A night run with an adrenaline-filled atmosphere
The route leads to the Balážka Lookout Tower
The event is for participants over 15 years old
additional: This is a unique nighttime event with a minimum entry fee of €7. Participants must be over 15 years old. Registration is open until 5 December 2025. The start is at Hviezdoslavova Elementary School in Lipany. Night run, start at Hviezdoslavova Elementary School, registration by 5 December 2025, discounted entry for groups and costumes, refreshments and showers provided.

name: Gučevo winter trail 2026
location: Planinarski dom PK Gučevo, Mount Gučevo, Serbia
description: Gučevo Winter Trail 2026 is a mountain race held on Mount Gučevo, starting near the PK Gučevo Mountain Lodge. The race is challenging, with 700 metres of total elevation gain and 700 metres of descent over a 13 km course. Participants can enjoy the natural scenery and demanding terrain, which tests endurance and running technique. The start is scheduled for 11:00, and the organizers emphasize the importance of following the rules and staying safe during the race.
course_highlights: 13 km course with 700 m of total elevation gain and 700 m of descent
Mountain terrain on Mount Gučevo
Checkpoints at 6 km and at the finish at 13 km
additional: Registration requires confirmation that participants have read and understood the race regulations and risks, as well as permission to use photos and videos from the race. Registration includes consent to participate at one’s own risk and acceptance of the regulations and rules of conduct.

name: BORVIDÉK FÉLMARATON
distance_verbose: 23 km, Félmaraton, 14 km, 10 km, 5 km, 1 km

name: Everesting+ Ultra Zărand
description: Ultra Zarand Everesting+ is an extreme mountain running race held in Căsoaia, Arad County, Romania, on 11-12 December 2026. The event offers two challenging distances: 172 km with 9,250 m of elevation gain, rated difficult, and 86 km with 4,600 m of elevation gain, rated intermediate. The race is known for its demanding mountain terrain and Everesting challenge, making it suitable for experienced runners seeking a top-level endurance competition. Participants can track their performance on a personalized results dashboard.
course_highlights: Distances of 86 km and 172 km with 4,600 m and 9,250 m of elevation gain, respectively
Mountain terrain rated intermediate and difficult
Everesting event with extreme endurance challenges
additional: The event has a personalized dashboard for tracking participants’ results. No entry-fee details or start times are provided. The race has a UTMB index for both distances, indicating international recognition of its difficulty. The event also includes a 10 km race to promote local tourism and natural and cultural heritage, offering a unique opportunity for ultramarathon and mountain running enthusiasts.

name: Semimaraton „Pe Argeș în Jos”
description: The “Pe Argeș în Jos” Half Marathon is an annual sporting event held in the heart of Pitești, bringing together runners of all levels. The courses start in Ștrand Park, pass through Lunca Argeșului and Ștrand parks, and continue along the Argeș River promenade, offering a distinctive natural and urban setting for running. The event includes races for all ages and fitness levels, from children’s races to the 21 km half marathon, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the local community. The atmosphere is vibrant, with supporters, music, and prizes for participants.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Ștrand Park, near the Summer Theatre
Course through Lunca Argeșului and Ștrand parks
Run along the Argeș River promenade, with picturesque views
additional: Race kit collection is on December 12 at EF Store and on December 14 at the Summer Theatre for participants from outside Pitești. The half marathon, 5 km, and 10 km races start at 10:00 in Ștrand Park. The children’s race starts at 12:30, and the awards ceremony is at 13:00. Participants under 18 must be accompanied by a parent or legal representative when registering and collecting their race kit. The event includes online registration, race kit collection on 12.12.2026, and access to results and photos after the event.

name: Deliblatska Peščara 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Za prijavu je potrebna uplata akontacije u iznosu od 1000 din.

description: Deliblatska Peščara 2026 is a one-day hiking event organized by PSK Pobeda, held in the beautiful surroundings of Deliblatska Peščara near Čardak. Participants can choose between two hiking groups, with routes ranging from 8 to 16 kilometers through rolling landscapes of sand dunes and woodland. The route is easy, with negligible elevation gain, and is suitable for people with light to moderate fitness levels. After the hike, participants can take a break and enjoy an organized lunch with hot soup and refreshments. This event offers a unique opportunity to enjoy nature and spend time together in the spirit of mountaineering.
course_highlights: Routes through rolling landscapes of sand dunes and woodland
Two hiking groups: 15–16 km or 8–10 km
Easy route with negligible elevation gain
additional: Departure is at 7:30 from Nebojšina Street, by the Church of Saint Sava. Recommended gear includes protection from wind, rain, and cold; sturdy hiking boots; layered clothing; a thermos or water bottle (minimum 1 liter); a flashlight; and hiking poles. Advance notice and registration with the guide are required for the organized lunch. Return to Belgrade is planned between 18:30 and 19:00. Participants must bring their hiking membership card, health insurance card, and ID card. The guide assigns bus seats in the order participants register and pay. Hiking through Deliblatska Peščara requires appropriate gear, registration with fee, and participant responsibility.

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: The Törökbálint Handicap is a friendly running event with optional laps, held in the Dióskert area of Törökbálint. Runners can complete the half-marathon distance in four laps, or choose to run fewer laps. The event has a welcoming atmosphere, with apples, hot tea and mulled wine for participants. Every entrant receives a commemorative medal, and the top three men and women receive a special medal. The awards ceremony takes place at 12:00, and registration is on-site, with a suggested voluntary entry fee.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Dióskert area of Törökbálint
The half-marathon consists of 4 laps, but runners can choose to complete fewer
A friendly, community atmosphere with apples, hot tea and mulled wine
additional: Registration is on-site, with a suggested voluntary entry fee of 500 Ft per lap. Every entrant receives a commemorative medal, and the top three men and women receive a special medal. The awards ceremony is at 12:00. Apples, hot tea and mulled wine are provided for participants. Runners can choose to complete fewer laps. On-site registration, refreshments and commemorative medals are provided. The event supports the community and local runners.

name: 7. Winter Trail Race na Fruškoj gori
description: The Fruška Gora Marathon is a traditional sports, competitive, and recreational event held on Fruška Gora. The race features a variety of courses, from ultra-extreme to beginner, with challenging climbs and beautiful natural surroundings. Participants can enjoy the challenges and beauty of the mountain terrain while competing in a unique atmosphere. The event brings together runners of all levels and promotes a healthy lifestyle and a love of nature.
course_highlights: Varied courses with 1 to 5 ITRA points
Mountain terrain with significant climbs and descents
Beautiful landscapes and natural surroundings of Fruška Gora
additional: Races are scored under the ITRA system, with different difficulty categories (1 to 5 ITRA points). The event includes ultra-extreme, ultra, medium, short, and beginner marathons. The beginner Southern Marathon is 22 km long, with 898 m of ascent and descent. Group and fun registration options are also available for the shorter courses. The event takes place in April, and the 7th Winter Trail Race on Fruška Gora is held in December. Participation includes courses of various lengths, and the event is part of a series of races on Fruška Gora, focused on trail and mountain sports. Registration details are not available.

name: MALACVÁGTA
distance_verbose: Maraton, 29.5 km, 12 km, 10 km, 5 km, 5 km, 3.5 km, 3000 meter, 2 km, 1500 meter, 1 km, 0.5 km, 0.3 km
description: Malacvágta is a recreational pre-New Year’s Eve running race taking place on December 30, 2024, at Bókay Garden in Budapest. Several age groups can take part, including junior, adult, senior and veteran categories, and there is also a stroller race. Participation is free, and every runner receives a free T-shirt, making this a friendly, family-oriented event.
course_highlights: 6,000-metre race for junior, adult, senior and veteran categories
3,000-metre stroller race
The race venue is Bókay Garden, Budapest
additional: Every runner receives a free T-shirt. The event has two races: a 6,000 m race for junior, adult, senior and veteran categories at 12:20, and a 3,000 m stroller race at 13:00. The venue is Bókay Garden; race times are 11:35 and 13:40. The event is part of the year-end community programme.

name: Horovská desiatka
description: Horovská desiatka is a traditional New Year’s Eve race, now being held for the 40th time. It starts by the Cultural Centre in Horovce. Runners compete on a 10 km course from Horovce to Tušice and back. The event is suitable for the general public and offers categories for different age groups, including children. The atmosphere is friendly, making it an ideal way to end the year with a sporting achievement.
course_highlights: 10 km course from Horovce to Tušice and back
Start and finish by the Cultural Centre in Horovce
Traditional New Year’s Eve race with a long history
additional: There are categories for adults and children based on age. The course is one 10 km lap. The event takes place on 31 December as a New Year’s Eve race. Date: 31.12.2026; terrain: probably road; registration is available via websites; adults start at 11:00 and children at 9:30; several categories for different age groups.

name: Silvestrovský beh
location: Humenné, Mestský atletický štadión, Humenné, Slovakia
organizer: Atletický klub Humenné, Mesto Humenné, ZŠ Hrnčiarska
price_range: dorast a juniori: 10 €, online 15 €, na mieste 18 €, online 25 €
description: The Silvester Run in Humenné is a traditional running race held at the Municipal Athletics Stadium. This 43rd edition features a main 5.7 km event, with categories for juniors, men, and women across different age groups. The race starts on December 31 at 11:00. Online registration is open until 11:00 on race day, or you can register in person at the venue from 8:30. Runners can download a GPX course map and view a route animation to help them prepare for the race.
course_highlights: A 5.7 km route at the Humenné Municipal Athletics Stadium
Categories for juniors, men, and women across different age groups
Option to download a GPX course map and view a route animation
additional: On-site registration is available from 8:30 on race day. Categories are divided by age and gender. The number of registered participants is limited; currently, 253 people have registered, with 207 payments made. terrain: municipal stadium, registration: online or on-site, categories for different age groups

name: HAPPY NEW TRAIL 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Nevezési díj: 7.000 Ft / 18 EUR Nevezés időszaka: 2025. november 13. 12:00 – december 27. 12:00

description: Happy New Trail 2026 is a recreational trail-running event held on Budapest’s Hármashatár Hill. The race covers 15 km with 550 m of elevation gain, and participants have 3 hours to finish. The start is at 10:00. Registration is online only, with a maximum of 300 participants. The entry fee includes a marked course, a hand-painted metal finisher’s medal, a personalized race number, electronic timing, refreshments at the finish, and medical coverage.
course_highlights: 15 km distance, 550 m elevation gain
Marked course on Hármashatár Hill
Hand-painted metal finisher’s medal in four designs
additional: Race-number pickup is at the venue from 09:00 to 09:45. There is no refreshment station on the course; refreshments are available only at the finish (tea, pogácsa, and sports drink). Mandatory equipment: a switched-on mobile phone, photo ID, a water container or bottle with a capacity of at least half a liter, and your own cup. Timing uses a chip attached to the back of the race number. Women’s hygiene products are available at the race center. The entry fee includes medical coverage. There is no on-site registration; registration is online only, with payment through the Barion system. The advertised event start was at 10:00, with a maximum of 300 participants and a 3-hour time limit. Registration is online only; on-site registration is unavailable. Refreshments were available at the finish. Mandatory equipment included a switched-on mobile phone, photo ID, a water container or bottle with a capacity of at least half a liter, and your own cup. Sources list the 2026 event as taking place on January 1, 2026, which differs from the stated date of January 7, 2027.

name: ÚJÉVI MALACOS FUTÁS
description: The New Year’s Piglet Run is an informal community run and a great opportunity to start the new year actively and in good spirits. The 6 km route follows paved and dirt paths, with uneven terrain in places, through Népliget in Budapest. The event is not a race but a fun community gathering, and wearing a pig costume is recommended to add to the festive atmosphere.
course_highlights: 6 km route on paved and dirt paths
Uneven terrain in places
Népliget, Budapest; the circular parking area at the corner of Vajda Péter Street and Könyves Kálmán Boulevard
additional: Meet between 9:30 and 9:45 before the start. Planned pace: 6:45–7:00 min/km. Dogs and strollers are permitted only if the rules are observed. There is no bag storage, but bags can be left in a car. The M3 metro and tram 1 stops are nearby. Parking at the venue is limited. According to the earlier notice, this is a community run, not a race; there was no bag storage, and parking was limited.

name: GÚTAI VÍZKERESZT MARATON, FÉLMARATON
organizer: Maratón klub Kolárovo – Maraton klub Gúta
description: The Gúta Water Cross Marathon and Half Marathon is a traditional winter running race in Slovakia, in the town of Kolárovo. The race takes place in January, and participants start from the town’s main square, with a cannon shot marking the start. Runners follow a varied route through the streets of the town and surrounding area, where wind and cold weather can also pose a challenge. The event is organized by Maraton Klub Kolárovo - Maraton Klub Gúta, and entry fees must be paid in advance by bank transfer. Participants must be over 18 for the marathon and over 16 for the half marathon.
course_highlights: The start from the town’s main square is marked by a cannon shot
A varied route through Kolárovo and the surrounding area
Winter conditions, with wind and cold presenting a challenge
additional: Registration is by bank transfer only; online registration is not available. Race bibs can be collected on race day between 7:30 and 9:20 at the canteen of Corvin Mátyás Primary School. The total number of participants is limited to 200 for the marathon and half marathon combined. A staggered start from 9:00 is available at the request of slower runners. The 2027 race announcement and the entry lists for the 42 km and 21 km races are available on the organizer’s website.

name: FUTAPEST TEREPFUTÁS
description: FUTAPEST Trail Running is an exciting trail-running series held on varied and challenging routes across different parts of Hungary, including Etyek. The races take place in natural settings on forested and hilly terrain, making them ideal for people who enjoy nature and running. Organized by Futapest Klub, the events offer a friendly atmosphere and professional organization for all participants. Several distances are available, so everyone can find a challenge that suits them.
course_highlights: Natural surroundings with forested and hilly terrain
Varied routes across different parts of Hungary
Challenging trail-running courses

description: The Oxygen Cup is a winter running series in Debrecen’s Great Forest, offering middle- and long-distance runners, as well as amateur runners, the opportunity to compete. The event aims to promote running and a healthy lifestyle, and to provide racing opportunities for different age groups and categories. Traditionally, the series supports runners’ winter training and strengthens the running community in the Great Forest, with its natural, runner-friendly terrain.
course_highlights: Run on the runner- and joint-friendly terrain of Debrecen’s Great Forest
Multi-lap courses from 1.5 km to 10 km for different age groups
Parking available in the car park next to the cemetery
additional: You only need to register once per year for the series, and your registration is valid for all races in that season. If your race bib is lost or damaged, you can purchase a replacement for HUF 2,000. There is also a team competition, with teams of at least 4 and no more than 8 members competing regardless of gender or age. Race results are available on sportstopper.hu the day after each event. The 2026/2027 season is the cup’s 20th-anniversary edition. Registration is required once per season; teams of 4–8 may enter the team competition. Details of the specified January 23 race are not included in the available season announcement.

name: TIHANY TRAIL
location: Tihanyi Bencés Iskola, Csokonai utca 73, Tihany, Hungary
description: Tihany Trail is a winter trail-running and Nordic walking race held on varied, challenging terrain in the beautiful surroundings of the Balaton Uplands. The course is especially distinctive because participants run along the rim of the caldera and on a rocky cliff edge, making for an exciting and scenic race. Participants can choose from 5, 10 and 15 km distances, and aid stations provide hydration and energy. This is a real treat for trail runners, attracting running enthusiasts even in winter.
course_highlights: Varied, challenging terrain in the beautiful surroundings of the Balaton Uplands
Running along the rim of the caldera, on a rocky cliff edge and along narrow trails
Aid stations with water, energy drink, glucose tablets and salted pretzels
additional: Race-pack collection takes place from 8:00 to 9:50, followed by a warm-up with Gabi Piros at 9:50. Refreshments are available at two points on the course and at the event centre. There will be no cups at the aid stations, so participants must bring a flask or cup. On the 15 km course, the first aid station is at the Forest School (approximately 6.9 km) and the second is beside the Apáti Church (approximately 10.3 km). <i:am> mineral+ energy drink and cherry-flavoured hypotonic drink are also available on the course. Trail-running shoes are recommended, with anti-slip aids if needed; road-running shoes are not suitable for the terrain. The race starts at 10:30. The event centre is at Tihanyi Bencés Iskola, Tihany, Csokonai u. 73. The organisers recommend trail-running shoes and, if needed, anti-slip aids. Participants must bring their own cup or flask for the aid stations.

name: ORADEA CITY TRAIL RUN
location: Parcul Ion C. Brătianu, Oradea, Romania
organizer: Asociaţia Clubul Sportiv Xterra Sport Bihor
description: Oradea City Trail is a running competition held in Ion C. Brătianu Park in Oradea, offering three routes: half marathon, cross, and mini. The event is for runners of all ages, with clearly defined age categories, and emphasizes sportsmanship and the outdoor experience. Participants receive personalized race kits and finisher medals, while the top finishers are awarded prizes by category. The race starts in the morning, and the routes are clearly marked, with refreshment points along the way.
course_highlights: 21 km half-marathon route with a time limit of 3.5 hours
10.5 km cross route with a time limit of 2 hours
Start and finish in Ion C. Brătianu Park, Oradea
additional: Race confirmation and race-pack pickup take place on race day between 07:00 and 09:30 in IC Brătianu Park. The technical briefing is at 09:30, before the start. The half-marathon route has three refreshment points, while the cross/mini route has one. Participants must wear their race number visibly on their clothing. Trail-running shoes are recommended. Minors must have parental consent.

name: VASI TEREPFUTÓ SOROZAT
description: The first race of the 2027 Vasi Trail Running Series will take place in Cák, on the beautiful trails of the Kőszeg Mountains. The race offers varied, exciting courses where participants can enjoy being close to nature and the challenge of trail running. Runners can expect a friendly atmosphere, professional timing and live results. Category winners will receive valuable gifts, and the series will conclude with overall awards for the top runners.
course_highlights: Varied terrain in the Kőszeg Mountains
Exciting, clearly marked courses
Electronic timing with the KORIM system
additional: Bib and chip pickup is from 9:30 to 10:50; on-site registration is available. Bibs are made of strong, tear-resistant paper. Runners are asked to bring them to every race and reuse them. Chips are provided free of charge, but a compensation fee of HUF 20,000 is payable if one is lost. Professional photos from the race are available to download free of charge. The awards ceremony is at 13:00, after the S, M and L distances. Parking is at the Cák football pitch car park and must be arranged individually. The race takes place on trails and requires appropriate physical and mental preparation. The stated date of January 24, 2027, is not confirmed by the available race page, which lists the 2026 race. According to a previous race announcement, parking was by the Cák football pitch and electronic timing was used.

name: Ľudova 50
description: Ľudova 50 is a mountain ultramarathon and long-distance hiking event through the beautiful Strážov Mountains. The 51 km route with 2,600 metres of elevation gain starts and finishes in the village of Uhrovec, birthplace of Ľudovít Štúr, after whom the race is named. The race is demanding, and experience with similar long-distance routes is recommended. There are three aid stations along the course, which follows marked hiking trails throughout, offering beautiful views and historical sites.
course_highlights: 51 km route with 2,600 m of elevation gain
Follows marked hiking trails in the Strážov Mountains
Checkpoints at Uhrovec Castle, Chata pod Čiernym vrchom and Kajtárov
additional: The participant limit is 200 runners/hikers. Participant check-in takes place the day before the race and on race morning. There are three aid stations along the route. The organiser recommends having completed at least one event with a 50 km route before the start. The course passes through areas inhabited by brown bears and other wildlife. The organiser monitors the weather and may adjust the route or programme in case of danger. The start and finish are at Ľudovít Štúr Square in Uhrovec. Information about mandatory equipment, rules and registration is available on the official website.

name: SKV Vertical Race
location: Promenada de sub Tâmpa, Brașov, Romania

description: The Oxygen Cup is a winter running series in Debrecen’s Nagyerdő, offering middle- and long-distance runners and amateur athletes the opportunity to compete. The event aims to promote running and a healthy lifestyle, while providing opportunities to race during the winter. The course runs along the trails of Nagyerdő, which have a runner- and joint-friendly surface and provide an ideal setting for participants. The series is traditionally very popular, and participants include both amateurs and registered athletes.
course_highlights: Trails in Nagyerdő with a runner- and joint-friendly surface
Distances: 1.5 km, 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km laps
Parking available in the car park next to the cemetery
additional: There is no per-race entry fee for the series; registration is valid for one year. Teams must have a minimum of 4 and a maximum of 8 members, regardless of gender or age. Competitors’ points are calculated using the formula applied in the team competition, and results are available on sportstopper.hu the day after the race. Registration is valid for the remaining races of that season. Teams of 4–8 may also enter the team competition.

name: Letecká stovka
description: Letecká stovka is a mountain ultramarathon and long-distance hike covering 106 km with +3,590 m of elevation gain in the Považský Inovec and Strážovské vrchy mountain ranges. The start and finish are in Trenčín. The route runs mostly along marked hiking trails and is ITRA-certified. The event is part of the Slovak Ultratrail League and is also a qualifying race for the 2028 Western States Endurance Run. It is organized by o.z. SLOVAK ULTRA TRAIL, an ITRA member since 2015. The race is open to individuals aged 18 and over, with participation also permitted from age 17 when accompanied by a legal guardian.
course_highlights: A 106 km route with +3,590 m of elevation gain in the Považský Inovec and Strážovské vrchy mountain ranges
Start and finish in Trenčín; the route runs mostly along marked hiking trails
ITRA-certified, part of the Slovak Ultratrail League, and a qualifying race for the Western States Endurance Run
additional: Participant check-in takes place on Friday, March 5, from 18:00 to 22:00 and on Saturday, March 6, from 05:00 to 05:40 in the Arena Ostrov building in Trenčín. The time limit to complete the race is 25 hours, with several checkpoints subject to specific time limits. The winners’ announcement and prize-giving will take place at the finish in the Arena Ostrov building, according to the finish times of the first three participants in each category. Both the start and finish are in Trenčín. According to information for the 2027 edition, the main race takes place on March 6–7; the available date information therefore does not match the stated date of March 13.

name: Avala trail race
description: Avala Trail Race is a mountain race held on Avala near Belgrade. Organized by the "Avala" Mountaineering Club, the event brings together runners who enjoy nature and the challenges of mountain terrain. The race is known for its demanding yet beautiful route through wooded areas, offering an opportunity for both a sporting challenge and camaraderie. The fifth edition of the race is scheduled for March 13, 2027.
course_highlights: Mountain trail on Avala
Wooded areas and natural surroundings
Challenging terrain with climbs
additional: The fifteenth edition of the race is organized by the "Avala" Mountaineering Club from Belgrade. Around 70 participants have registered for 2027 so far. Photographer Nemanja Jovanović is covering the event. Participants can expect medals, T-shirts, and professional timing. The race is part of an annual tradition of events on Avala.

name: OXIGÉN KUPA
price_range: 3000 Ft regisztrációs díj; 2000 Ft chipes rajtszám

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Rajtszám kiváltási díj, amely érvényes az évad összes futamára

description: The Oxygen Cup is a traditional winter running series in Debrecen’s Nagyerdő, offering middle- and long-distance runners and amateur athletes the opportunity to compete. The event aims to promote running and a healthy lifestyle, and encourage people to stay active during winter. The course follows the Nagyerdő’s natural, runner- and joint-friendly terrain, with a variety of distances for several age groups and categories. The series includes both individual and team competitions, strengthening the sense of community among participants.
course_highlights: Forest trails in the Nagyerdő with runner- and joint-friendly terrain
Distances: 1.5 km, 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km laps, with categories for several age groups
A running series featuring both individual and team competitions
additional: Participants need to register once per year for the series; there is no separate entry fee for individual races. Teams may have a minimum of 4 and a maximum of 8 members, regardless of gender or age. If a race number is lost or damaged, a replacement can be obtained for a fee of 2,000 HUF. Parking is available in the car park next to the cemetery. Registration is completed once per season; there is no per-race entry fee. A round may be cancelled in the event of dangerous weather or course conditions.

name: ALS charitatívny beh
description: The ALS Charity Run – Ján Svočák Memorial is a mountain trail run in Svit, offering a challenging 21 km course with 950 metres of elevation gain. The course runs mainly through forest (80%) and meadows (20%), with two refreshment stations at kilometres 8 and 16. Alongside the main race, the event also includes children’s races, relays, Nordic walking and a special trail run with a dog. The event is suitable for runners looking for a challenge in a natural setting, with high-quality organisation and a certified course.
course_highlights: 21 km trail with 950 m of elevation gain
80% of the route is through forest and 20% through meadows
Two refreshment stations at kilometres 8 and 16
additional: Individual start times for the trail run with a dog are between 09:30 and 09:40, at 10-second intervals, with each runner’s exact start time printed on their race number. Relays are 3 × 1.7 km with 140 m of elevation gain; the course surface includes forest trail, meadow, asphalt and gravel. Nordic walking takes place on a route that is 90% forest and 10% asphalt. All children’s categories are awarded and results are announced immediately at the finish. ITRA-certified course, 1 qualifying point for ALS 21 km. The event supports people with neuromuscular diseases. Sources differ on the 2027 event date: the listed date is 27 March, while the event website gives 20 March.

name: Kablar Skyrace 2026
description: Kablar Skyrace is a mountain race held on the slopes of Kablar in the spectacular Ovčar-Kablar Gorge. The race is 22.4 km long, with 1,600 metres of cumulative elevation gain, and is worth 1 ITRA point. The course combines fast sections through forests, technically challenging rocky segments, and climbs to two peaks of Kablar, offering beautiful views of the West Morava and surrounding mountains. The race is intended both for beginners in mountain running and experienced runners who want to enjoy the nature of western Serbia. It is organized by the "Kablar" Mountaineering Society of Čačak under the auspices of the Mountaineering Association of Serbia.
course_highlights: 22.4 km with 1,600 m of cumulative elevation gain
Technically challenging rocky sections and two Kablar peaks (889 and 885 m)
Views of the West Morava, Ovčar, Jelica, and Debela Gora
additional: The race has a four-hour time limit for competitors in the PSS National Series. The course is certified and is worth 1 ITRA point. The start and finish are at the Nature Center in Ovčar Banja. The organizer provides good race management, clear course markings, and safety throughout the race. The 2026 edition started and finished at the Nature Center in Ovčar Banja; it is listed as certified for 1 ITRA point. That page lists the date as April 4, 2026, not April 10, 2027.

name: Băneasa Forest Run
description: Băneasa Forest Run is a 100% trail running race held in Băneasa Forest in Bucharest. Since its first edition in 2018, it has grown organically to more than 2,400 participants. The event offers four races: half marathon (21 km), cross-country race (11 km), sprint (6 km) and Family Run (3 km), so every runner can find a suitable challenge. The varied routes include trails, dirt roads and asphalt, offering an enjoyable experience in nature, with well-positioned refreshment points. Băneasa Forest Run is about the joy of running in the forest, whether you run competitively or for fun with your family.
course_highlights: 100% trail routes in Băneasa Forest, with trails, dirt roads and asphalt
A range of distances: half marathon 21 km, cross-country race 11 km, sprint 6 km and Family Run 3 km
Refreshment points at the start, km 3.3, km 5, km 9 and the finish, with water, isotonic drinks and food
additional: The routes may have uneven ground, roots and vegetation; rain may bring puddles and mud. Group training sessions are organized for different paces, with coordinators. Refreshment points along the routes offer water, isotonic drinks and food. The edition scheduled for April 11, 2027 has been officially announced, and registration is due to open.

name: Beh Galantou – Beh oslobodenia
price_range: 15 € online, 12 € s GALAkartou; štafeta 40 € online, 32 € s GALAkartou; Samsung Run 10 €, 8 € s GALAkartou
description: Beh Galantou - Beh oslobodenia is the 40th anniversary edition of a traditional running event in Galanta, offering a range of disciplines for all age groups. The event is intended not only for athletes, but also for everyone who wants to experience an atmosphere full of emotion, the joy of movement and the challenge of surpassing themselves. Every participant receives a commemorative medal, refreshments and drinks; children also receive a ticket to the Galandia Water World and a package from COOP Jednota Galanta. The best runners receive cash prizes and valuable prizes, including televisions in special categories. After the race, a cultural programme is planned at the Municipal Cultural Centre in Galanta.
course_highlights: Courses for beginner and advanced runners
A commemorative medal for every participant, including children
More than 40 valuable prizes in the final raffle
additional: Registration opens at 8:00 on the day of the event and closes 20 minutes before the start of each category. Children receive a ticket to the Galandia Water World and a package from COOP Jednota Galanta. The best runners do not receive cups, but valuable cut glass. Winners in the special categories must hold a GalaKARTA. After the race, a cultural programme is planned at the Municipal Cultural Centre. The event includes various disciplines, prizes, refreshments and a cultural programme. Registration is online, and road closures are expected during the races.

name: Jarný beh Bojničky
price_range: 10 € online, 12 € na mieste, deti a dorast zdarma

price_tiers.distance: všetky kategórie okrem detí a dorastu

description: The Bojničky Village Spring Run is a traditional running race organized by Atletický klub Bojničky and the municipality of Bojničky. The race takes place in Bojničky in front of the Cultural Centre and is part of the Nitra Running League 2026. Children, juniors, adults and Nordic Walking participants can compete, with categories based on age and gender. A new feature is a competition for three-person men’s and women’s teams in the 5000 m Nordic Walking event. Starts are scheduled by category from 9:45 to 12:15.
course_highlights: The race takes place in front of the Cultural Centre in Bojničky
Competition for three-person teams in the 5000 m Nordic Walking event (5.2 km)
Categories for children, juniors, adults and Nordic Walking
additional: Race starts are divided among several categories: 9:45 — Bojničky residents’ run; 10:10 — children’s categories; 11:20 — Nordic Walking; from 12:15 — adults. The races are part of the Nitra Running League 2026. The course is on asphalt. Online registration is available until 9 April 2026. Maps and details about the categories are available on the official website.

name: Timravine Ostrôžky Trail
description: Timrava’s Ostrôžky Trail is a mountain running race in Divín, offering two challenging courses with beautiful views and significant elevation gain. The race is organized by OZ Ostrôžky and is suitable for runners looking for a challenge in nature. The Ostrôšky Ultra course is 47 km long with 2,000 m of elevation gain, while the shorter Langoš Trail is 27 km long with 950 m of elevation gain. The race starts in two waves: the longer course starts at 7:30 and the shorter one at 9:00.
course_highlights: Ostrôšky Ultra: 47 km with 2,000 m of elevation gain
Langoš Trail: 27 km with 950 m of elevation gain
Mountain trails with beautiful views around Divín
additional: The race starts in two waves: the 47 km course starts at 7:30, and the 27 km course at 9:00. The organizers are Lukáš Krnáč and OZ Ostrôžky. Entry fees depend on the registration period, with the highest price charged on site. Trail races with various categories, online registration, and start times at 07:30 and 09:00. The 2026 event will be held for the second time, following its first edition in 2025.

name: Beh oslobodenia Kálnice
description: The Kálnica Liberation Run is a traditional running race organized by the municipality of Kálnica in honor of the Romanian soldiers who fell during the liberation of the village. The race follows a route from Kálnica to Rakoľuby and back, with different distances for different age categories. The course is paved, flat, with a slight elevation gain and some turns. The event is suitable for the general public, including children, who may run accompanied by an adult. The race starts by the Cultural Center in Kálnica.
course_highlights: Route: Kálnica – Rakoľuby – Kálnica
Race distances: 1,500 m, 5,500 m, and 11,000 m
Paved course with a slight elevation gain of 36 m
additional: Online registration closes on 10.4.2025 at 23:55 or when the participant limit is reached. After this deadline, on-site registration is possible on race day if the limit has not been reached. Entry fees are non-refundable, but can be transferred to another person through an account on vysledkovyservis.sk or, for a handling fee of €4, without an account. The course is paved and flat, with a slight elevation gain; online registration is available until 10.4.2025; the entry fee includes refreshments and a raffle; the race takes place on 11 April 2026.

name: Zvolenská Corrida
location: Námestie SNP, Zvolen, Banskobystrický kraj, Slovakia
organizer: Mesto Zvolen, Mišo s. r. o.
description: Zvolenská Corrida is a running event held in the pedestrian zone of SNP Square in Zvolen. Runners complete five flat 1 km laps, for a total distance of 5 km. The event also includes children’s races and a fun run for parents and children, both free of charge. It is part of the Zvolen Running League and offers professional event organization and timing.
course_highlights: A 1,000 m lap in the pedestrian zone of SNP Square
Flat course, suitable for all age groups
Five laps in total, or 5 km for the main race
additional: Children’s races are free of charge, with age-group categories over distances of 50 m, 250 m and 500 m. Mama/Oco Corrida is a free 1 km run for parents and children. Registration for the main race is online and limited to 200 participants. Registration for the children’s races and Mama/Oco Corrida is available on site from 9:00. The schedule includes check-in, children’s races at 10:00, Mama/Oco Corrida at 10:30, the main race at 11:00 and the awards ceremony with a raffle at 12:00. The event features the 5 km main race, children’s races and family races. Registration is online or on site. Medals are awarded to the first 170 participants. The main race starts at around 11:00.

name: Furčiansky maratón – Memoriál Štefana Semana
description: The Furčiansky Marathon - Štefan Seman Memorial is a traditional running marathon organized by O5 Bežecký klub Furča Košice. This 23rd edition will take place on April 11, 2026, in Košice, offering runners the opportunity to test themselves on a certified course. The marathon is known for its community atmosphere and support for running activities in the region. The organizers welcome all runners who want to experience a high-quality, well-organized marathon.
course_highlights: marathon and relay categories
a traditional event with a long history
location in Košice with a great atmosphere
additional: Online results will be available from 10:00 on race day. Registration for the Furčiansky Marathon 2026 is closed. The organizer is O5 Bežecký klub Furča Košice. The event includes a marathon, an extreme marathon, and relay races, with various age categories and registration fees. It also commemorates Štefan Seman and supports the running community.

name: Jarný beh Michalovčanov
organizer: Mesto Michalovce, Atletický klub Michalovce, Stredná odborná škola technická
price_range: 2 € dospelí, 1 € mládež do 18 rokov, 0 € muži nad 70 rokov a ženy nad 60 rokov
description: The Jarný beh Michalovčanov is a traditional running race taking place on Saturday, April 11, 2026, in Michalovce, at the V. ZŠ on Školská Street. Competitors can look forward to races in various age categories, including a 400-metre race for children under 9. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant spring sports-day atmosphere, with results announced and medalists awarded.
course_highlights: Start and finish at V. ZŠ, Školská 2, Michalovce
Running courses for various age categories
Short 400 m race for children under 9
additional: The event programme includes the 400 m race start at 9:30 for boys’ and girls’ categories under 9, followed by the announcement of results and awards for medalists at 10:30. The children’s race starts at 10:00 and the main race at 10:15; the entry fee covers various age categories. Venue: Michalovce, V. ZŠ, ŠKOLSKÁ 2.

name: Cheile Turzii Race
location: Rezervația Naturală Cheile Turzii, Cluj County, Romania
description: Cheile Turzii Race is a mountain running competition held in the heart of Transylvania, in the Cheile Turzii Nature Reserve, Romania. The event offers two races: a 9 km cross-country race with 680 m of elevation gain and a 23 km half marathon with 1,300 m of elevation gain, on technical and spectacular routes featuring dramatic scenery and mountain trails. Participants can experience running beneath limestone cliffs, crossing bridges over the Hășdate River, and climbing to impressive panoramic viewpoints. The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners seeking authentic mountain challenges.
course_highlights: Technical routes on mountain trails and forest roads
Spectacular scenery featuring limestone cliffs and dramatic gorges
Climb to Crucea Sănduleștilor with 360° views of the Apuseni Mountains
additional: The start and finish are in front of the Cheile Turzii Mountain Rescue Base. The race kit includes a customized fabric drawstring bag and a finisher medal; the technical T-shirt or singlet is purchased separately. There are aid and hydration stations along the route with water, cola, isotonic drink, fruit, and snacks. Race kits can be collected on Friday, April 17, between 16:00 and 20:00 in Cluj-Napoca (Iulius Mall), and at Cheile Turzii between 19:00 and 21:00, with collection also available on race morning. The awards ceremony takes place at 15:30 at the Mihai Viteazu Town Hall Cabin. Mountain routes, two races, tourism promotion, maximum 400 participants.

name: ČSOB Bratislava marathon – desiatka, Minimaratón, deti, lezúni
description: The ČSOB Bratislava Marathon is a family-friendly running event with a long-standing tradition, held in Bratislava and attracting runners from Slovakia and abroad. It offers a range of disciplines, from the marathon, half marathon and relay races to the 10K, minimarathon, children’s races and crawling races. The atmosphere is full of emotion, fair play and camaraderie, where everyone who takes the start and pushes their own limits is a winner. The event also supports charitable activities and highlights the importance of helping one another and solidarity.
course_highlights: A 42.195 km marathon course through central Bratislava
The Mattoni 10K and Garmin Run Series Minimarathon as shorter events
Children’s races and crawling races for the youngest participants
additional: The Mattoni 10K starts on Saturday, 11.04.2026 at 16:00; the Garmin Run Series Minimarathon starts on Saturday, 11.04.2026 at 14:00; children’s races begin on Saturday, 11.04.2026 from 10:00, according to age categories. Relay races have special bib numbers with timing chips. Participant limits are set for individual events (for example, 2,000 for the 10K, 1,500 for the minimarathon and children’s races). The races take place in Bratislava. Registration is open, with various prices. The course includes city streets and the attractive surroundings of Eurovea Galleria.

name: Kysucká desiatka
organizer: Mestské kulturno-športové stredisko Kysucké Nové Mesto
description: Kysucká desiatka is a running race in Kysucké Nové Mesto, offering courses for various age groups, including children and adults. The race starts in the western part of Murgašova Street. Participants can compete in a 1 km race for children or a 10 km race for adults and juniors. The event is organized by the Municipal Cultural and Sports Centre of Kysucké Nové Mesto and offers categories by age and gender. The children’s race starts at 10:05 and the other categories at 10:30. The race is suitable for a broad running community and supports sport in the region.
course_highlights: The course runs through the western part of Murgašova Street in Kysucké Nové Mesto
Categories include a 1 km race for children and a 10 km race for adults
Categories are divided by age and gender, including junior men and junior women
additional: The children’s race starts at 10:05, and the men’s, women’s, junior men’s and junior women’s races start at 10:30. The event is organized by the Municipal Cultural and Sports Centre of Kysucké Nové Mesto. Contact: Renáta Kováčiková, tel.: 0902 405 190. The 10 km race starts in the western part of Murgašova Street. The event includes categories for children, juniors, men and women, with starts from 10:05 to 10:30. The course runs along the streets of Kysucké Nové Mesto; registration is available online or on site.

name: Majstrovstvá SR v maratóne mužov a žien, veteránov a veteránok (ČSOB Bratislava maratón 2026) (4.kolo BP SAZ)
description: The Slovak Republic Championships in the men’s and women’s marathon, including masters, are a major athletics event taking place in Bratislava. Competitors can look forward to a well-prepared course and professional organization under the auspices of the Slovak Athletic Federation. The event is part of a race series and offers the opportunity to compete in various categories, including masters. Registration is online and open to the wider running community.
course_highlights: A city-style marathon course in Bratislava
Races for men, women and masters in various categories
Organized under the auspices of the Slovak Athletic Federation
additional: Registration is online and must be completed by 12:00 on 7 April 2026. Team leaders will collect race bibs at check-in at the race office. Warm-ups are permitted outside the competition course. Changing facilities are available for boys and girls. Official results will be published on the Slovak Athletic Federation website. The event is part of the ČSOB Bratislava Marathon 2026 and is open to all age groups, including masters.
sources: http://statistika.atletika.sk/admin/media/propozice/MAJSTROVSTVA SR v maratone - propozicie_12.4.2026, Bratislava akt..pdf

name: Trenčianská bežecká liga – 2. kolo
description: The Trenčín Running League is a series of nine running events organized around Trenčín since 2015, open to the general public, including competitive runners and enthusiasts. One race takes place each month from March to November on a different, varied and interesting course. The races offer a friendly atmosphere, motivation, and the chance to meet people who support a healthy lifestyle. The results and points awarded after each race provide motivation for further training and improving performance.
course_highlights: An 8.95 km course with 130 m of elevation gain in Trenčianske Stankovce, mostly off-road, with 20% asphalt
The routes follow dirt roads, the embankment around a pond, village roads, and hills
Start and finish at the football field in Trenčianske Stankovce
additional: Check-in and registration take place on site from 9:00. The entry fee is paid on site. Runners can make a voluntary contribution to the Joint Boarding School in Trenčín. Running with a dog is allowed, but a runner with a dog receives 1 participation point, with no points awarded according to finishing place. The league race takes place at the football field in Trenčianske Stankovce. The event supports the community and a healthy lifestyle and is suitable for all ages and running levels.

name: Šrégom nočným Zvolenom
organizer: Technická univerzita vo Zvolene, WoodenWorld, Cyklo Zvolen o.z., Mesto Zvolen
description: Šrégom Night Run in Zvolen is a night race organized by the Woodenworld student organization at the Technical University in Zvolen and the City of Zvolen. Runners complete a 7 km course with 40 meters of elevation gain through the city of Zvolen, passing notable places such as Zvolen Castle, SNP Square, and the Hron River. The event offers electronic timekeeping, refreshments, prizes for place winners, and a commemorative item. The race starts at 20:30 in front of the Technical University and is suitable for the general public, including university students and staff.
course_highlights: A 7 km course with 40 m of elevation gain through the city of Zvolen
Passes Zvolen Castle and SNP Square
The route runs along the Hron River and finishes at the Technical University
additional: Online registration until 13.4.2026 costs €12; registration on race day from 18:30 to 20:00 costs €15. The entry fee includes a race bib, electronic timekeeping, refreshments, prizes, and a commemorative item. Competitors under 18 may take part with the consent of a legal guardian. Staff and students of TU Zvolen can enter the club name "Technical University" to be included in the ranking of the best TU runners. The race takes place at night, with a route passing notable landmarks in Zvolen. Registration is available online or on site. Men’s and women’s categories compete across different age groups.

name: Priateľský nočný beh mestom Vranov
location: Základná škola Sídlisko II., Vranov nad Topľou, Prešov, Slovakia
description: Priateľský nočný beh mestom Vranov is a traditional running event in Vranov nad Topľou, offering a nighttime running experience through the city. The race takes place on the grounds of Sídlisko II Primary School and is open to men, women, and children. The main race starts at 19:30, and the children’s race begins at 17:00. The organizers are OZ S rukou v ruke, Sídlisko II Primary School, the City of Vranov nad Topľou, and OZ Vranovské Vydry, who warmly invite all runners to enjoy a friendly atmosphere and a sporting experience.
course_highlights: Night run through the city of Vranov
Start and finish at Sídlisko II Primary School
Categories for men, women, and children
additional: The children’s race starts at 17:00. On-site entry fee: €20. Night course, online and on-site registration, children’s race, relay races

name: TTR BACKYARD ULTRA ~ 2026
location: Satul Roșu, Chiajna, Ilfov County, Romania
description: TTR BACKYARD ULTRA 2026 is an official endurance running competition organized by the TIME TRIAL RUNNING community, with the support of Chiajna Town Hall and local parishes. The event takes place in the village of Roșu, Chiajna commune, on April 17, 2026, starting at 14:00 at the sports hall of “Doamna Chiajna” Technological High School. It is a unique Backyard Ultra race, with a single 6.706 km event alternating between two different courses, one by day and one by night. The challenge is to complete the course in under 60 minutes and be present for every hourly start; the last competitor remaining in the race is declared the winner.
course_highlights: A single 6.706 km distance, with two different courses completed alternately
Day course along the embankment/western side of Lake Morii
Night course on the streets of Roșu village and along the Chiajna commune Promenade
additional: The race starts on the hour, every hour, and participants must complete the course in under 60 minutes to continue. The base camp includes indoor facilities (the sports hall, with changing rooms and toilets) and outdoor space (the park with synthetic grass). Food and hydration are available in the start/finish area, and hot meals will be served according to the schedule. Awards go to the winner (Last One Standing), second place (Assist), and the highest-placed woman (Last Woman Standing). Each participant receives a personalized trophy at the finish. The event features courses along the shores of Lake Morii and the Chiajna promenade, is limited to 100 competitors, and offers hot meals and personalized trophies.

name: III. ÁGOTA® Futás – Fuss Értük Szegeden! Jótékonysági futóverseny
organizer: Csongrád-Csanád Vármegyei Kormányhivatal, Szegedi Tudományegyetem, Gál Ferenс Egyetem

description: The ÁGOTA® Run is a charity race in Szeged that supports young people in the child protection system. The race starts at Dóm Square and follows paved, traffic-free city streets. Participants can choose from several distances, from children’s races to a half marathon, in a day celebrating movement, community, and care. The proceeds from entry fees fund services and experiences for the young people supported by the foundation.
course_highlights: Urban route on paved, traffic-free streets
Start and finish at Dóm Square, an iconic Szeged landmark
Course safety provided by police officers and volunteers
additional: The event offers distances for different age groups and fitness levels, including children’s races and adult distances. Children must submit a parental consent form. A lead cyclist and checkpoints at several points along the course help keep runners safe. After the race, participants can enjoy special bath offers, and the official ice cream flavor will be mango–passion fruit. By taking part, runners support the ÁGOTA® Foundation. The event offers several distances and categories, with a course that starts at Dóm Square and runs through the city. Online registration is available.

tiers.label: tier_1

description: The ÁGOTA® Run is a charity race in Szeged supporting young people in the child protection system. The race starts at Dóm Square and follows paved city streets closed to traffic. Participants can choose from several distances, from children’s races to a half marathon, and run individually or as part of a team. More than a sporting event, it is a community effort that supports young people in need, with growing support each year.
course_highlights: Flat urban route on paved streets closed to traffic
Start and finish at Dóm Square in Szeged
Lead cyclists and police cover at intersections
additional: The event offers races for different age groups and distances, including children’s races (100 m, 400 m, 800 m), adult distances (3 km, 6 km, 12 km, 21 km), and a 4 × 3 km relay. Lead cyclists and police cover help ensure safety. Registration is online; only a limited number of entries are available on site. All participants under 18 must provide a parental consent form. After the race, participants can enjoy special bath offers and gifts. Taking part supports young people in the child protection system. Registration is available online, with several running options and categories.

name: Ultramaratón Košice – Miskolc
organizer: Marathon Club Miskolc, Košice Marathon Club
description: The Košice–Miskolc Ultramarathon is a demanding international ultrarunning race taking place on April 18, 2026. The route runs from the center of Košice to Miskolc, challenging runners with a long course across varied terrain. The event is part of a series of running events organized by Maratónsky klub Košice and is intended for endurance runners seeking a unique experience that pushes them to their limits. The start is on Hlavná Street in Košice, giving the race a historic atmosphere and support from local spectators.
course_highlights: The route runs from Košice to Miskolc across varied terrain
Start and finish in Košice’s historic center on Hlavná Street
An international race crossing the border
additional: The race starts on Hlavná Street in Košice, between the DoubleTree by Hilton hotel and the Dargov department store. The event is part of the Košice Marathon events series and is organized by Maratónsky klub Košice. Specific information about start waves, capacity, or fees is not provided. The race starts at 6:00 and 7:00; registration deadlines and fees are specified. The races take place on Hlavná Street and at Dolná brána in Košice. The event is for runners aged 16 and over, with individual, pairs, and relay categories.

name: Ultramaratón Miškolc - Košice
organizer: Marathon Club Miskolc, Košice Marathon Club
description: The Košice–Miskolc Ultramarathon is a prestigious running event taking place on April 18, 2026. Runners travel from Košice to Miskolc on a challenging ultramarathon route. The event is part of the region’s rich running calendar and offers a unique experience for endurance runners. It is organized by Maratónsky klub Košice, which provides professional preparation and organization.
course_highlights: An ultramarathon route from Košice to Miskolc
Challenging terrain requiring endurance and fitness
Crosses two countries—Slovakia and Hungary
additional: The event is part of a series of running events in Košice, including the International Peace Marathon and other accompanying events. Organizers offer opportunities to participate as a volunteer, driver, or pacer. Runners receive comprehensive organizational support and benefits associated with the entry fee. The course follows cycle paths and has low traffic, with categories for individuals and two-, five-, and ten-person relay teams; start times are 6:00 and 7:00.

name: BoleRuN
location: areál TJ Slavoj Boleráz, Boleráz, Slovakia
description: BoleRuN is a running event held at the TJ Slavoj Boleráz grounds, offering courses for different age groups, including children, teenagers, and adults. Runners can compete over distances from 50 metres to 10 km, with the children’s start at 13:00 and the adults’ start at 14:00. The event is organised by the Municipality of Boleráz in cooperation with the Boleráz – Hýb sa initiative. It is suitable for runners aged 9 and over who want to enjoy a day of sport in a pleasant setting.
course_highlights: Adult courses: 10 km and 5 km
Course for teenagers aged 10 to 14: 2 km
Course for children under 9: from 50 metres to 1 km
additional: Children’s start at 13:00; adults’ start at 14:00. Categories are divided by age and course distance. The event is organised by the Municipality of Boleráz and the Boleráz – Hýb sa initiative. Registration is likely closed as of April 2024; the event includes categories for children and adults, electronic timekeeping, and a participant medal.

name: Šarišská míľa
description: Šarišská míľa is a running event organized by BK ZasRun in Šarišské Bohdanovce at the football pitch. The race is open to various age groups, including children, youth, adults, and Nordic Walking participants. The starts are divided into the children’s mile, running and Nordic Walking for women, and running and Nordic Walking for men. Entry is free, with the option to make a voluntary contribution at registration. The event offers a welcoming atmosphere for runners of all levels and ages.
course_highlights: The race takes place at the football pitch in Šarišské Bohdanovce
Categories for children, youth, adults, and Nordic Walking participants
Starts are divided into the children’s mile, running and Nordic Walking for women, and running and Nordic Walking for men
additional: Entry is free, with the option to make a voluntary contribution at registration. The children’s mile starts at 16:00, the women’s running and Nordic Walking events at 16:20, and the men’s running and Nordic Walking events at 16:45. Categories are divided by age and gender, including overall rankings for Nordic Walking. The race starts at 16:00, is open to the general public, and is suitable for all age groups.

name: Chlieb náš….
description: Chlieb Náš is an artisan bakery in Hronský Beňadik that makes sourdough bread using traditional methods and quality ingredients. It takes pride in honest baking, reflected in the bread’s crisp crust, lively sourdough starter and soft interior. The bakery offers an authentic experience where you can choose fresh bread straight from the oven. In addition to the quality of its bread, the bakery is also known for its unique Baroque ceiling, one of the most original in Trnava.
course_highlights: Traditional sourdough bread baking using quality ingredients
Crisp crust and soft bread interior
Unique Baroque ceiling in the bakery
additional: The bakery is open Tuesday to Friday from 7:00 to 16:00 and Saturday from 7:00 to 11:30, or until sold out. The business emphasizes honest artisan production and the family character of Trnka Gastronomy. The event is associated with traditional bread baking and is held at Dumas bakery in Hronský Beňadik. It is suitable for anyone interested in the baking craft.

name: Beh oslobodenia Turčianska Štiavnička
description: The Turčianska Štiavnička Liberation Run is a traditional race with a rich history, held to mark the anniversary of the village’s liberation by the Soviet Army. The 32nd edition will take place on April 18, 2026, at the football field in Turčianska Štiavnička. The approximately 10 km course runs mainly through mountainous terrain and offers runners a challenging but beautiful experience. Competitors are divided into age categories, with awards also given in the children’s categories and to the top runners from Štiavnička. The organizers welcome all runners and look forward to their participation.
course_highlights: The course runs mainly through mountainous terrain, along forest roads and through the local park
Approximately 10 km long, known as the “Štiavnická desiatka”
Start and finish by the cultural center and football field in the village
additional: Online registration is open from 1.4.2026 to 16.4.2026. The race is divided into men’s age categories, women’s categories and children’s categories. The race bibs are traditionally sewn and printed according to the original design from Ružomberok and are still used today. A ceremonial wreath-laying at the memorial to fallen heroes takes place before the race. Races start at 10:00 and 13:15; registration is available from April 1 to 16, 2026. The event has historical significance and is part of the local calendar of sporting events.

name: Banská Bystrica - Bežíme spolu v Banskej Bystrici
location: Park pod pamätníkom SNP, Banská Bystrica, Slovakia
description: Bežíme spolu in Banská Bystrica is a running event held in the park below the SNP Memorial in Banská Bystrica. It offers four distances, including a children’s run, and is suitable for the general public, including children under 6. The course is flat, with no elevation gain, making for an enjoyable run for all age groups. The event supports people with disabilities: €2 from each entry fee goes towards motivating them to be physically active.
course_highlights: Flat courses with no elevation gain
Four distances: 10 km, 5 km, 3 km and a 500 m children’s run
Start and finish in the park below the SNP Memorial in Banská Bystrica
additional: Support: €2 from each paid entry fee goes towards supporting people with disabilities. The children’s run is for children under 6 (born 2020–2026) and requires the presence of a legal guardian. Entry fees are valid from 7 April 2026. The course has no elevation gain, making the race easy to run. The course is flat; registration is online; the event supports people with disabilities; information about consent to the use of data is included.

name: Polus Tower Run
location: Polus Tower 2, Bratislava-Nové Mesto, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: Polus Tower Run is a unique stair-climbing event taking place on April 18, 2026, at the Polus Tower 2 office building in Bratislava. Competitors climb the elevation under their own power on two courses: a children’s course with 4 floors and 116 steps, and the main adult course with 19 floors and 416 steps. Participants start individually at 30-second intervals, and times are recorded electronically. The event is organized by the KOTRMELEC Sports Foundation and is conducted under the applicable TWA rules.
course_highlights: Adults: 19 floors / 416 steps, distance 400 m, elevation gain +80 m
PHZ (police officers, firefighters, paramedics): 416 steps / 19 floors, distance 400 m, elevation gain +80 m
Children: 4 floors / 116 steps, distance 200 m, elevation gain +21 m
additional: The children’s start is at 11:00, and the adults’ start is at 11:30. The awards ceremony is at 13:00. The course surface is 100% tile. Participants start individually at 30-second intervals, with electronic timekeeping. Awards are given by age category for men and women. Stair race, multiple categories, online registration, limited to 300 participants, race for children and adults, various age groups and medals
