description: Alergăraș în Făgăraș is a sporting event that brings together runners of all ages and performance levels to explore the natural and cultural beauty of the Făgăraș area. The courses offer a complete experience, with steep climbs, descents through spectacular scenery, and well-organized hydration points, while the start and finish take place near the historic fortress. The atmosphere is friendly and motivating, supported by an enthusiastic community and dedicated volunteers. The event promotes grassroots sport and respect for nature, offering a memorable day of running and socializing amid mountain scenery.
course_highlights: Steep climbs and descents through spectacular scenery
Start and finish in the area of Făgăraș Fortress
Well-stocked hydration points and excellent course marking
additional: Premium finisher medal, cash prizes for podium finishers, ITRA points and a UTMB Index for the Maratonu’ de pe Ardeal and Belvedere races, a voucher for a hot meal after the race, medical support with an ambulance, a massage tent, food and hydration points along the course and at the finish, and the option to purchase a technical running shirt. Multiple race categories, including marathon, trail, cross-country, and relays; the event includes cultural and tourist activities, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the natural beauty of the Făgăraș area.

name: Medieval Trail Race
description: Medieval Trail Race is a mountain running competition held in Arad County, Romania, on the hiking trails of the Zărand Mountains, between the localities of Șoimoș and Șiria. The event promotes both mountain running and the area’s natural and historical heritage, linking Șoimoș and Șiria fortresses, as well as other points of interest, along its routes. The courses offer an adventurous experience amid spring scenery and a medieval atmosphere, and are suitable for both amateur and professional runners. The 2026 edition is the 5th and is part of the ITRA National League and UTMB Index calendars.
course_highlights: Mountain routes featuring hiking trails, forest roads, and paved roads
Historical sites: Șoimoș Fortress, Șiria Fortress, Feredeu Monastery, Feredeu Hermitage
Significant elevation gains: 445 m (9 km), 1026 m (22 km), 2075 m (44 km)
additional: Participant kits are guaranteed for registrations made by April 12, 2026. The routes are marked with tape and arrows, and participants must pass through all checkpoints. Medical assistance and route monitoring are provided. On-site registration is available only for the 9 km cross-country race and the 22 km half marathon, without a guaranteed kit. Cancellations made by 28.02.2026 receive a 50% refund of the participation fee. The routes include hiking trails in the Zărand Mountains, with details about registration and participation requirements; the event takes place on April 18, 2026.

name: Fruškogorski maraton
distance_verbose: 134 km, 100 km, 59 km, Maraton, Polumaraton, 10 km
description: The Fruška Gora Marathon is a sporting competition and recreational event with a long tradition. It takes place in the hilly, forested area of Fruška Gora, near Novi Sad. The routes pass through natural beauty spots and numerous medieval Serbian monasteries, as well as historical and cultural landmarks. The competitive courses are ITRA-certified and serve as qualifiers for the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc. In addition to the competitive courses, there are nine recreational routes that promote a healthy lifestyle and nature conservation.
course_highlights: The routes pass through 97% forested terrain on Fruška Gora
Pass through medieval Serbian monasteries such as Grgeteg, Staro Hopovo, Novo Hopovo, Jazak, and Bešenovo
Climb Fruška Gora’s highest peak (539 m) and descend past the Dombovački Stream waterfall
additional: The competitive courses are ITRA-certified and serve as qualifiers for the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc. There are 14 different routes of varying distances and elevation gains, ranging from an ultra-extreme 134 km marathon to recreational routes. The routes include natural and cultural landmarks, as well as historical sites. The organizer also has a Viber group for registrations and communication. 14 routes of varying distances, ITRA-certified, including ultra and recreational distances, passing medieval monasteries and natural and cultural landmarks.

description: Fruška Gora Trail is a traditional sporting competition held on Fruška Gora, known for its old trails and new challenges. The race features a range of courses and categories, from ultra-extreme to recreational, suited to runners of different levels. The event brings together nature and running enthusiasts, offering a unique experience amid beautiful landscapes and demanding terrain. The organizers strive to provide quality logistics, including organized transport to the start and extensive support during the race.

Courses ranging from mini to ultra-extreme marathons
Beautiful natural landscapes of Fruška Gora, with challenging climbs and descents
additional: Organized transport from Novi Sad to the race start on April 25, 2026, from 6 a.m. Registration for individual sport categories and groups is open until April 15, 2026. The race includes courses with different ITRA point values, from 1 to 5, and distances suited to runners of all levels. The event features multiple race categories, online registration, organized transport from Novi Sad, and a variety of courses for runners of all levels.

name: Fuss a struccal 4 / 7 / 14 / 21
description: The Run with the Ostrich charity running festival will be held at Aranypart in Győr for the third time in 2026. Participants can choose from several distances, and the event is open to all ages, from the youngest to the oldest. The festival aims to support paediatric care, particularly by funding a specialised EEG device to diagnose children with epilepsy and serious medical conditions. Well-known athletes and public figures also take part, creating a warm, community atmosphere. Proceeds from the entry fees support the Foundation for Intensive Care for Children.
course_highlights: The race takes place on Aranypart’s picturesque hillside
Distances: 4, 7, 14 and 21 kilometres
A family-friendly event where four-legged companions are welcome
additional: Proceeds from the entry fees will be used to purchase a specialised EEG device to diagnose children with epilepsy and serious medical conditions. Well-known athletes, artists, police officers and volunteer firefighters also take part, with the firefighters running in their duty uniforms. Families and four-legged companions run alongside one another, while spectators cheer on participants from Aranypart’s hillside. The running festival has attracted more than 600 participants; entry fees support epilepsy diagnostics for children, and the event is a charity initiative for children’s recovery.

description: The Vértes Trail Marathon is a challenging trail-running race on the scenic trails and forestry roads of the Vértes Mountains. The event offers runners several distance options, from the ultramarathon to the minimarathon, each with varied elevation gain and a well-marked course. Participants can enjoy aid stations, personalized race bibs, timing, and a generous selection of finish-line food, along with the natural surroundings and sporting experience. The race has a friendly, intimate atmosphere, and the organizers pay special attention to runners’ comfort and safety.
course_highlights: Runs along trails and forestry roads in the Vértes Mountains
50 km ultramarathon with 1,410 m of elevation gain
Several aid stations, including Squeezy gels on the ultramarathon and marathon distances
additional: Personalized race bib and timing (Traxpace). Hungarian-made metal finisher’s medal, painted by people with disabilities. Women’s hygiene products available at the aid stations and event center. Massage for Marathon and Ultramarathon runners. Two types of non-alcoholic finisher beer. No cups provided; bring your own cup. Mandatory gear: mobile phone, ID, and at least 0.5 liters of fluid. Race-pack collection times: Ultra and Marathon 08:00–08:45; Half Marathon and Minimarathon 08:45–09:45. Awards ceremonies on race day from 12:30 to 15:00. Trail running in the Vértes Mountains, with several distances, elevation gain, and aid stations. Registration opens in January 2025. Held in Szár.

description: The Clear'97 Alpokalja Business Run is a community-building spring running festival in Szombathely, offering a range of distances in individual and relay categories for corporate, friend, and school teams. The event starts with a 2.5 km children’s race, followed by 5 km, 10 km, and 20 km distances, with relay options. Its aim is to promote sport and an active lifestyle, with a unique finisher’s medal, electronic timing, and live results. The event also includes a health day, with mental health professionals and therapy demonstrations. Free parking is available at the Vasi Skanzen car park.
course_highlights: 2.5 km laps with relay zones; relay handovers every 2.5 km
Relay categories: women’s, mixed, general, and secondary school teams
Electronic timing and continuously updated live results
additional: Free parking at the Vasi Skanzen car park. A unique finisher’s medal for the first 200 entrants, with medals from previous years also available to choose from. Electronic timing using the KORIM endurance timing system. Professional race photos available to download free of charge. Sponsor gifts for category, relay, and overall winners. Bag storage at the event centre. A selection of health-day activities with mental health professionals and therapy demonstrations. Relay teams must have at least 2 members, with handovers every 2.5 km. Women’s and mixed relays are offered, and school relays have a separate category. The entry fee for the first school relay team will be covered if it enters by April 10. The event takes place in Szombathely, near Erkel utca 39, and features awards, live results, photos, and various categories, including school teams.

name: XXIII. Motherson Szigetköz Félmaraton 2 / 5 / 10 / 21
location: UFM Aréna, Mosonmagyaróvár, Győr-Moson-Sopron County, Hungary
description: The 23rd Motherson Szigetköz Half Marathon is a traditional running race in Mosonmagyaróvár that promotes recreational sport. The race is part of the Olympic Five-Event Challenge and offers the chance to earn points in the 2 km, 5 km, 10 km and half marathon (21.1 km) distances. The start and finish are at the UFM Arena, which has changing rooms, showers and a cloakroom. Chip timing is provided, and there is a time limit for the longest distance. Entrants can have their name or nickname printed on their race bib if they register by April 10.
course_highlights: Individual chip timing for the 2, 5, 10 and 21 km distances
Half-marathon time limit: 2 hours 30 minutes
Name or nickname printed on the race bib if requested by April 10
additional: Race bibs must be worn at the front, at chest height. Triathlon race-bib belts are permitted. A chip is attached to the back of the race bib; it must not be removed or folded. Timing is provided by Agni-Timing. There is a time limit for the longest distance: the 21.1 km must be completed within 2 hours 30 minutes, or the runner will be disqualified. The small bridge in front of the UFM Arena will be closed on race day from 8:30 to 12:00. Registration is online and is open until April 11; the race is open to everyone, from beginners to professional runners.

name: Národný beh Devín - Bratislava (5.kolo BP SAZ)
description: TIPOS National Run Devín–Bratislava is Slovakia’s oldest sporting event, with a tradition spanning more than 100 years, and will be held for the 78th time. Runners will follow the iconic route from historic Devín Castle to the centre of Bratislava, creating a unique atmosphere that brings history and sport together. The event is suitable for recreational athletes as well as more demanding runners, and attracts thousands of participants of different ages every year. It is organised by STaRZ of the City of Bratislava, which provides all organisational information and registration.
course_highlights: The route runs from Devín Castle to the centre of Bratislava
Road race with more than 5,000 participants
Historic, iconic running tradition dating back to 1921
additional: Online registration is open until 15 April 2026 at 20:00. Group registration is available by emailing hromadne_prihlasky@starz.sk with billing details. A limited-edition T-shirt is available for EUR 13. The start list is available online. The event is organised by STaRZ of the City of Bratislava. The event includes various courses in Devín, registration is available online, and it is part of the Slovak Athletics Association running series. Results and statistics can also be followed on the official websites.

name: Sačurovská pätnástka – 20. Memoriál Heleny Slukovej
organizer: Obec Sačurov, OZ Sačurov, ZŠ Sačurov, MŠ Sačurov
description: Sačurovská pätnástka – 20th Helena Sluková Memorial is a traditional running race held in the village of Sačurov in Vranov nad Topľou District. The race starts in front of the primary school in Sačurov and offers categories for different age groups, including children, juniors and adults. The main category starts at 13:00, and the children’s race at 12:00. The organizers are the Municipality of Sačurov, OZ Sačurov, and Sačurov Primary and Nursery School. The race is suitable for local runners and beginners alike.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the village of Sačurov, in front of the primary school
Categories range from preschool age to seniors over 70
Awards for the top runners from Vranov District
additional: The entry fee must be paid online only. Men over 70 and women over 60 do not pay an entry fee. The children’s race starts at 12:00, and the main categories start at 13:00. Awards for the top runners from Vranov District are part of the event. The race is part of a community-support event, with online registration and various categories for all age groups.

The competition is divided into several age categories for men and women, welcoming participants of different ages and abilities. The organizer is MATORE s.r.o., which provides race organization and timing.

A 3.66 km short race and Nordic walking event with the same start time
Several age categories for men and women
additional: On-site registration is available from 9:30 on race day. The participant limit for adults is 130. All disciplines start together at 13:00. The event includes several categories and age groups, with registration available online and on-site. The start is scheduled for 13:00, and the event also includes children’s races and accompanying activities.

The organizers are the Municipality of Slovenská Kajňa, MATORE s.r.o. Humenné, and the Marcel Matanin Running Academy. The event is part of the POWERGRAF Michalovce–Sobrance Running League 2026.

The race takes place at the Municipal Sports Club’s football stadium in Likavka and is part of the 2025 Liptov Running League. Children, pupils, juniors, women, and men can compete in various age categories. According to the race regulations, the pupils’ start is at 10:05 and the adults’ start is at 11:40. The race is suitable for the general public and offers an opportunity to test your strength in the pleasant surroundings of Likavka.
course_highlights: The race takes place at the Municipal Sports Club’s football stadium in Likavka
Part of the 2025 Liptov Running League
Categories for children, pupils, juniors, women, and men in various age groups
additional: According to the race regulations, the pupils’ start is at 10:05 and the adults’ start is at 11:40. Categories include children, pupils, juniors, women, and men in various age groups. The organizers are the Likavka Municipal Office and Likavka Primary School with Kindergarten. The race is part of the 2025 Liptov Running League. The race takes place at the football stadium; registration is available online and on-site, the event includes various categories, and it is part of a regional running series.

name: Čadčianska desiatka
description: The Čadca Ten is a traditional running race organized by the Kysuce Marathon Club Čadca, the town of Čadca, and the Čadca Žarec Social Services Centre. The 30th edition will take place on 19 April 2026, starting at 10:00 in the Žarec housing estate in Čadca. Runners can look forward to a well-prepared course and a welcoming atmosphere at an event popular with the region’s running community. Online registration is open until 17 April 2026. You can also register on race day for a higher entry fee.
course_highlights: A traditional running race with a long history
Start and finish at the Žarec housing estate in Čadca
Race for the Mayor of Čadca Cup
additional: Registration is also available on race day for the higher entry fee of €10. Organizers ask participants to register even if they are unsure whether they can attend, to speed up check-in and minimize errors when recording names. If you do not attend, your name will not appear in the results. The race takes place on 19 April 2026 at 10:00. Registration is open until 17 April 2026. The start and finish are at the Žarec housing estate. The race is part of a traditional sporting event with a rich history.

name: Semimaraton Iași
organizer: Rotary Club Iași Copou, Salvați Copiii Iași, Primăria Municipiului Iași

price_tiers.distance: Cursa populară, Cursa copiilor, Cursa persoanelor cu dizabilități

description: Iași Half Marathon is the largest running event in northeastern Romania, held annually in the Palace of Culture Square. The half-marathon course consists of two loops that pass through the start area, giving runners a unique experience on the city’s main streets, with road traffic stopped and refreshment points along the way. The event has a strong charitable component, supporting children from disadvantaged backgrounds through educational and social projects. Taking part in the half-marathon, cross-country races and fun runs is an opportunity to do good and join a community committed to positive change.
course_highlights: Route along main streets with road traffic stopped
Passes in front of the Palace of Culture
Refreshment points for hydration and medical assistance
additional: Participants in the half-marathon, 10 km cross-country and 5 km cross-country races receive a disposable timing chip and a technical event T-shirt. Registration is available online until the deadline; after that, subject to availability, participants can register in person at the Iași Half Marathon kiosk in Palas Mall. Registration is not available on race day. The event provides an ambulance for medical assistance and plenty of photos at the finish and along the course. Participation includes hydration points, medical assistance, a race kit, and the option to participate online or in person. The event is charitable, supporting projects for disadvantaged children.

name: Dălhăuți Trail Challenge
price_range: 250 lei pentru înscriere de ultim moment fără kit
description: Dălhăuți Trail Challenge is a mountain running competition taking place on April 19, 2026, in the village of Dălhăuți, Vrancea County. The event is organized by the Velopower Sports Association and promotes running on varied terrain, including forest trails and forestry roads. Participants can enjoy a well-marked course with checkpoints and a friendly atmosphere, rounded out by an awards ceremony and a traditional lunch at the finish. The start is scheduled for 10:00, after a technical briefing and a coffee-fueled warm-up. The event emphasizes socializing and promoting exercise in nature.
course_highlights: Varied-terrain course: forest trails and forestry roads
Course clearly marked with tape, arrows, and signs
Checkpoints with time limits for each race
additional: Check-in and race-pack pickup between 08:00 and 09:30. Last-minute registration is available for only 20 spots, without a starter kit, for a fee of 250 lei. Mandatory equipment for the races: mobile phone, clearly visible race bib, liquid container (minimum 0.5 liters) for the 21 km race, and a survival blanket. Champions’ lunch of beans with sausages after the runners finish. Awards ceremony at 14:30. The event ends at 16:00 with group photos and socializing. The course includes trail terrain, registration details, the event schedule, and post-race activities.

name: UCM Night Run
description: UCM Night Run is a charity evening run taking place on 21 April 2026 at 20:00 at Trojičné námestie in Trnava. Runners will complete a 5-kilometre route through the historic streets of Trnava’s centre, offering the unique atmosphere of the “Little Rome.” The event is open to everyone, regardless of ability, and brings the community together through movement and support for those in need. Proceeds from the run will go towards rehabilitation and treatment for a child with a disability. The organisers are the City of Trnava, FMK UCM students and main partner CUKROVAR.
course_highlights: 5 km route through the historic streets of Trnava’s centre
Evening atmosphere at Trojičné námestie
Charity event supporting people with disabilities
additional: Programme: 16:00–19:15 registration, 19:00 guest appearances, 19:30 warm-up and route presentation, 20:00 start. Timing is provided by Terminovka. The event is partnering with the APPkA.app app to support people with disabilities. Registration via terminovka.sk. The event includes a charity collection, discussions about the CUKROVAR project, refreshments and a chill zone with a DJ.

name: ULTRABALATON
organizer: Balatonman Triatlon Kft & FULLCON IT Development Kft
price_range: 18 500 Ft/fő (7-13 fős csapat), 19 500 Ft/fő (egyéb csapatok), csapatonként 40 000 Ft
description: In 2026, the Ultrabalaton will be held for the 20th time. It is Hungary’s most popular mass-participation sporting event. The race is a single-loop running event around Lake Balaton, the longest running race in Central Europe, and can be completed individually or in a team, on foot or by bicycle. The distance is 209 kilometers, open to solo participants and teams of 2–6 people. The event has a friendly, community-focused atmosphere and offers activities that appeal to runners, their supporters, and cyclists alike.
course_highlights: A 209-kilometer single loop around Lake Balaton
The longest running race in Central Europe
Take part individually or in a team of 2–6
additional: Race office address: 1134 Budapest, Tüzér utca 9-11; opening hours: Monday and Tuesday, 10:00–13:00. #PROJEKT418 support, aid stations, and a split calculator are available to participants in StafétApp. Activities are also available for supporters accompanying runners and for cyclists. The registration deadline is September 27, 2025. The event takes place April 23–26, 2026, with the start on April 25, 2026. Participants can collect their race packs at the event center, and the lap-time calculator is available in the StafétApp app.

name: Mozdulj Csepel!
location: Kolonics György Szabadidőközpont, Hollandi út 8-10, Budapest, Hungary
description: Mozdulj, Csepel! is a free family running event organized by the Csepel Municipality as part of the Actively for Csepel program series. The race takes place on the beautiful Csepel Danube waterfront, starting from the Kolonics György Recreation Centre, and offers four distances: 3.5 km, 7 km, a 400 m children’s race, and a special race for people with disabilities. The event aims to share the joy of community and exercise with all age groups, with an environmentally conscious approach and cup-free refreshments. Race bibs must be worn for the 3.5 km and 7 km distances, and chip timing ensures accurate results.
course_highlights: The course follows Kolonics Promenade along the Danube.
Chip timing and overall men’s and women’s podiums for the 3.5 km and 7 km distances.
The children’s race course passes under the two-hole bridge; parental accompaniment is permitted.
additional: The event is cup-free, so participants are encouraged to bring their own soft cup, water bottle, or cup. The youngest participants will receive a medal, while older children will find a gym bag, an apple, and muesli at the finish. Strollers are permitted only at the participant’s own risk. The special race is a fun run for people with disabilities, where walking is also allowed. Multiple distances; registration required; environmentally friendly; chip timing; awards; family and special categories; route along the Danube; outdoor event; rain or shine.

name: Galbicska Péter Emlékfutás Tata 7 / 14
organizer: Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület
description: The 6th Galbicska Péter Memorial Run will take place on April 25, 2026, on Tópart Promenade in Tata. Runners can choose between two distances: 7 km (1 lap around the lake) and 14 km (2 laps around the lake). Entries are available by age group and gender. The event has a friendly atmosphere and takes place in a lakeside setting, offering participants both a challenge and an enjoyable experience. The start is at 10:00, and registration is open until 18:00 on April 23.
course_highlights: 7 km and 14 km lakeside laps
Scenic surroundings on Tópart Promenade in Tata
Race distances available by age group and gender
additional: Required fields must be completed during registration; separate entry codes apply for each age group and gender. Registration is online, with the entry fee payable by bank card or bank transfer through the SimplePay system. The registration deadline is 18:00 on April 23. The event includes several categories, and participants must register by April 23. The event is part of Tata’s sporting life and traditions.

name: BACKYARD ULTRA ESZTERGOM
location: Franka Pálya – Gimnázium Sportpálya, Esztergom, Komárom-Esztergom County, Hungary

description: Backyard Ultra Esztergom 2026 is a special ultrarunning race that continues until only one runner remains. Competitors complete a 6,706-metre loop every hour, and only those who finish before the next start remain in the race. The event is part of the Hungarian Backyard League and is held as an age-group championship, with the top female and male runners awarded in 11 age groups. The race takes place at Franka Pálya - Gimnázium Sportpálya in Esztergom, and participants who complete distances of up to 160 kilometres may also receive recognition.
course_highlights: A 6,706-metre loop to be completed every hour
A last-runner-standing race: runners must finish before the next start to continue
An age-group championship with 11 categories for female and male competitors
additional: The race is part of the Hungarian Backyard League and is held as an age-group championship, with the top female and male runners awarded in 11 age groups. The entry fee can be paid by bank card or bank transfer; for bank transfers, a payment request will be sent. The Backyard MINI event consists of 6 laps (40.236 km), with gold medals awarded to the fastest female and male runners. Competitors can earn multiple medals and trophies. On-site registration may be available if places remain, at a higher price. The race takes place at Franka Pálya - Gimnázium Sportpálya; detailed registration and award information can be found on the official website. The race is a celebration of perseverance and community, where runners can push their own limits.

name: Ultra Kras
location: Národný park Slovenský kras, Turni nad Bodvou, Slovakia
description: Ultra Kras is a mountain ultramarathon covering 57 km with 2,400 m of elevation gain, running through Slovak Karst National Park. The start and finish are in Turňa nad Bodvou, and the race has a 12-hour time limit. It is part of the Slovak Ultratrail League and offers a challenging course with several refreshment and checkpoint stations. Race-pack collection takes place the day before the start and on race day, with a mass start at 7:00 a.m.
course_highlights: The course runs through Slovak Karst National Park
57 km with +2,400 m of elevation gain
Live checkpoints at refreshment stations
additional: Participant registration takes place on Friday, 24 April 2026, from 18:00 to 22:00, and on Saturday, 25 April 2026, from 5:00 to 6:30. The time limit is 12 hours from the start, meaning runners must finish by 19:00. Checkpoint K3 Hačava (30 km) has a cutoff of 7.5 hours after the start (by 14:30). The start and finish are at the parking lot next to Hviezda cinema in Turňa nad Bodvou. Electronic timing records arrivals at checkpoints and the finish. 57 km course, 12-hour time limit, registration on 24–25 April, refreshment stations, mandatory equipment, men’s and women’s categories, part of the Slovak Ultratrail League.

name: Demänovský Štvanec
location: Demänová rezort, Liptovský Mikuláš, Žilinský kraj, Slovakia
organizer: WinTeam o.z. a Agentúra 8P v spolupráci s Demänová rezort
description: Demänovský Štvanec is a running event for both recreational runners and competitive athletes, held amid the beautiful scenery of Demänovská Valley in Liptovský Mikuláš. The event offers three disciplines: the 5 km Malý Štvanec, the 10 km Veľký Štvanec with TUI, and the children’s Štvanček races. Alongside the sporting experience, participants can enjoy a family-friendly atmosphere and additional activities at Demänová Resort. The event is part of a weekend full of movement, games and fun, organized by WinTeam o.z. and Agentúra 8P in cooperation with Demänová Resort.
course_highlights: The courses pass through the beautiful scenery of Demänovská Valley
The 5 km Malý Štvanec and 10 km Veľký Štvanec have time limits of 1:30 and 2:00 hours, respectively
Children’s Štvanček races have staggered starts by age category
additional: Registration and race-number pickup are available on Friday, 24.04.2026, from 17:00 to 19:00, and on Saturday, 25.04.2026, from 8:00 to 10:00 for children and adults. Timing for adults is provided by VOS-TPK using chips, with results published live at www.sportsofttiming.sk. When booking a stay at Demänová Resort, the entry fee is included in the accommodation price. Children’s categories start in stages from 11:00 according to age. The event includes online and on-site registration, categories for different age groups, family activities, and accommodation packages at Demänová Resort.

name: Račiansky polmaratón, Račianska desiatka
location: Športový areál Tbiliská 4, Bratislava-Rača, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: The Rača Half Marathon and Rača Ten are traditional running events in the Bratislava-Rača borough, offering participants the choice of a half marathon or a 10K. Runners can enjoy a course through the Tbiliská 4 sports complex and the surrounding parts of Rača. The event is suitable for the general public, including recreational runners and more competitive athletes. It is organised by the Bratislava-Rača borough, which provides quality facilities and services for participants.
course_highlights: The course passes through the Tbiliská 4 sports complex in Bratislava-Rača
Choose between the half-marathon and 10K courses
The route passes through the Rača borough in a pleasant urban setting

name: Prešov Running Series 1. kolo
price_range: 10 eur (detský štart), zľava 2 eurá pre poistencov Dôvery
description: Prešov Running, o.z. warmly invites you to Prešov Stars Run 2026, taking place on April 25 in the centre of Prešov. This running evening will take you back to the atmosphere of the 1990s, with music, retro sportswear and fun. Runners can choose from children’s races and 5 km and 10 km courses, accompanied along the way by DJs and a performance by MC Erik. Prešov Stars Run is the first event in the Prešov Running Series 2026, which consists of three separate runs in different parts of the city and its surroundings.
course_highlights: Running courses in the centre of Prešov
Music from DJs during the run
Retro atmosphere with 1990s hits and a performance by MC Erik
additional: Dôvera policyholders can get a €2 discount on the entry fee (excluding children’s races). The discount is non-transferable, and if you are unable to attend, cancellation is possible only by the date specified in the race information. After a warm-up to Cvičme v Rytme with Omnis Vitality, the 5 km and 10 km runners will start. The Prešov Running Series 2026 consists of three separate runs held in April, June and September. The course includes city streets. Online registration is available, and the event features an accompanying programme of music and performances.

name: Gavurky run 2026 + Backyard ultra
description: Gavurky Run 2026 is a running event in Dobrá Niva offering several distances, including the main race, a hobby run, Nordic walking and a Backyard ultra. The races take place on 25 April 2026, with registration and starts at SNP Square. The event is suitable for a wide range of participants, including children, recreational runners and ultramarathoners, with capacity limited to 400 participants. The organizer, ŠPORTKLUB Dobrá Niva, o.z., provides professional event management and timekeeping.
course_highlights: Main race: 10.4 km with 190 m of elevation gain
Backyard ultra: 6.7 km with 132 m of elevation gain; starts at 8:00
Hobby run and Nordic walking: 5.6 km
additional: Registration for the Backyard ultra is from 7:00 to 7:30 at SNP Square. Registration for the main race, hobby run and Nordic walking is from 8:30 to 10:30. Children have separate races, with free on-site registration. Event capacity is 400 runners. Online registration closes on 24 April 2026 at 12:00 or when the limit is reached. Entry fees can be paid online, by bank transfer or on site (for an additional fee). The course includes paved and unpaved roads. Registration is available online and on site. The event also includes children's races and Nordic walking. Participants can look forward to medals, goulash, a raffle and chip timing.

description: Agrotim Race is a running event organized by the Municipality of Zemplínska Nová Ves and AGROTIM spol. s.r.o. It takes place in Zemplínsky Klečenov, beneath the gazebo at Oáza oddychu. The race is open to men and women, with online registration available until April 22, 2025. A discounted entry fee is available for early registration, with a higher fee for registration on site. The event is suitable for runners looking for an enjoyable running experience in a natural setting.
course_highlights: The course runs in Zemplínsky Klečenov, beneath the gazebo at Oáza oddychu
A natural setting suitable for running
Organized by the Municipality of Zemplínska Nová Ves and AGROTIM spol. s.r.o.

The start is beneath the gazebo at Oáza oddychu in Zemplínsky Klečenov. The event is suitable for runners of all levels. Course details are not specified, and the event takes place in a natural setting around Zemplínska Nová Ves.

description: The 1000-Year Run is a running competition organized by SPK Medveď in Spišská Nová Ves. It takes place on 25 April 2026 at the tennis courts by the hospital with polyclinic. The route runs mostly along dirt and forest roads, with the main race covering approximately 9.6 km and 267 m of elevation gain. The event also includes categories for children, adolescents, juniors, Nordic walking, and a run for health. Runners are provided with refreshments on the course and at the finish, including goulash or pirohy and a drink. Registration is available online or by email, and the entry fee is paid on site on race day.
course_highlights: The route runs mostly along dirt and forest roads
Main race: approx. 9.6 km with 267 m of elevation gain
Start at the tennis courts by the hospital with polyclinic
additional: Race-day check-in is from 8:30 to 9:30. The entry fee is paid on site on race day. Each participant is entitled to refreshments at the finish (goulash or pirohy and one drink—beer or Kofola). Results are announced after the last runner finishes, at around 13:30. Registration is also available on site on race day. The main race starts at 11:00, and the children’s races start at 9:30. The event takes place at the tennis courts by the hospital with polyclinic in Spišská Nová Ves.

name: Beh oslobodenia Chtelnice
description: The Chtelnica Liberation Run is a traditional race with an unchanged route. It starts at 1. mája Square and passes through the picturesque surroundings of the Little Carpathians. The course combines asphalt sections with a forest path running past the Chtelnica Reservoir, a memorial to those who fell in World War II, and the Chapel of St. Roch. Runners can enjoy natural scenery and challenges such as the legendary steep climb on the forest section. The event is suited to runners looking for a mix of asphalt and natural terrain in peaceful mountain surroundings.
course_highlights: The route passes through the beautiful surroundings of the Little Carpathians
Section alongside the Chtelnica Reservoir
Forest path with a memorial to the fallen and the Chapel of St. Roch
additional: Online registration and timing are provided by SunBell s.r.o. - VysledkovyServis.sk. Online registration closes on 24.04.2025 at 23:59. After this time, registration may be available at the venue on race day if the participant limit has not been reached. Competitors take part at their own risk and must have health insurance. The course is marked with white markings on the asphalt and white ribbons in the forest. The use of racing spikes is not recommended because of the asphalt sections. Registration is available online or at the venue. The event is part of the Chtelnica Liberation celebrations and is the 41st edition of the event.

name: Čirov beh – Radobica
description: Čirov Run - Radobica is a traditional village race offering runners the chance to enjoy varied terrain on a 5.4 km course with 201 metres of elevation gain. The route follows asphalt roads, village streets, dirt roads, hills, flat sections and through small forests, including a short, steep section. The event also includes 800-metre children's races, suitable for younger runners. It takes place in Radobica, in front of the municipal office, and is open to various age groups, including local runners. The organizers offer cash prizes for breaking course records.
course_highlights: 5.4 km course with +201 m elevation gain
Varied terrain: asphalt, village streets, dirt roads, hills, flat sections and small forests
Children's races: 800 m with no elevation gain
additional: The race award ceremony takes place at 17:15. Categories include various age groups for men, women and youth. The overall winner and the winner of the women's category may receive cash prizes for breaking course records (€150 and €100). The start is in front of the municipal office in Radobica. Participants take part at their own risk. The race is suitable for all age groups, and registration is available on site. The event begins in the afternoon and includes various categories and accompanying activities.

name: Jablonická desiatka – Memoriál Felixa Rímeša
description: Jablonická desiatka - Felix Rímeš Memorial is a running race organized by ŠK Jablonica and the Municipality of Jablonica, held near the Health Centre in Jablonica. The race offers categories for children, youth, juniors, and adults, with various age categories for men and women. The children’s races start at 14:30, and the races for youth, juniors, and adults start at 17:00. The event is an opportunity for runners of all ages to take part in a traditional race in pleasant surroundings.
course_highlights: Course through the Malé Karpaty Protected Landscape Area with beautiful views
Categories for all age groups, including children and veterans
Main events: 10 km and 4 km races
additional: The children’s races start at 14:30, and the races for youth, juniors, and adults start at 17:00. Categories include children’s, school-age, youth, and junior categories, as well as men’s and women’s categories in various age groups. The event is part of regional running cups and also offers goulash and a pleasant atmosphere after the races. Registration is available through the contacts on the website.

The event is designed for the whole family, is suitable for children and offers wheelchair access. Runners can enjoy an active way to spend their free time in the pleasant surroundings of the village. The entry fee is symbolic, and children and young people can participate for free.
course_highlights: Running memorial in honour of Felix Rímeš in the village of Jablonica
Wheelchair access and suitable for children
Pleasant surroundings of the village of Jablonica

It includes categories for children, young people and adults, with courses of various lengths, and is suitable for families and running enthusiasts.

Proceeds from the run go to the civic association Čiernouško, which helps homeless, abused, and animals in need. The event is organized by the civic association Čiernouško and STG Nové Zámky, and is suitable for animal lovers and runners who want to combine sport with charitable support.

Flat course away from public roads
Start and finish by Berek restaurant, Tatranská Street

The organizers are the civic association Čiernouško and STG Nové Zámky. For information, contact Stanislav Šufliarsky, tel.: 0910 141 546. Mostly asphalt, flat course, away from public roads; include RUN + NAME in the registration note.

name: Sereďský Horalky beh
description: The Seredský HORALKY Run 2026 is a running event held in the beautiful surroundings of the Castle Park in Sereď. The race offers runners of different age groups and ability levels the chance to enjoy a day of sport in nature. The course passes through the picturesque park and surrounding countryside, making it an enjoyable experience for all participants. The organizers welcome all runners and sports fans to this traditional event.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Castle Park in Sereď
Natural surroundings with picturesque views
Suitable for runners of different age groups and ability levels
additional: The event takes place in the Castle Park and its surroundings. Online registration is available, and activities for children, health and prevention zones, and a prize raffle are planned.

The event offers a sporting atmosphere full of music and energy, while children’s races are free and require no registration. The day is filled with sporting activities, culminating in an evening run with a mass start at Svätopluk Square.

5 km and 10 km courses for runners, plus 5 km Nordic Walking
Free children’s races in the city centre

The event is limited to 1,000 participants, so advance registration is recommended. Children’s races are free and require no registration; every young participant receives a medal. There will be music and a sporting atmosphere in the city centre during the evening run. The course will be illuminated in the evening. DJ, parking nearby, changing rooms, refreshments, medical service, headphones permitted. The course runs through the city centre over a mixed surface. Time limit: 2 hours.

description: La Petrovaselo in the Vineyard is a sporting event dedicated to running in nature, organized to promote a healthy lifestyle and encourage more people to take up outdoor running. Organized by the Alergotura Sports Club Association in partnership with Petro Vaselo Winery, the event offers three races of varying distances on scenic routes through the Petro Vaselo vineyard. Participants can enjoy an outdoor sporting experience on well-marked courses with aid stations, in a friendly and well-organized setting. After the race, participants are invited to relax with goulash and wine, offered on presentation of their race number.
course_highlights: Nature running routes through the vineyard, with distances of 5 km, 14 km, and 28 km
The 28 km route consists of two laps of the 14 km route, with the second lap run in the opposite direction
The routes are marked with tape and signs, with volunteers at direction-change points
additional: Participants should arrive at least 30 minutes before the start at Petrovaselo Winery. The 14 km and 28 km races start at 09:00, and the 5 km race starts at 09:15. Each race has a finish time limit (5 km – 10:15, 14 km – 11:05, 28 km – 13:00). After the race, participants receive goulash and wine on presentation of their race number. Depending on the weather, parts of the routes may be muddy. Transfers between races are permitted before the start, subject to availability. Participants can register and check the participant list online; the event combines sport with the vineyard scenery of the Recaș area.

name: The Color Run București
description: The Color Run Bucharest is an untimed 5 km race full of color and energy, celebrating health, joy, and originality. Participants start in white clothing and are showered with colored powder at every kilometer, culminating in a vibrant party at the finish. The event takes place on April 25, 2026, in Bucharest, along Bd. Unirii and the surrounding areas, offering a festive experience for all ages. It is a celebration of movement and community, featuring special moments such as the colored powder cloud and live music.
course_highlights: A 5 km route along Bd. Unirii and the surrounding areas of Bucharest
Colored-powder stations at every kilometer
A colored powder cloud at the finish, accompanied by music
additional: Race kits can be picked up at Mega Mall Bucharest between April 18 and 24, with extended hours. Access to the event area begins at 12:00, staggered starts take place between 14:00 and 14:20, and the colored powder cloud takes place from 16:00 to 16:15. Children aged 0–6 can participate for free without a kit, and multiple participants can be registered by adding them to the form. The event is untimed and open to all ages; people with disabilities also receive free access. The route includes urban areas; registration includes medals and colored powder; the event has multiple start waves and kit pickup points.

name: Maratonul Codrului
description: The 5th edition of Maratonul Codrului is an event organized by Club Sportiv Pro Racers and the Romanian Cycling Federation, taking place on 25 April 2026 at Lake Oţeloaia, Satu Mare. It is a competition for both amateurs and professionals, featuring MTB and Trail Run events on spectacular forest routes, with challenges for all levels. The event offers new, more challenging MTB routes, as well as hobby events with shorter routes to encourage participation. There is also a special race for children, and participants receive a race pack, timing, hydration points, medical assistance, a pasta party, and finisher medals.
course_highlights: New, more challenging MTB routes, without the road section in the final 5 km
Varied Trail Run routes from 6 km to 43.5 km, with significant climbs
Kids Race for children, with a 2 km route and 70 m of elevation gain
additional: The entry fee includes a race pack with a race number and sponsor products, on-course photos, hydration points along the route and at the finish, emergency medical and mountain rescue services, timing, a finisher medal, and a pasta party. Routes may be modified up until race day. MTB and Trail Run routes, age categories, online registration, finisher medals, technical T-shirts, an event for families and the community

name: Forest Race Marghita
location: Str. Tudor Vladimirescu Nr.73, Marghita, Bihor County, Romania
description: Forest Race Marghita is a moderately difficult trail running competition held in the deciduous forest near the city of Marghita. The event is organized by Clubul Sportiv Run For Freedom together with Clubul Sportiv XTERRA Sport Bihor and offers four different routes suited to various levels of runners. The start and finish are at Freedom Adventure Park, and the routes are clearly marked along forest roads. The competition promotes a healthy lifestyle and respect for the environment.
course_highlights: Routes on properly marked forest roads
Moderate elevation gains: 460 m for the half marathon, 230 m for the cross, and 20 m for the mini
Start and finish at Freedom Adventure Park
additional: The official T-shirt is not included in the price and cannot be ordered through registration; it costs 100 lei and must be purchased separately. Participants under 18 must present a medical certificate and parental consent. Organizers may withdraw competitors who are intoxicated or do not have appropriate equipment. Registration is available exclusively through the official webshop. Trail-running routes in the forest, three different routes, organized by local sports clubs, first edition in spring 2022

name: RotaRUN for Charity
price_range: taxa de înscriere (specific amount not provided)
description: RotaRUN for Charity is a sports and charity event organized by Rotary Club Cluj-Napoca, combining running with community involvement to support the renovation of the Pediatric Oncology Department at the „Prof. Dr. Ion Chiricuță” Oncology Institute in Cluj-Napoca. The event on April 25, 2026, includes 3 km and 9 km races and a 2-hour race, giving participants the opportunity to run for a good cause and help create a modern, welcoming environment for children with cancer. Participants receive a race kit with a T-shirt, race bib, and timing chip, as well as access to hydration and refreshment stations. All funds raised from entry fees go toward completing the renovation of the Pediatric Oncology Department.
course_highlights: Running course along the Someș Promenade, Cluj-Napoca
3 km race (one lap of the course) and RotaRun 9 km (three laps of the course)
Long Run — a 2-hour endurance race
additional: T-shirt size is guaranteed for registrations made by April 10, 2026; after that date, sizes will be allocated in registration order, subject to availability. Participants receive a race bib and timing chip, and access to hydration and refreshment stations offering sweet and savory foods, isotonic drinks, and supplements. The top three male and female finishers in each race will be awarded, both in the Open category and by age group. The event also supports the purchase of modern furniture and medical equipment for the Pediatric Oncology Department, as a community fundraising and awareness project.

name: Maratonul Vinului powered by OMV Petrom
description: Maratonul Vinului powered by OMV Petrom is Romania’s first charitable mountain biking race, now in its 14th edition. The event takes place in the town of Urlați, Prahova County, on April 25, 2026, among the area’s hills, vineyards, and wineries. Participants can choose from several routes suited to their ability, ranging from 4 km for children to 50 km for experienced cyclists. The race promotes cycling as a healthy lifestyle and supports important social causes.
course_highlights: 50 km route for experienced cyclists
30 km route for amateur cyclists and juniors
18 km route recommended for less experienced cyclists
additional: The children’s races (4 and 8 km) start at 09:00, the 18, 30, and 50 km routes at 10:35, and the Family Ride at 10:45. Race packs can be collected in Bucharest and at the venue during specified time slots. Family Ride participants do not receive a race kit and may go directly to the start. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 15:00, and the cutoff time is 16:30. The event also includes activities for families and children, supports social and educational causes, and promotes wine culture and local tourism.

name: RotaRun 2026
description: RotaRun for Charity is a sports and charity event organized by Rotary Club Cluj-Napoca, combining running with community involvement to support children with cancer. The event on 25 April 2026 aims to complete the renovation of the Pediatric Oncology Department at the “Prof. Dr. Ion Chiricuță” Oncology Institute in Cluj-Napoca. Participants can choose from several races, ranging from a 3 km run to a 2-hour race, all held along the Someș Promenade, with the start and finish near the “Horia Demian” Sports Hall. All funds collected from registration fees go directly to the charity project.
course_highlights: Route along the Someș Promenade in Cluj-Napoca
3 km run (one lap) and RotaRun 9 km (three laps)
Long Run — a 2-hour race covering the maximum distance possible
additional: T-shirt size is guaranteed for registrations made by 10 April 2026; after that, sizes are allocated while supplies last. Participants receive a race number and timing chip, access to hydration and refreshment stations, and photos at the start/finish and along the route. The top three male and female finishers in each event will be awarded prizes in both the Open and age categories. The event supports the renovation of the Pediatric Oncology Department; details about the route and registration are expected to be announced soon.

description: La Petrovaselo in the Vineyard is a sporting event dedicated to trail running, organised to promote a healthy lifestyle and encourage more people to run outdoors. The event takes place in Recaș, Romania, and features three races on scenic vineyard trails, covering 5 km, 14 km and 28 km. Participants can enjoy a friendly atmosphere supported by the community and local partners, with refreshment stations and a chance to socialise after the race. The routes are well marked and designed for comfort and safety, and the event is organised with the support of local authorities and sponsors.
course_highlights: Vineyard trails in a natural setting, covering 5 km, 14 km and 28 km
The 28 km course consists of two laps of the 14 km route, with the second lap run in the opposite direction
The routes are marked with tape and signs, with volunteers at points where the direction changes
additional: Participants must arrive at Crama Petrovaselo at least 30 minutes before the start. Participation kits are limited to 1,000 in total, with specific allocations for each race. After the race, participants can enjoy goulash and wine by presenting their race number. Depending on the weather, some sections of the routes may be muddy. Transfers between races are permitted before the start, subject to availability. The event includes trail activities and cultural races, and is open to runners of all levels. Registration and race details are available online.

name: 140 BPM - 25 aprilie 2026
location: Parcul Regele Mihai I (Herăstrău), București, Romania
description: 140 BPM is a running race held in King Michael I Park (Herăstrău) in Bucharest, scheduled for April 25, 2026. The event offers routes for all ages, including races for children and adults, over distances of 3 km and 6 km. The routes are designed to be accessible and enjoyable, following the park paths and offering a recreational and competitive outdoor experience. Participants can enjoy a friendly atmosphere and facilities dedicated to runners.
course_highlights: 3 km route for children (Snails / Bunnies) – one 1.5 km out-and-back loop
6 km route for adults (Tortoises) – one 6 km loop
Located in King Michael I Park (Herăstrău), an attractive urban natural setting
additional: The children’s race follows a short route, 1.5 km out and back, while the adults’ race is one 6 km loop. The event has a history of previous editions in the same park, with photo galleries and results available online. The event also includes results and photo galleries from previous editions, offering an opportunity to socialize and promote an active lifestyle.

name: Šumadija Trejl Staza Snage (Gledićke Planine)
description: Šumadija Trail: Trail of Strength is a demanding race through the unspoiled nature of the Gledić Mountains, with two courses that test runners’ strength and endurance. The longer course, Prkos, is 17.5 km long with 1,000 m of elevation gain, while the shorter course, Zamah, is 8 km long with 450 m of elevation gain. The race combines steep climbs and technical descents, offering a unique challenge and an opportunity to enjoy Šumadija’s hospitality. The start and finish are at Adžine Livade, and runners receive a generous race pack and a surprise lunch.
course_highlights: Prkos course: 17.5 km with 1,000 m of elevation gain
Zamah course: 8 km with 450 m of elevation gain
Highest point: Cerovi Peak at 775 m; lowest point: 330 m
additional: Race-pack collection is available only on race day, from 08:00 to 09:45 in the start area. Time limits are 5h30min for Prkos and 3h30min for Zamah. The race pack includes a medal, a dry-fit shirt, a chip-equipped race bib, refreshments, professional photos, a marked course, aid stations, and a surprise lunch. Prizes are prepared for the top finishers on the shorter course, separately for men and women. The event is scheduled for 25 April 2026, at Kragujevac / Adžine Livade. More information will be available on the organizer’s Instagram page.

description: Staza snage is a trail race in the beautiful natural surroundings of Adžine Livade, for runners who want to push their limits and experience challenging terrain. The race has two courses: Prkos, 17.5 km with 1,000 m of elevation gain, and Zamah, 8 km with 450 m of elevation gain. The course combines steep climbs and technical descents down water channels, requiring sure footing, concentration, and courage. At the finish, the winner is not the fastest runner, but the one who has conquered the course and its strength. The race starts on April 25, 2026, in Adžine Livade: the longer course starts at 10:00 and the shorter one at 10:30.
course_highlights: Prkos course: 17.5 km with 1,000 m of elevation gain (5%+-)
Zamah course: 8.0 km with 450 m of elevation gain (5%+-)
Technical descents down water channels requiring sure footing and concentration
additional: Each participant receives a race pack with a race number and chip, a T-shirt, refreshments at checkpoints and the finish, a marked course, a GPX track, and a finisher medal. No additional registration is available after registration closes or on race day. Course distances: 17.5 km and 8 km; elevation gain up to 1,000 m; technical terrain; registration via the MyRace.rs platform. Race packs include T-shirts, medals, and a marked course.

name: 4. Jablanik Trail
description: Jablanik Trail is a UTMB Index race held in Valjevo, Serbia. The race is 34 kilometres long with a total elevation gain of 1,837 metres, offering runners challenging and attractive terrain. The course provides a unique opportunity to experience the natural beauty of western Serbia through its mountainous landscapes. The race brings together experienced runners and trail-running enthusiasts, creating a competitive and friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Course distance: 34 km
Total elevation gain: 1,837 metres
Mountain terrain in western Serbia
additional: Early registration offers discounts before 25 March 2026, and the race is part of a series of events promoting nature and outdoor activities in the region.

name: IX. Miklósi Futónap
distance_verbose: Félmaraton, 8 km, 3.5 km, 1 km, 0.8 km, 0.5 km
description: The 9th Miklósi Running Day is a family-friendly running race in Szigetszentmiklós, taking place on April 26, 2026. It offers several distances, from 500 metres up to the half marathon (21 km). The event starts in front of the City Sports Hall and follows the Szebeni Road, Petőfi Road and Gerincút route before returning to the sports hall. Changing rooms, a cloakroom and toilets are available at the venue. The race aims to promote sport and community for all age groups.
course_highlights: Route starts in front of and returns to the City Sports Hall
Szebeni Road – Petőfi Road – Gerincút route
Distances: 500 m, 800 m, 1,000 m, 3.5 km, 8 km, 21 km (half marathon)
additional: Race-pack pickup and the information point are located at the entrance to the City Sports Hall. Changing rooms, a cloakroom and toilets are available in the sports hall. There is no on-site registration or in-person late registration on race day. Registration is online only, with payment by bank card through the Barion system. Children under 6 may enter the 500 m distance only when accompanied by an adult. The organizers may limit the number of participants. The event offers categories for several age groups and types of runners; online registration is required to participate. The event includes timing, refreshment stations and parking.

name: III. Strázsa-hegyi Trail Futóverseny 2 / 5 / 10 / 21
location: Monor, Strázsahegyi dűlő, Pest County, Hungary
description: The III Strázsa-hegyi Toyota Kovács Trail Running Race will take place on April 26, 2026, in the Strázsahegyi dűlő area of Monor. Participants can choose from a 500-meter family run, 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, and half-marathon distances. Runners can tackle the courses on varied terrain in a nature-rich setting. The event aims to promote a love of sport and nature in a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Nature-rich trail routes around Monor
10 km and half-marathon distances available
A 500-meter family run for the youngest participants
additional: Entries are accepted until April 12. GPX maps of the 10 km and half-marathon routes are available on the race’s official website. Online registration is available, and the event welcomes participants with local food and wine in a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: STRÁZSA-HEGYI TRAIL
location: Szent Orbán tér, Monor, Pest County, Hungary
description: The III Strázsa-hegy Toyota Kovács Trail Running Race will take place on April 26, 2026, at Szent Orbán Square in Monor. For the third time, runners will test their strength on varied terrain around scenic Strázsa Hill. The race offers a challenge for all participants in a welcoming atmosphere and a natural setting. The event celebrates sport and community, and welcomes running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Natural surroundings and varied terrain around Strázsa Hill
Challenging trail running routes
Start location: Szent Orbán Square, Monor
additional: The race will take place on April 26, 2026, from 08:00 to 15:00 at Szent Orbán Square in Monor. It is part of the Toyota Kovács Trail Running Race series and will be held for the third time. The event provides chip timing, free bus services, and parking. The registration deadline is April 12.

name: ÍROTTKŐ HILLCLIMB
location: Kőszeg Rőtfalva, Kőszeg, Vas County, Hungary
description: The Írottkő Hillclimb is a varied and memorable mountain running race, taking place on April 26, 2026, near Rőtfalva in Kőszeg. The race has a new start location in Bozsok and offers runners several distances, from a 7 km introductory trail run to the 102 km Alpokalja Ultra. The courses take participants across varied terrain, with beautiful views and aid stations, and require stamina and good physical preparation. The race also offers family-friendly activities, so even the youngest visitors can enjoy nature-conservation and interactive exhibitions.
course_highlights: A new start location in Bozsok as the race continues to evolve
A 23 km distance with 780 metres of elevation gain and wonderful views from the summit of Írottkő
The 102 km Alpokalja Ultra, taking in the most spectacular spots in the Kőszeg Mountains
additional: The race starts from a new location in Bozsok, and the course has several aid stations and water-refill points. The 23 km distance includes 780 metres of elevation gain, with panoramic views from the summit of Írottkő. The 102 km distance can also be completed as a team, making the shared finish a special experience. The youngest visitors can enjoy an interactive exhibition and nature-conservation activities. The race is semi-self-supported, and runners must carry mandatory equipment, such as a mobile phone, a water container, a windproof or rain jacket, a headlamp and a spare battery. The race showcases the natural beauty of the Kőszeg Mountains across varied terrain, with a new start in Bozsok, and offers people of different ages and ability levels the opportunity to take part.

name: FUTAPEST TEREPFUTÁS
description: The Futapest Terepfutás Bér race is an exciting trail-running event held in the scenic surroundings of Bér, Virágospuszta. Runners can test their strength on varied routes close to nature, enjoying its beauty and the challenging terrain. The race is organized by Futapest Klub, which has supported trail running and cross-country running in Hungary for many years. All runners are warmly welcome to join this friendly, community-focused event.
course_highlights: Varied terrain close to nature around Bér, Virágospuszta
Challenging hilly sections and forest trails
Scenic landscape and fresh air for runners
additional: The race offers several distances and is intended for people who enjoy nature and sport. Detailed information is available on the website.

description: The Run for A(tra)ktívny Bardejov is a charity run that brings together the community in Bardejov and the surrounding area every year. The event takes place in Radničné Square and offers participants the opportunity to support four selected projects through their entry fees. Runners can compete in person or take part virtually from anywhere in the world. The atmosphere is enhanced by a live music performance and a family run for children under 6, making the event suitable for all age groups.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Radničné Square in Bardejov
Virtual run option with a minimum distance of 2 km
Family run for children under 6, with a medal and a sweet treat at the finish
additional: The charity run is part of the A(tra)ktívny Bardejov grant programme. Each runner supports one of four projects, which receive grants funded by entry fees, sponsorship donations and a contribution from the foundation. The event also includes a raffle with gifts from partners and an MC. Runners from different regions and even from Poland can take part. The event is suitable for all age groups, registration is available online, and participants can also join virtually. It supports community and health.

description: The Šamorín Running League is a series of running races organized by 3klub Šamorín in the beautiful surroundings of Pomlé Forest Park. The league is open to the general public, with no age or performance limits. Men, women and children compete in various categories. The entry fee includes timekeeping, race bibs and refreshments at the finish. Competitors collect points throughout the year, and at the end of the league the top runners are recognized according to an age coefficient. The league is ideal for anyone who wants to compete regularly and improve their performance in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Pomlé Forest Park — a natural setting ideal for running
Various categories, including children’s races over shorter distances
Main adult races of 3 km, 5 km and 1.5 km, depending on the lap
additional: The entry fee includes race bibs, timekeeping, refreshments at the finish and league scoring throughout the year. Children do not pay an entry fee. Check-in is open from 9:00 until 30 minutes before each category’s start. Toilets and a changing room are available at the amphitheatre. The league is officially recognized during the final round. Preschoolers receive a medal after finishing, with no results recorded. The route is in the park. Registration is available online or on site. There are no age or performance limits.

name: Beh oslobodenia obce Chocholná-Velčice
location: Pred hasičskou zbrojnicou, Chocholná-Velčice, Trenčín, Slovakia
description: The Liberation Run of Chocholná-Velčice is a traditional sporting event, taking place for the 52nd time on Sunday, April 26, 2026. It is organized by the Municipality of Chocholná-Velčice, Jednota Sokol, DHZ Chocholná-Velčice, and SOŠ dopravná Trenčín. The race starts in front of the fire station in the village and is open to all sports enthusiasts. The event is suitable for children and is wheelchair accessible, ensuring access for all participants.
course_highlights: Start in front of the fire station in Chocholná-Velčice
Wheelchair-accessible event
Suitable for children
additional: The event lasts approximately 270 minutes and is organized in cooperation with local organizations, including Jednota Sokol and the Voluntary Fire Brigade. The start is in front of the fire station in Chocholná-Velčice. The event is part of the municipality’s events calendar, is wheelchair accessible and suitable for children, and allows pets. It is scheduled for April 26, 2026, includes various categories for all age groups, and features accompanying activities, including a historical lecture and a memorial ceremony.

name: Beh oslobodenia Bodíc
location: Kultúrny dom Bodice, Bodice, Liptovský Mikuláš, Slovakia
