description: The Bodice Liberation Run is a traditional running race held in Bodice, a district of the city of Liptovský Mikuláš, with its hub at the Bodice Cultural Centre. The race also serves as the Slovak Forest Running Championships and offers categories for children, youth, juniors, women and men across various age groups. The children’s race starts at 9:00, the youth and adult races at 10:25, and the main men’s category at 11:30. The event is organised by Bežecký klub Bodice and Olympijský klub Liptova, offering a quality sporting experience in pleasant surroundings.
course_highlights: Slovak Forest Running Championships
Race held in Bodice, a district of Liptovský Mikuláš
Bodice Cultural Centre serves as the start and finish
additional: The children’s race starts at 9:00, the youth and adult races at 10:25, and the men’s A, B and C categories start at 11:30. Categories are divided by age and gender, with several age groups. The event is organised by Bežecký klub Bodice and Olympijský klub Liptova. For information, contact Ing. Štefan Ganoczy, PhD, tel.: 0905 522 651, 044/5549058. City run, categories for children, youth and adults, various age groups, start from 9:00.

name: Beh za A(tra)ktívny Bardejov
description: Run for A(tra)ctive Bardejov is a running race held in the picturesque town of Bardejov in the Prešov Region. The course is approximately 6 km long and offers runners of all levels the opportunity to enjoy a day of sport in pleasant surroundings. The race is part of Slovakia’s running season and is suitable for the general public interested in physical activity and a community sporting event.
course_highlights: A 6 km course around Bardejov
A race suitable for the general public
Picturesque surroundings in the Prešov Region
additional: The event offers various starting options, including a virtual run, and supports community and charitable projects in Bardejov.

name: URME PE PLAY
price_range: prima înscriere este gratuită, alte detalii nu sunt specificate
description: Urme pe Play is a mountain running competition held in the commune of Rășinari, at the foot of the Cindrel and Lotru Mountains. The marked routes include natural trails, forest roads, and asphalt, offering an authentic sub-mountain experience. The event is open to both adults and children, with races for each age group. Participants can enjoy picturesque scenery and the friendly atmosphere of the local community at an event that combines sport with local culture and tradition.
course_highlights: Routes along marked trails in Rășinari and the hills at the foot of the Cindrel and Lotru Mountains
Varied terrain: asphalt, forest roads, natural trails, and meadows
Picturesque spring scenery at the foot of the mountains
additional: Participation is at your own risk, and participants must sign a liability waiver. The minimum age is 14 for the Fuguț race and 18 for the Cros, Semi, Maraton, and Ultra Maraton races. Children under 14 may participate in dedicated races. The registration pack is not mailed. The organizer may prohibit a participant from starting or continuing the race if they are not in suitable physical condition. The event also includes cultural activities, hikes, and a local products fair, offering an opportunity to discover the traditions and beauty of the Rășinari area.

name: Takovski grm
description: Takovski Grm is a 13.5 km road race taking place on April 26, 2026, starting in Takovo and finishing in Gornji Milanovac. The race runs through Takovo’s historic natural surroundings and along a newly opened route, with plenty of uphill and downhill sections, offering both a challenge and the pleasure of enjoying the natural beauty. The organizers invite runners to take part and enjoy running together, the results, and socializing at the finish. All participants who complete the race receive a finisher’s medal, while the top runners are awarded cash prizes and trophies.
course_highlights: A 13.5 km road race starting in Takovo and finishing in Gornji Milanovac
A route through Takovo’s historic natural surroundings and along a newly opened trail
Significant uphill and downhill sections
additional: Race-pack pickup from 7:00 to 8:30 in Gornji Milanovac. Organized transport to the start in Takovo at 8:30. Refreshments during and after the race. Awards ceremony at 12:30 in central Gornji Milanovac. Participants run at their own risk. The event includes timekeeping, medals, T-shirts, and other logistical arrangements for participants.

name: Etyekrun
organizer: RUNaway Sportszervező Kft. és Etyek Trend
description: EtyekRUN is a unique running race in the rolling hills of Etyek, where the atmosphere of the wine region, its vineyards, rows of vines and spring scenery accompany participants every step of the way. The race is part of the Garmin WTF series, which celebrates the joy of movement and the diversity of athletic achievements, with both shorter road distances and longer trail-running routes. The event is family-friendly, and sustainability, consistency and enjoyment are at the heart of the community. Participants will have a unique experience amid the beauty of nature and the wine region.
course_highlights: A route through the rolling hills of Etyek, among rows of vines and vineyards
Spring scenery and the atmosphere of the wine region
Mixed terrain: road and trail running
additional: Discounted family registration is available, allowing one adult to register up to 5 family members. Family registration does not include a medal by default, but one can be ordered for an additional fee. Registration cannot be cancelled, but it can be transferred to another race no later than 21 days before the event. The registration system automatically sends an invoice, and several payment methods are available. The Garmin WTF series puts sustainability and a sense of community first. Participants can choose from several distances, and free Pilates classes, local wines and food will be available in connection with the event. The race is an ideal event for lovers of vineyards and nature.

name: XI. Ezerjó Félmaraton 5 / 10 / 21
location: Mór, Szent István tér, Mór, Hungary
description: The 11th Ezerjó Half Marathon will take place on May 1, 2026, in Mór, at Szent István Square. The event offers three distances: 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon (21 km). Runners can take on the routes through beautiful vineyards across varied terrain, with climbs and panoramic views. The event is family-friendly and also welcomes younger participants with children’s races. Finishers are rewarded with refreshments and a finisher’s medal. The event’s distinctive atmosphere comes from the local wine region and the sense of community.
course_highlights: 5 km route within Mór, with minimal elevation gain on easy terrain
10 km route through vineyards, following a hilly and varied course
21 km half marathon with long climbs, views of Csókakő Castle, and downhill sections
additional: The start area is in front of Mór Town Hall. Start times: half marathon at 10:00, 5 km at 10:05, and 10 km at 10:10. The entry fee includes participation, a finisher’s medal, chip timing, refreshments, a fröccs station, coffee, and ice cream at the finish. The race is cup-free as part of its commitment to environmental protection. Children’s races will also take place in Szent István Park, with separate age groups and awards. The half marathon uses chip timing, with a UHF chip attached to the back of the race bib. Technical and cotton T-shirts can be ordered for an additional fee during advance registration. Scenery: park and city streets. Advance registration is open until April 20; on-site registration is available at higher fees. Children’s races. A finisher’s medal is not guaranteed for on-site registrations.

name: 50. Komárom-Komárno Nemzetközi Utcai Futóverseny
location: Komárom, Szabadság tér, Komárom-Esztergom megye, Hungary
description: The 50th Komárom-Komárno International Street Race is a traditional international running event held in two countries within one city. Participants can choose between 5.5 km and 10 km races, as well as a children’s race. The event is open to both competitive and recreational runners. The race starts at Szabadság Square in South Komárom and finishes at the sports hall in North Komárom. Its aims are to promote running, strengthen the running community, and support a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: The course runs through the streets of North and South Komárom, crossing two countries within one city
5.5 km and 10 km distances, as well as a 200-metre children’s race
The finish is at the sports hall in North Komárom
additional: Race-pack collection is available on race day: by 9:15 at the latest for the 10 km race and by 9:45 for the 5.5 km race. The children’s race is for participants aged 10 or younger. The time limits are 1 hour 30 minutes for the 10 km race and 45 minutes for the 5.5 km race. The awards ceremony takes place at 11:30 at the sports hall in North Komárom. The participant limit is 1,500. Several thousand people take part in the event, and registration is open until April 25. The race is part of the Komárom Days events and the course passes several points around the city, including the area around Szabadság Square and the North Komárom Municipal Sports Hall.

name: KOMÁROM – KOMÁRNO FUTÓVERSENY
description: The Komárom-Komárno International Street Running Race is an open, recreational running event held on the streets of the cities of North and South Komárom—two countries, one city. The event offers 5.5 km and 10 km distances, as well as children’s races, and welcomes both competitive and recreational runners. Its aim is to promote running, strengthen the sense of belonging to the running community, and support healthy living. The start is at Szabadság Square in South Komárom, and the finish is at the City Sports Hall in North Komárom. The event is a longstanding international tradition that also strengthens cooperation between the two cities.
course_highlights: Street course through the districts of North and South Komárom, in two countries
5.5 km and 10 km distances, plus children’s races
Start: Szabadság Square, South Komárom; finish: City Sports Hall, North Komárom
additional: Race-pack pickup on race day: by 9:45 at the latest for the 5.5 km distance and by 9:15 for the 10 km distance. The event aims to strengthen the running community and promote healthy living. The mayors of the two cities are the event’s patrons. Race directors and local race coordinators oversee the organization. The event takes place on May 1, 2026; registration is open, and detailed information is available on the official websites. The event brings together the local community and international runners.

name: FUT AZ ÜLLŐ
description: “Fut az Üllő” is a traditional urban running race held in the city center of Üllő. The race aims to promote sport and community life and is open to all age groups. A limited number of on-site registrations will also be available on race day from 7:00 a.m. The event is organized by the Municipality of Üllő, which ensures its success with the support of the local community.
course_highlights: Running course in the city center
Community-oriented, family-friendly event
On-site registration available on race day

description: Varín Forest Run is a running event in the foothills of the Malá Fatra, offering scenic routes with views of the Malá Fatra ridge. Runners can choose between a longer 13.7 km route with 600 m of elevation gain and a shorter 6.5 km route with 120 m of elevation gain. The event is ideal for runners and nature lovers who want to enjoy a run in picturesque surroundings. The programme also includes children’s races, and a prize raffle is held after the results are announced. The organisers are Žilinský pedál, XIRIS, AUTOSKLO Stehlík and the municipality of Varín.
course_highlights: The route runs through the foothills of the Malá Fatra, with views of the Malá Fatra ridge
The long route is 13.7 km with 600 m of elevation gain
The short route is 6.5 km with 120 m of elevation gain
additional: Race registration is open from 7:30 to 9:45 at the J. Sobola Sports Complex in Varín. The briefing is at 9:55 for the long course and at 10:15 for the short course. The short course starts at 10:20, and the children’s races begin at 10:30. The results announcement and prize raffle are scheduled for 13:30. Race registration is on Saturday from 7:30 to 9:45; the long course starts at 10:00, the short course at 10:20, the children’s races at 10:30, and the results are announced at 13:30. The routes run through the foothills of the Malá Fatra, with views of the Malá Fatra ridge.

The races offer a marathon, a half marathon, and a half-marathon relay, suitable for a wide range of participants, including experienced runners and recreational athletes. The organizers provide quality services, including electronic timing, refreshments along the course and at the finish, stylish T-shirts, and finisher medals. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and support for the regional running community.

Electronic chip timing for accurate results
Refreshments along the course and at the finish, including fruit, water, Kofola, and beer

Men over 70 and women over 60 receive a €5 discount when registering by 28.4.2026. Winners from the previous edition can enter for free if they register by 28.4.2026. The event includes a marathon, a half marathon, and relay races, with detailed information about the course, rules, and prices on the official website.

Runners can compete on certified courses in men’s and women’s categories, with various age groups. The organizer encourages online registration and provides refreshments and medals for all participants.

The event also offers children’s races and activities in the safe surroundings of the start and finish area. It is organized by the Čachtické podzemie civic association together with its partners and the municipality of Žitná-Radiša.

The race takes place at the football field in Žitná-Radiša, with a choice of 14 km and 5 km courses, as well as categories for children and students.

name: Behaj lesmi – Smolenice

The routes pass below Smolenice Castle, where themed characters cheer on the runners and create a unique atmosphere. You can compete on two main routes—12 km and 19 km—with a Conti Speed Section on the course offering a valuable prize.

name: Beh oslobodenia obce Budča
description: The Budča Liberation Run is a traditional running race held in the village of Budča to commemorate its liberation. The main race is 8.4 km long with 232 metres of elevation gain and follows a route around the village on forest roads and asphalt, starting and finishing by the municipal office. The event also includes children’s categories with shorter courses adapted to the runners’ ages, as well as the “Ride for Health” category, open to everyone regardless of age or ability. The race is part of the Zvolen Running League and offers electronic timing, refreshments and medals for participants.
course_highlights: A loop around the village of Budča through the forest areas of Kremenný Jarok and Sietno
The main race is 8.4 km long with 232 m of elevation gain
A refreshment station at approximately the 4 km mark
additional: The children’s categories start at 10:15, and the “Ride for Health” category starts at 12:05. Runners permanently resident in Budča do not pay an entry fee. The entry fee includes a race bib, electronic chip timing, refreshments at the finish, a participant puzzle medal and prizes for the top three in each category. Registration is available online until 26.4.2024 or in person on race day from 9:00 until half an hour before the start. The race takes place in May. Registration is available online or on site, and the “Ride for Health” category is free of charge.

name: Bucharest International Half Marathon

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Taxa de participare se poate achita ONLINE cu cardul bancar până la data de 12 APRILIE 2026.

description: The Bucharest International Half Marathon by Constantina Diță is an international half marathon held on some of Bucharest’s most beautiful and fastest streets, offering both professional athletes and amateur runners the opportunity to achieve a competitive personal best. The event also includes 10 km races, races for people with mobility impairments, and a 3.5 km fun run for all ages. The race kit includes a bib with chip timing and a finisher’s medal, while the official T-shirt is optional. The organizer is the Constantina Diță Sports Club Association, and the event is supported by major partners such as Decathlon.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course on Bucharest’s main streets
World Athletics Label-certified half marathon course
Dedicated routes for the half marathon, 10 km, people with disabilities, and the fun run
additional: The race kit must be collected in person at the Expo, upon presentation of an ID document. The official T-shirt is optional and can be purchased separately for EUR 15. Participation for wheelchair users is free. The time limit is 3 hours for the half marathon and 1.5 hours for the 10 km race. Some streets will be closed during the event, so using public transport is recommended, especially the metro to Aviatorilor station. The course offers options for running and walking, with the opportunity to take part in record attempts; the event also includes other races, such as the 10 km and relay races.

name: Subcarpați Trail Run
location: Baza Sportivă „Stejarul”, Cocorăștii Mislii, Prahova, Romania
distance_verbose: 50 mile, Maraton, Maraton, 23 km, Semimaraton, Semimaraton, 5 km

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Categoria de vârstă 14–17 ani beneficiază de taxă redusă: 150 lei pe toată perioada înscrierilor

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Fun Race – 125 lei / persoană, indiferent de vârstă

description: Subcarpați Trail Run is a mountain running competition organized for trail running enthusiasts, offering a unique experience in the heart of Goruna Forest, in the Prahova Subcarpathians. The varied courses, from the Fun Race to the Ultramarathon, test runners’ endurance and perseverance in spectacular natural surroundings. The event brings together amateurs and professionals in a friendly, motivating atmosphere, with the start and finish at the „Stejarul” Sports Base in Cocorăștii Mislii. It is an excellent opportunity to discover the beauty of the area and enjoy running in nature.
course_highlights: Courses through Goruna Forest, with scenery of wooded hills
Distances and difficulty levels vary, from the 4 km Fun Race to the 75 km Ultramarathon with 2,800 m of elevation gain
Start and finish at the „Stejarul” Sports Base in Cocorăștii Mislii
additional: Race kits can be collected on Friday from 16:30 to 21:30 and on Saturday morning, depending on the race. The Ultramarathon starts at 06:00, the Marathon at 10:00, and the Half Marathon and Cross Country Race also at 10:00. The Fun Race starts after 11:45. Cash and product prizes are awarded to winners, including bonuses for course records. Varied courses, start and finish at the „Stejarul” Sports Base, on-site registration available, official photographers on the course.

name: Sălciua Trail Run
location: Sălciua de Jos, Alba County, Romania
description: Sălciua Trail Run 2026 is a trail-running event held in the commune of Sălciua, situated between the Trascău Mountains and Muntele Mare, offering spectacular views. The event brings together people passionate about running, nature, culture and fun, offering an opportunity to escape the everyday and enjoy the beauty of nature with loved ones. The competition includes four races: Cursa Zmeilor (28 km), Crosul Liliecilor (15 km), Family and Young Run (5 km), and Cursa Spiridușilor (400–800 m), open to all participants who meet the age and registration requirements. The organizers provide a complete experience, with race kits, an awards ceremony and themed workshops for all ages.
course_highlights: Routes through nature reserves, hills and meadows
Areas with waterfalls and caves unique to the region
Natural setting between the Trascău Mountains and Muntele Mare, at an altitude of 700–1,400 m
additional: Race kit distribution on race day from 07:00 to 08:30. Starts in order: Crosul Liliecilor (15 km) at 09:00, Family and Young Run (5 km) at 09:30, and Cursa Spiridușilor (400–800 m) at 10:00. The awards ceremony begins at 13:00. The event includes themed workshops for children and adults during breaks. Participation includes various race categories, with details about registration requirements and the schedule; all are scheduled for May 2026.

name: Chindia City Race
location: Piața Tricolorului, Târgoviște, Dâmbovița County, Romania
description: Chindia City Race is a traditional run organized in the heart of the Târgoviște Citadel, right next to the iconic Chindia Tower. The event takes place on May 2, 2026, in Tricolorului Square, bringing together participants of all ages in a festive atmosphere of friendly competition. The start is scheduled for 10:00, and the race celebrates the spirit and history of the city, inviting runners to test their speed and endurance on an energetic urban course steeped in tradition.
course_highlights: Start in Tricolorului Square, in the historic center of Târgoviște
Urban course with views of the Citadel and Chindia Tower
Event for all age groups and fitness levels
additional: The start area is in Tricolorului Square, Târgoviște. The event has a festive atmosphere and is open to everyone, with a recommendation to bring suitable shoes and plenty of stamina. The event is part of Carpat Race and is supported by the local community, offering an opportunity to promote health and physical activity in Târgoviște.

name: Még egy kört / Încă o rundă - Trail challenge
location: Világlátó, Sfântu Gheorghe, Covasna County, Romania
description: Még egy kört este is a trail-running challenge held on the outskirts of Sfântu Gheorghe, in a wooded, hilly area known as “Világlátó.” Participants can run or take part in Nordic walking for 2, 4, or 6 hours, aiming to complete as many 1.6 km laps as possible, each with 60 m of elevation gain. The event is designed as a mental and physical challenge, with a friendly atmosphere, music, and a bar on site. It’s a great opportunity for running enthusiasts and others to test themselves in a natural, welcoming setting.
course_highlights: Wooded, hilly terrain known as “Világlátó”
1.6 km lap with 60 m of elevation gain
2-, 4-, or 6-hour challenge, with a Nordic walking option
additional: Nordic walking poles are available in limited quantities by requesting them via email. There will be music and Wunderbar on site. Each participant receives a starter pack with a race bib and other promotional materials. The event combines running with a mental challenge, with participants aiming to complete as many laps as possible within their chosen time. A trail challenge with 1.6 km loops and running or Nordic walking options, held as part of Szent György Napok.

name: 24. Öntúlszárnyalás maraton
description: The 24th Self-Transcendence Marathon will take place on May 3, 2026, at Malomvölgyi Lake in Pécs. Organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team, this family-friendly race follows a loop course and offers marathon and half-marathon distances. The course runs on compacted forest trails and crushed stone, with 30 meters of elevation gain, giving participants varied terrain to race on. Chip timing ensures accurate results, and the aid stations provide plenty of refreshments.
course_highlights: 5.2 km loop course; the marathon covers 8 laps
Compacted forest trails and crushed stone, with 30 meters of elevation gain
A combination of the walking path around the lake and a marked course
additional: Chip timing uses a chip attached to the back of the bib. The aid station at the start/finish offers isotonic drinks, water, sweet and savoury biscuits, sandwiches, fruit, vegetables and chocolate. Field limit: 250 participants. A T-shirt can be ordered separately for HUF 3,500 until April 15. Cut-off times: 5.2 km — 50 minutes; 10.4 km — 1 hour 40 minutes; half marathon — 3 hours; marathon — 6 hours. Bib and T-shirt collection is available on race day between 7:00 and 7:45; on-site registration is also available during this time. Multiple distances, a forest course, chip timing, on-site and online registration, a participant limit (max. 250), cut-off times and awards by distance, and nearby accommodation offers.

name: Farkasmályi Dűlő és Pince futás
organizer: Gyöngyösi Triatlon Klub, Farkasmályi Borpincék Egyesület
description: The Farkasmály Vineyard and Cellar Run is an atmospheric trail-running race along the vineyard slopes of Farkasmály in Gyöngyös, among vineyards and wine cellars. The event offers challenges over several distances, including a shorter, less hilly 3 km loop and a longer 8.5 km loop with climbs. Runners can enjoy being close to nature, visits to wine cellars, and varied terrain suitable for beginners and experienced runners alike. The event is organized by GYÖTRI Klub, which has decades of experience running sporting events.
course_highlights: Vineyard Loop: 3,000 m, 40 m elevation gain, 2 loops among the vineyard slopes, with a wine-cellar visit
Farkasmály Loop: 8,500 m, 190 m elevation gain, 4 loops with climbs and wine-cellar visits
Relay race: 4 × 1,500 m; Spritzer Run for teams of 3, with an 800 m distance and spritzer drinking stations
additional: Registration and bib pickup from 13:00; on-site registration closes 15 minutes before the start of the relevant race. Parking is available on the grassy area beside the Szilue Hotel. Race location GPS coordinates: 47.805908, 19.955025. Registration for the race is open from April 10 to April 30; prizes and a wine tasting await participants.

name: MÁSODSZOR IS CÉLBA ÉRÜNK!
description: Koraszülöttfutás 2026 is a charity running event that starts in Zalaegerszeg and finishes in Keszthely, covering a total distance of 66 km. Along the way, participants run through the beautiful landscapes of Zala County, with ten relay points, and the entire route is timed using chip timing. The event gives special support to premature babies, and includes a separate run for them. Teams can cross the finish line together to share the experience and the achievement. The start and pasta party venue is the Zala Zone Automotive Test Track. The run takes place on Sunday, May 3.
course_highlights: 66 km between Zalaegerszeg and Keszthely
10 relay points and a refreshment point at the Göcseji Village Museum
The route is marked with small teddy-bear signs and ribbons approximately every 200 metres
additional: Timing is provided by a chip attached to the race bib. The time limit for the distance is 8 hours 30 minutes. The pasta party takes place at the Zala Zone Automotive Test Track on May 2 at 17:00. The route also crosses two railway crossings; participants are escorted by an ambulance across the first one. The run for premature babies takes place on May 3 at 16:00, from the castle park in Keszthely to Fő tér. The event includes several related activities, including registration, race-pack collection, relay points and the finish, and offers the option to enter individually or as a team.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 4. kolo
description: The 2 Mile Run Bratislava is a regular 2-mile (3.218 km) race held at the Kuchajda swimming complex in Bratislava. It is organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team and is open to the general public, including children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. Registration takes place at the venue on race day from 9:30, with the start at 10:00. The race is part of a series in which runners earn points toward a traveling cup based on their categories and performances.
course_highlights: A 2-mile (3.218 km) course at the Kuchajda swimming complex
Race check-in and registration by the volleyball court
Categories for children, juniors, women, men, and veterans
additional: Registration takes place at the venue on race day from 9:30. In the event of a tie in the competition, the best time after applying a coefficient decides the result, followed by shoe size. Competitors can earn an extra point by improving their best time of the year. At the end of the year, the two worst months are removed from the overall results (amnesty). The race takes place on a public road in the Kuchajda area of Bratislava; categories include children, juniors, women, men, and veterans; on-site registration is also available.

name: Beh 2 míle
description: The 2-Mile Run in Bratislava at Kuchajda is a regular 2-mile (3.218 km) race organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team. Check-in and registration take place on site by the volleyball court from 9:30, with the start at 10:00. The race is open to various age categories, including children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. It is part of the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team Traveling Trophy, with finishing times adjusted using age coefficients and runners awarded points based on participation and performance.
course_highlights: A 2-mile (3.218 km) course in the Kuchajda swimming pool grounds
Check-in and start by the volleyball court
Categories for children, juniors, women, men, and veterans
additional: Registration takes place on site by the volleyball court from 9:30. The Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team Traveling Trophy awards points based on participation and performance, with the option to disregard the two worst participations of the year. In the event of a tie, age and the best time that year determine the result. The race takes place at the Kuchajda swimming pool grounds in Bratislava, with registration from 9:30 and the start at 10:00. The Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team Traveling Trophy competition is scored based on points and times, with categories for various age groups.

name: Stropkovská dvadsiatka
description: Stropkovská Dvadsiatka is a traditional road race with a rich history dating back to 1977, held in the town of Stropkov. The course passes through several villages and gives runners the opportunity to compete over a distance of 20 km, with refreshments along the route and at the finish. The event is organised by Klub Bežcov Stropkov, which supports the development of running in the region. Runners can expect good organisation, race packs, and the opportunity to recover after the race at the indoor swimming pool. The race is part of the Michalovce–Sobrance Regional Running League.
course_highlights: The route passes through the villages of Stropkov; refreshments are available at 5 km, 11 km, 16 km, and 19 km.
Finish at Námestie SNP in Stropkov, with refreshments and the option to recover at the indoor swimming pool.
A 20 km road race with a rich history dating back to 1977.
additional: Online registration is open from 01.03.2026 to 30.04.2026. On-site registration is available until 10:30 on race day. The first 150 participants who register and pay the entry fee in full will receive a complete race pack, including a medal. The event is part of the Michalovce–Sobrance Regional Running League. After the race, showers and recovery facilities are available at the indoor swimming pool by ZŠ Konštantínova ul. from 12:30. Event date: 3 May 2026; Location: Námestie SNP, Stropkov. The event includes categories for different age groups and activities such as Nordic walking and barefoot running.

name: Stropkovská desiatka a  I. ročník Barefoot
location: Námestie SNP v Stropkove, Stropkov, Slovakia
description: The Stropkov 10K and the 1st Barefoot edition are part of the traditional road races in Stropkov, which have a rich history dating back to 1977. The event is organised by the Stropkov Runners Club to support running in the region and across Slovakia. Runners can expect well-prepared courses and an atmosphere created each year by hundreds of fans and runners. In addition to the main race, the programme includes a barefoot run, offering participants a new experience.
course_highlights: Road race courses with a rich history dating back to 1977
Courses lined with fans in Stropkov and the surrounding area
The programme also includes a new barefoot run (Barefoot)
additional: The event includes several running disciplines on the same day: the Stropkov 20, Stropkov 10 and 10 Barefoot, Stropkov 5 and 5 Nordic Walking, and the Children's Run for Mum. All main races start at 11:00 at SNP Square in Stropkov. The event offers races over 5 km, 10 km and 20 km, with an emphasis on sporting experiences and a community atmosphere.

name: 2. E.ON Business Run
description: The E.ON Business Run is a special running event held at the National Athletics Centre in Budapest. The race aims to bring together people from the corporate world and everyone interested in a shared active experience, where both individual achievement and team spirit take centre stage. Runners can choose from three options: a 5 km individual run, a 3-person relay (3 × 2.7 km), or a 2 km walking stadium tour. Music, a party and street food accompany the event, making it an unforgettable experience even after the run.
course_highlights: The iconic running track at the National Athletics Centre
Three distance options: 5 km individual run, 3 × 2.7 km relay, and a 2 km walking stadium tour
Run near the Danube, enjoy the stadium experience and soak up the fantastic party atmosphere
additional: Payment at the event is possible by bank card and SZÉP card. Registration requires a BSI account. Finishers receive a unique finisher’s medal. After the race, participants can enjoy a fantastic party, music and street food. Each runner in the 3-person relay completes approximately 2.7 km. Free online training and a charity option are also available at the event. Distances: 5 km, 3-person relay (3 × 2.7 km), stadium tour (2 km walking). The event takes place at the National Athletics Centre in Budapest. Participation is possible with online or on-site registration.

name: E.ON BUSINESS RUN
description: The E.ON Business Run is a special running event taking place on May 6, 2026, at the National Athletics Centre in Budapest. The event welcomes not only people from the corporate world but everyone interested in coming together to get active, take on a challenge and celebrate. There are three distances: an individual 5 km, a 3-person relay (3 × 2.7 km) and a 2 km stadium walking tour. Participants will receive a unique finisher’s medal, and music, street food and an evening party will provide the entertainment.
course_highlights: The iconic track at the National Athletics Centre
3 distances: individual 5 km, 3 × 2.7 km relay, 2 km stadium walking tour
A special riverside location on the Danube
additional: Online registration is available only by bank card and SZÉP card. A BSI account is required to register. Finishers receive a unique finisher’s medal. Music, street food and an evening party await participants. Contact details for the registration office are available on the website. Music, street food and a festive atmosphere await participants at the National Athletics Centre, where community activities will also take place alongside the running event.

name: VSE City run Košice
price_range: 3 EUR (pre deti, študentov, seniorov, PWD), ďalšie dary prijímané

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Deti, študenti, dôchodcovia a ZŤP osoby: 3 EUR

description: VSE City Run in Košice is a 4 km charity run taking place on 7 May 2026. The event is open to the general public, including children, students, seniors and people with disabilities. Entry fees are donated to support the Platform of Families of Children with Disabilities. The run takes place in the centre of Košice and is known for its inclusive atmosphere and community spirit. The organisers work with the Košice Marathon Club and other partners. The event aims not only to promote sport but also to help families with children with disabilities.
course_highlights: 4 km course in the centre of Košice
Charity run with an inclusive character
Support for families of children with disabilities
additional: Entry fees are paid in cash on the day of the run when race numbers are handed out, from 14:00. Participants under 12 must run accompanied by an adult. Groups can use the online Google form to register together. The programme also includes the VSE City Run Walk at 16:30. The event offers a charity run and the option to register in person or online; the programme includes both a walk and the main run, and proceeds support children with disabilities.

name: Columbia Sunset Trail
description: The Columbia Sunset Trail is an exciting trail-running race held at sunset in the area around Naszály Hill. Runners receive a unique wooden finisher’s medal, and the top three women and men in each distance receive special prizes. The event offers plenty of aid stations, changing rooms and luggage storage. Runners are advised to use a headlamp and hydration pack. The atmosphere and proximity to nature are sure to make this an unforgettable experience.
course_highlights: Run at sunset in the area around Naszály Hill
Unique wooden finisher’s medal for every distance
Plenty of refreshments at the aid stations and finish
additional: Free, cool photos available the day after the race. Changing rooms and luggage storage at the base. A working, fully charged headlamp is mandatory. Your mobile phone must be charged, switched on and have the volume turned up. You must use a hydration pack, bottle or cup, as there will be no disposable cups at the aid stations or finish. This trail-running event welcomes runners with excellent organization and participant services, including photos, prizes and equipment recommendations.

name: COLUMBIA SUNSET TRAIL
location: Naszály, Bocskai utca 1, Naszály, Pest County, Hungary
description: The Columbia Sunset Trail is an exciting trail-running race held at sunset in the scenic surroundings of Naszály. Runners receive a unique wooden finisher’s medal at every distance, and the top finishers are awarded special medals. The event offers plenty of aid stations, changing rooms and baggage storage. For a safe race, runners are advised to use a headlamp and a hydration pack. The atmosphere and closeness to nature are sure to make this an unforgettable experience.
course_highlights: Run at sunset in Naszály’s natural surroundings
Unique wooden finisher’s medal at every distance
Plenty of refreshments at the aid stations and finish
additional: Free, fantastic photos available the day after the race. Special medals for the first three female and male finishers at each distance. Changing rooms and baggage storage at the base. A headlamp is mandatory; it must be in working order and fully charged. Bring a fully charged, switched-on, working mobile phone with the volume turned up. A hydration pack, bottle or cup is recommended, as there will be no disposable cups at the aid stations or finish. An ID card or a legible copy is required for registration. This trail-running event offers participants plenty of refreshments, safety equipment and memorable experiences.

name: Memoriál brig. gen. Ľ. Kukorelliho
organizer: Mesto Hanušovce nad Topľou, Mestské kultúrne stredisko mesta Hanušovce nad Topľou, ZO SZPB Hanušovce nad Topľou, Hermanovský bežecký oddiel
description: The Brigadier General Ľ. Kukorelli Memorial is a running event in Hanušovce nad Topľou, offering categories for men, women, relays with varying numbers of team members, and a fun run. It is organized by the Town of Hanušovce nad Topľou, the Municipal Cultural Centre, ZO SZPB, and the Hermanovský Running Club. There is no entry fee, allowing the wider public to take part without financial burden. The race starts at the Municipal Office in Hanušovce nad Topľou.
course_highlights: Start location: Municipal Office in Hanušovce nad Topľou
Categories: men, women, relays (2 to 5 members), fun run
Organized by the town and local running clubs
additional: There is no entry fee. The organizers are the Town of Hanušovce nad Topľou, the Municipal Cultural Centre, ZO SZPB, and the Hermanovský Running Club. Categories include relays with 2 to 5 members and a fun run. The event takes place in Hanušovce nad Topľou; the exact course profile is not specified. Registration is available via the contact details listed on the official website.

name: Charitatívny beh obcou Bukovec
organizer: Obec Bukovec a občianske združenie Oáza-nádej pre nový život
description: The Charity Run through the village of Bukovec is a traditional sporting event organized by the Municipality of Bukovec, its mayor, and members of the municipal council. The run takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Bukovec, known for its recreational area with reservoirs and natural beauty. Runners can enjoy a pleasant sporting experience near the local church while supporting charitable causes. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a community experience in peaceful surroundings.
course_highlights: The route runs through Bukovec near the local church
Picturesque surroundings with views of the reservoirs and the Ida River
A recreational area with natural scenery and tranquil surroundings
additional: The event is organized by the Municipality of Bukovec, the mayor, and members of the municipal council. The race regulations are available to download in PDF format. Bukovec is known for its recreational area with reservoirs, which are part of the route’s surroundings. Information about the event is published on the municipality’s official website. Date: May 8, 2026; start: 10:00; location: Bukovec, by the church; on-site registration is available; proceeds support charitable causes.

name: Crosul de noapte
description: Crosul de Noapte - Delonghi is a running race held in Cluj-Napoca, offering participants two distances: 4 km and 10 km. The event takes place on May 8, 2026, and is suitable for runners of all levels who want to enjoy a nighttime sporting experience in the city. It is an excellent opportunity to run in an urban setting with a friendly and competitive atmosphere.
course_highlights: 4 km and 10 km distances
Night run in Cluj-Napoca
Urban course accessible to all levels
additional: The event includes well-marked courses, online registration, and a safe environment for participants.

name: Iron Ultra Trail
description: Iron Ultra Trail is a challenging trail race held in Valjevo, known for its demanding courses and beautiful landscapes of Western Serbia. The race brings together trail-running enthusiasts and adventurous spirits, offering a unique experience across forest and mountain terrain. The organizers, West Serbia Trails, promise a great atmosphere and smooth organization for all participants.
course_highlights: Courses through the forests and mountains of Western Serbia
Challenging climbs and technical sections of the course
Beautiful natural landscapes and unspoiled nature
additional: The organizer is West Serbia Trails, known for putting on the best trail parties in Western Serbia.

name: SALOMON ULTRA TRAIL HUNGARY
location: Lázár cár tér, Szentendre, Pest County, Hungary
distance_verbose: 111 km, 50 miles, 50 km, Maraton, 30 km, Félmaraton
description: The Salomon Ultra-Trail Hungary is Hungary’s most prestigious trail-running race, consisting of six separate distances and attracting around 1,500 trail runners in total. The race takes place across varied terrain, including dense, dark forests, with challenging climbs. The longest distance is 111 km, with 4,200 m of elevation gain, 9 aid stations, 2 drop bags, and a 20-hour cutoff. The race is held in Szentendre, with the start and finish at Lázár cár Square. A detailed map and an information center are available to runners and their accompanying supporters to help ensure the event runs smoothly.
course_highlights: 111 km distance with 4,200 m of elevation gain
9 aid stations and 2 drop bags on the longest distance
Dense, dark forests and varied terrain
additional: The race has a maximum capacity of 1,600 participants, with 300 places available on the longest distance. The race’s Google map shows the aid stations, start and finish locations, and race headquarters. There are staffed crossings along the course where supporters are not allowed to cheer. The Dömös and Pap-rét aid stations cannot be reached by car and require a 30-minute walk. Registration for the race opens on November 2, 2025, with various entry options and activities associated with the event.

name: FARKASMÁLYI DŰLŐ- ÉS PINCEFUTÁS
location: Gyöngyös Farkasmályi pincesor, Gyöngyös, Heves County, Hungary
organizer: Gyöngyösi Triatlon Klub, Farkasmályi Borpincék Egyesület
description: The Farkasmály Vineyard and Cellar Run is a unique running race along the cellar row in Farkasmály, Gyöngyös, taking place on May 2, 2026. Participants run through beautiful vineyards and wine cellars on varied terrain with some small hills. The race includes a shorter, less hilly loop and a longer loop with more elevation, so everyone can find a suitable distance. The event is organized by GYÖTRI Klub, one of the region’s leading sports clubs.
course_highlights: Vineyard Loop: 3000 m, 40 m elevation gain, 2 laps, through vineyards and wine cellars
Farkasmály Loop: 8500 m, 190 m elevation gain, 4 laps, hilly terrain and visits to cellars
Relay race and fröccs race for teams, with special wine-fröccs drinking stations
additional: Registration and race-bib pickup from 13:00; on-site registration closes 15 minutes before the start of the relevant event. Parking is available on the grassy area next to the Szilue Hotel. Race distances: Vineyard Loop (2 laps), Farkasmály Loop (4 laps), relay race 4x1500 m, and a fröccs race for teams of 3: 800 m + 4 fröccs drinking stations (wine or must fröccs). At the end of each lap, the course passes through cellars; runners climb a small hill towards the finish arch. Trail running, routes between cellars, wine tasting, advance and on-site registration, awards, open cellars, refreshments, and awards ceremony.

name: SzalamandRUN futónap 3 / 5 / 11 / 21 / 42
description: The SzalamandRUN running day is a race in Solymár offering a variety of distances: 3, 5, 11, 21 and 42 km. The event is ideal for both beginners and experienced runners who want to test themselves over different distances. The race takes place in a natural setting, providing participants with an enjoyable running experience. The organizers offer professional timing and convenient registration options.
course_highlights: A running course close to nature around Solymár
A variety of distances: 3, 5, 11, 21 and 42 km
Professional chip timing (RFID, HuTag)
additional: Chip timing (RFID, HuTag) is provided at the race. Registration takes place on korido.hu, where automatic confirmation and SimplePay card payment are also available. Race bibs and safety pins are provided to participants. The race is held across multiple categories and distances, with children’s races also available, and the organizers prioritize athletes’ experience.

name: Előzd meg a Fogaskerekűt!
description: Beat the Cogwheel! is a traditional sporting event in Budapest’s 12th district, welcoming runners, cyclists, and relay teams in 2026. The aim is to reach the finish before the Cogwheel Railway while tackling an approximately 4 km climb with 325 metres of elevation gain in the Buda Hills. The race challenges athletes of all fitness levels and is also a great group activity for families and colleagues. The event is organised by Hegyvidéki Szabadidősport Nonprofit Kft. and Városmajori Tanuszoda.
course_highlights: Approx. 4.0 km distance
325 metres of elevation gain
Scenic surroundings in the Buda Hills
additional: Participants can enter in running, cycling, and relay categories. Rules on wearing race numbers and using chips, along with the privacy notice and terms and conditions, are available among the official documents. Competitors can enter age groups for those under and over 18, and results from previous years can be viewed in the archive. The race is known as an extreme challenge and offers prizes, individual and relay options, and registration details on the official website.

name: Krones Charity Run
location: Déli Ipari Park, Debrecen, Hajdú-Bihar County, Hungary
description: The Krones Charity Run is a charity running event taking place on May 9, 2026, in Debrecen, on the grounds of the Southern Industrial Park. In addition to promoting sport and physical activity, the event aims to introduce the venue and support the Foundation for Children with Leukemia. The full amount of the entry fees, along with donations doubled by Krones Hungary, will be donated to the foundation. Participants can choose from several distances, and everyone who finishes receives a unique finisher’s medal. A MIZUNO event T-shirt and full BioTechUSA refreshments are provided, and the Athletes Garden will welcome runners at the end of the event.
course_highlights: 10 km individual race, on a 4-lap course
Held in the Southern Industrial Park, where Krones Hungary was the first company to move in
MIZUNO event T-shirt and BioTechUSA refreshments at the aid stations
additional: Registration takes place through the StafétApp mobile app, which is available free of charge. Race packs are also collected using StafétApp. Every runner who finishes within the time limit receives a unique finisher’s medal. The Athletes Garden will provide an on-site program at the end of the event. Eco-friendly, ÖKO race packs are used, and plastic use is reduced. The full amount of the entry fees will be donated to charity. Online and on-site registration are both available, and the participation package includes a MIZUNO T-shirt and BioTechUSA refreshments.

name: CSALÁDI FUTÓNAP
location: Bocskai István Általános Iskola, Páty, Pest County, Hungary
description: The EDURACE Family Trail Running Day is a family-friendly recreational trail-running event organized by the EDUSPORT Sports Association. The race takes place in Erzsébet Park in Gödöllő and offers races for all ages, from children’s races to a half marathon. The event aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and a sense of community, with expert support and a varied program. Participants receive a finisher’s pack, a medal, and refreshments, and the day concludes with a colorful Color Run.
course_highlights: Trail-running course in Erzsébet Park, Gödöllő
No elevation gain; distances are easy to complete
Children’s races and team races for families
additional: Race-number pickup and on-site registration from 07:30; warm-up at 09:00; children’s races from 13:30; Color Run at 15:30. The entry fee includes timekeeping, a race number, a finisher’s medal, a finisher’s pack, and refreshments. Changing rooms, toilets, and bag storage are available at the event. Children’s races, team races, Color Run, prize draw, online and on-site registration, detailed routes, refreshment stations, commemorative medal, finisher’s pack

name: EDURACE
location: Erzsébet Park, Gödöllő, Pest County, Hungary
distance_verbose: Félmaraton, 10 km, 5 km, 3000 meter, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: The EDURACE Family Trail Running Day is a varied trail-running event taking place in 2026 in Erzsébet Park, Gödöllő. It offers several distances, from 500-meter children’s races to a half marathon, making it suitable for all ages and levels of running experience. Alongside nature-filled routes and a community atmosphere, participants can look forward to a unique finisher’s medal and a great time. The event aims to appeal to families and sports enthusiasts alike and promote a healthy, active lifestyle.
course_highlights: Forest routes with varied terrain in Erzsébet Park
Elevation differences ranging from 24 m to 340 m across the different distances
A unique finisher’s medal and family-friendly activities at the finish
additional: Race bib collection begins on October 31 at 16:00. Free cloakroom and bag storage are available. On-site registration is possible in limited numbers, but advance online registration is recommended. Medical staff will be available at the event; participation is at your own risk. The event features several distances, family and children’s races, team competitions, a pet-friendly race, online and on-site registration, and post-race activities.

name: FUT A VÁROS
location: Fő tér, Szombathely, Vas County, Hungary
description: The Szombathely Running Race, Fut a város, will take place on May 9, 2026, in the heart of the city, on Fő tér. The race offers several distances, so runners of all ages and abilities can find an option that suits them: a 400-metre children’s race, 2 km, 5 km, 10 km individual races, and a 4×2.5 km relay. The event promotes sport and a healthy lifestyle. Participants can look forward to unique finisher medals and chip timing. The race has a family-friendly atmosphere, with courses passing through the city’s historic sites, refreshment points and medical supervision.
course_highlights: Run past Szombathely’s historic sites, including Fő tér, the Fountain and Sportliget
Routes are secured and partially or fully closed to traffic throughout the race
Refreshment point at the finish and chip timing
additional: Chip timing will be used, and every participant will receive a unique finisher medal. Competitors under 14 must submit parental consent for distances over 2 km. Race packs can be collected at the venue from 7:30. The use of mobile phones and other audio devices with headphones during the race is prohibited. Chip timing will be used; race-pack collection is at the event centre, registration opens at 07:30, and start times vary by category.

name: ÚJPESTI FÉLMARATON
location: Halassy Olivér Sportközpont, Budapest IV. kerület, Budapest, Hungary
organizer: Budapest Főváros IV. ker. Újpest Önkormányzata
description: The Újpest Half Marathon is a popular running event taking place on May 9, 2026, at the Halassy Olivér Sports Center in Budapest’s 4th district. Runners can enter individually or as part of a relay, for the quarter-marathon or half-marathon distances. The event aims to promote sport and a sense of community in Újpest in a friendly, family-oriented atmosphere. Participants can choose a T-shirt size when registering, and the organizers ensure the event runs smoothly.
course_highlights: The event takes place at the Halassy Olivér Sports Center, one of Budapest’s popular sports centers.
Distances include the 21 km half marathon and the 10.5 km quarter marathon, with a relay category also available.
The race features refreshment stations and chip timing, with medals awarded at the finish.
additional: Entries are available in individual and relay categories for the quarter-marathon and half-marathon distances. Participants can choose a T-shirt size when registering (XS–3XL). A maximum of 5 people can be entered at once in the individual category. Providing an emergency contact is mandatory. Registration is online only, and the entry fee includes a race pack, T-shirt, sports drinks, refreshments, a medal, and medical coverage. The course runs partly along a stream embankment and partly on asphalt.

name: SCHRÖDINGER DELUXE ULTRA
description: Schrödinger Deluxe Ultra 2026 is a trail running race near Piliscsaba, taking place on May 9, 2026. The race starts at Csemetekert at 8:00 a.m. Runners follow varied terrain, passing several notable locations and natural landmarks in the Pilis Mountains. The race offers a unique experience for those who enjoy nature and a challenge.
course_highlights: Varied terrain in the Pilis Mountains
Passing numerous natural landmarks and local points of interest, such as Sas-szikla, Fehér-hegy, and the Saint-Gobain lookout
Challenging elevation gains and forest sections
additional: The race starts at Csemetekert. The organizers can be reached at info@gulyakor.hu, +36 20 2992446. The race is part of the Gulyakör trail series, which includes multiple distances and events. Registration is via the website, but no specific prices are available in the sources. Trail relay race, 35 checkpoints, unknown order, approximately 143 km, registration deadlines and fees specified.

name: Košice Peace Half marathon
location: Dolná brána, Hlavná ulica, Košice, Košice, Slovakia
organizer: Maratónsky klub Košice, Progress Promotion Košice
description: The Košice Peace Half Marathon is a traditional half-marathon held in the historic centre of Košice. The course follows the city's picturesque streets, including Dolná brána and Hlavná ulica, offering runners a unique experience in an atmosphere of peace and sportsmanship. The event is part of a series of running events in Košice and is organized with an emphasis on quality and safety for all participants.
course_highlights: The course passes through the historic centre of Košice, including Dolná brána and Hlavná ulica
A running experience in an atmosphere of peace and sportsmanship
Organized as part of a series of major running events in Košice
additional: The event includes various race distances, accompanying activities, finisher medals, and discounts for registered participants on other events in the Košice Peace Marathon series.

name: Strážovská 50
description: Strážovská 50 is a mountain ultramarathon and long-distance hiking event covering 50 km, held in the beautiful surroundings of the Strážov Mountains. Both the start and finish are in the spa town of Trenčianske Teplice. The route follows marked hiking trails and is ITRA-certified at Mountain level 5. The event is part of the Slovak Ultra Trail League 2026 and offers a challenging experience for both runners and hikers.
course_highlights: A 50 km mountain ultramarathon in the Strážov Mountains
The route follows marked hiking trails with a challenging mountain profile
ITRA-certified route with 2 points and Mountain level 5
additional: Registration is available online only from 10 February 2026 to 24 April 2026, or until the 250-participant capacity is reached (50 places are reserved for the 50 km with dog category). On-site registration is not available. Participants must be at least 18 years old. The entry fee must be paid by bank transfer within 7 days of registration. The route includes challenging navigation sections where participants must pay close attention to the markings. Participants must carry all required equipment and submit a signed informed consent form at check-in. Ultramarathon, 50 km, mountain terrain, registration required, part of the Slovak Ultra Trail League, categories with and without a dog, registration includes mandatory equipment

name: Beh oslobodenia Lietavskej Lúčky
location: Lietavská Lúčka pri dome kultúry, Lietavská Lúčka, Žilina, Slovakia
organizer: Obec Lietavská Lúčka v spolupráci s Bežeckou ligou Žilina
description: The Lietavská Lúčka Liberation Run is a running event organized by running enthusiasts and the municipality of Lietavská Lúčka. The race takes place by the cultural center in Lietavská Lúčka and features an asphalt and cooperative-road course. The 10 km race starts at 9:30 and the children’s race at 9:40. Categories are divided by age and gender, allowing runners of various age groups to take part.
course_highlights: The course runs on asphalt and cooperative roads
Start by the cultural center in Lietavská Lúčka
Categories available by age and gender
additional: Categories are divided by age and gender, with overall rankings for men and women. The organizer is Miroslav Ščibran, contact: 0903 611 060. The race takes place on May 9, 2026. The main race starts at 9:30 and the children’s race at 9:40. Course surface: asphalt and cooperative roads. Categories for men and women across various age groups. Online and on-site registration available.

name: Vertical Chopok
description: Vertical Chopok is a vertical running event taking place on 9 May 2026 in the Low Tatras, on a route from Srdiečko to Chopok Juh. Runners face a challenging climb with almost 950 metres of elevation gain over 6.4 km. The event is part of the Slovak Skyrunning Association calendar and is also a qualifying race in the vertical category. The course runs mainly along the road to Kosodrevina and through Zadné Dereše, allowing runners to perform at their best. The Vlado Plulík Memorial, after which the event is named, has a long tradition and commemorates a significant figure in Slovak sport.
course_highlights: Almost 950 metres of elevation gain over a 6.4 km course
The route runs from Srdiečko via Krupová to Chopok Juh
The course follows the road to Kosodrevina and passes through Zadné Dereše
additional: The event is included in the Slovak Skyrunning Association calendar for 2026 and serves as a qualifying event in the vertical category. Since 2025, the course has been extended and adjusted to allow for better performances and avoid congestion on the opening section. GPX coordinates for the route are available in the attachment. Registration opens on 20 December 2025. The race is part of the Slovak Mountain Running Cup 2019 and takes place in mountainous terrain, with the possibility of qualifying for the European Championships, the U23 World Championships and the Masters World Championships.

name: Podhájska Trail
description: Podhájska Trail is a community running event held at the Podhájska Thermal Swimming Pool, bringing together outdoor exercise, a healthy lifestyle and the local community. The event offers two main courses: a long 18 km route with 353 m of elevation gain and a short 7 km route with 143 m of elevation gain, as well as children’s races of various distances based on age. The route runs mainly along forest roads and paved cycle paths, with the start and finish at the thermal swimming pool. The event also has a charitable dimension, supporting local young people by purchasing sports equipment.
course_highlights: The route follows a dike, forest cycle paths and the area between the villages of Podhájska and Veľké Lovce
The course surface is 20% paved cycle paths and 80% forest roads
Elevation gain is +353 m on the long course and +143 m on the short course
additional: Race registration is from 8:30 to 10:30 at the thermal swimming pool. The children’s races start at 9:30, the short course at 10:30 and the long course at 11:00. Competitors receive free access to the car park in front of the thermal swimming pool. The route is marked with white-and-red ribbons and marshalled by organisers. Age categories are based on the age attained in the year of the race. The 100 m children’s category is not chip-timed, and all children receive an award. The route follows a dike, forest cycle paths and the area between villages, with a surface of 20% paved cycle paths and 80% forest roads. The event has a charitable dimension, and the participant limit for the main races is 400. Children’s categories are also included.

name: Squarebizz Ultra maratón na 6 hodinovka a M-SR v behu na 50 km
location: Areál Squarebizz Business Center Bory, Bratislava - Devínska Nová Ves, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: The Squarebizz Ultra 6-hour ultramarathon and Slovak Championships in the 50 km run is a challenging race held at the Squarebizz Business Center Bory grounds in Bratislava - Devínska Nová Ves. The event offers two main disciplines: a 50 km run and a 6-hour run, with men and women competing in various age categories. It is also the Slovak Championships in the 50 km run, adding to its prestige and appeal for endurance runners. The organizer is Michal Šuľa, who also provides contact information for those interested in taking part. Entry fees vary by discipline and registration date, increasing gradually until the beginning of May 2026.
course_highlights: A 50 km course at the Squarebizz Business Center Bory grounds
Choose between the 6-hour run and the 50 km run
Slovak Championships in the 50 km run, with categories by age and gender
additional: Categories are divided by age and gender, including overall standings. The event takes place at the Squarebizz Business Center Bory grounds in Bratislava - Devínska Nová Ves. The organizer can be reached by phone at +421 944 013 358. The race is held on a certified loop in Devínska Nová Ves, with online registration, refreshments during the race, changing rooms and toilets, and awards for the top finishers in each category. The event also includes medals, diplomas, and prizes for the winners.

name: Krupanská desiatka
location: OŠK Dolná Krupá, Dolná Krupá, Slovakia
organizer: Bežecký klub Dolná Krupá a Obecný úrad Dolná Krupá
price_range: 10 € online, 15 € na mieste; zľavy pre obyvateľov Dolnej Krupé a deti zadarmo
description: Krupanská desiatka is a traditional running race organized by Bežecký klub Dolná Krupá, held at the OŠK Dolná Krupá grounds. The course is 10 km long with 107 metres of elevation gain; 85% of it is on asphalt and 15% on forest roads. In addition to the main 10 km race, the event also includes shorter races and a 5 km Nordic walking event. The race is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere for an outdoor sporting event.
course_highlights: 10 km course with 107 m of elevation gain
85% asphalt and 15% forest road
Start and finish at the OŠK Dolná Krupá grounds
additional: Runner check-in and registration take place on race day from 09:00 to 11:30. The children’s races start from 10:00. The 10 km race starts at 12:00, the 5 km race at 12:05, and Nordic walking at 12:10. The maximum number of participants on each course is 250. The event is organized by the Občianske združenie Horný Chríb. The race takes place on 9 May 2026. Registration is open until 7 May 2024. The start is scheduled for approximately 12:00 at the football pitch at the OŠK Dolná Krupá grounds.

name: BTK Run Fest
organizer: Občianske združenie Bežecko Triatlonový klub Veľký Biel
description: BTK RUN FEST 2026 is a running event for everyone, taking place on May 9 in the grounds of the manor house in Veľký Biel. It offers various disciplines, including 5 km and 10 km road races, children’s races, a parent + child relay, and an adrenaline-filled obstacle race for children and adults. The routes run mainly on asphalt and paved surfaces around a lake in scenic surroundings. The event is suitable for recreational runners, families, and experienced athletes, with awards and medals for the top finishers and all finishers.
course_highlights: 85% asphalt and 15% paved surfaces
Flat route around the lake, with the start and finish at the manor house
Two laps for the 10 km race will test runners’ fitness
additional: The children’s races are 350 m, 600 m, and 1,000 m long. The parent + child relay is 2 × 350 m. The obstacle race is for children and adults and is 1 km long. The entry fee includes a race number, refreshments, photos, and awards. On-site registration is available if the participant limit has not been reached. Start times are scheduled by discipline from 09:00 to 13:10, with results announced between races. The event takes place on a surface consisting of 85% asphalt and 15% paved areas; registration is open with different deadlines and fees; races include various distances and categories for adults and children.

name: Fiľakovský cross
description: The Fiľakovo Cross is a running event organized by OZ FTC Fiľakovo and the Sports and Physical Education Commission of the Municipal Council in Fiľakovo. The races take place at the FTC stadium in Fiľakovo and offer various categories, including children’s, hobby and Nordic walking. The course combines dirt roads, asphalt and grass, making the run varied and interesting. The children’s race starts at 10:00 and the adults’ race at 12:30. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a welcoming sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: Course surface: dirt roads, asphalt and grass
Start and finish: FTC stadium in Fiľakovo
Various categories, including children’s, hobby and Nordic walking
additional: The children’s race starts at 10:00 and the adults’ race at 12:30. Categories include children’s, hobby and Nordic walking. The organizers are OZ FTC Fiľakovo and the Sports and Physical Education Commission of the Municipal Council in Fiľakovo. Contact persons: Mgr. Attila Visnyai (0915 163 310), Mgr. Gabriel Nagy (0908 948 429). The event includes various courses ranging from approximately 3 to 14 km. Registration is open from 1.4.2024 to 10.5.2024, and the event is intended for all age groups, including children and hobby runners.

description: EuroPainClinics Bardejov Mountain Run is a mountain race held in the picturesque setting of Bardejovské Kúpele. Runners can choose from three courses: a cross-country half marathon with more than 1,000 metres of elevation gain, a seven-kilometre spa course, and accompanying children’s and youth categories. The event is suitable for all runners who enjoy challenging terrain and mountain running. The organizers provide on-course refreshments, medals, T-shirts and other benefits for participants who register early.
course_highlights: Course A: 22 km cross-country half marathon with 1,000+ m of elevation gain
Course A refreshments at the 8 km mark near Zborov Castle and at the 15 km mark on Stebnícka Magura (899 m above sea level)
Course B: Spa Seven, 7 km with 180+ m of elevation gain
additional: Registration for Course C (children and youth) takes place at the event venue; the number of starters is limited to 80. Runners in Courses A and B receive free parking in Bardejovské Kúpele, a race bib with a chip, a T-shirt, on-course refreshments, a medal, trophies, prizes, lunch and a post-race drink. Times are not recorded for Course C; all participants receive a medal and a sweet treat. The course runs through mountain terrain. Registration is available online or on-site. There are several categories, including children and youth, a race-day programme, and detailed instructions for participants.

name: Beh pre Labky
organizer: Únia vzájomnej pomoci ľudí a psov
description: Beh pre labky 2026 is a charity run organized by the Union of Mutual Aid for People and Dogs (UVP), taking place in Košice, in the Kavečany area near Chata Hrešná. The event’s 10th edition gives runners the opportunity to support a good cause while enjoying a pleasant run in nature. The course is 5 km long and suitable for all age groups, including children and runners with dogs. The event is open to the general public and offers various categories by age and participant type.
course_highlights: The route runs through the natural surroundings of Kavečany near Chata Hrešná
The course is 5 km long and consists of one lap
Participants can run with their own dog or a dog from a shelter
additional: The event is a charity run organized by the Union of Mutual Aid for People and Dogs (UVP). Categories include men, women, boys and girls under 15, as well as categories for participants with a dog and with a shelter dog. Registration is through pretekaj.sk, where users can create an account to manage their entries. The event supports people and dogs in need. Registration is available online, and results are posted on the organizer’s website.

name: DOBRObeh

description: DOBRObeh is a charity run in Čadca offering five different courses, including the main Mária Marcibálová Run, which is 21.5 km long with 600 m of elevation gain. The course runs mainly through forest, on asphalt and across meadows, and is clearly marked and supported by event organizers. The event is for all runners who want to support a good cause, and everyone who takes part is a winner. The start is on Palárikova Street by the Rybka fountain in the pedestrian zone in Čadca. Alongside the main run, shorter courses are also available, including 10 km, 4.5 km and children’s runs.
course_highlights: Mária Marcibálová Run: 21.5 km with +600 m elevation gain; 70% forest, 10% asphalt, 20% meadow
KERICross 10 km: 65% asphalt, 25% meadow, 10% gravel; +180 m elevation gain
Run Through the City 4.5 km: 90% asphalt, 10% forest; +42 m elevation gain
additional: Mandatory equipment: your own drinking cup, trail shoes, a mobile phone with the organizer’s number, a watch or mobile phone with the route, and folding running or hiking poles. Refreshment stations at 3.8 km and 13.8 km. The course is clearly marked with arrows and ribbons, and organizers guide runners at ambiguous points. Awards ceremony at 12:30. A charity run with no winners’ awards, where everyone who supports DOBRO is a winner. Participants can contribute food or money. The event offers various courses, including a 21.5 km run, and supports people in need.

The event offers two races, one of 14 km and one of 7 km, suitable for different age groups and experience levels. The courses are well marked and offer a sporting experience in nature, with prizes for the top competitors. Participants benefit from electronic timing and an official event T-shirt.

The start and finish are in the Betfia Sinkhole area (parking lot)
Timing with an electronic chip integrated into the race bib
additional: Awards for the top three finishers in the OPEN category and in the age categories. Timing with an electronic chip attached to the back of the race bib. Registration may be transferred to another person until 20 May 2026, for a fee of 25 lei. The participation fee is refundable until 10 May 2026, subject to a 25 lei deduction. The official event T-shirt is included. The trail running courses take place in the Betfia / Baile 1 Mai area, with registration fees in lei, based on the BNR exchange rate. name: TRAILRUN IN TARA NASAUDULUI
location: Casuțele din Plai, Valea Caselor, Năsăud, Bistrița-Năsăud, Romania
description: Trail Run in Țara Năsăudului is an outdoor running event for all age groups and experience levels, held around Casuțele din Plai, Valea Caselor, Năsăud. The event offers three different races: a 2 km course for children and families, an intermediate 5 km course with short climbs and forest paths, and a 10 km course for runners seeking an authentic trail-running challenge. Participants can enjoy a supportive atmosphere, socializing, and fair play, with hydration points along the courses and a Starter Kit included for the 5 km and 10 km races.
course_highlights: A 2 km course for children and families, with 1 hydration point
A 5 km course with short climbs, forest paths, and views of the hills around the city of Năsăud
A 10 km course with 2 hydration points, for runners who love authentic trail-running challenges
additional: The start and finish of each course are at Casuțele din Plai, Valea Caselor, Năsăud. Car access to the start is prohibited; the organizers provide minibuses from the parking area by the chapel in Năsăud (meeting point and parking). The courses are available on Strava, with GPX files available to download to a smartwatch or phone. The Starter Kit includes the official T-shirt and medal for 10K, the medal for 5K, and the certificate for 2K. First place in the 10K Challenge also receives 2 nights of accommodation at Casuțele din Plai. The event includes courses for all ages and levels, emphasizing nature, community, and fair play, with the start in Valea Caselor, Năsăud.

description: Trascău Trail Run is a mountain race offering three events: a marathon, a half marathon, and a cross-country race, set amid the picturesque landscapes of the Rimetea area in Alba. The routes pass through spectacular locations such as Piatra Secuiului, Colțești Fortress, Plaiului Gorge, and Huda lui Papară Cave, offering a mountain-running experience with significant elevation changes and impressive views. The event is organized by the Green & Wild Association and emphasizes adventure in nature and local heritage. Participants receive access to hydration and refreshment points, medals, and prizes. Registration is limited and available online.

The cross-country race offers an accessible mountain-running experience, with peaceful scenery in the forest near the Ardeșcheia massif

The race aims to provide an enjoyable experience for all ages and to offer runners a full event experience.

Parking, toilets, a playhouse, a first-aid point and a buffet are available on site. The race will not be held in 2026 because the number of entries did not reach the minimum set by the organizers.

The entry fee includes a race bib, timing, aid stations, baggage storage, changing facilities and medical services, as well as chimney cake at the finish and a choice of medals. Race numbers must be collected in advance; there is no on-site registration. Timing is chip-based, using a chip attached to the back of the race number.

The varied, gently undulating course takes runners through some of the area’s most beautiful spots. The longer distance reaches as far as Balf, with views of scenic Lake Fertő and its reed beds accompanying runners along the way. This race is not only a challenge but also an enjoyable running experience, with new views and inspiration at every kilometre. The event also operates as a green race, highlighting the importance of environmental protection.

Participants can run 21.1 kilometres individually or as part of a 2–3-person relay. The race is part of Budapest’s Europe Day festival. Runners follow a three-lap course passing iconic Budapest landmarks, and everyone who finishes receives a unique commemorative medal. The event is organised by the Representation of the European Commission in Hungary and the European Parliament Liaison Office in Hungary, with Nagy Sportágválasztó, BBU Nonprofit Kft. as professional partner.

Refreshment stations along the course and chip-based net timekeeping.

Participation is free but requires registration, and places are limited (2,000 individual runners and 700 relay teams). There will be no full road closures; traffic will be managed by the police and civil guard. Participants must register to take part. Race bibs and T-shirts can be collected from May 5–8 at Europa Experience, or at Szabadság tér on race day. The detailed course route, refreshment stations and start/finish locations can be found on the official website.

Registration is online, the run is supported by the Wings for Life World Run app, and all proceeds go to spinal cord injury research.

The routes pass through Beckov’s mysterious corners and are accompanied by legends, making the race an energetic adventure. Runners can enjoy an appealing 6 km loop through the park’s picturesque setting, with its pond and the largest plane-tree grove in Central Europe, along the Váh River, through the town centre and past Hlohovec’s main landmarks. The event offers categories for children, a main race and Nordic walking. The start is in front of the amphitheatre in the Castle Garden. Organisers emphasise safety and recommend reflective accessories and headlamps. Finisher medals are prepared for the first 550 participants.
