name: Dac Warrior
description: Dac Warrior 2026 is a unique obstacle race in Romania, taking place on May 23 in Tohani, Gura Vadului, Prahova. The courses are challenging, with significant elevation gain and a variety of obstacles designed to test participants’ physical endurance and willpower. The event offers an experience of initiation and reconnection with the spirit of the Dacian ancestors, combining athletic effort with tradition and authentic nature. Participants can choose from several events, ranging from 6 km to 21 km, each with its own challenges and obstacles. The atmosphere is one of camaraderie and competition, and after the race participants are invited to discover the local culture and enjoy its traditions and rituals.
course_highlights: Ultimate Run: 21 km with 1,060 m of elevation gain and over 30 obstacles
Legend Run: 11.6 km with 690 m of elevation gain and 25 obstacles
Brave Run: 7.35 km with 348 m of elevation gain and 20 obstacles
additional: Registration validation and race-kit pickup take place on Friday, May 22, 2026, between 16:00 and 20:00 at Domeniul Satul Dacilor. The courses feature a variety of obstacles, including low fences, log jumps, rings, sandbags, a log pyramid, ropes, parallel bars, monkey bars, a muddy trench, a wall traverse, and a surprise obstacle. There are age- and gender-based prize categories, with cash prizes for the top finishers. The race is recommended for experienced participants, especially the Ultimate Run, which is a challenging OCR. The event offers different distance categories and courses and is open to both amateur and advanced runners.

description: The Color Run Cluj-Napoca 2026 is an energetic 5-kilometer race full of positive energy, color, and fun, perfect for all ages and fitness levels. The urban course starts and finishes in Piața Unirii, offering a festival atmosphere with multiple consecutive starts and an explosion of colored powder at the finish. Participants receive a kit with a T-shirt, bandana, temporary tattoos, medal, and colored powder, and the event promotes a healthy lifestyle and community.

The event includes three races: a 21 km half marathon, an 11 km cross-country race, and a 7 km hike, each suited to different types of participants, from experienced runners to those looking for a more relaxed experience. The organizers emphasize safety, recovery, and socializing, offering amenities such as stretching sessions, post-run massage, camping, and activities for children. name: Nebeski visovi – 4. kolo Nacionalne serije u planinskom trčanju
description: The Nebeski Visovi race in Zlatibor is the fourth round of the National Mountain Running Series, organized by the Tornik Mountaineering Club from Čajetina. Participants can choose between two loop courses: the longer red course, 21 km with 1,400 meters of elevation gain, intended for seniors, and the shorter blue course, 10 km with 500 meters of elevation gain, for juniors. The courses pass through Zlatibor’s unspoiled nature and over the peaks of Ljujaš, Orlić, Jelova Gora, Bandera-Tornik, and Liska, offering scenic, wild landscapes. The race attracts competitors from across Serbia and abroad. Scoring in the National Series is governed by the rules of the Mountaineering Association of Serbia, a member of the World Mountain Running Association.

The Mountaineering Association of Serbia is a member of the World Mountain Running Association (WMRA). Participants can expect challenging mountain courses, and the race is part of a wider national series promoting mountain running in Serbia.

Participants enjoy a unique experience as the steadily uphill route to the summit tests their endurance. Finishers receive a special medal, and participants can also make a charitable contribution when registering.
course_highlights: 11.6 km distance with 671 m of elevation gain
Beautiful natural surroundings in the Mátra Mountains
Steadily uphill, challenging terrain
additional: Registration is available exclusively online at nevezes.futanet.hu, with payment by bank card or SZÉP card. A BSI account is required to register. Finishers receive a special medal. On race day, ordered Kékes Summit Run apparel can be collected at the race center in Mátrafüred. The race also supports charity, with the option to make a contribution during registration. hiking, registration, trail challenges, nature-based experience

name: KÉKES CSÚCSFUTÁS

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Április 13-ig kedvezményesen nevezhetsz a 29. Kékes Csúcsfutásra!

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Április 13-ig kedvezményesen nevezhetsz a 29. Kékes Csúcsfutás Trailre!

description: The Kékes Summit Run is one of Hungary’s most beautiful and iconic running races. The 11.6 km course climbs 671 metres to Kékestető, Hungary’s highest point. Set amid the Mátra’s picturesque landscapes and stunning natural surroundings, it is a true challenge for runners looking to test their endurance and fitness. Runners come from hundreds of towns and villages, and finishers receive a unique medal to make the day memorable. The race is more than just a running event—it is also an inner journey where nature and the joy of achievement come together.
course_highlights: 11.6 km course with 671 m of elevation gain
Run to Kékestető, Hungary’s highest point
Stunning natural surroundings and panoramic views in the Mátra
additional: Online registration is available exclusively at nevezes.futanet.hu. Payment can be made by bank card or SZÉP card. A unique Kékes Summit Run running shirt and running socks can be ordered and collected at the race centre. Contact details for the registration office and further registration information are available on the official website. Information about discounted registration, mountain terrain, online registration, participation by wheelchair and handbike competitors with advance registration, unique medals, the option to purchase a running shirt and running socks, a training plan, and charitable support.

name: Vertikál Martinky
organizer: Fatra Outdoor Team a Winter Park Martinky

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: MUŽI / ŽENY: 25€, registrácia a platba na mieste v deň preteku

description: Vertikál Martinky is the fourth edition of a challenging uphill race that is part of the Slovak Skyrunning League. Runners have the opportunity to earn ITRA Score points and compare themselves with the best on an extreme course with 944 metres of elevation gain. The event offers a challenge for both professional and recreational runners in the beautiful surroundings of Martinky. Children’s categories are also available, with shorter courses and the option for parents to accompany their children. The organisers provide transport of personal belongings to the finish, refreshments and free parking.
course_highlights: An extreme uphill course with 944 metres of elevation gain
Start and finish at the Martinské hole ski resort
Children’s categories with 76 m and 186 m of elevation gain
additional: Race-day registration is from 8:30 to 9:30 at the FATRA SKI rental shop, Hrdinov SNP Martin - Stráne, and from 10:15 to 10:45 at the Nová Ponorka restaurant. Free parking is available above the adult registration venue and at Martinky for children. The entry fee includes transport of personal belongings to the finish, a drink and a meal at the restaurant. Children may start at 11:00, and a parent may accompany them free of charge. Runners take part at their own risk, and participants under 18 need written consent from a legal guardian. The course is 20% asphalt and 80% forest road. Registration is available online and on site. Transport of personal belongings is provided. The event starts at 10:00 and ends at around 14:00. Free parking is available.

name: Beh vďaky – Továrne – memoriál Františka Chmeľa
description: The Thanksgiving Run – Továrne – František Chmeľ Memorial is a running event organized by the municipality of Továrne in the Vranov nad Topľou District. The race takes place in front of the Municipal Office building in Tovarné and is open to a broad range of runners, with categories based on age and gender. The event has a traditional character and offers the opportunity to compete in various age categories for men and women. The organizers provide participants with comprehensive information and support.
course_highlights: Categories available for different age groups and genders
Two course distances: 5 km and 10 km
Held in the picturesque setting of the municipality of Tovarné
additional: The race is organized by the municipality of Továrne. The contact person is Mayor Kvetoslava Mižáková. Information about entry-fee payment is sent by email after registration or can be found via the payment status in the list of registered participants. Categories are divided by age and gender, and the race takes place in front of the Municipal Office building in Tovarné. Registration is available online or on site. The event is dedicated to the memory of František Chmeľ and is open to the general public.

name: Orungutan Run
description: The oRUNgutan charity run at Bratislava Zoo is a traditional sporting event that brings runners of all ages together in support of primate conservation. Runners can make their way through the zoo grounds, including areas normally closed to the public. Proceeds from the entry fees go towards improving conditions in the Primate Pavilion, home to Sumatran orangutans and other species, including the zoo’s new residents. The event is suitable for families, companies, and individuals who want to exercise while supporting a good cause.
course_highlights: The run takes place on the grounds of Bratislava Zoo, with access to areas normally closed to the public
Courses are available for children and adults, with various race categories
Supports the revitalization of the primate habitat and improved living conditions, including for Sumatran orangutans
additional: The event is a charity fundraiser and is limited to 800 participants. Runners can take part in teams or individually. Proceeds will be used to renovate and improve the Primate Pavilion, including the installation of bioflooring, new climbing structures, and greenery. The run takes place on Sunday, May 17, 2026, from 10:00. Companies can participate as a team or offer places to their employees and families. Results are available at vysledkovyservis.sk/orungutan. The course probably runs through Bratislava Zoo; online registration is available; proceeds go towards improving conditions for primates.

name: Beh Zabudišovou
location: Zabudišová, okres Nové Mesto nad Váhom, Slovakia
price_range: 8€ online, 10€ na mieste, zadarmo pre deti

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Deti štartovné zdarma a prihlasovanie online

description: The Zabudišová Run is a running event held in the village of Zabudišová, Nové Mesto nad Váhom District. It offers a 5,400-metre course with scenic views and 133 metres of elevation gain. The course surface combines asphalt, gravel and a grassy path. The event also includes fun races for children in various age groups. After the finish, participants can enjoy game goulash, a raffle, medals and prizes for the winners. Runners take part at their own risk. Online registration is available, with a limit on the number of participants; children run for free.
course_highlights: 5,400 m course with 133 m of elevation gain (2 hills)
Surface: 25% asphalt, 75% gravel or grassy path
Scenic views along the route
additional: Runner check-in is from 9:00 to 10:30, the children’s races start at 10:30, the main race starts at 11:00, and the awards ceremony is at 12:15. Game goulash, a raffle, medals and prizes for the winners are available at the finish. There are no changing rooms or showers, but two toilets are available (a flush toilet and an outhouse). Parking is limited directly at the start; once full, parking is available at the football pitch 200 m from the start. Timing is provided by SunBell s.r.o. - VysledkovyServis.sk electronic timing. Race bibs are compulsory and must be visible on the chest. The course is mostly natural, with hilly terrain. The race is suitable for all age groups, registration is limited to 100 participants, and the event takes place on 17 May 2026.

name: Behá celá rodina
location: Športový areál ZŠ Báhoň, Báhoň, Slovakia
description: Behá celá rodina is the first edition of a charity run taking place on 17 May 2026 at the sports grounds of ZŠ Báhoň. The event is open to all age groups, from the youngest children to adults, with different race distances and accompanying activities for children. Entry is by voluntary donation, and all proceeds will go towards supporting the kindergarten and primary school in Báhoň. Come and get active, have fun, and support a good cause in the welcoming surroundings of the village of Báhoň.
course_highlights: Children’s distances: 200 m, 400 m, 800 m
Adult distances: 2.6 km, 5.2 km, 8.2 km
Nordic walking: 2.6 km
additional: The event offers distances for different age groups, including children and adults, as well as Nordic walking. Games and accompanying activities will be available for children throughout the event. Entry is by voluntary donation, and all proceeds will go towards supporting local schools. Race distances for children and adults; supporting local schools; online registration.

name: Accenture Heroes Challenge
location: Parcul Sportiv Universitar Iuliu Hațieganu, Cluj-Napoca, Cluj County, Romania
description: Accenture Heroes Challenge is an intense competition featuring tests of strength, speed, agility, and skills, held at Iuliu Hațieganu University Sports Park in Cluj-Napoca. The second edition, scheduled for May 17, 2026, challenges participants to push their limits on an obstacle course. The event offers two distances, 6 km and 12 km, to suit both experienced runners and those looking for a shorter challenge.
course_highlights: Obstacle course testing strength, speed, and agility
Location at Iuliu Hațieganu University Sports Park, Cluj-Napoca
Available distances: 6 km and 12 km
additional: The event includes technique and strength obstacles. Registration and participation details are available on the official website and Facebook page.

name: Crosul Sport4All
location: Universitatea Europeană Drăgan, Lugoj, Timiș County, Romania
description: Crosul Sport 4 all is an annual running event held in Lugoj, open to all ages and fitness levels. It includes untimed races for children and a 2 km fun run, as well as timed 4 km and 6 km races for older participants. The courses loop around the Drăgan European University and along the city’s central streets, offering a pleasant urban experience. Participants receive finisher medals, and the timed races have age categories. The event is supported by Lugoj City Hall and Drăgan European University, with 400 free places offered by sponsor Mondial S.A.
course_highlights: Loop courses around Drăgan European University and along the central streets of Lugoj
Races for all ages, including untimed races for children and timed 4 km and 6 km races
Participation medals for all participants in the untimed races
additional: Register online by 10.05.2026 at 23:59 or until all 400 free places are filled. Race kits are distributed on Saturday and Sunday at Drăgan European University. The event includes an awards ceremony for the timed races, as well as warm-up sessions and a technical briefing before the start. Volunteers receive a volunteer kit and a volunteer agreement in accordance with the law. Races for children and adults, untimed and timed races, urban courses, online registration, race kit, medals and diplomas for participants, event organized in partnership with Lugoj City Hall and Drăgan European University.

name: Prima Evadare
description: Prima Evadare is the largest cross-country cycling marathon in Romania, held annually on a classic route between Bucharest and Snagov. The race offers a friendly and accessible experience, with a distance of approximately 55 km through forests and country roads, with no significant elevation changes. The event brings together cycling enthusiasts from across the country, creating an energetic and welcoming atmosphere, ideal for kicking off the MTB marathon season.
course_highlights: Approximately 55 km through forests and country roads
No significant elevation changes, making for an accessible experience
The classic Bucharest–Snagov route
additional: Race packs can be collected on the Friday and Saturday before the race at Greenfield Plaza Băneasa. Participants can expect a varied route with natural terrain and diverse scenery, making this a landmark mountain biking event in Romania.

name: Somborski polumaraton
description: The Sombor Half Marathon is a traditional race held in Sombor, featuring a new course through beautiful parts of the city. The event brings together many runners from Serbia and abroad, promoting a healthy lifestyle and recreational running. The organizers strive to make the race well organized and enjoyable for all participants, with special attention to the atmosphere and socializing. The race is part of the rich program of activities of the Somaraton Athletics and Recreation Club, which has fostered Sombor’s long-standing running tradition.
course_highlights: New course through Somborica
Organized transportation for participants
Medal for all participants
additional: Organized transportation to Somborica is available for participants; the contact person is Milan Kovačić. The celebration of ARK Somaraton’s 16th anniversary is part of the accompanying activities. Runners receive a medal for participating. The club has around 65 members, with active training sessions and support for runners of all levels. The event also includes organized city tours, cultural activities, and support during the race, and is open to all age groups.

name: Ultrabug
description: Ultrabug is a fully supported, 3-day ultramarathon held on scenic mountain trails in Romania’s Carpathian Mountains, in the Fundu Moldovei area. The main route covers 100 km across mountain trails, mineral-water streams and villages with a rich culture, and is suitable for all fitness levels, including first-time ultra participants. The event also includes shorter alternative races, such as Marathon XFun, Ultra XFun and Fun Run, offering participants a range of options. After the race, participants are invited to an awards ceremony and a traditional party with local food. Ultrabug is internationally recognised, awards iTRA points and has been voted among the 50 best ultramarathons abroad.
course_highlights: A 100 km route across mountain trails, mineral-water streams and traditional villages
Spectacular scenery with green pastures and the authentic sounds of bells and running water
Alternative routes of 42 km + 8 km, 50 km + 8 km, and an 8 km race open to all ages
additional: A jacket/hoodie is included only for registrations made by 1 May 2026. The event awards finishers 3 iTRA points. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and a party with traditional food, including BBQ with polenta, cheese and homemade bread. The race is open to runners, hikers and walkers, with a minimum age of 18 for the 100 km race; the 8 km race is open to all ages. The event includes accommodation at Casa Ileana in Fundu Moldovei, awards iTRA points and attracts international participants.

name: LÉLEKFUTÁS ÉS PIKNIK
description: The Soul Run and Picnic is a warm, community-focused event in Magyarpolány, centered on movement and renewal for body and soul. Runners of all ages take part, and the day is rounded off with delicious food and meditative activities such as walking the labyrinth and a gong sound bath. More than just a sporting event, it is a vibrant community celebration held in the embrace of nature. The event is organized by the Habitus Foundation and takes place as part of the Polány Pentecost event series.
course_highlights: A nature-focused running race for families and all ages
A meditative labyrinth walk offering a unique inner experience
A gong sound bath for inner calm and renewal
additional: The event is part of the Polány Pentecost event series. After the race, participants can enjoy a communal picnic and delicious food, including chili con carne and vegan salads. The program includes a gong sound bath and a meditative labyrinth walk offering a special inner experience. Several special prizes are also awarded, and the sense of community is a central part of the event. Participants can enjoy races, a family picnic, relaxation activities, refreshments, and spring water. Advance registration is required.

name: SALGÓTARJÁN – LOSONC MARATONVÁLTÓ
description: The International Novohrad Marathon Relay is a relay race between Salgótarján and Lučenec, covering 42.2 km in six stages for teams of 4–6. The route passes through scenic settlements, with runners completing the full distance in relay. The event has a friendly atmosphere, with refreshment stations and goulash at the finish, while cultural programs add to the day. The race takes place on August 23, 2025. Online registration is available until August 20; afterward, on-site registration is possible only if places remain.
course_highlights: A 42.2 km relay race in 6 stages, with legs of 5–7.8 km
Route through Salgótarján, Somoskőújfalu, Radzovce, Rátka, Trebeľovce, Hladký Majer, and Lučenec
Refreshment stations approximately every 5 km; goulash and cultural programs at the finish
additional: The relay is for teams of at least 4 and at most 6 runners, with handoffs at the relay points. Runners must be at least 15 years old. The full course runs alongside traffic, on the left-hand side, and traffic regulations must be followed. Members of the first 30 teams receive medals, and the top three finishers in each category win cups. The course passes through several towns, with refreshment stations every 5 km, online registration and the possibility of on-site registration, and cultural programs and concerts at the finish.

name: SALOMON TWIN PEAKS TRAIL
description: The Salomon Twin Peaks Trail is a 22-kilometre trail running race that is part of the Salomon Ultra-Trail Hungary. The course runs around Dömös and Szentfa-Kápolna and includes the famous “two spikes,” which present runners with a special challenge. This race offers a unique finish-line experience in Hungary that only UTH can provide. It is ideal for those who want to get a taste of the atmosphere and trail-running challenges of Ultra-Trail Hungary.
course_highlights: 22-kilometre course around Dömös and Szentfa-Kápolna
The elevation gains of the dreaded two spikes
A unique finish-line experience in Hungary
additional: Registration was open until noon on 1 May 2026; registration transfers and distance changes could still be arranged on that day. The race is part of the Salomon Ultra-Trail Hungary series, which offers several distances and races. The event is supported by sponsors at several levels and media partners. The race venue is Dömös, Szentfa-Kápolna; bus transfer is included in the entry fee; there is no water available at the start location.

name: SALOMON VISEGRAD TRAIL
description: The Salomon Visegrád Trail is a 30-kilometer trail-running race that starts at the former Roman watchtower in Visegrád and finishes in downtown Szentendre. Runners pass through the most beautiful and challenging-to-reach parts of the Visegrád Hills, on varied and demanding terrain. The race offers an unforgettable experience for both nature lovers and trail-running enthusiasts. The event is traditionally of a high standard, with well-organized support provided for participants along the course.
course_highlights: 30 km from the former Roman watchtower in Visegrád to Szentendre
The most beautiful and challenging-to-reach parts of the Visegrád Hills
Varied terrain and natural surroundings
additional: Registration has closed because the maximum capacity of 1,600 participants has been reached. The race headquarters and expo are at the Ferences Sports Hall, Áprily Lajos tér 3, Szentendre. Bag storage is in the Reformed Secondary School building. The race is supported by several well-known brands, including Salomon, TUI, Leki, Petzl, Garmin, and Rudy Project. Lists of the different distances, registration, volunteering opportunities, sponsors, and media partners.

name: Night Run Trenčín
location: Klub Lúč, Mierové námestie, Trenčín, Slovakia
price_range: 12 € až 35 € v závislosti od registrácie a kategórie
description: Night Run Trenčín is a running event taking place on May 23, 2026, in Trenčín, at the Lúč club and, weather permitting, at Mierové Square. Runners can challenge themselves in the pleasant atmosphere of the city in the evening. Registration is available online until May 21, 2026, or on race day at the venue if the participant limit has not been reached. The organizer provides electronic timing and refreshments along the course. The event is suitable for runners aged 12 and over; younger participants need the consent of a legal guardian.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Lúč club or, weather permitting, at Mierové Square
Electronic timing at the start, finish, and 4 km point
Option to use municipal parking near Trenčianska Gate
additional: Race check-in is from 17:00 to 20:40 at the Lúč club or, weather permitting, at Mierové Square. Men and women over 60 do not pay an entry fee but must register online. The minimum participant age is 12; participants under 15 must have the consent of a legal guardian. The organizer accepts no responsibility for damage to property or health. Electronic timing is provided by SunBell s.r.o. - VysledkovyServis.sk, and results will be published on an ongoing basis at vysledkovyservis.sk. Night run, online and on-site registration, start from 17:00 to 20:40, option to use municipal facilities, medical information on the race bib

name: Dynasport beh na Vtáčnik
description: Dynasport Run on Vtáčnik is a challenging mountain race around Kamenec pod Vtáčnikom, offering three courses of different lengths and elevation gains. Runners can choose a 50 km course with 2,000 m of elevation gain, a 27 km course with 1,000 m of elevation gain, or an 8.4 km course with 380 m of elevation gain. Each course has a time limit and categories for women and men under and over 40. The race starts at a farm below Vtáčnik, with refreshments provided at several points along the route. The organizer emphasizes mandatory equipment and runner safety.
course_highlights: 50 km course with +2,000 m elevation gain and a 10-hour time limit
27 km course with +1,000 m elevation gain and a 5-hour time limit
8.4 km course with +380 m elevation gain and a 2-hour time limit
additional: The 50 km course has three refreshment stations at 9 km, 27 km and 44 km. Mandatory equipment includes identity documents, a charged mobile phone, a map or GPX file, a personal collapsible cup or bottle with a capacity of at least 1.5 dl, a first-aid kit (thermal blanket, elastic bandage), and at least 0.5 l of water. The race bib must be clearly displayed on the front of the body throughout the race. Recommended equipment includes a waterproof jacket in case of rain. Course distances: 50 km, 27 km, 8 km; elevation gains: +2,000 m, +1,000 m, +380 m; mandatory equipment, refreshment stations on the courses, time limits of 10, 5 and 2 hours.

name: Petržalská 10
price_range: 20 € (online pred 1. aprílom 2026), 25 € (po, do uzávierky registrácie); deti 6-8 €
description: Petržalská 10 is a popular running race in Bratislava, held at Námestie Republiky in Petržalka. The event offers various categories, including a children’s run, a 10 km main race, Nordic walking, and a family run with a dog. The children’s races start at 10:00 and the main race at 11:30. The organizer, Športová Nadácia Kotrmelec, ensures a welcoming atmosphere and quality organization for all participants.
course_highlights: The course is in Bratislava-Petržalka, with the start and finish at Námestie Republiky
10 km main race with categories for men, women, and Nordic walking
1.8 km family run with a dog and 5 km children’s run
additional: Children under 5 and children from Centres for Children and Families (CDR) can enter for free. Categories include men’s and women’s age groups, 5 km Nordic walking, and a 1.8 km family run with a dog. Several categories are available, including 5 km, the family run, and Nordic walking; starts at 10:00 and 11:30; online registration; venue at Námestie Republiky in Petržalka.

name: Medzinárodný Novohradský Maratón štafety
description: The International Novohrad Marathon Relay is a running relay marathon taking place on May 23, 2026, along a route between Salgótarján, Hungary, and Lučenec, Slovakia. The course is 42.2 km long and is divided into four legs, run by four relay team members. The race is open to men’s, women’s, and mixed teams, with mixed teams required to have at least 50% women and 50% men. Refreshment stations are provided along the course, and goulash, sports trophies, and cash prizes for the top teams await at the finish. The race starts at 10:00. Registration is available online until May 21, 2026, or on site if places remain.
course_highlights: The route passes through Salgótarján, Šiatorská, Rátka, Rapovce, and Lučenec
The relay has four legs: 11 km, 10 km, 10.7 km, and 10.5 km
Refreshments are available at every relay exchange point, with goulash at the finish
additional: Registration is valid once the entry fee has been paid. Capacity is limited to 20 relay teams. Each team consists of four runners, and exchanges are permitted only at designated points. The time limit for the full course is four hours. Accompanying participants on the course by car, bicycle, or scooter is strictly prohibited for safety reasons. Runners aged 15 and over may take part. The race takes place on roads open to traffic, with runners keeping to the left. The event is open to participants aged 15 and over, with an emphasis on safety and following the rules. The event also includes cultural activities and online registration.

name: Hlbocký boyard – extrémny beh s prekážkami
description: Hlbocký Boyard is an extreme individual race taking place on 23 May 2026 in the village of Hlboké nad Váhom. This 6th edition features a single lap with numerous adrenaline-fuelled obstacles and steep hills on a motocross track. There are nine categories by age and gender, including children’s categories. Runners can enjoy the fresh air, challenges along the course and, after the race, awards, refreshments and commemorative items.
course_highlights: A 9–10 km course with many new obstacles compared with previous editions
Steep hills and adrenaline-fuelled obstacles on a motocross track
Drinking water at the start and along the course, plus refreshments and goulash after the race
additional: Race-day check-in is from 07:45 at the venue by the football pitch. Starts are staggered: first the children’s Boyard, followed by groups of 4–5 runners every 5 minutes. The entry fee includes a medal, a commemorative item, a goulash and drink voucher, a sweet, water and refreshments along the course. After the race, showers with hot water are available in the football changing rooms. Spectators have free access to the entire course. Parking is free. The race takes place in all weather conditions. Registration is available by prepayment; medals and refreshments are included. It runs from March to May 2025.

name: Jacovská dvadsiatka
description: Jacovská dvadsiatka is a running race held in Jacovce at the football stadium. It offers two distances—a 22 km main race and an 8 km hobby run—on asphalt and gravel farm roads. The 22 km race starts at 10:00 and the 8 km race at 10:15. The event is open to different age groups and genders and is organized by ATK Javorina Jacovce. Entry fees are affordable, making the event accessible to a wide running community.
course_highlights: 50% asphalt roads and 50% gravel farm roads
Two distances: 22 km and 8 km
Start at the football stadium in Jacovce
additional: The 22 km categories are divided by age: up to 39, 40–49, and 50 and over. The 8 km categories are men and women. Starts are staggered: 10:00 for 22 km and 10:15 for 8 km. The course is 50% asphalt and 50% farm roads. Registration is available by email. Race bibs can be purchased or exchanged. The race takes place on May 23, 2026.

name: Kostolanský májovec
description: Kostolanský májovec is a running event organized by run ForRest run o.z., held at the Michal Podolan Football Stadium in Veľké Kostoľany. Runners can choose between two courses measuring 10.90 km and 5.40 km, both with 64 metres of elevation gain and a surface combining asphalt and meadow. The start is scheduled for 11:00, and competitors are divided into age categories, with awards for the fastest man and woman from Veľké Kostoľany. The event offers a refreshment station and is suitable for runners looking for an enjoyable run with gentle elevation in a pleasant setting.
course_highlights: 10.90 km course with +64 m elevation gain
5.40 km course with +64 m elevation gain
Surface: 50% asphalt and 50% meadow
additional: The race awards ceremony is at 12:45. Year of birth determines category placement. To be eligible for the fastest runners from Veľké Kostoľany awards, participants must enter the municipality of Veľké Kostoľany during registration. Number of refreshment stations on the course: 1. The race is run in accordance with traffic regulations. Participants are responsible for their own health insurance. The course is mostly flat, registration is available online and on site, and the event includes categories for different age groups and is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners.

name: Sninský trailový polmaratón
description: The Snina Trail Half Marathon is a running event in Snina, Slovakia, offering two courses: the main 21 km course and a shorter 7.5 km course. The race is for all trail-running enthusiasts who want to enjoy the beauty of nature and the challenges of the terrain. The organizers welcome runners of all levels and offer a great sporting-event atmosphere.
course_highlights: Trail running in the natural surroundings of Snina
Two course options: 21 km and 7.5 km
A challenge for runners of all levels
additional: The race is suitable for runners of all levels, with the option to register online or on-site. It includes various categories, including children and youth.

name: Beh Soviou Poľanou
description: The Run Around Soviou Poľanou in Podolínec is a forest running race offering quality training and the chance to test your abilities on mountain terrain. It is suitable for runners looking to enjoy an exhilarating day in nature and prepare for important races during the season. The route winds through picturesque forests around Podolínec and offers a challenge even for experienced runners.
course_highlights: Forest trails around Podolínec
Mountain terrain with natural obstacles
Picturesque views in the Poľana area
additional: Children’s races are available, along with several routes, including 11 km and 18 km options. Maps, posters, and race regulations are available to download. Registration takes place online via the official website. The race is part of a series and offers online registration and various categories, including a children’s race. The event promotes trail running in nature and offers attractive prizes for the top finishers in each category.

name: Mravenčárska míľa
description: Mravenčárska Mile is a running event held at the football stadium in Plavecký Štvrtok. The race offers categories for men and women across various age groups, as well as categories for children, school-age runners, youth, juniors, Nordic walking, and canicross. The school-age race starts at 10:10 and the main category at 12:00. The event is organized by the Plavecký Štvrtok Municipal Office, which ensures a welcoming atmosphere and high-quality organization for all participants.
course_highlights: The race takes place at the football stadium in Plavecký Štvrtok
Multiple age-group and special categories, including Nordic walking and canicross
The main categories start at 12:00, and the school-age race starts at 10:10
additional: Categories include men and women in various age groups, children, school-age runners, youth, juniors, Nordic walking, and canicross. The organizers are Milan Zajíček and Soňa Zajíčková; their contact phone numbers are 0907 467 595 and 0908 423 975. The race offers categories for various age groups, including children, Nordic walking, and canicross; starts are scheduled for 10:10 and 12:00; the venue is the football stadium in Plavecký Štvrtok.

name: Niže Linča
organizer: Dobrovoľníci z obce Zeleneč, Obecný úrad Zeleneč, Vinársky spolok vinárov a vinohradníkov Zeleneč, DHZ Zeleneč, Zdravotnícka služba Zeleneč

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Štartovné: 15 € do 15.05.2026 ( online registrácia bude spustená od 13.4. 2026 )

description: Niže Linča is a running event in Zeleneč, organized by volunteers from the village together with local associations and the medical service. The race is open to men, women and juniors under 18, with awards also for the fastest man and woman from Linča. The entry fee includes admission to a wine tasting during the St. Urban Festivities, giving the event a unique atmosphere and bringing sport and culture together. Online registration opens on 13 April 2026, and the race takes place on 23 May 2026.
course_highlights: Race in Zeleneč, Zeleneč Vineyards
Categories for men, women and juniors under 18
Admission to a wine tasting included in the entry fee
additional: The entry fee includes admission to a wine tasting during the St. Urban Festivities, valued at €5. Online registration from 13 April 2026; location: Zeleneč, Trnava District; start time: 18:30; venue: Jednotka

name: Martinský offroad maratón a polmaratón
description: The Martin Off-Road Marathon and Half Marathon is a running event held in the beautiful natural surroundings of the Fatra region, in Tomčany near Martin. Runners can enjoy running across meadows, hills, and the foothills of the Fatra, with wonderful views of the Lúčanská, Krivánska, and Veľká Fatra ranges. The route is off-road, with natural obstacles such as mud and fallen trees, adding to its appeal and challenge. The event is intended for runners of different abilities, who can choose a trail to suit their skills and preferences.
course_highlights: A race through the natural surroundings of the Fatra, across meadows and hills
Wonderful views of the Lúčanská, Krivánska, and Veľká Fatra ranges
An off-road route with natural obstacles such as mud and fallen trees
additional: Mandatory equipment: a cup or bottle with a capacity of at least 0.2 l, and a phone with the organizer’s number (0949 465 006). Location: Tomčany (a district of Martin). This is the first edition of the event. No specific prices or registration dates are listed on the website. Distances range from 4.5 km to the marathon. Registration via MisoSport.sk. Mandatory equipment includes a cup or bottle and a phone with the organizer’s number. Various routes and activities are available for children. Start at 10:00.

name: AZ-Pneu Vertical – Dúbravský beh na Kobylu
location: Ul. Pod záhradami, Mestská časť Dúbravka, Bratislava, Slovakia

price_tiers.distance: AZ-pneu vertical 10 km a Dôverun 5 km

description: AZ-Pneu Vertical – Dúbravský beh na Kobylu is a running event in Bratislava, offering races for both children and adults. The race takes place in the Dúbravka borough, starting on Pod záhradami Street (by Lidl). You can compete in the 10 km AZ-pneu vertical, the 5 km Dôverun, or the children’s races. The event is organized by Beh si ty, o.z., together with the Dúbravka Borough. It is suitable for the general public and offers age- and gender-based categories.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the Dúbravka borough of Bratislava
The AZ-pneu vertical course is 10 km long
In addition to the main race, there are children’s races and the 5 km Dôverun
additional: Dôvera health insurance policyholders receive a €2 discount when paying the entry fee online. The children’s races start at 10:20, the AZ-pneu vertical 10 km race starts at 11:00, and the Dôverun 5 km race starts at 11:20. The course follows urban roads in Dúbravka. Registration is available online and on site. The event is scheduled for 23 May 2026.

name: Beh s vlkmi pre život
price_range: od 11 € do 40 € v závislosti od spôsobu registrácie
description: Run with the Wolves for Life is a charitable running event organized by the CHADIM’S CHARITY Foundation, held in the scenic setting of Čierne at the tripoint of Slovakia, Czechia and Poland. It offers six different races, including a half marathon, a 10 km race, a 5 km race, Nordic walking and children’s races. The routes run mainly along paved and forest roads, with beautiful mountain views. Runners can expect well-organized races with marked routes, refreshment stations and a support vehicle carrying water. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes a healthy lifestyle and charitable causes.
course_highlights: Half marathon with +500 m elevation gain, running along mountain ridges with beautiful views
Routes run mainly along paved and forest roads
Routes marked with ribbons, with volunteers at key junctions
additional: The half-marathon course has a time limit of 5 hours, and the 10 km race has a limit of 2 hours. Runners must wear their bib numbers on the front and pass through all checkpoints. There is one refreshment station on the course, and drinks are provided at both the start and finish. During the race, a support vehicle will distribute water at accessible points. Required equipment includes personal identification documents. Insurance covering medical expenses is recommended, as the route crosses the territories of several countries. The event includes various categories for adults and children, on-site registration, an accompanying program and refreshments, with an emphasis on supporting charitable activities.

name: Hutňanská šelma
description: Hutňanská šelma is a running event in Novoveská Huta, offering races for children and adults. The event takes place in the pleasant surroundings of Remeselný šenk za Holubnicou and is divided into several age categories, with prizes for the top three finishers. The children’s races start at 10:00, and the races for adults and older children start at 13:00. The event is suitable for runners of different ages and abilities.
course_highlights: Races in Novoveská Huta, at Remeselný šenk za Holubnicou
Several age categories, from children to adults
Children’s races start at 10:00; races for adults and older children start at 13:00
additional: Race categories include children under 6, children aged 7–9, children aged 10–14, youth, and adults divided by age, with prizes for the top three in each category. The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Novoveská Huta. The children’s races start at 10:00 and the adults’ race at 13:00. Participants also receive a medal, and various activities are offered during the event.

name: Transylvania 100
location: Castelul Bran, Bran, Brașov County, Romania
description: Transylvania 100 is a mountain running event offering five different races, from a half marathon to a 100 km ultramarathon, held in the Bucegi Mountains. The routes cross narrow trails, ancient forests, mountain plateaus and exposed ridgelines, with numerous climbs and descents, all starting and finishing at Bran Castle, in the shadow of the legendary Dracula. The event is recognised as a UTMB Index race and promotes values such as respect, solidarity and self-sufficiency in mountain running. Participants must have prior mountain-running experience for the longer races, and everyone who finishes within the time limits receives a special souvenir.
course_highlights: Routes through narrow trails and ancient forests
Course across mountain plateaus and exposed ridgelines
Start and finish near Bran Castle
additional: SportHG technical T-shirts are available until 1 May 2026, after which they will be replaced by neck warmers. Participation limits and prior experience are mandatory for races over 20 km. All races are solo, with strict self-sufficiency rules between checkpoints. The event includes races for different experience levels, with prizes for winners and medals for all finishers. Participation requires trail-running experience, and registration is online, with limited places.

name: Maratonul Internațional Sibiu
location: Piața Mare, Sibiu, Sibiu County, Romania

price_tiers.distance: Pași pentru oraș by Bilstein 3.35 km

description: Sibiu International Marathon is Romania’s largest philanthropic running event, reaching its 15th edition in 2026. The event combines the joy of running with support for community projects, with runners able to choose to support various local causes through their entry fee. The event features multiple races for all ages and levels, from the full marathon to children’s races, held in Sibiu’s Great Square and surrounding areas. It is a movement that unites and inspires communities, with a strong tradition and significant social impact.
course_highlights: Multiple races: marathon, half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, relay and children’s races
Start and finish in Great Square, Sibiu
A philanthropic event supporting local community projects
additional: Entry fees are considered donations supporting community projects. The event includes races for all ages, including children’s races and a relay. The registration deadline is 4 May 2026. It features multiple races, a registration deadline of 4 May 2026, donation-based fees, and a focus on social and community causes.

name: BRASOV MARATHON Eveniment organizat de CPNT Brașov
description: Brașov Marathon is one of Romania’s largest mountain running events, held in the heart of the Carpathians, around the city of Brașov. The courses include the 10K Cross, Half Marathon, Marathon, and Ultra Marathon, crossing the Tâmpa, Postăvaru, and Piatra Mare massifs and offering impressive views and a unique combination of sport and nature. The event starts in Piața Sfatului, passes historic and natural landmarks, and is part of the Carpathian Circuit, offering ITRA and UTMB points. It is a celebration of health and sport, open to runners of all ages and experience levels.
course_highlights: Mountain routes across the Tâmpa, Postăvaru, and Piatra Mare massifs
Start and finish in Piața Sfatului, passing the Black Church and the Weavers’ Bastion
Panoramic views of Brașov and the surrounding area
additional: Race kits can be collected in Piața Sfatului, with specific hours for each race. The Ultra Marathon starts at 08:00, while the Half Marathon starts in two waves. Mandatory gear checks apply to the Ultra Marathon, Marathon, and Half Marathon. The event also includes races for children and teenagers, held over three days. The start area offers refreshments between 10:30 and 23:00. The event includes races for children and people with special abilities, and is dedicated to promoting running, nature, and the local community.

name: JIDVEI WINELAND TRAILS
location: Castelul Bethlen-Haller, Cetatea de Baltă, Alba, Romania
price_range: 50 lei donație pentru acces la zonele Food & Drinks (pentru ediția Harvest) sau 120-150 RON pentru cursele de alergare
description: Jidvei Weinland Trails is a unique sporting event held on the grounds of Bethlen-Haller Castle, in the heart of Transylvania. The event combines running and cycling on scenic routes through the Jidvei vineyards, offering participants spectacular views and an authentic experience surrounded by nature. It includes races for all fitness levels, from children to adults, as well as recreational and food-and-wine activities for the whole family. It is a celebration of sport, culture, and local tradition, with a friendly and safe atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Running and cycling routes through vineyards and ancient forests
Spectacular scenery in the Jidvei vineyards, in the heart of Transylvania
Event held on the grounds of Bethlen-Haller Castle
additional: Race kits for the 42 km, 21 km, 10 km, and 5 km races, as well as the 1 km and 2 km children’s races. Prizes for the youngest runners. Relaxation activities and food-and-wine experiences are included in the event. The organizers are preparing a fun-filled world and creative workshops for children in a safe, friendly setting. Participants can choose from 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km races. The event also includes a grape-picking competition, guided tours, activities for children, charitable donations, and wine and traditional food tastings.

name: Semimaratonul Eroilor Invictus
description: The Invictus Heroes Half Marathon, taking place on May 23, 2026, in Bistrița, is a sporting event dedicated to commemorating Heroes’ Day and promoting mass-participation sports. The event brings together the local community and amateur athletes, offering a half-marathon race and other sporting events. The route starts in Central Square and passes through the city’s main thoroughfares. The event is held under the patronage of Prince Radu, with support from several local institutions and associations. Participants are encouraged to read the regulations, register, and donate in support of the cause.
course_highlights: Urban route starting and finishing in Central Square, Bistrița
Passes through the city’s main streets: Dornei Street, Șincai Street, Mihai Eminescu Street, Republicii Boulevard, and Barbu Șt. Delavrancea Street
Event dedicated to commemorating Heroes’ Day and promoting mass-participation sports
additional: Online registrations are validated until May 1, 2026; the event is organized by the Invictus Volunteers Association – Bistrița Branch, under the High Patronage of Prince Radu; participants can receive the official Invictus T-shirt and related merchandise; the event includes other sporting events in addition to the half marathon; participants are advised to read the regulations for details about equipment, timing, and prizes. Four different routes, simplified registration, a donation required for the T-shirt, an event for all ages, and activities promoting solidarity and gratitude.

name: Obciniada Night Run
organizer: Obciniada / Asociația Ținuturi Durabile / Asociația Club Sportiv Bucovina între Obcini
description: Obciniada Night Run is a night running race in the heart of Bucovina, offering spectacular routes and a festival atmosphere beneath the stars. The event promotes outdoor activity and a healthy lifestyle, engages the local community, and supports the education of disadvantaged children. Participants can choose from several distances, from a half marathon to children’s races, and enjoy an authentic experience in nature, with hydration points, a hot meal, and prizes. The festival combines sport with a friendly atmosphere and environmental responsibility.
course_highlights: Spectacular night routes through the forests and ridges of Bucovina
Hydration and food points along the route
Festival atmosphere with general admission and a hot meal at the finish
additional: Participants receive a personalized race bib with a timing chip, access to hydration and food points, a general admission wristband for the festival area, a hot meal at the finish, and cash prizes in the age-group and OPEN categories. The festival offers accommodation options at a campsite or partner hotels and recommends traveling by train or bus to reduce environmental impact. Multiple race distances, festival atmosphere, prizes, real-time results, participant amenities, charitable purpose

description: Tour de Tur is an annual mountain biking and trail running competition held in the area around Lake Mujdeni, Orașu Nou Commune, Satu Mare County. The event offers varied courses for all levels, from MTB marathon races to trail running, and is dedicated to both professional athletes and amateurs passionate about nature and adventure. The 20th edition in 2026 promises a complete sporting experience, with well-marked courses and significant elevation gain, set in picturesque natural surroundings. The organizers invite all participants to register online and enjoy the event’s competitive and friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: MTB Marathon course: 44 km with 1,180 m of elevation gain
MTB Race course: 34 km with 930 m of elevation gain
Trail Running Half Marathon course: 25 km with 990 m of elevation gain
additional: The courses have significant elevation gain, ranging from 184 m for the Fun Run (6 km) to 1,180 m for the MTB Marathon (44 km). Minors must have written consent from a parent or guardian to register. The organizer is the Transylvanian Carpathian Society - Satu Mare. Telephone contact: +40-743-419443. Registration is exclusively online, and the event includes courses ranging from 6 km to marathon distance, suited to different fitness levels.

name: S24H
location: Parcul Copiilor „Ion Creangă”, Timișoara, Timiș County, Romania
description: S24H is an international ultramarathon held in Ion Creangă Children’s Park in Timișoara, Romania. Participants run on a 1,222.75-meter paved course, illuminated at night, aiming to cover the greatest distance in 6, 12, or 24 hours. The event is open to both professionals and enthusiasts of endurance running, offering a transformative experience and an exceptional mental and physical challenge. There are also 50 km and 100 km races, as well as a 12-hour relay for teams of four.
course_highlights: A 1,222.75-meter paved course in Ion Creangă Children’s Park
The course is illuminated at night for runners’ safety
Two hydration and nutrition stations along the course, offering water, glucose, electrolytes, fruit, and snacks
additional: There are pavilions/tents along the course where runners can store their personal gear, food, and sleeping bags. Race kits must be picked up the day before, and a medical certificate is mandatory for all individual events, except relays. The event includes a runners’ briefing and a pasta party before the race. The event takes place on a paved, illuminated course, with the option to participate in several distance and time categories, making it an excellent opportunity to test physical and mental endurance.

name: SEMIMARATONUL EROILOR INVICTUS
description: The Invictus Heroes Half Marathon is an annual race held in Timișoara, dedicated to heroes and supporting wounded military personnel. The event promotes a winning spirit and national values through sport as part of the Invictus Romania project. The fourth edition continues the tradition of bringing runners and supporters together in an atmosphere of respect and solidarity. Participants can also contribute through donations to support wounded military personnel.
course_highlights: Symbolic courses in the colors of the national flag: blue, yellow, and red
An event of solidarity and national commemoration
Organized by Invictus Romania, with a tradition spanning more than a decade
additional: The event is part of a broader Invictus Romania project, which also includes other sporting competitions and activities supporting wounded military personnel. Official Invictus Heroes Half Marathon T-shirts are available for supporters. No details were found about start times, distance options, or registration prices. The event takes place in May 2026 in Timișoara and includes a half marathon and commemorative activities.

name: Mokra Gora Trail
description: Mokra Gora Trail is a new regional hiking trail that runs across Mount Mokra Gora, connecting Montenegro, Kosovo* and Serbia. The trail is part of the Via Dinarica network and offers a unique opportunity for adventure tourism and exploration of the Balkans’ unspoiled nature. It was developed with the support of the Institute for Territorial Economic Development and the Regional Cooperation Council, with the aim of promoting cross-border tourism and preserving the region’s natural beauty. The trail is known for its Via Ferrata attractions, which offer exciting experiences for hikers and nature lovers.
course_highlights: The trail runs across Mount Mokra Gora, connecting three countries: Montenegro, Kosovo* and Serbia
It is part of the Via Dinarica network, known for its unspoiled nature and mountain landscapes
Via Ferrata sections offer adventure opportunities for hikers
additional: The trail is part of the Via Dinarica cross-border project and was developed to promote sustainable tourism and improve infrastructure. No race price or registration details are listed, indicating that the focus is on the hiking trail rather than a competition. The contact organization is the Regional Cooperation Council, headquartered in Sarajevo. The project is linked to the development of regional hiking trails, including Via Ferrata, GPS mapping and the installation of signage, with the aim of promoting sustainable tourism and cooperation in the region.

name: Dragutin Tomašević
description: The Dragutin Tomašević Memorial Athletics Race is held in the village of Bistrica near Petrovac na Mlavi in memory of the first Serbian Olympian. This 21st anniversary race brings together runners of all ages and categories, offering opportunities to compete in the men’s and women’s events and across age groups. Participants receive chipped bib numbers and “Joma” Dry Fit T-shirts, while the organizers provide transportation and a celebratory dinner. The race is known for its tradition and support from the local community, creating a welcoming atmosphere for all runners.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the village of Bistrica, Petrovac na Mlavi
Chipped personalized bib number and “Joma” Dry Fit sports T-shirt
Transportation from the registration center to the race start and a celebratory dinner at the Olimpik swimming pools
additional: The participant package includes transportation from Belgrade (Arena) to Petrovac na Mlavi and back, with a tour leader. It is limited to 50 competitors who pay first. Participants receive a 50% discount on a day ticket to Ždrelo Spa. Special accommodation benefits are available for race participants at the Olimpic swimming pool. The race is part of the annual events honoring Dragutin Tomašević, with organization that includes timing, promotion, T-shirts, and medals for participants.

name: Ivanjica Trail
description: Ivanjica Trail is a unique trail race in Serbia, bringing together runners of different fitness levels across several courses of varying distances and difficulty. The races take place in the beautiful natural landscapes of Ivanjica and Golija, with viewpoints, meadows, forests and streams, offering an unforgettable running experience in nature. The Golija PREMIUM race, starting at the summit of Golija, and the two-day ULTRA 66K stage race, which connects three mountains and offers a challenge for experienced runners, are particular highlights. The organizers provide race packs, refreshments, lunch, transport and accommodation for participants, creating a welcoming and supportive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Routes through spectacular landscapes featuring viewpoints, clearings and meadows
Race starts at elevations of 800 to 1833 meters above sea level
Electronic timing and staffed aid stations
additional: Free transport is provided for the Golija PREMIUM 29K race from Ivanjica to the start and from Kovilj back. ULTRA 66K is a two-day stage race with overnight accommodation at a school in Kovilj, four meals, six aid stations and a gathering around a campfire. The first ULTRA 66K stage starts at 11h, and the second at 09h the following day. The race pack includes a race number, finisher’s medal, refreshments and lunch. Multiple distances, a two-day event, an available list of registered participants, technically challenging routes, electronic timing, and race packs with medals and meals.

name: ONERUN 2026
description: One Run is an international race taking place for the eighth consecutive year, simultaneously across multiple countries and continents. The event is known for having been entered in the Guinness World Records twice as the world’s largest half marathon with a synchronized start. The race is open to everyone, with four distances available, and promotes health, accessibility, and community through sport and outdoor activities. This year, we are running in Veliko Gradište, Serbia, on May 23, with the goal of taking part in a new Guinness World Record attempt in Serbia for the first time.
course_highlights: Four distances: 1 km, 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km
Synchronized start across multiple countries and continents
Event with two Guinness World Records for the largest half marathon with a synchronized start
additional: Registration is at Žitni trg in Veliko Gradište from 08:00 to 11:30 in the tent. The race pack includes a race bib with a chip, sponsor gifts, live results, and a diploma in PDF format. The race program includes a warm-up at 12:45, the start of the 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km races at 13:30, and the awards ceremony at 15:30. The event features races of different distances, is open to all ages, and race packs and medals are available to participants. It takes place in the center of Veliko Gradište, with morning registration and afternoon races.

name: SALOMON SZENTENDRE TRAIL
description: The Salomon Szentendre Trail is a 54-kilometer trail-running race held in and around Szentendre, with 1,800 meters of elevation gain. Runners cross the Apátkúti Stream twelve times and pass through beautiful landscapes, including Visegrád and Kálvária. The finish is in Szentendre’s main square and along the Danube promenade, where tourists applaud the finishers. This race offers a unique experience where nature meets the urban environment.
course_highlights: 54 km distance, 1,800 meters of elevation gain
Twelve crossings of the Apátkúti Stream
Beautiful views in Visegrád and at Kálvária
additional: 54 km, 1,800 meters of elevation gain, trail, registration, volunteer opportunity, multiple distances also available (30k, 42k, 84k, 111k)

name: SALOMON SZENTLÁSZLÓ TRAIL
location: Lázár cár tér, Szentendre, Pest County, Hungary
distance_verbose: 111 km, 50 miles, 50 km, Maraton, 30 km, Félmaraton
description: The Salomon Szentlászló Trail is an exciting trail-running race in Szentendre, featuring the steepest climbs in the Visegrád Mountains. The race starts at dawn, and participants run across the misty Sikáros Meadow as the cuckoo welcomes them. Before reaching the finish, runners are also cheered on by tourists along the pedestrian streets and in the Main Square. This challenge offers an unforgettable experience for nature lovers and trail-running enthusiasts alike.
course_highlights: The steepest climbs in the Visegrád Mountains
A route across the misty Sikáros Meadow
Finish in Szentendre’s Main Square, where tourists cheer on the runners
additional: Registration was open until noon on May 1, 2026, and entries reached the maximum of 1,600. The race starts at dawn, when the bell strikes two. During the race, runners travel through natural surroundings over varied terrain, and they finish before 7 p.m. Multiple distances (54K, 84K, 30K, 22K, 42K, 111K), varied terrain, registration available, 14:00 start, multiple sponsors and categories.

name: VeganRun
description: VeganRun Slovakia is the first official Slovak vegan running event, organized by the Slovak Vegan Society. The event brings together sport, health, and compassion, offering more than just a run—it is a shared step toward a healthier body, a cleaner planet, and a better-informed society. The routes start at the iconic Rača Amphitheatre and pass through the meeting point of the Carpathian forest and vineyards, offering forest therapy, varied terrain, and epic views of Bratislava. Runners can choose between the 5 km, 10 km, and Canicross events, which allow them to run with a dog.
course_highlights: The routes pass through the Carpathian forest and flowering vineyards, with fresh air and shade from the trees
Panoramic views of Bratislava from vineyard trails
Varied terrain, from soft forest paths to winding trails in the Little Carpathians

Proceeds from the event support animals in shelters and an educational program on plant-based nutrition for doctors. The event is charitable and supports educational programs on plant-based nutrition, with proceeds donated to animal shelters and doctor education.

organizer: Behači Bytča a okolie, v spolupráci s Mesto Bytča
description: Bytčiansky Kros is a traditional running race in Bytča, offering four courses of varying lengths and difficulty, including the 21 km Super Kros with 500 m of elevation gain. The course runs mostly over terrain such as farm tracks, meadows, and cycle paths, with 80% off-road and 20% paved surfaces. Runners can expect three aid stations on the longer courses and clear course markings. Competitions are divided into age categories for both men and women, with the first three finishers in each category receiving awards.

The course is 80% off-road and 20% paved
Three aid stations on the longer courses
additional: Runners on the 21 km Super Kros must download the GPS course file to their phone or watch and carry a charged, working mobile phone. description: Crosul Copiilor 2026 is a competition for children aged 0 to 14, held in Central Park in Baia Mare. The event offers races tailored to different age categories, from the Baby Run for children under 4 to timed, competitive races for the older age groups. It is a race full of energy and joy, with support from parents, where every child is encouraged to take part and enjoy running. The organizers limit the number of participants to ensure a pleasant and safe experience for everyone.
course_highlights: Course in Central Park in Baia Mare
Races tailored to age categories from 0 to 14
Non-competitive Baby Run with medals and prizes for all participants
additional: The total number of participants is limited to 250, with 20 places for the Baby Run. Children may participate only with parental consent. Prizes are awarded for first, second, and third place in the timed races by age category, while the Baby Run is non-competitive, with medals and prizes for all participants. The event includes medical support, medals, prizes, and surprises for children. Registration is open until 16 May 2026.

name: TRANSYLVANIA 100K
description: Transylvania 100 is a mountain ultramarathon event held in the wilderness of the Bucegi Mountains, crossing high-altitude trails. The event includes five different races, ranging from a half marathon to a 100 km ultramarathon, all starting and finishing near Bran Castle, known as Dracula’s Castle. The routes offer a unique experience for mountain-running enthusiasts, combining narrow trails, ancient forests, mountain plateaus, and exposed ridgelines. Races are open to solo competitors, with category prizes and special keepsakes for those who finish within the time limits.
course_highlights: Mountain trails featuring narrow paths and ancient forests
Routes across mountain plateaus and exposed ridgelines in the Bucegi Mountains
Start and finish near Bran Castle, an iconic landmark
additional: Previous experience on mountain trails is required for registration, with different requirements depending on the distance. After 1 May 2026, SportHG technical T-shirts will be replaced with neck gaiters. Places are limited, and registrations are confirmed after online payment and verification of previous experience. The event also includes other mountain races, such as a skyrace and a half marathon, and offers prizes and finisher mementos.

name: SH4H Concursul internaţional de alergare de anduranţă
location: Parcul Copiilor “Ion Creangă”, Timișoara, Timiș County, Romania
description: The S24H International Endurance Running Competition is an ultramarathon held in “Ion Creangă” Children’s Park in Timișoara, on a lit, paved loop measuring 1,222.75 metres. Participants can choose 6-, 12- or 24-hour events, as well as 50 km and 100 km races, aiming to cover the greatest possible distance within the allotted time. The event is open to professional and amateur runners, offering a transformative experience and the opportunity to test their physical and mental limits. It is organised to high standards, with international recognition and dedicated participant facilities.
course_highlights: A 1,222.75-metre paved loop, illuminated at night
6-, 12- and 24-hour events, plus 50 km and 100 km races
Located in “Ion Creangă” Children’s Park in Timișoara
additional: The course is measured and IAAF-certified, with individual distance tracking and chip timing. Participants receive a race kit and finisher’s medal, and have access to a pasta party, hydration and fueling stations, equipment storage, free photos, recovery massage and emergency medical services. The event also includes a technical briefing and pasta party on the evening before the race. A paved, night-lit course and multiple duration and distance events for amateur and professional athletes.

name: Trail trka Tibuzde 2026
description: 1. Tibužde Trail is a trail race held in the village of Tibužde, near Vranje. The race offers two different distances, 27 km and 7 km, giving participants the opportunity to enjoy challenging terrain and the beauty of nature. The race starts at 7 a.m., and the event runs until 5 p.m., creating a great atmosphere for all running and nature enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Natural terrain around the village of Tibužde
Two distances: 27 km and 7 km
Views and challenging terrain
additional: The race runs from 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. Terrain: mountainous. Registration: online. Categories: multiple, including a children's race. After the race, there is a get-together with lunch and music.

description: The BUFF-CEUS 72H World Cup is an international ultrarunning race held at Füred Camping and Holiday Village in Balatonfüred. The event features races of several durations, including 72, 48, 24, 12, and 6 hours, as part of the Central European Ultra Series. The course is a 898-meter loop with a minimal elevation gain of 1 meter, making it ideal for long-distance runners. Participants can enter individual and team categories, and every participant receives a commemorative medal. The event has a friendly, family atmosphere, and a central refreshment table is available at the race centre.
course_highlights: 898-meter loop course with a minimal elevation gain of 1 meter
Race centre on the east side of Füred Camping
Central refreshment table with water, hot tea, isotonic drink, squash, and coffee
additional: The event features races of several durations: the 72H World Cup and 48H European Cup start at 12:00 on 2026.05.28; the 24H European Cup starts at 12:00 on 2026.05.30; the 12H European Cup starts at 08:00 on 2026.05.30; and the 6H European Cup starts at 06:00 on 2026.05.31. The opening ceremony and technical briefing take place on 2026.05.27 from 17:00 to 18:30. Race-number pickup is available at several times before and during the event. Accommodation and parking spaces are available from 2026.05.27 at 12:00 until 2026.05.28 at 10:00; vehicle movement is restricted during the race. Awards are given in age-group and gender categories, as well as in team competitions. Every participant receives a commemorative medal. The event takes place at Füred Camping and Holiday Village in Balatonfüred, from May 28 to 31, 2026. Participants can enter different distances, and the organizers provide runners with the necessary infrastructure and services.

The start is scheduled for 17:30, with categories for men, women, local runners and Nordic Walking. Participants receive a race bib, a timing chip, refreshments and a finisher’s medal.

Grass loop on the stadium
Two disciplines: 7 km run and 4 km Nordic Walking
additional: The race package includes a race bib, a timing chip (to be returned at the finish after the race), refreshments along the course and at the finish, and a finisher’s medal. Changing rooms are available at the Ružindol sports complex. Categories are divided by age and gender, including categories for local runners from Ružindol. The course combines asphalt, dirt and a grass loop; the event is open to men, women, local runners and Nordic Walkers. Registration is available online or on site. Refreshments and medals for winners are included.

This community sports event offers participants the joy of exercise and the chance to enjoy the natural surroundings. The program includes a variety of sporting events and family activities, offering an enjoyable experience for all ages. The beautiful setting of Lake Tisza is ideal for relaxation and active recreation.

Community and family activities in nature
A wide range of sports opportunities around the lake
additional: The event takes place in Sarud, on the shores of Lake Tisza, where Élményfalu offers a variety of experiences and a range of sports and leisure activities, including bicycle and e-bike rental, sailing, water sports, and family and children’s programs. Several types of accommodation are available at the venue. The event also supports the Slow Food movement and showcases local culinary experiences. Participants can also enjoy a range of accommodation options, local attractions, and family activities in the Lake Tisza area.

Organized by Sprint Futóklub, the event offers running enthusiasts the chance to enjoy nature and varied terrain. The race aims to promote the joy of sport and physical activity, and welcomes everyone who enjoys an active lifestyle. The organizers reserve the right to change the date and program.

Varied, hilly terrain
A run close to nature
additional: The race takes place at Tardos Football Pitch, starts at 10:00, and is part of a series organized by Sprint Futóklub.

description: The Hegyen-Völgyön Run is a traditional running race for sports enthusiasts in Tardos, organized by the Sprint Running Club. The race offers challenges over three different distances: a 200-meter children’s run, plus 4 km and 12 km distances for more serious runners. The race starts at the Tardos sports field and uses chip timing to ensure accurate results. The event has a friendly, family atmosphere and attracts many runners from the surrounding area each year.

Three distances: 200 m, 4 km and 12 km
Chip timing for accurate results
additional: Registration and race-day preparation are available at the venue from 9 a.m. The race is organized by the Sprint Running Club. The 33rd edition of the event is family-friendly and offers several age groups the opportunity to participate. Venue: Tardos / Sports Field. Multiple distances, prizes, medals, trophies, gifts and chip timing.

name: Beh v Raji – prológ
description: Beh v raji is a traditional running race held in the beautiful surroundings of Dobšinská Ice Cave and the surrounding area. Participants can choose from several distances, including a prologue, half marathon, 10 km and 5 km races, which run mainly on asphalt roads with partial traffic closures. The prologue is a hilly 1 km run along a forest trail from the car park to the ice cave. The event is suitable for the general public and also offers Nordic walking.
course_highlights: The 1 km prologue is a hilly forest-trail course leading to the ice cave
The half-marathon course follows an asphalt road through the village of Stratená and Stratenská Píla
The 10 km and 5 km courses are flat and follow an asphalt road with partial traffic closures
additional: Race-day registration takes place in the OOCR building. The prologue starts on Friday, 29.5.2026, from 16:00 to 17:15; Saturday’s races take place on 30.5.2026, from 8:00 to 10:40. Participants will receive a functional-material headband featuring the Beh v raji logo (the first 300 registered participants) and refreshments after crossing the finish line. The races take place with partial road closures and one lane reserved for runners. The race time limit is 2 hours 30 minutes. The event includes men’s and women’s categories, starts at 17:30, registration is available on the website, and the race is supported by the Košice Region.

description: The Salibský Half Marathon, Hornosalibská Ten and Hornosalibská Three are traditional running events organised by RoniRun Club in the village of Horné Saliby. The races offer certified courses of 21.1 km, 10 km and 3 km, running through a picturesque area, with refreshments and chip timing. The event is suitable for the general public, including children, for whom special children’s races are held. In addition to the sporting experience, visitors can look forward to a rich accompanying programme featuring music, martial arts demonstrations and a raffle.
course_highlights: Certified courses of 21.1 km, 10 km and 3 km
Refreshment stations with Zlatý bažant non-alcoholic beer and a wide selection of drinks
Picturesque surroundings in the village of Horné Saliby, with the TJ Horné Saliby football ground
additional: The race pack includes a race number, refreshments during the race and at the finish, chip timing, Zlatý bažant non-alcoholic beer, a raffle ticket and an event plastic cup. The race is environmentally friendly, with paper cups and reusable cups subject to a €2 deposit. Children’s races are free, and children receive a medal. A rich accompanying programme is planned, including bouncy castles, horses, horse-drawn carriages, drummers, a DJ, and martial arts and archery demonstrations. The event includes 21 km, 10 km and 3 km courses, with starts scheduled for 10:00, 10:30 and 10:35, and the children’s race starting at 9:15. The event also has a charitable dimension and uses eco-friendly cups.

name: Self-Transcendence 6/12h a 100km beh / Sri Chinmoy Self-Transcendence 100km beh
description: The Sri Chinmoy Self-Transcendence 6/12-hour and 100 km race in Šamorín is a traditional ultrarunning event held on May 30, 2026, in Pomlé City Park. This is the 24th edition of the 6-hour race and the 15th edition of the 12-hour and 100 km races, with categories for individuals and relays. Runners can compete in various age categories, including men’s and women’s veteran categories over 50. Relays consist of up to three runners, who may take turns in any order, with each member required to complete at least one lap after taking over. Results are measured by the actual distance covered, to the nearest meter.
course_highlights: The race takes place in Pomlé City Park in Šamorín.
The course is a loop, and relay runners may take turns in a specially marked section.
The time limit for the 100 km race is 12 hours.
additional: Runners may take a break at any time, but must report it to the lap recorder. After the race ends, runners must place a marker on the left side of the course and remain nearby until their actual distance covered has been recorded. For safety reasons, accompanying runners by bicycle or on skates is not permitted. The course doctor has the right to withdraw a runner from the race at any time. The event includes 6-hour, 12-hour, and 100 km categories, with relay options, and has rules for measuring distance and conduct during the race. Registration is open, with dates and fees provided.

The event also includes children’s categories, with different race distances according to age, as well as the main 5 km and 10 km races. It is suitable for the general public and offers awards in age and gender categories. The organizers emphasize convenient online registration and accurate chip timing.

The course surface is asphalt and dirt road
Children’s categories with race distances from 40 m to 1,000 m
