3 km recreational course suitable for the general public
Children’s events for preschoolers through juniors
additional: The race is accompanied by a rich cultural and social program, a raffle, and performances by musical groups. It is also part of regional running competitions and the East Slovak Grand Prix for Endurance Runners (VVCV). Race director Ján Tomčo is an active runner and founder of the MTC Vyšná Šebastová club, bringing a spirit of fair play and determination to the event. The course includes a climb to Nevická Cottage; the event also features children’s races, a rich cultural program, awards, and recognition.

name: Crosul Supereroilor
description: The Superheroes Run is an energizing race that brings together thousands of participants in Cluj-Napoca as part of Sports Festival. The event promotes team spirit and fun, offering a unique sporting experience in the heart of the city. Participants can enjoy a vibrant atmosphere and challenges on routes adapted for all ages and fitness levels.
course_highlights: Urban route in the Cluj Arena area
Part of Sports Festival
Friendly, energizing atmosphere for all ages
additional: The 2025 edition took place at Cluj Arena, and half of the registration fee was donated to the Via Transilvanica project of the Tășuleasa Social Association. Registration details and the fee for 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: Tinca Cross
description: Tinca Cross is a running race organized by ACS Bihorul Oradea in partnership with Tinca Town Hall and the Local Council, taking place on 7 June 2026. The event features cross-country races over 5 km and 10 km, suitable for endurance runners aged 14 and over. The course starts at the Tinca communal stadium and follows a 2.5 km loop through the forest beside the stadium, finishing at the stadium. Participants under 18 need written consent from a parent or guardian. Cash prizes and diplomas are awarded to the top finishers.
course_highlights: A 2.5 km loop through the forest beside the communal stadium
5 km race: 2 laps; 10 km race: 4 laps
Marked with red-and-white tape; start and finish at Tinca communal stadium
additional: Participants can confirm their attendance on Saturday from 17:00 to 19:30 at Tinca communal stadium, or on race day from 8:00 to 9:30. Technical briefings will be held on Saturday, 06.06.2026, at 19:00 and on race day at 9:00. A refreshment point at the start will offer water, isotonic drinks, soft drinks, and fruit. Participants under 18 need written consent from a parent or guardian and copies of their ID cards. Athletes suspended for doping may not participate. Cross-country courses; online registration is open until 31 May 2026, with on-site registration available if needed.

name: Village Trail
description: Village Trail 2026 is the third edition of the race, held in Višnjica, on the outskirts of Belgrade, on June 7, 2026. The race combines sport, nature, and adventure, with two courses winding through beautiful landscapes, including a viewpoint overlooking the Danube and Belgrade. The start and finish are at Dunavska Terasa restaurant, and the event is suitable for experienced runners and beginners. An entertainment program is provided for children and families, while runners can look forward to support from volunteers and an after-run party.
course_highlights: The course passes by the Church of St. Nicholas, built in 1842
Views of the Danube and Belgrade from a viewpoint
The course passes by the protected habitat of the European bee-eater
additional: The race pack includes a race number with a timing chip, an official Village Trail T-shirt, and a finisher's medal for everyone who completes the race within the time limit. Professional race photos and a detailed plan will be sent by email before the race. A special entertainment program is provided for children and families, and runners can enjoy the after-run party. Participation includes medals, T-shirts, and organizational support, and the race is intended for fans of trail running and nature.

name: Angličák night run Pezinok
description: Angličák Night Run Pezinok is a 5-kilometre night race held at the Rozálka Health Park in Pezinok. Runners can enjoy a fast, dynamic run along a route through the Little Carpathians, illuminated by artificial lighting that creates a unique atmosphere. The event is open to everyone aged 15 and over and is divided into starting corrals according to performance. The organisers prioritise safety, so headphones are prohibited, and reflective gear or headlamps are recommended. Registration is available online and is tied to the runner’s name; ticket re-registration is possible until 9 June 2026.
course_highlights: A 5 km night run with artificial lighting
The route passes through Rozálka Health Park, the Little Carpathians and Radničné Square
Starting corrals are assigned according to the time submitted from a previous race
additional: Participants must be at least 15 years old in the calendar year 2025. A ticket can be re-registered to another person until 9 June 2026 for a fee of 10 euros. The use of headphones during the race is strictly prohibited. Reflective gear and headlamps are recommended for the night run. Entry is non-transferable and tied to the runner’s name. The route runs from Rozálka Health Park through Malokarpatkú, Majakovského Bridge, Okružná Street, SNP Bridge, Kupeckého and Holubyho, and finishes at Radničné Square. Registration is available online only; re-registration is required, and entry is tied to the participant’s name.

name: The Run Slovakia
description: THE RUN SLOVAKIA 2026 is a national relay race across Slovakia, taking place over three days. Runners cover more than 530 km together from Košice to Bratislava, passing through beautiful natural scenery, historic landmarks and picturesque towns. The event offers a unique sporting atmosphere, teamwork and many unforgettable experiences. The route passes significant places such as Spiš Castle, the High Tatras, Orava Castle and the Little Carpathians, with a rich programme of accompanying activities for runners to enjoy.
course_highlights: A 530 km route from Košice to Bratislava
Passes significant natural and historic landmarks such as Spiš Castle, the High Tatras and Orava Castle
Total ascent of 7,308 m and descent of 7,376 m
additional: The total number of participating teams is limited to 100. Registration takes place via a web application that enables real-time runner tracking, live results, navigation and notifications from the organizing team. The race is intended for teams of runners and offers real-time results tracking. Registration is open, various promotional items are available, and a mobile app is provided for tracking performances.

name: SepsiRun
description: SepsiRun is a running festival held in the city of Sfântu Gheorghe and its surroundings, with the aim of becoming the area’s largest running event and attracting over 1,000 participants from across the country. The event features several races on urban and trail routes, suitable for all experience levels, with distances ranging from 5 km to 23 km. SepsiRun offers a complete running experience, combining nature and the city with varied routes and a welcoming atmosphere for runners.
course_highlights: Urban and trail routes in Sfântu Gheorghe and the surrounding forests
A range of distances: 5 km, 10 km, 21 km (half marathon), 23 km trail, and children’s races
Routes suited to all experience levels, with urban and natural scenery
additional: The event also includes special races such as Vertical Night Run, Nordic Walking, Gen Z Run, and Kids Run. There is a separate edition called Sepsi Inst. Run 2, with 5 km and 8 km routes, featuring a quiz along the course and special prizes. After the race, participants can enjoy healthy snacks and film screenings in Piața Libertății. Participants can choose from the 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, and trail races, with registration periods in March, April, and May. The event has a festival atmosphere, with an emphasis on promoting the city and its surroundings.

name: Pedală în Bănie ~ 2026
distance_verbose: Maraton, 24 km, 14 km, 3000 metri, 1500 metri, 0.6 km
description: Pedală în Bănie is a traditional sporting event in the Dolj region, dedicated to mountain biking and trail running enthusiasts. Held in the Palilula area of Craiova, the event offers routes inspired by the “JURASSIC” theme, with challenges that test participants’ strength, speed, and endurance. With a range of races for all ages and skill levels, Pedală în Bănie promotes health, community spirit, and environmental protection, offering a complete experience of competition and adventure in nature. Its friendly atmosphere and thoughtful organization make it a celebration of sport and outdoor activity.
course_highlights: Themed routes inspired by dinosaurs and prehistoric tribes
The 43 km T-Rex MTB & E-Bike race, the ultimate test of strength and endurance
A variety of trail running and mountain biking routes in the Palilula area of Craiova
additional: The cycling events take place on June 13, and the running events on June 14. Cycling helmets are mandatory for all competitors. Mountain bikes with 26-, 27.5-, or 29-inch wheels are permitted, and electric bikes are accepted only in the MTB & E-Bike categories. Special volunteering and cleanup activities are also organized before and after the event. mountain biking, running, family-friendly, multiple categories, community impact

name: Brutálfutás 15.0
description: Brutálfutás 15.0 is a fun obstacle race in Nyáregyháza, where participants can take on a mix of a military training course and an obstacle race over 2, 3 or 7 kilometres. It’s not about performance, but about having a great time and creating unforgettable memories—with mud and water guaranteed. Runners can look forward to a unique finisher’s medal and plenty of mud, and can also enter as charity runners. The event attracts participants from hundreds of towns and villages across the country and offers a truly entertaining, family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: A mix of a military training course and an obstacle race
Plenty of mud and water, with unforgettable obstacles
A unique finisher’s medal and a party atmosphere
additional: Registration is available exclusively online at nevezes.futanet.hu, with payment by bank card or SZÉP card. The venue is the MotoCross track in Nyáregyháza, easily accessible from the M5 motorway. The student discount is available to school-age participants upon presentation of a full-time student ID. Traditional running gear is not needed for the race; a good mood and a spirit of adventure are what matter most. Trail running, online and on-site registration, a unique finisher’s medal, challenging obstacles and a mud-filled course.

name: Bábolna Bio Sunset Run

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Ovis futam -> ingyenes, de regisztrációhoz kötött

description: The Bábolna Bio Sunset Run is a lively evening running event taking place on June 13, 2026, in the center of Bábolna, in front of the Strand- és Termálfürdő. Along the route, runners pass the riding stables and the famous Bábolna Arboretum and Animal Park. The race starts at sunset with extra atmospheric lighting, and participants can choose from three distances, including a half marathon relay. Runners receive a premium race pack with BioTechUSA refreshments, and everyone who finishes within the time limit receives a unique finisher’s medal.
course_highlights: The route passes the riding stables
Runs through the Bábolna Arboretum and Animal Park
Evening start at sunset with extra atmospheric lighting
additional: BioTechUSA refreshments are provided at the aid stations. Participants can choose between ECO and premium race packs; the premium pack includes a Mizuno event T-shirt. At the finish, runners are welcomed at the Athletes Garden with a unique finisher’s medal. The race starts in the evening at sunset, so the summer heat is not a problem. Time limits apply to the 5.25 km, 10.5 km and half marathon distances; there is no time limit for the preschoolers’ and family runs. The race office is located on Tüzér Street in Budapest, with opening hours and a phone contact. Evening event, multiple distances, registration required, an eco-friendly and family-friendly atmosphere, and the option to buy discounted bath admission after the race.

name: Edelényi Kastélysziget Esti Körök 3 / 7 / 14 / 21
description: The Edelény Castle Island Evening Circuits is a charming running race held around the L'Huillier-Coburg Castle. The race offers several distances, so everyone can find a challenge that suits them. It is an ideal choice for those who enjoy the castle park’s distinctive atmosphere and the experience of running in the evening. The organizers welcome participants with professional timekeeping and a convenient registration platform.
course_highlights: Run in the grounds of L'Huillier-Coburg Castle
Evening atmosphere and a distinctive setting
Several distances: 3 km, 7 km, 14 km, and 21 km
additional: Registration takes place on korido.hu, where chip timing (RFID, HuTag) is provided. Participants can choose from several distances, and the organizers send automatic confirmation of registration and payment. Bib production and safety pins are provided, and payment is also possible by card via SimplePay. The race offers several distances and RFID timing, with varied terrain including forest and asphalt sections. Registration takes place on korido.hu.

name: Kecskeméti Sport Fesztivál
description: The Kecskemét Sport Festival is a traditional community sporting event in Kecskemét, near Benkó Hill. The event promotes recreational exercise and sport, welcoming participants in a family-friendly atmosphere with a variety of running activities. Alongside running, the festival also features charity events and community activities, bringing sport and social responsibility together. The organizers warmly invite everyone who wants to run to enjoy the pleasures of exercise and the closeness of nature together.
course_highlights: Running route near Benkó Hill in pleasant natural surroundings
Community running events with a family-friendly atmosphere
Charity running programs and additional sporting events
additional: The event also includes charity activities, with proceeds supporting local foundations. There is usually a raffle for runners, and the organizers provide refreshments and food for participants. The event may include ultramarathons, easy runs, and other sporting activities that encourage active participation by the venue and the community.

name: UTBT (Ultra Tokaj-Bodrogkeresztúr-Tarcal)
description: The Ultra Tokaj - Bodrogkeresztúr - Tarcal running race is a challenging 63 km ultra-distance event that winds through the scenic vineyards and hills of Tokaj-Hegyalja. The race offers three different distances, giving both beginners and experienced runners the chance to find the challenge that suits them. The event is more than just a running race: it is an experience set amid the landscapes of one of Hungary’s most beautiful wine regions. Races start in mass-start format, and refreshments are provided along the course and at the finish.
course_highlights: 63 km ultra distance through vineyards and hills
Legendary Tokaj-Hegyalja route
Refreshments along the course and at the finish
additional: Both individual and team categories are available, with teams of 2, 3, or 4 members. Starts are mass starts; team start times will be published no later than June 5, 2026. The entry fee can be paid by bank card or bank transfer. Participants receive a downloadable electronic certificate, and related programs and discounts are also available. Cutoff times: Ultra 8 hours, Marathon 6 hours, Half Marathon 3 hours. Age limits vary by distance, from 12 to 18 years. There are three different distances; registration details have not been provided. The event venue is in the vicinity of Fesztiválkatlan.

name: BRUTÁLFUTÁS
description: Brutálfutás is a fun obstacle race in Nyáregyháza, offering an unforgettable muddy, water-filled experience over distances of 2.3 and 7 kilometres. The race is a mix of a military training course and an obstacle race, with fun and community spirit at its heart. Participants arriving from hundreds of towns and villages across the country can look forward to a unique finisher’s medal and plenty of mud. The race is not about taking things seriously, but about fun and challenge, so everyone can find a distance that suits them.
course_highlights: A mix of a military training course and an obstacle race
Muddy, water-filled 2.3- and 7-kilometre courses
A unique finisher’s medal and plenty of mud
additional: Registration is available exclusively online at nevezes.futanet.hu. Payment by bank card or SZÉP card. A BSI account is required to register. Participants can look forward to a unique finisher’s medal and plenty of mud. The event welcomes participants with online registration, charitable elements and a festival atmosphere. The race offers both challenges and a community experience.

name: Ultra Nízke Tatry
description: Ultra Nízke Tatry is the first edition of a mountain running event that follows the ridge of the Low Tatras from west to east. The route is 49.7 km long, with 2,650 metres of elevation gain, and follows marked hiking trails from Donovaly to Srdiečko. The event is part of the Slovak Skyrunning Association calendar and also serves as the Milan Styka Memorial, in honour of the prominent runner and mountaineer who tragically died in 2025. The start is scheduled for 13 June 2026 at 7:00 in Donovaly, by the Donovalský pivovar brewery.
course_highlights: 49.7 km route with 2,650 m of elevation gain
Along the Low Tatras ridge from Donovaly to Srdiečko
The route follows red, green and yellow hiking markers, passing M. R. Štefánik Chalet and Kosodrevina
additional: Registration is available online from 20.12.2025 at 0:00, and also at the start venue, Donovalský pivovar, on 13.6.2026 from 16:00 to 21:00 and on race morning from 6:00 to 6:45. The provisional cutoff at Chopok, after 37 km, is 15:00 (8 hours after the start). The organizer reserves the right to change the route depending on the weather and to set time limits. The route passes through mountain terrain. Additional information concerns registration, the memorial nature of the event, possible weather-related route changes, and time limits set according to conditions.

name: Strečnianska mašľa
description: Strečnianska Mašľa is a mountain ultramarathon and long-distance hike around Strečno, taking place on 13 June 2026. The event offers two routes: a challenging 50 km route with approximately 2,985 metres of elevation gain and a shorter 25 km route, which is also suitable for runners with dogs. The routes follow marked hiking trails through both parts of the Malá Fatra and part of a national park, with the start and finish at the Radinové football field in Strečno. The organizers provide race packs, prizes for the top finishers, and good conditions for participants.
course_highlights: 50 km route with approximately 2,985 m of elevation gain through the Malá Fatra
Routes follow marked hiking trails and pass through a national park
Start and finish at the Radinové football field in Strečno
additional: Participant limits: 300 for the 50 km route, 300 for the 25 km route, and 50 for the 25 km route with a dog. Race numbers and chips are assigned by the organizers. Mandatory equipment includes a first-aid kit, valid identification, insurance covering Mountain Rescue Service intervention, a charged mobile phone, a personal drinking container, a whistle or bells (recommended for the 50 km route), a map or GPS route, sunglasses, and sunscreen. Overnight stays are possible in the changing rooms or tents at the football field. Accommodation is also available at Pizzeria Alžbetka and SIP ŽSR Strečno. The race offers certified routes; registration opens on 1 March 2026. The event is part of the Slovak Ultratrail League, and the course passes through Malá Fatra National Park.

name: Krosak pod hradom
organizer: Mgr. Ján Podstavský, Vladimír Adam, Ing. Ladislav Ondrik, Vladimír Sikorai, Gabriel Sabo, Štefan Karafa
description: Krosák pod hradom is a running race in Trnava pri Laborci, offering various categories, including the 10 km Big Cross-Country Run, the 5 km Small Cross-Country Run, a Health Run, and Nordic Walking. The course follows farm and forest roads with asphalt surfaces, while the Big Cross-Country Run consists of two 5 km loops. The race is part of the Michalovce–Sobrance Running League and is suitable for a wide range of runners, from juniors to veterans. The race starts at the Municipal Office in Trnava pri Laborci. Children’s races start at 9:00, and the main race at 11:00.
course_highlights: The course follows farm and forest roads with asphalt surfaces
The Big Cross-Country Run is 10 km (2 × 5 km loops)
The race takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Trnava pri Laborci
additional: Race check-in begins at 8:00 at the Municipal Office; check-in for children’s categories begins at 7:30. New registrations on race day are possible only while race numbers remain available. On-site payment is €25. The event takes place on 13 June 2026, with starts at 09:00 and 11:00. It includes 10 km, 5 km, and Nordic Walking categories, with an emphasis on charitable causes and community participation.

name: Kysucký maratón
location: Čadca, Čadca, Matičné námestie - pred Domom kultúry Čadca, Slovakia
price_range: 35 EUR do 1. 5. 2026, 40 EUR po 1. 5. 2026, 25 EUR pre účastníkov z okresu Čadca
description: The Kysuce Marathon is the second-oldest marathon in Slovakia and a major sporting and social event in the Kysuce region. The course runs through the picturesque Kysuce valley along the Kysuca River, with a safer and more attractive route along the running and cycling path introduced in 2025. In addition to the marathon, the event includes a half marathon, a marathon relay and a children’s minimarathon. The start and finish are at Matičné Square in Čadca, in front of the House of Culture. Races are held in various age categories, and participants have access to refreshment stations and facilities including changing rooms and wellness services.
course_highlights: The course runs through the picturesque Kysuce valley along the Kysuca River
A safe and attractive route along the running and cycling path (Bystrica Cycling Highway)
The marathon turnaround is at the square by the Slovak Astronomical Clock in Stará Bystrica
additional: The start and finish are at Matičné Square in Čadca, in front of the House of Culture. There are 8 refreshment stations along the course. Refreshments are provided after the race. Participants can use the changing rooms, swimming pool and sauna at the local swimming pool. The marathon time limit is 5 hours for 40 km; runners who exceed this time are not guaranteed a place in the results. Certified course, refreshment stations along the route, changing rooms, swimming pool, sauna, post-race refreshments, online registration until 1.6.2026, no insurance provided by the organizers

name: Beh Hodkovským parkom

price_tiers.distance: Beh pre zdravie 4 km a Nordic walking 4 km

description: The Run through Hodkovce Park is a running event held on the grounds of Hodkovce Manor in Žehra. The course runs mostly along farm and forest roads, with some asphalt sections. The event features an 8 km competitive race for various men’s and women’s age groups, as well as non-competitive 4 km categories for Run for Health and Nordic walking, with no age restrictions. The organizer, DOMOVINA n.o., provides a welcoming atmosphere and quality organization for all participants. Discounted entry is available online, encouraging early registration.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly along farm and forest roads, with an asphalt section
The event takes place on the grounds of Hodkovce Manor in Žehra
Categories for various age groups, plus non-competitive running and Nordic walking options
additional: Entry is €7 for online registration by 12 June 2025, and €9 on site. The course is suitable for various age groups and includes non-competitive running and Nordic walking options. The start and finish are on the grounds of DSS DOMOVINA n.o. in Žehra, in the Hodkovce area. The event includes various categories for all age groups. Registration is open until 12 June 2025; the course includes forest paths, farm roads and asphalt sections.

name: Beh Kalváriou
description: Beh Kalváriou is a charity running race held in the beautiful surroundings of Kalvária in Považská Bystrica. The event offers courses for both adults and children, with forest paths making up the course surface. This fourth edition is an opportunity to experience community, exercise, and joy, with proceeds from the race going to children in need. The organizers emphasize high-quality event management and support for charitable causes.
course_highlights: Forest paths in the surroundings of Kalvária
Courses for adults and children
A scenic, varied course with good weather
additional: Registration is available online only through vysledkovyservis.sk. Registration will not be available at the venue or on race day. After the entry fee is paid, the participant’s name will appear on the list of registered participants and a confirmation will be sent by email. You can make a voluntary contribution during registration to support Hugo and Simonka. The participant limit is 500 adults and 250 children. The event follows the rules of the Slovak Athletics Federation. Registration is online only; the event is charitable; the participant limit is 500 adults and 250 children; starts are scheduled for 10:00 for children and 12:15 for adults.

name: Lemešanská bežecká liga 2. Letné kolo
location: Lemešany, Lúka nad obcou Lemešany, Slovakia
organizer: Obec Lemešany, Športová komisia obce Lemešany, Záhrada pohybu
price_range: dospelí: 10 € online, 15 € na mieste; občania obce: 5 € online, 10 € na mieste; deti a juniorské: 3 €; detské behy zdarma
description: The Lemešany Running League 2nd Summer Round is a running event held in Lemešany, on the meadow above the village. The race is divided into several categories by age and gender, including children’s categories and Nordic walking. The main categories start at 17:00, and the children’s categories start at 17:10. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant summer race atmosphere.
course_highlights: Various categories for all age groups, including children and adults
Online registration with a low entry fee
Children’s races on the meadow are free
additional: Categories: Men A (ages 18–39), Men B (ages 40 and over), Women F (ages 18–39), Women G (ages 40 and over), Girls/Boys 1 (ages 12–14), Girls/Boys 2 (ages 15–17), Children under 12 (accompanied by an adult only), Nordic Walking men/women. Children’s races on the meadow are free. Online registration until 12 June 2026. An additional €2 entry fee is payable for the race bib. Starts at 17:00 and 17:10.

name: Beh na chatu pri Zelenom plese – Memoriál K. Jakeša
location: Tatranský Mlyn pri Zelenom plese, Vysoké Tatry, Prešovský kraj, Slovakia
description: The Run to the Green Lake Hut is a mountain race for sports and nature enthusiasts, suitable for amateur and professional athletes alike. The event has been held regularly since 2005 on the second weekend of June and commemorates Karel Jakeš, a prominent Czechoslovak mountaineer. The course crosses challenging mountain terrain with significant elevation gain, making it a test for all participants. The aim is to bring together different sporting groups and offer them a unique experience in the beautiful surroundings of the High Tatras.
course_highlights: Course distance: 7.7 km
Total elevation gain: 651 m
Total elevation loss: 18 m
additional: The event is held with financial support from the Ministry of Tourism and Sport of the Slovak Republic. The race brings athletes, runners, alpinists, skiers, mountaineers, cyclists and ski mountaineers together as one sporting community. Registration for the 20th edition is closed. The race takes place in June 2026. Registration is available on the official website. The course starts at the Biela voda bus stop and finishes at the Green Lake Hut. It is suitable for runners of all levels who love mountain challenges.

name: Roșia Montană Marathon
description: Roșia Montană Marathon is a sporting, environmental, and socio-cultural event held in the Apuseni Mountains, in the commune of Roșia Montană, Alba County. The 13th edition, in 2026, celebrates the area’s nature, history, and cultural heritage, offering a variety of routes for runners of all levels. Races include a marathon, half marathon, cross-country race, and children’s race, on courses that combine mountain trails, local roads, and paved sections. Along the way, participants can admire the natural scenery and historic architecture in a setting that promotes a healthy lifestyle and respect for the environment.
course_highlights: Routes with elevation changes on mountain trails and local roads
A mix of mountain and road running
Natural scenery and centuries-old architectural heritage
additional: The event takes place from 19–21 June 2026, with race-kit pickup at Central Square on the day before the race. The programme also includes cultural and social activities, such as creative workshops and concerts. The routes are designed for both mountain and road runners. The event features cultural and environmental activities, community projects, and educational initiatives, offering an opportunity to support the area’s natural and cultural heritage.

name: Atinge OMU
description: Atinge Omu is a mountain running race in the Bucegi Mountains, along the Peștera - Vf. Omu - Peștera route. The event takes place in the first ten days of June, when the landscape is dominated by ridges tinged red with rhododendron. The race offers runners a combination of intensity and natural beauty, and at the finish participants are treated to grilled bulz and jintiță. It is an authentic mountain experience, starting at the Peștera cable car, with a friendly, traditional atmosphere.
course_highlights: Mountain route: Peștera - Vf. Omu - Peștera
Scenery with rhododendron flowers and red-tinged ridges
Participants are treated to grilled bulz and jintiță at the finish
additional: The start area is at the Peștera cable car. The event has been held since 2015. The organizers welcome participants with a warm, traditional atmosphere. Breathtaking mountain routes, start and finish at Peștera, mandatory equipment, cutoff times for the 41 km and 24 km races

name: Maraton Scaunul Domnului
location: Rezervația Naturală Scaunul Domnului, Bistra Mureșului, Deda, Harghita, Romania
description: Maraton Scaunul Domnului is a challenging mountain race held in the Scaunul Domnului Nature Reserve, near Bistra Mureșului. The event offers several races, including a 42 km marathon with more than 2,100 m of elevation gain, a half marathon, a 10 km cross-country race, as well as races for families and children. The marathon route passes through spectacular scenery, with aid and checkpoint stations, and includes sections of forest road, unmarked trails, and lookout areas. Safety is a priority, with mandatory equipment checks and time limits for each race. The atmosphere is rounded out by an awards ceremony and a bonfire after the race.
course_highlights: A 42 km mountain route with 2,100 m of positive elevation gain
Spectacular views toward the Călimani Ridge and areas with exposed viewpoints
Multiple aid, hydration, and checkpoint stations along the route
additional: Race kits can be collected on Friday, June 12, from 17:00 to 23:00, and on Saturday, June 13, from 6:00 to 8:00 for the main races. Mandatory equipment is checked at the start. Each race has time limits and intermediate checkpoints. Competitor parking is arranged on a forest road 1.3 km from the start/finish area. The awards ceremony starts at 18:00, and the Mini MSD ceremony at 17:00, followed by a bonfire. The event also includes family races and mini races, with registration details available on the official website.

name: The Color Run Iași

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Inscriere gratuita pentru copii 0-6 ani (numar de concurs, medalie, pudra colorata, fara tricou)

description: The Color Run Iași 2026 is an untimed 5-kilometer race full of color and positive energy, celebrating health, joy, and originality. Participants start in white clothing and are showered with powder at every kilometer, finishing the race in a vibrant cloud of colors. The event takes place in front of the Palace of Culture in Iași and offers a festival atmosphere with music and fun for all ages, making it perfect for a memorable day with friends and family. It is an experience accessible to everyone, including children and people with disabilities, with free or full-kit registration options.
course_highlights: 5 km route in central Iași, starting and finishing at the Palace of Culture
Color-powder stations at every kilometer
Festival atmosphere with music and a cloud of colored powder at the finish
additional: The event has staggered starts at 5-minute intervals, and participants must wear their race number visibly on their shirt. There is no baggage storage. Bicycles, rollerblades, scooters, and pets are not allowed. The standard kit includes a T-shirt, bandana, temporary tattoos, medal, and colored powder. Children aged 0–6 can participate free of charge without a T-shirt, receiving only a number, medal, and powder. People with disabilities and their companions receive free admission. Participants receive a kit with a T-shirt, race number, bandana, temporary tattoo, medal, and colored powder; the event promotes a healthy lifestyle and fun for all ages.

name: Retezat Sky Race
description: Retezat SkyRace is a skyrunning race held amid the spectacular scenery of Romania’s Retezat Mountains, offering runners a challenging experience on varied, technical mountain trails. The event combines rugged terrain with the natural beauty of ridges, valleys, and alpine lakes, and is aimed at mountain-running and adventure enthusiasts. Organized with careful attention to safety and respect for the environment, the race offers a passionate community and opportunities to socialize and push personal limits. On June 13, 2026, participants can experience a true mountain adventure in the heart of Retezat.
course_highlights: Technical trails along steep ridges and mountain paths
Spectacular scenery of valleys and alpine lakes
Aid stations with water, energy drinks, and fruit
additional: Registration validation and race-kit pickup are available from 16:00 on the day before the race and between 7:00 and 8:30 on race day. The kit includes a personalized race bib and a technical item for the first 800 participants. Aid stations with water and food are available along the routes. The awards ceremony takes place at 17:30. DJ Cătălin Sănătescu provides the atmosphere throughout the event. There is also a children’s race, Retezat SkyRace Kids Race. Spectacular mountain trails, online registration, categories and prizes, annual event.

name: Maratonul Sării

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Contributia de participare este 200 de lei pentru oricare traseu

description: The Salt Marathon is a sporting event combining running and mountain biking, held amid the natural and historic landscape of Târgu Ocna, Bacău County. Participants can choose between 10 km and 21 km trail-running races, as well as a 30 km mountain-bike race, all starting and finishing in Piața Primăriei. A unique feature of the competition is a 7 km stretch through the underground galleries of Târgu Ocna Salt Mine, offering an unusual experience and health benefits thanks to the ionized air. The event promotes an active lifestyle and respect for nature, and also includes plogging activities to clean up the routes.
course_highlights: Routes through forests, hills, and the underground galleries of Târgu Ocna Salt Mine
A 7 km underground stretch at a depth of 240 m, with ionized air
Elevation gains: 250 m for 10 km, 740 m for the 21 km trail race, and 800 m for the 30 km mountain-bike race
additional: Start and finish in Piața Primăriei, Târgu Ocna. The mountain-bike race takes place on Sunday, 14 June 2026, and the trail-running races on Saturday, 13 June 2026. Payment is by card only at registration. The event includes plogging activities to clean up the routes. The routes include trail-running and mountain-bike sections; registration is available online, with payment by card.

name: Maraton Maramureș
description: Maramureș Marathon is a mountain race set in the picturesque landscapes of Baia Mare and its surroundings on June 13, 2026. The routes include a 13 km run and hike, a 21 km mountain half marathon, and a full 42 km marathon, each offering challenges and spectacular views. Participants will tackle sustained climbs, trails along the shore of the Firiza Dam, and areas with impressive panoramas of local peaks. The event is suitable both for experienced mountain runners and for those seeking a trail-running experience in nature.
course_highlights: A sustained 7–8 km climb with 560 meters of elevation gain
Views of Firiza Dam and Igniș Peak
A spectacular trail along the dam shore with memorable views
additional: GPX files for the routes are available to download. The marathon route includes a 21 km loop through scenic areas such as Limpedea, Groapele Chiuzbăii, and Fântâna cu borcut. There are refreshment and control points along the route, and the routes are marked with distinctive signs. Volunteers guide competitors along shared and branching sections of the routes. The trail routes include mountain terrain, technical trails, and climbs, highlighting the area's natural beauty. Participation includes official materials and access to event facilities.

name: Maraton Tarcău
description: Tarcău Marathon is an annual competition held in the natural landscape of the Tarcău area, Neamț, offering marathon, half-marathon, and cross-country races. The event emphasizes physical preparation and appropriate equipment, providing a complete and safe sporting experience. Participants can collect their race kits the day before the competition and must comply with the official race regulations. Time limits are set for each race, ensuring a competitive and well-organized event.
course_highlights: Marathon, half-marathon, and cross-country routes in the Tarcău area, Neamț
Course time limits: 7 hours for the marathon, 4 hours for the half-marathon, and 2 hours for the cross-country race
Race kit provided the day before the competition
additional: Race kits are provided on Friday, June 12, 2026, and participants must sign a liability waiver. A technical briefing is held before the start. Course time limits are: 7 hours for the marathon (start at 9:00), 4 hours for the half-marathon (start at 10:00), and 2 hours for the cross-country race (start at 11:00). Registration takes place on June 12, with a race kit and liability waiver; races have time limits; spectacular mountain routes.

name: Maraton Scaunul Domnului (Deda)
location: Rezervația Naturală Scaunul Domnului, aproape de Deda, Mureș, Romania
description: Scaunul Domnului Marathon is a challenging mountain race held in the Scaunul Domnului Nature Reserve, near Deda, Mureș. The event offers several races, including a 42 km marathon, a 21 km half marathon, a 10 km cross-country race, and races for families and children. The courses combine sustained climbs, forest roads, and sections with spectacular views, making them suitable for mountain runners seeking adventure and nature. Safety is a priority, with mandatory gear checks and checkpoints along the course.
course_highlights: 42 km course with 2,100 m of positive elevation gain
Sections with spectacular views of the Călimani Ridge
Multiple aid stations and checkpoints, including on the Scaunul Domnului Plateau
additional: Race kits can be collected on Friday, June 12, from 17:00 to 23:00 and on Saturday, June 13, from 6:00 to 8:00 for the main races. The main races start at 09:00, while the Family and Mini races start at 09:15. Gear checks are mandatory for safety. The awards ceremony begins at 18:00, followed by a campfire. Competitor parking is provided in a specially designated area beside the Blidăreasa forest road, accessible from the locality of Bistra Mureșului. Mountain trails, registration details, and the event schedule; registration closes on June 6, 2026.

name: PENIEL TRAIL RUN
description: Peniel Trail Run is an outdoor running event held on trail routes in the Bistrița area, promoting health through movement, community, and truth. The event offers races for all levels, from a half marathon for experienced runners to 10 km and 5 km races, as well as a children’s race. Peniel Trail Run is more than a sporting competition: it is a call to live life fully in body, mind, and spirit, with a profound message of direction and a living relationship with God. The name Peniel symbolizes “the place of encounter,” where sport, community, and faith meet in an authentic way that is relevant to today’s generation.
course_highlights: Trail routes in the Bistrița area, set in nature
Half marathon for experienced runners
Accessible 5 km and 10 km races for all levels
additional: The event includes races for children (Cross Kids). Technical details and course maps will be updated on the website at a later date. Event T-shirts are provided, with a size guide. Trail running in nature, promoting health, community, and faith, with multiple race categories for all ages.

name: Stara Planina 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: CENA PO OSOBI: 14 900 RSD U cenu uračunato: tri noćenja u konaku Ždrma, hrana (subota)

description: Stara Planina Skiing 2026 is a four-day winter program offering skiing, sledding, walks, and socializing amid the unspoiled nature of Stara Planina. Enjoy the thrills and beautiful scenery at the Babin Zub ski resort, with more than 13 kilometers of groomed trails of varying difficulty, including a freeride trail and an artificial snowmaking system. The program is for skiers and winter-sports enthusiasts, with departures from Belgrade and Niš and accommodation at Ždrma Inn. If there is not enough snow, hiking tours are organized, making the event accessible to nature lovers and those seeking an active getaway.
course_highlights: Babin Zub ski resort, with 13+ km of groomed trails of varying difficulty
The Konjarnik four-seater chairlift and Serbia’s first gondola at Jabučko Ravnište
A freeride trail and an artificial snowmaking system
additional: Departure from Belgrade at 17:00, with a possible pickup in Niš. Transfers to the ski resort take place in the morning at 8:30 or 9:30, depending on the accommodation. If there is not enough snow, hiking tours are organized. Accommodation at Ždrma Inn in rooms with 3–5 beds. Activities on the slopes until 16:00 each day. A 4-day/3-night ski trip with transport from Belgrade and Niš, accommodation options, ski activities and lessons, as well as the option of hiking tours if snowfall is insufficient.

name: X. Sopron Trail 5 / 10 / 25
organizer: Sopron Város Polgármesteri Hivatal Sportfelügyeleti Csoportja, SMAFC Tájfutó Szakosztálya, SMAFC Tájfutó Sportjáért Alapítvány, Sopron-Trail
description: The Sopron Trail 2026 trail-running race will take place in the scenic surroundings of Sopron-Brennbergbánya on June 14, 2026. The race aims to promote trail running and showcase the wild landscapes of the Sopron Hills. Participants can choose from several distances, including 5.9 km, 10.7 km and 25.9 km. One of the distances is part of the Alpokalja Trail King running series. The race also offers a special extra challenge: a timed uphill section, with special prizes for the fastest male and female runners. Race headquarters will be at the Brennbergbánya Cultural Centre, which has toilets and showers.
course_highlights: Wild, scenic trails in the Sopron Hills
A separate timed uphill section on the 10.7 km and 25.9 km courses
Aid stations on the 10.7 km and 25.9 km courses; cups will not be provided for environmental reasons
additional: The start and finish are on Brennbergbánya’s main square. The awards ceremony is scheduled for Sunday at 12:30 at the finish. Showers and toilets/WC are available at race headquarters. Cups will not be provided at aid stations for environmental reasons, so runners are advised to bring their own bottle or cup. Registration is through e-nevezés, with a deadline of June 13, 2026, at 12:00. Challenging uphill sections receive special awards; registration is online through the E-nevezés system; the organizers use environmentally friendly solutions.

name: Lussonium Trail 1 / 5 / 14
description: Lussonium Trail is a family-friendly trail running race among the hills of Paks-Dunakömlőd, offering wonderful panoramas and challenging climbs. The race has a friendly, cheerful atmosphere where runners can meet again year after year. Finishers receive a unique medal that can be joined with the Feldwar Trail medal, but it is also possible to register without a medal. The event is also a points-collection station for the Ötpróba program, so participants can earn points and redeem them for rewards. The start area is at the Lussonium Roman Ruins, where parking, toilets, a playground, and a first-aid point are available.
course_highlights: Wonderful panoramas among the hills of Paks-Dunakömlőd
Challenging climbs and varied terrain
Impressive start/finish venue at the Lussonium Roman Ruins
additional: The race will be held if there are at least 100 registrants. Entries are capped at 400, including a maximum of 100 preschool and lower-primary-school children. Parking, toilets, a playground, and a first-aid point are available on site. The finish medals can be joined with the Feldwar Trail medal. The event is also a points-collection station for the Ötpróba program. The race takes place at the Lussonium Roman Ruins in Dunakömlőd and offers sporting opportunities for families and individual runners alike.

name: CROSSKOVÁCSI Dockyard Terepfutó verseny
description: The Crosskovácsi Dockyard Trail Running Race is a trail-running event offering a variety of distances in the picturesque surroundings of Nagykovácsi, near Teleki-Tisza Castle. The race features four distances: mini (3 km), short (7 km), middle (13.5 km) and mountain half marathon (21.7 km), each starting with a 1 km lead-in lap in the castle park. The courses cross varied terrain with significant elevation gain, and participants can refuel at aid stations. Every finisher receives a commemorative medal. The race uses electronic timing, and the organizers pay particular attention to runners’ safety and medical care.
course_highlights: Distances: 3 km, 7 km, 13.5 km, 21.7 km (mountain half marathon)
Significant elevation gain: 85 m+ on the mini course, 595 m+ on the mountain half marathon
Two aid stations on the course; three aid stations on the mountain half marathon. Bringing your own soft cup is recommended.
additional: The race has two starts: the Mountain Half Marathon at 9:00 and the School, Mini, Short and Middle distances at 9:30. Mountain half marathon participants must use their own soft cup at the aid stations. The race uses electronic timing, and the rescue system is supported by off-road vehicles and medical staff. Registration is via SPORTNAPTAR.HU; pre-registration opens on December 6, 2025. Every finisher receives a commemorative medal. Multiple distances, aid stations, medical services, parking, car-free start/finish area.

name: LUSSONIUM TRAIL
description: Lussonium Trail is a trail running race among the hills of Paks-Dunakömlőd, offering stunning views, tough climbs and an impressive start/finish venue. The race has a friendly, family atmosphere, with participants of all ages able to test themselves over several distances. Finishers receive a unique medal that can be joined together with the Feldwar Trail medal, but a lower-priced entry without a medal is also available. The event is also a points-collection stop in the Ötpróba program. Parking, toilets, a playground and a first-aid station are available at the venue.
course_highlights: Stunning views among the hills of Paks-Dunakömlőd
Tough climbs on the trails
An impressive start and finish venue at the Lussonium Roman Garden
additional: The race will be held if there are at least 100 entrants, and entries are accepted for a maximum of 400 people, including a maximum of 100 preschool- and primary-school-aged children. Parking, toilets, a playground and a first-aid station are available at the venue. The finisher medals can be joined together with the Feldwar Trail medal. The event is also a points-collection stop in the Ötpróba program. Several distances, family and children’s categories, hilly trails, medals and refreshments are available to participants.

name: Račiansky kros – leto
location: Knižková dolina, Bratislava – Rača, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: Račiansky kros LETO is a running event in Bratislava-Rača, offering three courses of varying lengths and elevation gains. The main course is 16 km with 503 m of elevation gain, and another course is 9.5 km with 335 m of elevation gain. Children’s races are also available. The courses run mainly through forest terrain, with some paved sections, and are clearly marked in three ways. The event is suitable for various age groups, with awards for the top finishers in each category. The start is in Knižkova dolina, and the time limit for the main course is 3 hours.
course_highlights: 16 km course with +503 m elevation gain; 3-hour time limit
9.5 km course with +335 m elevation gain; 2-hour time limit
Surface: 80% forest, 20% paved; marked with pink ribbons, white arrows, and laminated arrows on trees
additional: The course is marked in three ways: pink ribbons printed with the race name and attached to trees, white flour arrows on the ground, and laminated arrows on trees (blue, pink, and orange). Number of aid stations: 2 on the 16 km course and 1 on the 9.5 km course. Required equipment: a race bib visibly pinned to the chest. Results are announced shortly after the finish. The course is mainly forest trails with paved sections. Registration is available online or on-site. The event also includes children’s races with medals and prizes, and is part of the Račiansky kros series, which has several editions throughout the year.

name: Vranovská desiatka
location: Dom kultúry vo Vranove nad Topľou, Vranov nad Topľou, Slovakia
organizer: Mesto Vranov nad Topľou, Mestský športový klub Vranov nad Topľou, Mestský dom kultúry
description: Vranovská desiatka is a traditional running race in the town of Vranov nad Topľou, offering 10 km and 5 km distances. The race is organized by the Town of Vranov nad Topľou, the Municipal Sports Club, and the Municipal Cultural Center. Categories are divided by age and gender, and the top three runners from Vranov are also recognized. The start and finish are at the Cultural Center in Vranov nad Topľou. The race is suitable for a wide range of participants, from recreational runners to competitive athletes.
course_highlights: 10 km and 5 km routes in the town of Vranov nad Topľou
Categories by age and gender, including recognition of the top runners from Vranov
Start and finish at the Cultural Center in Vranov nad Topľou
additional: Race categories are divided into 10 km (men and women by age group) and 5 km (men and women, with no age categories). The entry fee is €15 for online registration and €20 for on-site registration. The organizers are the Town of Vranov nad Topľou, the Municipal Sports Club, and the Municipal Cultural Center. The contact person is Eva Fedorňáková, telephone number 0917 127 502. The race offers 10 km and 5 km categories, starts at the Cultural Center, and allows registration online or on-site.

name: Čeľovská sedmička
description: Čeľovská Sedmička is a running event held in the village of Čeľovce, Trebišov District, in front of the Cultural Centre. The race is for various categories, including men, women, families and children, and also offers a summer walk and a competition for the youngest runners. The event is part of the Beh.sk running community and promotes an active lifestyle in the pleasant setting of the village.
course_highlights: The event takes place in front of the Cultural Centre in Čeľovce
The event is open to various age groups and families
The event takes place on 14 June 2026
additional: The start is in front of the Cultural Centre in Čeľovce. Categories include men, women, families and children, including the youngest runners, as well as a summer walk. The race is part of local activities and is suitable for all age groups, including children and families.

name: Tatranská 15
organizer: Obecný úrad Mlynčeky, Športoví nadšenci z Mlynčekov
description: Tatranská 15 is a running race organized by the Mlynčeky Municipal Office and sports enthusiasts from Mlynčeky. The race takes place at the football pitch in Mlynčeky and offers runners the chance to experience a sporting event in beautiful surroundings. An early-bird entry fee is available, and registration is also possible on race day. The organizers welcome all runners and sports enthusiasts to this traditional event.
course_highlights: A 15 km course through the picturesque countryside of Mlynčeky
Part of OCR races, including Barbarian and Spartan
Affordable entry fees: €10 for registration by 21.6.2024
additional: The entry fee is paid at check-in on race day. The organizers are the Mlynčeky Municipal Office and sports enthusiasts from Mlynčeky. The start is at the football pitch in Mlynčeky. Entry fees: €10 for registration by 21.6.2024; €12 for registration on race day. Venue: Football pitch, Mlynčeky

name: Run for Heroes
description: Run for Heroes is an annual charity race taking place on June 14, 2026, in Herăstrău Park, Bucharest, on Șoseaua Kiseleff. The event brings together runners of all ages, families, and pets to support free psychotherapy services. The courses are accessible and beginner-friendly, with an energetic atmosphere full of fun and solidarity, where every kilometer run contributes to a worthy cause. Participants receive superhero-themed race kits and enjoy a full day of sports and recreational activities.
course_highlights: Flat, fully marked urban routes suitable for beginners and experienced runners
A dedicated route accessible to people with disabilities
A welcoming atmosphere for families, children, and pets
additional: The race kit includes an official T-shirt, superhero cape, themed accessories, a goodie bag, a race bib, and a medal. Medical assistance and hydration stations are available along the route. The event offers dedicated areas for families, children, pets, and people with disabilities, as well as secure bag storage, a security team, and volunteers to provide guidance. After the race, participants can enjoy sports and wellness activities, children's workshops, themed photo booths, and relaxation areas. Charity event, recreational activities, areas for families and children, kits with T-shirts and accessories, hydration and first-aid stations.

name: SPORTS FESTIVAL Alergăm pentru Cluj!
description: Sports Festival is Romania’s largest multi-sport event, held in Cluj-Napoca from June 11 to 14, 2026. The festival combines sporting competitions, introductory activities, demonstrations, concerts, and educational events, offering a unique sports and entertainment experience for all ages. The Superheroes Run, a 5 km and 10 km race, is an important part of the festival, motivating participants to run for a social cause and support the Via Transilvanica community. The event brings together champions, fans, and sports enthusiasts in a festive, friendly setting.
course_highlights: Superheroes Run: 5 km and 10 km races on dedicated courses
The Via Transilvanica route, a long-distance tourist trail with markers and sculpted mileposts
Sports events and demonstrations in Prof. Dr. Iuliu Hațieganu Sports Park
additional: Taking part in the Superheroes Run supports the Via Transilvanica social project, with part of the entry fee donated to the community. The festival includes areas for children, a food zone with healthy menus, concerts, and dance demonstrations. Participants receive a race kit, and the event promotes sport as a way of life and social engagement. The event features activities for all ages, sporting competitions, and support for social causes.

name: Topoloveni Summer Tour ~ 2026
description: Topoloveni Summer Tour is an event for amateur cyclists in Romania, organized by Riders Club. Participants can choose to enjoy a ride outdoors or compete for a place in the national amateur cycling rankings. The route is carefully planned to protect the natural environment, and markings will be limited to respect the forests and natural areas. The event offers opportunities for all ages, including children’s races and options for families with special discounts. In the event of unfavorable weather conditions, the race may be rescheduled to a reserve date.
course_highlights: Route carefully marked to protect forests and natural areas
Route markings will be shared in the Participant Guide during event week
Start location accessible via Google Maps
additional: The event is limited to 1,000 starting places. The reserve race date is June 20, 2026. Children aged 5 to 13 must have a personal account on the Riders Club platform and be registered; they are recommended to be accompanied on the route. Families receive a 20% discount for a minimum of 3 people. E-MTB races allow electric bikes with motors that provide pedal assistance only, with a single battery for the entire race. Advance registration is required. The event is open to all experience levels, with the option to compete in electric races and prizes for participants.

name: Sunrise Marathon
location: Bačka Palanka, South Bačka District, Serbia
description: The Sunrise Marathon in Bačka Palanka is an event that supports the mission of the Sunrise Association, an organization that provides free summer day camps for children with cancer and their siblings. Runners are invited to join Team Sunrise and help bring joy and happiness back to children facing this illness through running and fundraising. By taking part in the race, participants have the opportunity to support unique programs and camps that bring smiles and hope to children around the world.
course_highlights: Enjoy a drive through the beautiful natural surroundings of Bačka Palanka
A choice of race distances (marathon, half marathon, 10K, 5K)
Support charitable causes for children with cancer
additional: Race participants can join Team Sunrise and receive a personalized fundraising page, a Team Sunrise T-shirt, and tools for collecting donations. Registration is handled directly through the race organizer, and participants arrange their own travel. Charity race bibs are limited and allocated on a first-come, first-served basis. Participation is often linked to charitable donations and fundraising for children with cancer; registration details and dates are available from the organizer.

name: Vidra Gradac Trail
description: Vidra Gradac Trail offers a unique running experience along the Gradac River, known for its untouched nature and crystal-clear water. The course runs through a canyon rich in wildlife and varied terrain, including forest trails, rocky banks, and stream crossings. This race combines natural splendor and adventure, making it ideal for runners who want to experience trail running at its most scenic. It takes place in Valjevo, Serbia, and is part of the West Serbia Trails series, which connects the mountains, rivers, and valleys of western Serbia.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Gradac River canyon, with its crystal-clear water
Varied terrain: forest trails, rocky banks, and stream crossings
Abundant wildlife and the natural beauty of an untouched landscape
additional: The race is part of the West Serbia Trails series, which connects the mountains, rivers, and valleys of western Serbia. It is inspired by the otter, a symbol of vitality and playfulness. No specific information was found about the race start time, registration, or prices. This trail race features varied terrain along the Gradac River and focuses on natural beauty and adventure. It takes place in June 2026.

name: 9. Vidra Gradac Trail
description: Vidra Gradac Trail is part of the West Serbia Trails series of events held in the beautiful natural landscapes of western Serbia. The race offers 10 km and 19 km courses that run alongside the Gradac River, one of the cleanest rivers in Europe, known for its unspoiled nature. Participants have the opportunity to experience Serbia’s unspoiled nature, running through forested and mountainous areas that are often accessible only to pedestrians. This event is ideal for running and nature enthusiasts who want to test their abilities in an authentic setting.
course_highlights: 10 km and 19 km courses
Running alongside the Gradac River with its clear waters
Unspoiled nature and mountain scenery accessible only to pedestrians
additional: The organizers provide refreshments along the course, with drinks and snacks at several points. Comfortable sportswear suitable for running in nature is recommended. The event is part of a series of races and hiking tours held throughout the year in western Serbia. Trail running and hiking in the scenic landscapes of western Serbia, with experiences of local culture and nature.

name: I. Szentivánéji Futótűz 5 / 10 / 21
description: The 1st Midsummer Night Run is a night-time running festival in the Lakeside Park in Balatonszárszó, held on Midsummer’s Eve. Participants can choose from several distances, including a half marathon, shorter races, and an evening walk along the shore of Lake Balaton. The event celebrates the start of the summer season and welcomes families and community sports enthusiasts as well as runners. The race is part of the Ötpróba program, which offers the opportunity to collect points for valuable rewards.
course_highlights: Night running along the shore of Lake Balaton
400 m children’s race on a traffic-free route in Lakeside Park
Refreshment point at approximately 2.6 km on the 5.25 km course
additional: Race number collection starts at 10:00 in Lakeside Park. Relay handovers take place at the finish arch by passing on the chip-equipped race number; using a race number belt is recommended. The entry fee includes refreshments (dextrose tablets, biscuits, salted pretzels, mineral water, squash, and gummy sweets). Balatonszárszó residents receive a 30% discount, and a season discount is also available based on previous participation. A technical T-shirt can be purchased separately (8,500 HUF). The event supports the Ötpróba program and offers discounts for local participants and season pass holders, as well as various running options and prizes.

name: SZENT LÁSZLÓ TEREPFUTÁS
organizer: Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület
description: The Szent László Trail Run is a traditional trail-running race in the Gerecse Mountains, near Baj, organized by the Tata Mass Sport and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Association. The race is held in honor of Saint Ladislaus, the patron saint of the infantry and the firearms branch. It has taken place regularly since 2010, with only one cancellation, in 2013, due to flooding. Runners test their strength on varied terrain, forest trails, and hilly routes. This friendly community event is recommended for anyone interested in both nature and sport.
course_highlights: Varied terrain in the Gerecse Mountains
Forest trails and hilly sections
A scenic, challenging course close to nature
additional: The race is organized by the Tata Mass Sport and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Association, which has several departments, including athletics and triathlon, orienteering, hiking, sport shooting, and other sports. The race is traditionally held in June, and the 2026 edition will be the 16th. Maps and past results are available to competitors on the organizer’s website. Mountain trail running, annual event, multiple distances and categories; detailed information is not provided

name: BALATON BAJNOKSÁG
distance_verbose: 50 miles, 50 miles, 50 km, 24 km, 12 km, 5 km, 5 km

name: Skyrun Kubínska
price_range: 25,- € online, 35,- € na mieste (Skyrun); 15,- € online, 20,- € na mieste (Skyshort)
description: Skyrun Kubínska is a mountain race set in the beautiful natural surroundings of Orava, offering 24 km and 11 km courses. The race is dedicated to the memory of Barnabáš Üvegeš, and runners can enjoy challenging terrain with views of the surrounding countryside. Runners will experience a mix of mountain trails and natural scenery that makes this event a special experience.
course_highlights: Mountain routes in the natural surroundings of Orava
Two course options: 24 km and 11 km
Challenging terrain with beautiful views
additional: A trail race featuring mountain terrain, held in memory of Barnabáš Uvegeš. The race takes place in June 2026.

name: Beh Ludrovskou dolinou
organizer: Obec Ludrová, OŠK Ludrová, Ružomberskie Strely o.z.
price_range: 5 € pre dospelých, zadarmo pre deti a mládež
description: Beh Ludrovskou dolinou is a running event held in Ludrovská dolina near the football stadium in Ludrová. The race offers events for children on grass and for adults on forest roads and asphalt. It is suitable for runners of a wide range of ages, from children to seniors, with categories divided by age. The organizers, Obec Ludrová, OŠK Ludrová, and Ružomberskie Strely o.z., provide a welcoming atmosphere and quality organization.
course_highlights: Children’s categories run on grass
The other categories follow forest roads and asphalt
The start and finish are at the football stadium in Ludrovská dolina
additional: The children’s categories start at 9:30 and the main categories at 10:30. Categories are divided by age and gender, including juniors and several adult age groups. The organizers are Obec Ludrová, OŠK Ludrová, and Ružomberskie Strely o.z. Organizer contact: Peter Laco, tel. 0905 284 430. The course includes grass, forest roads, and asphalt; start times are 9:30 and 10:30; registration is available on site; categories are offered for various age groups; course distances range from 60 m to 10 km.

name: Prešov Running Series 2. kolo
description: The second round of the Prešov Running Series, known as Šariš Run, is a running event held on the shores of the ponds in Veľký Šariš, beneath the historic Šariš Castle. This venue is new to the series and has become very popular with runners. The event is full of sporting spirit, community, and love of nature, and also offers a rich programme of activities, including musical performances, health-service stands, a relaxation zone, and activities for children. The friendly, family atmosphere makes the run an unforgettable experience for all participants.
course_highlights: The course runs along the shores of the ponds in Veľký Šariš, beneath Šariš Castle
A new venue in the heart of Šariš that has proved very popular with runners
A natural setting with a community feel and a family-friendly atmosphere
additional: The event offers a rich programme of activities, including a musical performance by the band Hrdza, stands offering health services and joint supplements, a relaxation zone, medieval costumes, a photo wall and a royal throne, activities for children, and a raffle. 10 km course, children’s races, accompanying programme with music, stands, activities, and a raffle; venue beneath Šariš Castle

name: Beh cez Zalužické poľa
price_range: 20€ on-line, 21€ na mieste pre hlavné kategórie; 3€ on-line, 4€ na mieste pre deti
description: Beh cez Zalužické poľa is the second edition of a running event taking place on June 20, 2026, in Zalužice. The race offers runners a chance to experience the nature and beauty of Zemplín in summer. The event is part of the Zemplínsky extrém series, which brings various running challenges to the region.
course_highlights: The route passes through natural fields around Zalužice
Located in the picturesque Michalovce District
Part of the Zemplínsky extrém series, featuring several running events
additional: The race takes place on paved, dirt, and grassy roads; registration is available online and on site, with categories for different age groups.

name: toRunská vrtuľa
organizer: Zuzana Jankovičová, Lívia Skurská, Monika Tomisová
description: toRunská vrtuľa is a charity running and community day in the beautiful surroundings of the Dubník Reservoir in Stará Turá. The event focuses on exercise and helping others, with all funds raised from entry fees donated to support rehabilitation for Simonka Zigová. Running pairs have 8 hours to complete as many laps around Dubník as possible, in a friendly and supportive atmosphere. The organizers and volunteers run the event without payment, emphasizing its community and charitable spirit.
course_highlights: A lap around the Dubník Reservoir, approximately 2.4 km long
Running pairs have 8 hours to complete as many laps as possible
Pleasant natural surroundings and a community atmosphere
additional: Registration is available as a pair or as a solo runner. Children up to 14.99 years old can register on site for a symbolic entry fee of at least €5, and the first 100 children will receive a race pack. The first 170 registered and paid runners will receive a race pack and a medal. Water and healthy refreshments will be provided during the run. After each lap, runners must report their completed lap at the check-line tent, where a point will be recorded for them. The event ends with the results announcement at around 18:00. The event raises funds to help Simonka Zigová, a young girl. It is organized by the toRun Stará Turá running club and is a charity, community, and fundraising event, with registration available online.

name: Tatry charity run
location: Relax Park Jazierko, Tatranská Lomnica, Slovakia
organizer: Športová Nadácia Kotrmelec, mesto Vysoké Tatry, TANAP

description: Tatry Charity Run is a running event held in Tatranská Lomnica at Relax Park Jazierko. The course runs mainly on asphalt and paved terrain, providing comfortable running conditions for all participants. The race is open to the general public and offers categories for men and women in different age groups. It is organised by Športová Nadácia Kotrmelec, the City of Vysoké Tatry and TANAP, who ensure the event runs smoothly. Online registration is available, with a limit of 300 runners. On-site registration is also available on race day.
course_highlights: 80% asphalt and paved terrain
Start and finish at Relax Park Jazierko, Tatranská Lomnica
Categories for men and women in different age groups
additional: The maximum capacity for online registration is 300 runners. If capacity is not reached, registration is also available at the event venue on race day for €30. Categories are divided by age and gender. The course is 80% asphalt and paved. Online registration is available until 15 June 2026, and the maximum number of participants is 300.

name: Beh k Iliašovskej kapličke
price_range: 10,00 € (5 € pre obyvateľov Iliašoviec, deti do 12 rokov zadarmo)
description: The Run to the Chapel of Iliašovce is a running event held in Iliašovce at the FK56 football field. The race offers two main courses, 5.6 km and 10.8 km long, which run mostly along field and forest roads. The main category starts at 10:00, and the children’s race starts at 13:00. The event is suitable for runners across a wide range of ages, including children, and offers a pleasant atmosphere in nature.
course_highlights: Mostly field and forest roads
Two main courses: 5.6 km and 10.8 km
Start at the FK56 football field in Iliašovce
additional: The children’s race starts at 13:00. Categories are divided by age and gender for both courses. Organizer contact: Mgr. Ladislav Petrek, tel.: 0901 712 711. The course runs along field and forest roads; registration is available by phone at 0901 712 711 or by email at info@bik.sk

description: Doby vežu is an extreme obstacle race and trail run held in Brezno, Slovakia. Competitors must tackle challenging obstacles and complete a course leading to the top of Slovakia’s second-highest observation tower, which stands 40 metres tall and offers beautiful views. The course runs mainly along forest paths, across meadows and through a stream, with very little asphalt, and includes steep climbs and descents. Alongside the sporting challenge, an entertainment programme for all age groups is also planned. The organiser is M.Š.K Jašterice Brezno o.z., and the race director is Marek Janoštiak.
course_highlights: Forest paths, meadows, a stream and very little asphalt
450 m of elevation gain with challenging obstacles (crawling through mud, a slide, parallel bars, slackline, climbing, cargo net and more)
The top of Slovakia’s second-highest observation tower, standing 40 metres tall
additional: Online registration closes on 13.06.2026 at 23:55 or when the entry limit is reached. After this deadline, on-site registration is possible on race day if the limit has not been reached. Penalties for failing to complete obstacles are burpees (15 for Hobby, 20–30 for Open). Helping other competitors is allowed in Hobby and prohibited in Open. Refreshments are available on the course and at the finish (fruit and a drink). Children may compete only with the consent of a legal guardian. Categories are divided by age and course type. The event includes an obstacle race and trail run, registration closes on 13 June 2026, categories are available for children and juniors, and refreshments and an entertainment programme are included.

description: Urlea Super Vertical is an extreme mountain race set amid the wild landscapes of the Făgăraș Mountains, offering a unique vertical running experience and an intense descent. It is Romania’s first and only up-and-down relay, where one partner climbs while the other descends, adding an innovative and spectacular element to the competition. The 12 km course, with 1,833 m of elevation gain, tests runners’ endurance and technique across forest roads, woodland trails and alpine pastures. The event is for those seeking pure adrenaline and an intense mountain challenge, with a revolutionary awards system that rewards individual and team performance.
course_highlights: 12 km course with 1,833 m of elevation gain, reaching an altitude of 2,474 m
Romania’s first and only up-and-down relay, with one partner climbing while the other descends
Varied terrain: forest roads, logging roads, trails through deciduous and coniferous forests, and alpine pasture
additional: A revolutionary awards system with individual and team rankings, cash prizes for teams, and bonuses for individual performances. The race kit includes a personalized race number (for early registrations), a finisher’s medal engraved in stone, a superlight technical singlet for the first 300 registrants, aid and hydration stations, medical support, and access to educational sessions and workshops. Parking is available for 360 cars. Payment is by bank card only, and registration is valid only after full payment. The event includes race-kit pickup, tent accommodation and accommodation suggestions, as well as the race start and awards ceremony on race day.

name: Maratonul Târnavei
description: Târnava Marathon is a trail-running event organized by the Târnăveni Cycling Association in collaboration with Ruck Ventilatoare, held in the municipality of Târnăveni, Mureș County. Now in its 10th edition, the marathon promotes a healthy lifestyle and running in nature, aiming to improve environmental education and raise awareness of the benefits of outdoor sports. The start and finish are located on the premises of Ruck Ventilatoare, and the competition offers several trail-running courses for all ages and levels. The event brings together a community of athletes passionate about running and respect for the environment.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the premises of Ruck Ventilatoare
A variety of trail-running courses: half marathon 21 km, 10 km cross-country race, 4 km cross-country race, and Kids Trail Running
Event held in the Transylvania region, surrounded by nature
additional: Race kits can be collected on the day before and on race day, on the premises of the Ruck Ventilatoare factory. A fitness instructor leads a warm-up before the start. Children’s races are organized by age group. After the competition, there is a Gulaș Party, a concert, and an awards ceremony. Participants can choose from the 21 km, 10 km, and 4 km courses, as well as children’s races, with activities including kit collection, races, and awards ceremonies.

name: Cros Montan Traversare Igniș
description: Traversare Igniș is a traditional mountain running competition, now in its 17th edition, bringing together runners and mountain lovers from across the region. The event offers two races in an authentic mountain setting, with substantial elevation gain and spectacular scenery. The courses include a 14 km Cross with 1,000 m of positive elevation gain and a Half Marathon of approximately 23 km with 1,450 m of positive elevation gain. Participants receive a race kit, access to hydration points, and medical support. The finish is at Pensiunea Mountain Pearl.
course_highlights: Cross course: 14 km with 1,000 m of positive elevation gain, sustained climbs, and technical descents
Half Marathon course: approximately 23 km with 1,450 m of positive elevation gain, offering an additional challenge
Spectacular scenery and hydration points along the route
additional: The start is at Podul Berdu, in the Ferneziu neighborhood, at the base of Lake Firiza. The routes are marked with ribbons, signs, and paint. The race kit includes a chip-equipped bib, T-shirt, medal, access to refreshment points, medical support, and a guide. The finish is at Pensiunea Mountain Pearl, the event’s main partner. The courses are on mountain terrain. Registration closes on June 9, 2026. Participation includes a kit with a bib, T-shirt, medal, and hydration points. The event takes place on June 20, 2026.
