description: The Crosul Hoia GlobalLogic is a running race held in Cluj-Napoca, giving participants the opportunity to run along the shady trails of Hoia Forest. The event includes 15 km, 7 km and 3 km races, as well as a race for families, making it suitable for runners of all ages and levels. Organizers Runners Club promote a friendly atmosphere and support the local running community. Held in June, the race swaps urban asphalt for nature and offers an outdoor running experience.
course_highlights: Route along the shady trails of Hoia Forest
15 km, 7 km and 3 km races, plus a family race
Outdoor event in a natural setting
additional: The registration package includes a race bib and other benefits. Awards are presented by category. The event is organized by Runners Club, which supports free group training sessions in Cluj-Napoca. The event takes place in Hoia Forest, with online registration and medals for participants. The route includes natural trails and is suitable for runners of all ages and levels.

name: Maratonul Roșia Montană - Cursa Copiilor ~ 2026
location: Centrul istoric al Roșia Montană, Alba, Romania
description: The Roșia Montană Marathon is a celebration of nature, history, and cultural heritage, held in the heart of the Apuseni Mountains, in the commune of Roșia Montană. The varied routes, which include mountain trails, local roads, and paved sections, offer a unique experience for both trail runners and road runners. The event includes races for all ages, including the Kids’ Race, which follows age-appropriate routes in the town’s historic center. Along the way, participants can admire the natural scenery and centuries-old architectural heritage.
course_highlights: Varied routes with elevation changes along mountain trails and local roads
Natural scenery in the Apuseni Mountains and Roșia Montană’s historic architectural heritage
The Kids’ Race follows age-appropriate routes in the historic center
additional: The Kids’ Race has different routes depending on age, from 700 m for children aged 0–10 (with a parent/guardian required for ages 0–6) to 2.3 km for children aged 13–16. The start and finish are in Piața Centrală in Roșia Montană. The event also includes other races: Marathon 42.16 km, Half Marathon 25.2 km, and 10 km Cross-Country Race. Race kits can be collected in Piața Centrală the day before, and the program also includes cultural activities and concerts. The Kids’ Race includes three different routes (700 m, 1.3 km, and 2.3 km), with prizes and medals for participants. The event takes place on June 21, 2026, in the commune’s historic center, and promotes the area’s cultural and ecological values.

name: Ultramaraton Palić
price_range: 50 € donacija po disciplini, startnina 50 € za strane državljane, smeštaj od 30-50 € po noći
description: The Palić Ultramarathon is a national and international ultramarathon championship held in Palić and organized by the Ultramarathon Association of Serbia. The event features several disciplines: 6-, 12- and 24-hour races, as well as 50 km and 100 km races, with the start and finish at the Great Terrace. The competition is open to all ultramarathoners who follow the rules, with participants competing in the overall and age categories. Alongside the competitive spirit, the event offers a well-stocked aid station, a communal lunch and prizes for the top finishers, as well as special prizes for the youngest and oldest participants.
course_highlights: 6-, 12- and 24-hour races
50 km and 100 km races
Start and finish at the Great Terrace in Palić
additional: Accommodation is arranged in hotels and motels, with a shared tent also available for competitors who do not need overnight accommodation. A well-stocked aid station is available during the race, followed by a communal lunch for all participants. Prizes are awarded in the overall and age categories, including special prizes for the youngest and oldest participants. The event includes recreational training sessions, competitions and the promotion of ultramarathoning in the region, and takes place in June 2026.

name: Trka prijateljstva Kula
location: Kula, South Bačka District, Vojvodina, Serbia
description: The Friendship Race in Kula is a traditional event held since 2009 that promotes sport, friendship, family values, and recreation. The race brings together amateur, recreational, and professional runners from the region and beyond, creating a unique running community. Over the years, it has become the largest sporting event in the municipality of Kula, with more than 6,000 participants and a total of 34,000 kilometers run. The organizers continuously improve the event, prizes, and organization to make the race even better and more appealing to all participants.
course_highlights: Promotes sport and friendship
Large-scale regional event
Long-standing tradition since 2009
additional: The Friendship Race is the largest sporting event in the municipality of Kula and brings together runners from across the region. The organizers are committed to continuously improving the event and the running community. The Kula Running League is a related activity that brings runners together throughout the year and has a significant history and number of participants. Participants can run on a 5 km or 10 km course, with special safety measures in place during the COVID-19 pandemic. The organization also includes support with registration locations and transport from Belgrade.

organizer: SBT Spid.com, s.r.o., Susedský Hi o.z., PavúčikSport Team o.z., obec Chorvátsky Grob
description: Grobský Runfest is a two-day sports festival in Chorvátsky Grob, bringing together professional athletes and recreational enthusiasts of all ages. It offers running courses of various distances, children’s runs, cycling races, and a rich cultural and entertainment program, including a food zone and live music. The event supports community spirit and a healthy lifestyle in a pleasant setting, with a range of activities for all visitors.
course_highlights: 5 km WeLive Run on flat asphalt
12 km Run for the Village Cup, 30% asphalt and 70% off-road, mostly flat
Children’s runs and cycling races divided by age group
additional: On-site registration for the 5 km: 16:00–17:45; results announcement at 19:15. On-site registration for the 12 km: Saturday 16:00–18:00, Sunday 10:00–11:15; results announcement Sunday at 13:00. The courses are mainly asphalt and off-road, with a flat profile. The festival also features a floorball tournament, a football cup, a cycling zone, a food zone, and a recovery zone. The program also includes live music and presentations by local organizations. The event includes a range of sports activities, concerts, children’s zones, refreshment stations, a recovery zone, and competitions for all age groups.

name: Tvrďák – Bratislava
description: Tvrďák Bratislava is Slovakia’s largest obstacle race, held at the Divoká Voda complex in Čunovo. Runners tackle more than 20 obstacles on a course of approximately 5 km, and can choose from different formats, including a non-competitive Fitness format or a timed race. After the race, participants can relax by the pool, enjoy refreshments and watch strength competitions. The race is also suitable for children aged 8 to 14 and includes a medal, photos and a race video as souvenirs of the experience.
course_highlights: Approx. 5 km course with more than 20 obstacles
Obstacles adapted for children aged 8 and up
Held at the Divoká Voda complex in Čunovo, with the option to relax by the pool
additional: Participants can take on Tvrďák 5+ km solo or as part of a team (at least 3 people; mixed-gender teams are allowed). Fitness format (non-competitive, no timing, no penalty exercises, obstacles may be skipped) and Timed format (time measured; penalty exercises apply if an obstacle is not completed). After the race, participants can relax by the pool, enjoy refreshments, try water sports and watch strength competitions from 14:00. Entry fees are non-refundable; entry can be transferred to another person or to the following year for a fee. The event also includes a children’s race, team or individual starts, and water activities and entertainment for all age groups after the race.

name: Behu ulicami mesta Veľký Krtíš
price_range: 15 € pre hlavnú trať, 3 € pre juniorov, 15 € pre Nordic Walking, zľavy pre seniorov
description: The Run Through the Streets of Veľký Krtíš is a traditional race organized by the Bežci VK civic association. It offers several categories, including children, hobby runners and Nordic Walking. The race takes place in Veľký Krtíš, with distances ranging from 3,000 m to the 11,000 m main race. The children’s race starts at 09:45, while the main race and Nordic Walking start at 11:00. The event is suitable for the general public and offers discounts for seniors over 60.
course_highlights: 11,000 m main race through the city streets
3,000 m hobby race
6,000 m Nordic Walking route
additional: A 50% discount on the entry fee is available for participants aged 60 and over. On-site registration is possible at least 30 minutes before the main race starts, at the increased entry fee of €17. The route includes city streets and asphalt roads. Online registration is open until 14 June 2025. The event is suitable for all age groups.

name: Moldavský pohár Bodvy
location: Hlavné námestie, Moldava nad Bodvou, Košice, Slovakia
description: The Bodva Moldavian Cup is an international road running, cycling and inline skating event held in Moldava nad Bodvou. The event offers various categories for runners, cyclists and inline skaters, with routes through the surrounding countryside and villages. It is known for its tradition and high-quality organization, with the start and finish at Main Square in Moldava nad Bodvou. It also includes a mass run for health, open to the general public.
course_highlights: The running route follows the road between Moldava nad Bodvou and Jasov and back.
The cycling route passes through several villages, including Budulov, Janík and Turnianska Nová Ves.
The inline skating route is 17.5 km long and is part of the Slovak Inline Cup.
additional: Race registration is open from 7:00 to 8:30. The awards ceremony takes place in front of the Secondary Vocational School of Agricultural Engineering. Cash prizes are awarded to the top three competitors in the men’s and women’s categories; all others receive medals. All competition categories have age limits, and competitors may register only for the category corresponding to their age. The event includes several categories, online registration and sponsor support.

description: Iskra Kosmaj Trail is a trail race held on the beautiful Kosmaj mountain, giving participants the chance to enjoy dense forests and breathtaking views. The race is a great opportunity for an outing and socializing in the race village located in the start and finish area. Three distances are available, and the race is open to runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers of all ages; participants under 18 need parental consent. The organizer guarantees safety and a great atmosphere, and participants receive a race pack with a T-shirt if they register on time.
course_highlights: Trails through the dense forests of Kosmaj mountain
Beautiful viewpoints and natural landscapes
A race village with food, drinks, and music in the start and finish area
additional: The total number of participants is limited to 1,000. Race packs can be collected in Belgrade ten days before the race. Entry fees are non-refundable, but participation can be gifted or transferred to the following year. Changing and leaving belongings is at participants’ own discretion. The race is also open to walkers and Nordic walkers. Registration is open until June 10, 2025. The start is scheduled for 08:00 in the morning, and the race takes place near the monument to the Kosmaj Partisan Detachment. Participants will be able to enjoy nature and visit local attractions after the race.

name: 32. DECATHLON Futóest
description: The 32nd Decathlon Night Run is a special night race in the heart of Budapest, taking place at the illuminated Heroes’ Square and along Andrássy Avenue. Runners can compete in quarter-marathon, half-marathon, pairs and trios, while enjoying the city’s magical nighttime atmosphere. Thousands of runners from towns and cities across the country take part, and every participant receives a unique finisher’s medal and a finisher’s pack. The race starts at 21:00 on the evening of June 27, 2026, giving runners the chance to experience running amid the city lights.
course_highlights: Run through Budapest’s historic Heroes’ Square and along Andrássy Avenue
A night run through the illuminated city, with a special play of light and shadow
Join thousands of runners and receive a unique finisher’s medal and finisher’s pack
additional: Online registration is available only by bank card or SZÉP Card. On-site registration at the event venue opens at 18:30. Assistance with generating a unique email address is available for minors and people without an email address. A limited-edition technical running shirt can be ordered in advance. Several distances and team races (pairs and trios) are available. Every participant receives a unique finisher’s medal and finisher’s pack. night race, multiple distances, city center route, online registration, promotional merchandise available

name: KIPRUN FUTÓEST
price_range: kedvezményes nevezési díjak a március 30-ig tartó előnevezésnél
description: The 32nd Decathlon Running Night is a special night race in the heart of Budapest, on illuminated Heroes’ Square and Andrássy Avenue. Runners can enjoy the city’s magical atmosphere over quarter-marathon and half-marathon distances, where history and sport meet. Several thousand runners from towns and cities across the country take part, and participants are welcomed with a unique finisher’s medal. The race is an ideal choice for anyone looking to experience a summer night run at an iconic location.
course_highlights: Run through Budapest’s historic Heroes’ Square and along Andrássy Avenue
Illuminated urban setting with a nighttime atmosphere
Quarter-marathon and half-marathon distances
additional: Registration is available exclusively online at nevezes.futanet.hu. Payment can be made by bank card or SZÉP card. Running T-shirt available for purchase, training plans, multiple distances, night running, urban setting

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: The Törökbálint Handicap is a friendly running race with a voluntary entry fee, held in Dióskert. Runners can complete the half-marathon distance by running four laps, but they may also run fewer laps. The event has a welcoming, family atmosphere. All participants are offered an apple, hot tea and mulled wine, and receive a commemorative medal. The top three male and female runners also receive a special medal. The awards ceremony takes place at 12:00.
course_highlights: The course is in Dióskert, in a natural setting
The half-marathon consists of 4 laps, but runners can choose to run fewer
A friendly, family atmosphere, with a voluntary entry fee per lap
additional: Registration takes place at the venue. The suggested voluntary entry fee is 500 Ft per lap. All participants are offered an apple, hot tea and mulled wine. The awards ceremony is at 12:00. Every participant receives a commemorative medal, and the top three male and female runners also receive a special medal. The half-marathon is 4 laps; runners can do fewer laps. Registration is on site. Refreshments and commemorative medals.

name: Holló a Kövön, Várfutás - Palóc TM Kupa
Malofatranská stovka
description: Malá Fatra 100 is a mountain ultramarathon in the Malá Fatra range, offering demanding routes with significant climbs and descents. The race is intended for experienced runners in excellent physical condition and crosses the entire range, including Krivánska Fatra and Lúčanská Fatra. The event is a registered ITRA member and serves as a qualifying race for other prestigious ultratrails. It is organized by Slovak Ultra Trail in cooperation with volunteers and partners.
course_highlights: The route crosses the entire Malá Fatra range (Krivánska Fatra and Lúčanská Fatra)
Significant climbs and descents, including exposed sections
Available routes: MF100 (107 km / 7300 m+), MF50 (56 km / 4400 m+), MF33 (35 km / 2600 m+)
additional: Insurance covering Mountain Rescue Service intervention is part of the mandatory equipment and can be ordered directly during registration. Functional and cotton T-shirts with an original print are available. Discounts on the entry fee may be available based on the ITRA Performance Index. Race check-in and the start take place in Terchová. Trail race through Malá Fatra with significant ascents and descents, exposure, and mountain terrain; registration details not specified.

name: Svätojánsky beh na Domaši
description: The Svätojánsky Run at Domaša is a traditional running race held at the Domaša Dobrá recreation centre. Runners can choose between two courses: a short 5 km route and a long 13 km route, which run mainly along forest roads and trails with varied elevation. The event is suitable for the general public, with categories by age and gender. Organisers provide refreshment stations, changing rooms, toilets and medical services. The atmosphere is friendly and competitive, with valuable prizes for the winners.
course_highlights: The 13 km long course has approximately 356 m of ascent and 314 m of descent
The 5 km short course follows a forest road and has 70 m of elevation gain
Refreshment stations are located at 5 km, 10 km and at the finish of the long course; refreshments are available at the finish of the short course
additional: The children's race is free of charge. The changing room, toilets and baggage storage are at the harbour by the Loď Bohémia. Every runner must wear their race number visibly attached to their chest. Medical services are provided by the organiser. The entry fee will be refunded in full for withdrawals made by 8 June. The race is held in accordance with the rules of athletics competitions and the event regulations. 13 km and 5 km courses, children's race, categories for men and women in various age groups, start from 09:45 to 10:15, car park by Bogárka, Domaša Dobrá recreation centre

name: Beh za zdravie – Záhorská Bystrica
location: BYS3T PARK, Záhorská Bystrica, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: The Run for Health in Záhorská Bystrica is a charity running event that combines sport with support for health and the community. It will take place on 27 June 2026 at BYS3T PARK, offering a chance to enjoy a great atmosphere and inspiring stories, while every participant contributes to a good cause. The event is open to all ages and fitness levels, promoting a healthy lifestyle and support for disadvantaged people. Run for Health was founded in 2023 and each year supports selected individuals or foundations through physical activity.
course_highlights: Takes place at BYS3T PARK in Záhorská Bystrica
The event combines running with support for the community
Open to all ages and fitness levels
additional: The event is charitable and supports disadvantaged people and organizations. Children, adults, and older people can take part by running, moving at a slower pace, or walking. The organizers offer the opportunity to volunteer and help run the event. The event takes place on park paths and streets in Záhorská Bystrica, with the option to participate as a runner, walker, or volunteer. A virtual participation option is also available.

name: Velvet Run Košice
location: Košice, pri Urbanovej veži na Hlavnej ulici, Košice, Slovakia
organizer: Progres Promotion Košice, s.r.o., Maratónsky klub Košice
description: Velvet Run in Košice is a running event taking place on 27 June 2026 at Urbanova Tower on Hlavná Street. Women can choose from the 5 km, 10 km and 5 km Velvet Nordic Walking events. The event is exclusively for women and offers valuable prizes to winners in various categories. Times will be measured using the MyLaps system, and results will be published on the official websites.
course_highlights: Velvet Run 5 km and 10 km courses in central Košice, near Urbanova Tower
5 km Velvet Nordic Walking event
Race registration and start on Hlavná Street
additional: Online registration is open until 23 June 2026 or until capacity is reached. On-site registration is also available from 14:00, provided the technical and safety limits have not been reached. The awards ceremony begins at 18:00, and the event ends at 19:00. Pair competitions, “Mother and Daughter” and “Sisters,” are held in the 5 km and 10 km runs. Times are measured using the ChampionChip system by MyLaps. The event includes various categories for different age groups, with timing provided by the ChampionChip system; on-site registration is also available.

name: Čergovský umirak
location: Drienica, Sabinov District, Prešov Region, Slovakia
organizer: Marián Gargalovič, Ondrej Janiga, Slavomír Uličný

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 25,– € Po úhrade štartovného a následnom odhlásení sa z preteku si organizátor nárokuje na 50% z ceny štartovného.

description: Čergovský Umirak is a mountain race of approximately 30 km with around 1,000 metres of elevation gain, intended for trained runners. The race takes place at the Drienica recreation centre, with refreshments and additional activities available for families. The course follows a marked hiking trail, and runners must wear their race number visibly attached to their chest. Safety on the course is provided by the Čergov Mountain Rescue Service, and each participant starts at their own risk. After the last runners finish, results are announced and prizes are awarded to the top men and women.
course_highlights: Mountain race of approximately 30 km with around 1,000 m of elevation gain
Marked hiking trail in the Čergov region
Start and finish near Chata Ride pub in Drienica
additional: Mandatory equipment: a charged mobile phone, a water bottle with a minimum capacity of 0.5 l, and a space blanket in case of bad weather. A race briefing takes place at 8:30 at Chata Ride pub, covering the course and navigation. Refreshments are provided. Race numbers are non-transferable and must be visibly attached to the chest. Safety during the race is provided by the Čergov Mountain Rescue Service. The course is marked as a hiking trail; trail shoes are recommended. Organisers can be contacted by phone or email for registration.

name: Hámornický polmaratón
description: The Hámornický Half Marathon is a traditional running race organized by the Spartak Medzev running club as part of the celebrations of Medzev City Days. The event includes the half marathon, the accompanying Hámornícka Desiatka run, and children’s Hámorníček categories, which are part of the children’s running league. The start is symbolically marked by striking a hammer against an anvil, giving the event a unique atmosphere. Runners can look forward to attractive performance T-shirts, medals with a modern design, and refreshments during the race. The course runs through a beautiful, deep valley, surrounded by natural beauty and the historic atmosphere of the town of Medzev.
course_highlights: The route runs through a beautiful, deep valley with natural springs and birdsong
Symbolic start marked by striking a hammer against an anvil
Accompanying races include the Hámornícka Desiatka and the Hámorníček children’s categories
additional: Participants receive attractive performance T-shirts and medals with a modern design. Children participate free of charge in 14 categories and receive a packet of sweets and juice at the finish. The event is supported by the city of Medzev and the village of Štós, and the organizers welcome support through 2% tax donations. The course also includes the football stadium; registration is available online and on site; categories are available for men, women, and seniors.

name: Beh cez Hornoorešanské vŕšky – Memoriál Františka Hečka
location: Futbalový štadión, Horné Orešany, Trnava, Slovakia
organizer: Bežecký klub Viktoria, Obecný úrad Horné Orešany
description: The Run through the Hornoorešanské Hills – František Hečko Memorial is a running race in Horné Orešany, featuring a 10,300-metre course with 100 metres of elevation gain. The course is half asphalt and half trail, making the race both interesting and challenging. The event is open to all age groups, from children aged 1 and up to seniors, with categories for men, women, juniors and local runners. It is organised by Bežecký klub Viktoria together with the Municipal Office in Horné Orešany. The children’s start is at 15:35 and the start for everyone else is at 17:00.
course_highlights: 10,300 m course with 100 m of elevation gain
Course surface: 50% asphalt, 50% trail
The route passes through the Hornoorešanské Hills, with beautiful views
additional: The children’s start is at 15:35, and the start for everyone else is at 17:00. Categories include all age groups, from children aged 1 and up, juniors, men and women in various age groups, as well as a local category for teams of three. The course is approximately 10.3 km long, split equally between asphalt and trail. Registration is available online or on site. Start times are 15:35 and 17:00.

name: Rajec RunTour Bratislava
description: Rajec RunTour Bratislava is a family running festival offering courses for all ages and ability levels. Participants can choose from 3, 5 and 10 km races, as well as children’s runs of 500 and 1,000 metres. The event takes place at two locations and offers a race pack with everything runners need. Alongside the races, there is a varied programme of activities, refreshments along the course and at the finish, medical and pacer services, and facilities with changing areas and baggage storage. The whole day is designed as an experience for runners and their families, with a raffle and the option to have personal details engraved on medals.
course_highlights: 3, 5 and 10 km courses for recreational and elite runners
Children’s runs of 500 and 1,000 metres
Refreshment stations along the course and at the finish, plus medical and pacer services
additional: Runners can follow pacers carrying flags to help them maintain their pace. After the run, they can have their finish time and name engraved on their medal. Showers, baggage storage and a varied programme of activities are available, including a children’s zone and a raffle with valuable prizes. 3, 5 and 10 km courses, children’s runs of 500 and 1,000 m, refreshments, showers, baggage storage, medals, photos, raffle, family atmosphere

name: Behaj lesmi Bachledová dolina
location: Bachledová dolina, Bachledová dolina, Bachledka Ski & Sun, Slovakia
description: Behaj lesmi Bachledová dolina is a trail race in the beautiful surroundings of the High Tatras, offering runners a unique experience of running on soft terrain in the fresh mountain air. The course passes through the Treetop Walk, Monkova Valley and the Spišská Magura ridge, with the start reached by cable car. The race is part of the Behaj lesmi series, which combines sporting achievement with support for local families and charitable causes. Behaj lesmi Bachledová dolina is a challenge for experienced runners and newcomers alike, offering a chance to enjoy mountain nature and unforgettable views.
course_highlights: The course passes through the Treetop Walk
Views of the High Tatras and the Spišská Magura ridge
Start reached by cable car in Bachledova Valley
additional: The race is listed among UTMB Index Races and has an international points ranking. The course features a Conti Speed Section, where participants can win a tire voucher and a running shirt. Online preregistration and changes to the entry fee are available through a SportID profile or at the race venue. The event includes eco-friendly cups, water stations and various race categories, including children's races, and offers discounts when registering multiple participants.

name: Carpathia Trails
distance_verbose: 100 km, 58 km, 57 km, 50 km, Maraton, 36 km, 23 km, 5 km
description: Carpathia Trails is a mountain running race taking place on July 4, 2026, at Cheile Grădiștei Resort in Fundata, crossing three mountain ranges: the Bucegi Mountains, the Leaota Mountains, and the Piatra Craiului Mountains. The event offers six individual race options, ranging from 6 km to a 102 km ultramarathon, suitable for all experience levels. Participants can enjoy spectacular scenery and a unique experience in nature in a friendly, well-organized setting. Registration is limited and available online until June 23, 2026.
course_highlights: Routes crossing three mountain ranges: Bucegi, Leaota, and Piatra Craiului
Distances ranging from 6 km to a 102 km ultramarathon
Spectacular natural scenery in the Cheile Grădiștei area
additional: All races start on the same day, July 4, 2026, at Cheile Grădiștei Resort, the event’s hub. Registration is limited and available online. The organizer may award wildcards to recognized athletes. The event is supported by participant donations, sponsors, and partners. The code of conduct is mandatory for all participants to protect the trails and ensure safety. Participation is through an online form, with limited registration and the possibility of wildcards for recognized athletes. The event takes place on July 4, 2026, in Cheile Grădiștei, Fundata, Brașov.

name: Rodnei Sky Race
description: Rodnei Sky Race is a mountain running competition held in the Rodnei Mountains, in the Borșa area of Maramureș. The event offers three distinct courses suited to different experience levels: the Puzdrelor course, the most difficult, for experienced runners; the Gărgălău course, a moderate challenge for well-prepared runners; and the Musceta course, a fast route with a large elevation drop. The race is part of the Carpathians Circuit and focuses on the experience of running in nature amid spectacular mountain scenery. The organizers invite families and mountain sports enthusiasts to enjoy an active weekend outdoors.
course_highlights: Puzdrelor course: 29.5 km with 2200 m of elevation gain, recommended for experienced runners
Gărgălău course: 21 km with 1300-1500 m of elevation gain, suitable for well-prepared but less experienced runners
Musceta course: 16 km with 500 m of ascent and 1500 m of descent, a fast and technical route
additional: The race takes place in Borșa, in the Rodnei Mountains, a mountainous area with spectacular scenery and a tradition of mountain sports. There are several accommodation options near the start, from guesthouses to campsites, between 190 m and 17.6 km from the start. The courses combine marked and unmarked trails, forest roads, and steep slopes, offering an authentic mountain-running experience. The race is part of the Carpathians Mountain Running Circuit. The mountain course requires a mandatory equipment check and starts at the base of the Borșa gondola. GPX downloads and information about accommodation and registration are available. Entry fees include hydration stations, photos, goulash, and parking access.

name: Sinaia Mountain Run
location: Piața Primăriei Sinaia, Sinaia, Prahova County, Romania
description: Sinaia Mountain Run by Constantina Diță is a spectacular mountain race starting and finishing in Sinaia Town Hall Square. The routes pass through picturesque areas such as Cota 1000 and Cota 1400, offering runners an authentic and challenging mountain experience. The event is open to both elite runners and mountain-running enthusiasts, with 10K and 21K races. Participants receive a race kit with a race number, timing chip, and medal, and the organizers provide free digital photo galleries.
course_highlights: Mountain route with climbs up to Cota 1000 and Cota 1400
Passes through tourist areas marked with red and yellow trail markers
Start and finish in Sinaia Town Hall Square, on Bd. Carol
additional: Race kits can be collected in person only, upon presentation of an identity document. The time limit for completing the 10K route is 4.5 hours, and for the 21K it is 6 hours. Minors aged 14 to 18 may participate only when accompanied by an adult and with written consent. The official T-shirt is optional and can be purchased separately for 50 RON, while the special children’s T-shirt is free. Only participants with a valid race number, officials, and authorized personnel are allowed on the route. The routes feature varied mountain terrain, with details about the races and cultural and historical attractions in the area, such as Peleș Castle and Sinaia Monastery.

name: Cluj Running Festival
description: Cluj Running Festival is an international road-running event held in the heart of Cluj, bringing together elite athletes, thousands of amateur runners, and children. The festival combines competitive sport with the joy of movement and the energy of the city, offering a flat, fast course ideal for runners of all levels. The event includes races for children, open 5 km and 10 km races, and an elite race featuring top international athletes. Cluj-Napoca, a young and active city, provides the perfect setting for this celebration of running.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course in the heart of Cluj-Napoca
Races for children with distances adapted to their ages
International and Romanian elite athletes
additional: Children’s races take place on Saturday, June 27, and adult and elite races on Sunday, June 28. Children’s distances: 800 m (ages 6–9), 1,200 m (ages 10–13), 3,000 m (ages 13–15). Amateur races: 5 km (minimum age 14), 10 km (minimum age 16). The event is organized by the team behind Brașov Running Festival. All participants in the children’s races receive medals and surprises. The event includes children’s races, open categories, and an international elite competition with a World Athletics label; it takes place in Cluj-Napoca and promotes urban running.

name: CROSUL ORASULUI MIOVENI 1485
description: The Mioveni City Run is an annual sporting event organized by the Invictus Mioveni Association in partnership with Mioveni City Hall and the city’s Cultural Center. The event brings together runners of all ages, from children aged 3 to seniors aged 78, on varied 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km courses, as well as special races for little ones. The atmosphere is vibrant, with music, applause, SMURD demonstrations and artistic performances, making for a day dedicated to health, community and sporting fun. The run is a celebration of movement and community spirit, supported by major sponsors such as TEMAD, WD-40 Romania and UHU Romania.
course_highlights: 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km courses in Mioveni’s Civic Center
Special “DINO” races for children
A vibrant atmosphere with music, SMURD demonstrations and artistic performances
additional: The event includes raffles with prizes and surprises for participants, provided by sponsors such as UHU and WD-40. Participants include both adults and children; the youngest runner was 3 years old, and the oldest was 78. Courses of 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km, races for children, an event promoting health and sport, and support from sponsors TEMAD, WD-40 and UHU Romania.

description: The Hoia GlobalLogic Cross-Country Run is a running race held in Hoia Forest, Cluj-Napoca, giving participants the opportunity to run on cool forest trails. The event includes 15 km, 7 km and 3 km races, as well as a race dedicated to families, making it suitable for all ages and fitness levels. The organizers, Runners Club, foster a friendly atmosphere and support the local running community. The race is a great opportunity to trade urban pavement for fresh air and the beautiful scenery of the forest.
course_highlights: Routes along cool trails in Hoia Forest
A range of races: 15 km, 7 km, 3 km and the family race
An event suitable for all ages and running levels
additional: The registration package includes a technical T-shirt and race bib. Prizes are awarded to winners in each race. The event is organized by Runners Club, which also offers free group training sessions in Cluj-Napoca. Route along the trails of Hoia Forest; online registration; the fee includes a medal, timing and medical assistance.

name: Crosul Oraşului Mioveni 1485 - Ed. a - IV - a ~ 2026
location: Centrul civic, Mioveni, Argeș County, Romania
description: The Mioveni City Cross-Country Run is a sporting event organized by Invictus România, dedicated to promoting a spirit of solidarity and courage, especially among wounded military personnel. The event takes place in the civic center of Mioveni and is part of a series of charitable and commemorative sporting competitions. Participants are encouraged to join in support of the values of honor and respect, in a friendly and motivating setting.
course_highlights: Course through the civic center of Mioveni
Event dedicated to wounded military personnel and war veterans
An atmosphere of solidarity and community support
additional: The event includes several sporting activities, but details about the course and registration are not specified

name: Noćni maraton
location: Novi Sad, South Bačka District, Serbia
organizer: Tletsko rekreativni klub “Fruška gora” – Novi Sad
description: The Novi Sad Night Marathon is one of the most attended races in Serbia and a unique nighttime athletics and recreational event. The main race is the 42 km marathon, which demands dedication and mental strength, while the half marathon attracts the most participants and brings the special energy of a night race. There is also a mini-marathon for children and Nordic walking, making the event accessible to all ages and fitness levels. The race has become a tradition and a source of pride for Novi Sad, with carefully organized race packages and a rich experience on the course and after the race.
course_highlights: A night race through the streets of Novi Sad
A 42.2 km marathon as the main event
A half marathon with mass participation and a unique atmosphere
additional: Race packs can be collected the day before and on race day. Participants receive a technical shirt, a bib with a chip, a finisher’s medal, on-course refreshments, and a post-race massage. Registration is available only through the trka.rs portal; registration on race day is not allowed. Participants under 18 cannot enter the marathon, and parental consent is required for the mini-marathon and half marathon. The event includes several race distances and a Nordic walk, with registration through the trka.rs platform. It is scheduled for late June 2026, with registration and program details available on the official website.

name: Mala Sveta Gora
description: The Mala Sveta Gora running race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Ovčar Banja and offers three running categories: 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon (21 km). The race is known for its challenging course through nature, offering runners a unique experience and the opportunity to compete over different distances. The organizers invite all running enthusiasts to take advantage of promotional prices and take part in this sporting event, which brings together runners from across the region.
course_highlights: Routes through the natural surroundings of Ovčar Banja
Three categories: 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km
A challenging and varied running route
additional: The event is connected with local cultural and historical landmarks and natural beauty, and takes place within Ovčar Banja’s broader tourism and sporting setting.

name: TORNIK RACE 2026
description: Tornik Race is a unique running adventure on Zlatibor that combines adrenaline-fueled challenges with nature conservation. The races are designed for all ages and ability levels, with 6 km, 15 km and 25 km courses, as well as children’s races. Participants can enjoy Tornik’s natural beauty, test their endurance and contribute to protecting the environment through the Plogging Race. The organizers aim to build a community of passionate runners and nature lovers, offering an unforgettable experience and a healthy sporting spirit.
course_highlights: Courses through Tornik’s natural landscapes in three distances: 6 km, 15 km and 25 km
A Plogging Race combining running with cleaning up nature
Children’s OCR races with obstacles suited to different age groups
additional: The children’s OCR races take place on 27.06.2026 at 9:30, with categories based on age and course length. Competitor registration is on Friday from 17:00 to 20:00 and Saturday from 08:00 to 09:00. The Plogging Race combines running with an environmental cleanup activity. Registration is required for the children’s races, and participation is free. All participants receive race T-shirts and medals, while the top finishers receive gift packages. Trail and environmental activities, multiple course distances, a children’s obstacle race, registration required for the children’s race, date: 27.06.2026.

name: 17. Noćni maraton
description: The Novi Sad Night Marathon is one of the most popular races in Serbia and a unique nighttime athletics and recreational event. The main event is the 42 km marathon, which requires dedication and mental strength, while the half marathon attracts the most participants and brings the special energy of a night race. There is also a mini-marathon for the youngest runners and Nordic walking, making the event accessible to everyone. The organizers, ARK Fruška gora, continually improve the event, which has become a tradition and a source of pride for Novi Sad.
course_highlights: A night race along Sunčani kej in Novi Sad
A range of distances: marathon, half marathon, mini-marathon, and Nordic walking
An organized aid station and post-race massage
additional: Race packs can be collected the day before and on race day. The participant pack includes a technical T-shirt, a bib with a chip, a finisher’s medal, on-course refreshments, a bag drop, beer, post-race massage, and sponsor gifts. Adults are eligible to participate, while minors may take part only in the mini-marathon and half marathon with the consent of a parent or guardian. The race includes participant packs, medals, aid stations with water and fruit, and rules for fair and safe competition.

name: 2. Dr Milk TORNIK RACE
description: Tornik Race is a unique running adventure on Zlatibor that combines adrenaline-filled challenges with nature conservation. The races are suitable for all generations and levels, with 6 km, 15 km and 25 km courses, as well as children’s races. Participants can enjoy Tornik’s natural beauty, test their endurance and contribute to environmental conservation through the Plogging race. The organizers aim to build a community of passionate runners and adventure lovers, offering an unforgettable experience and encouraging a healthy sporting spirit.
course_highlights: Trails through Tornik’s natural surroundings in three distances: 6 km, 15 km and 25 km
A Plogging race combining running with cleaning up nature
Children’s OCR races with obstacles adapted to different age groups
additional: The children’s OCR races take place on 27.06.2026 at 9:30, with categories based on age and course length. Participant registration is Friday 17:00–20:00 and Saturday 08:00–09:00. The Plogging race promotes environmental awareness and cleaning up nature while running. Race starts are in the morning at Tornik Ski Center, and registration and information are available via the official email. Trail races of 6 km, 15 km and 25 km, a Plogging activity to protect nature, a children’s race, and an environmental focus.

name: Columbia Triton Trail
description: Columbia Triton Trail 2026 is an exciting trail running race in Nagybörzsöny, Hungary, organized by Trailrun.hu and Andrew Erdei. The race offers a unique experience for runners who enjoy being close to nature and taking on a challenge. The event takes place on June 28, where participants can test their strength and endurance on varied terrain in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Trail running through varied natural surroundings
Beautiful forest and mountain sections
Challenging climbs and technical sections
additional: The race takes place in Nagybörzsöny, Hungary. Participants can choose from different distances, and the event is characterized by its closeness to nature and its community atmosphere.

name: Rácalmás Szigetfutás
location: Jankovich Kúria, Rácalmás, Tolna County, Hungary
description: The Rácalmás Island Run is a friendly, family-oriented trail-running event held in the scenic surroundings of Rácalmás, on the protected Nagy Island and along the banks of the Danube. The varied terrain features shaded forest trails, views across farmland, riverside routes and paved sections, with minimal elevation gain. The event aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and provide accessible sporting opportunities for all ages, whether running, walking or cycling. The event centre is the historic Jankovich Manor, an ideal venue for the start and finish as well as the accompanying activities. Participants can look forward to custom medals and T-shirts, and a friendly atmosphere close to nature.
course_highlights: Routes on the protected Nagy Island and along the Danube
Varied terrain: forest trails, views across farmland and paved sections
Minimal elevation gain; routes pass beneath shady trees and beside a picturesque boat harbour
additional: Race number collection is from 8:00 to 10:00. Several aid stations are available along the courses. Participation is free for RSE members, but registration is required. On-site registration is available in limited numbers only; advance registration is recommended. Various accompanying activities, health checks and food and drink options are available on race day. Custom medals and T-shirts can be ordered in advance. Participants can also look forward to finisher medals, aid stations, medical services and family activities. Registration is online via Köridő.hu, with favourable prices and early-bird registration options.

name: Mistrovství světa veteránů v běhu do vrchu – nahoru
description: The 2026 Masters Mountain Running World Championships is a prestigious international mountain running event for masters, held in the picturesque setting of Janské Lázně. The races offer several challenging courses with significant elevation gain, testing the endurance and strength of competitors from more than 30 countries. The event is organized by TJ Maratonstav Úpice under the patronage of the towns of Janské Lázně and Úpice. Registration is open until May 24, 2026, and runners can look forward to professional organization and sponsor support.
course_highlights: Uphill race: 7.79 km with 851 m of elevation gain
Long Distance race: 22.17 km with 1,332 m of elevation gain
Up/Downhill race: 8.95 km with 594 m of elevation gain
additional: Registration is open until 24 May 2026. Runners must be members of the Masters Association of the Czech Athletics Federation; otherwise, they will not be allowed to start. Start lists are updated 1–2 times a week. After registering and paying the entry fee, runners will receive a confirmation email. The organizers are TJ Maratonstav Úpice, under the patronage of the towns of Janské Lázně and Úpice. The race is intended for masters; registration details and precise course information are not specified.

name: Beh údolím Idy
location: Kultúrne stredisko, Železiarenská 9, Košice-Šaca, Košice, Slovakia
description: The Run through the Ida Valley is a traditional running race organized by the Košice-Šaca Borough and the Municipality of Malá Ida. The race takes place in the pleasant surroundings of the cultural center in Košice-Šaca and offers the opportunity to compete in various age categories. The entry fee is symbolic, and local runners can enter for free. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the region.
course_highlights: The race runs through the Ida Valley in Košice-Šaca
Cultural Center, Železiarenská 9, as the start and finish
A traditional event with a long history
additional: Local runners can enter for free. The organizers are the Košice-Šaca Borough and the Municipality of Malá Ida. Organizer contact: Mgr. Janka Jaššová, tel.: 055/726 08 11, 055/726 08 16. The course is not specified. Registration is by phone or email. The event takes place at the Cultural Center at Železiarenská 9.

name: Beh na Poludňový Grúň
organizer: Občianske združenie Grúň, Chata na Grúni
description: The Run to Poludňový Grúň is a mountain running race in the picturesque Vrátna Valley, in the Malá Fatra mountain range. The course passes through challenging mountain terrain, with beautiful views of peaks such as Poludňový Grúň, Stoh and Veľký Rozsutec. The race is ideal for nature lovers and mountain runners looking to experience a unique atmosphere and a challenge in the heart of Malá Fatra. The organizers warmly invite you to enjoy this sporting event in the beautiful surroundings of Terchová.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain with an ascent to Poludňový Grúň (1,460 m)
Passage through Stohové sedlo and the area around Veľký Rozsutec
The route passes through Jánošíkove diery, with ladders and footbridges
additional: Chata na Grúni is the highest mountain chalet in Vrátna Valley and is suitable for hosting courses and events. There are two ski lifts nearby, with slopes featuring artificial snowmaking. The route passes through a national nature reserve with numerous waterfalls and bizarre rock formations. The race is part of regional sporting events; registration includes a fee and parking, and the start is at Vrátna Paseky at 10:00.

name: OK Trip Trail
description: OK Trip Trail is a race held in the beautiful surroundings of Ovčar Banja, known for its natural beauty and healthy lifestyle. The race brings together lovers of sport and nature, offering a unique opportunity to enjoy a challenging course through forested areas and mountain terrain. The Healthy Spirit Festival, under whose auspices the race is organized, promotes an active and healthy lifestyle in the heart of Serbia.
course_highlights: Trails through the forested and mountainous areas of Ovčar Banja
Natural surroundings with fresh air and beautiful views
Challenging terrain suited to trail running
additional: The event is part of the Healthy Spirit Festival, which highlights healthy living, sport, and outdoor activities.

name: 10. Ócsai Pincesorfutás Radics József emlékére 4 / 12 / 24

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 10 km-es túrára a regisztrációs felületen lehet jelentkezni, időkorlát nélkül 1000 Ft

description: The Ócsa Cellar Row Run in memory of József Radics is a community trail-running event that takes runners past landmarks in the town of Ócsa. The race is run on a 10.5 km course, which can be repeated for the longer distances of 21 km and 42 km. The event uses individual chip timing and aims to bring sport and community together in memory of József Radics. The start and finish are in front of the Egressy Gábor Leisure Centre, and the course includes a variety of paved and dirt paths.
course_highlights: The 10.5 km course passes Ócsa landmarks, including the Öreghegy cellar row and the Reformed Church
The 21 km distance consists of two laps, and the 42 km distance four laps, of the 10.5 km course
Varied terrain: paved streets and dirt paths; 100% trail running through the cellar row
additional: The race uses individual chip timing, recording both net and gross times. Placings are determined by gross time. Residents of Ócsa receive a discount on the entry fee upon presentation of proof of address. Entry is free for people born in 1960 or earlier. The race is limited to a maximum of 550 participants. The start and finish are on the street in front of the Egressy Gábor Leisure Centre. The event features multiple distances, including commemorative runs and community events in keeping with the local spirit; it is open to participants and takes place on varied terrain.

name: TRAIL RELAY BANSKÁ ŠTIAVNICA – VISEGRÁD
location: Banská Štiavnica, Banská Štiavnica District, Banská Bystrica Region, Slovakia

tiers.label: tier_2

tiers.label: tier_3

description: TRAIL RELAY BANSKÁ ŠTIAVNICA - VISEGRÁD is a 220 km trail relay race connecting the historic towns of Banská Štiavnica and Visegrád. The race consists of 18 stages that pass through the Štiavnica Mountains and Duna-Ipoly National Park, with abundant natural and cultural attractions along the way. Runners can take part in teams of different sizes or in individual categories, so everyone can find a challenge that suits them. The race aims to connect the two royal towns and showcase the region’s natural and historical heritage.
course_highlights: Passes through the Štiavnica Mountains and Duna-Ipoly National Park
18 stages, 8–16 km long, with varied terrain and difficulty
Historical and natural attractions, including Drégely Castle, Esztergom Basilica, and Prédikálószék
additional: The race is open to teams of 3–8 runners and individual runners. Teams take turns over 18 stages, each 8–16 km long. Individual runners may complete the full distance at their own risk and with their own support, and may use the refreshment stations. The course passes through protected natural areas and historical sites. The race route includes sections through Duna-Ipoly National Park and other nature reserves, highlighting both natural beauty and cultural heritage.

name: Zalău Ultra Trail
description: Zalău Ultra Trail is a mountain running competition held over three days in the heart of the Sălaj Mountains. The event offers a variety of races for all levels, from children to experienced runners, including a 103 km ultra race with over 5,000 m of elevation gain. ZUT is more than a competition: it is a platform that brings together athletes, the local community, and nature, promoting a spirit of adventure and respect for the environment. The routes are challenging and spectacular, offering an authentic trail-running experience amid impressive natural landscapes.
course_highlights: 103 km ULTRA course with 5,255 m of elevation gain
Well-equipped aid and checkpoint stations along the route
A variety of races, from a 2.5 km children’s race to a 103 km ultra
additional: The event takes place over 3 days, with multiple races suited to different levels of fitness. The Last Man Standing race is a special endurance competition with 6.7 km laps every hour, eliminating participants who do not finish in time. There are prize categories for children and Cross races. Mandatory equipment is specified in the regulations, and aid stations provide water, isotonic drinks, fruit, and hot food along the ultra course. Multiple race distances, including races for children and charity events; an emphasis on promoting local values and community spirit; the event also includes an environmental awareness component.

name: Tara Ultra Trail 2026
location: Nacionalni park Tara, Bajina Bašta, Serbia
organizer: Udruženje Tara Ultra i PK Tara
description: Tara Ultra Trail 2026 is a mountain trail race held in Tara National Park, Bajina Bašta, on the first weekend of July. The race offers several distances suited to different fitness levels, from a vertical climb to an ultra-long 62 km course with significant elevation gain. The trails pass through hidden and scenic parts of Tara, giving runners an unforgettable nature experience and a challenge for body and mind. Alongside the races, an all-day outdoor festival and accompanying cultural events take place at the finish, creating a unique atmosphere for participants and visitors alike.
course_highlights: The TUT 62 course runs from Rača Monastery through hidden parts of Tara National Park to Bajina Bašta, with 2,600 m of elevation gain
The Crnjeskovo and Sokolarica viewpoints and the Rača Canyon offer spectacular views during the race
Varied terrain includes singletrack, gravel roads, paved sections, and technical descents
additional: Registration opens at midnight on January 1, 2026. Participants under 18 cannot take part in TUT 62, and children under 14 may run only when accompanied by a parent. An all-day outdoor festival and the Bašta Fest short film festival take place at the finish. The children’s race (ages 4–12) is free and adapted for the youngest competitors. Online registration opens on January 1, 2026, and the races include various distances and categories, with activities for all ages and ITRA points.

name: Balkan Mountain and Trail Running Championships
organizer: Balkan Mountaineering Union (BMU), Planinarski savez Srbije (PSS), Tara Ultra Trail, Planinarski klub Tara
description: The first Balkan Mountain and Trail Running Championships will take place from July 2 to 4, 2026, in Tara National Park and Bajina Bašta, Serbia. The competition features four races: Mountain Uphill, Mountain Classic, Mountain Trail, and U18 Mountain Classic, bringing together the best mountain runners in the Balkans. The varied and challenging courses offer spectacular scenery and technical climbs, providing a true challenge and an opportunity to enjoy nature. The organizers are the Balkan Mountaineering Union, the Mountaineering Association of Serbia, Tara Ultra Trail, and Mountaineering Club Tara. We invite all runners to join us and celebrate mountain and trail running in the heart of Serbia.
course_highlights: Mountain Uphill: 6 km with over 1,000 m of elevation gain, finishing at the Sjenič viewpoint with panoramic views of Tara
Mountain Classic: 13.6 km with 550 m of elevation gain, starting at Rača Monastery, passing through the Rača Canyon, and finishing in Bajina Bašta
Mountain Trail: 36 km with about 1,900 m of elevation gain, a technically challenging course with two climbs to the Tara plateau and spectacular viewpoints
additional: The races are for runners born in 2008 or earlier for Mountain Uphill and Mountain Classic, while Mountain Trail is for runners born in 2006 or earlier. Mountain Uphill is the only race that neither starts at Rača Monastery nor finishes in Bajina Bašta. The courses include technical single-track sections, fast descents, and challenging climbs, with final sections suited to a strong finish. Several race categories, including U18, focus on mountain terrain and natural beauty; the event is organized by regional and local mountaineering and sports organizations.

name: Tara Ultra Trail
location: Nacionalni park Tara, Tara Mountain, Serbia
organizer: Udruženje Tara Ultra i PK Tara
description: Tara Ultra Trail is a mountain trail race held in Tara National Park, Serbia, on the first weekend of July. The race offers several distances suited to different levels of runners, from a vertical climb to a 62 km ultradistance with significant elevation gain. The routes pass through hidden and beautiful parts of the mountain, offering unforgettable scenery and challenges. In addition to the races, an outdoor festival and accompanying events for all ages and fitness levels take place at the finish. The event is an opportunity to experience the mountain in all its beauty and grandeur.
course_highlights: A 62 km course with 2,600 m of cumulative elevation gain through Tara National Park
Spectacular viewpoints such as Crnjeskovo, Sokolarica, and the Rača Canyon
Varied terrain including technical singletrack sections, gravel roads, and asphalt
additional: The children’s race (ages 4–12) is free and tailored to the youngest participants, with parents and guardians welcome to join them. An all-day outdoor festival and accompanying cultural events are held at the finish in Bajina Bašta, including the short film festival “Bašta Fest.” All races award ITRA points and count toward the ITRA National League. Multiple distances, Balkan Championship, outdoor festival, children’s race, registration via prijavise.net

name: IX. Holdfény Éjszakai Félmaraton és Családi Sportnap
location: Népkert sor, Szeged, Csongrád County, Hungary
description: The 9th Moonlight Night Half Marathon and Family Sports Day is a charity running event in Szeged, welcoming runners for a night half marathon. The event also serves as a family-friendly sports day where participants can enjoy the pleasures of community sport. It takes place on Népkert sor, an ideal setting for both running and family activities. The event is traditionally popular, with more than 1,100 participants.
course_highlights: Night half marathon distance
Family-friendly sports day activities
The green surroundings of Népkert sor, Szeged
additional: The event is held for charity and is organized as a family sports day, offering night running. More than 1,100 participants took part in a previous year. The event takes place on Népkert sor in Szeged, and the program includes the half marathon and the family sports day.

name: VI. Tapolca Rockwool Trail 8 /  14 km / 22 / 33 / 45
location: Tapolca, Szabadság utca, Tapolca, Veszprém County, Hungary

description: The 6th Tapolca Rockwool Trail is a scenic running race through the beautiful landscapes of the Balaton Uplands, around Tapolca-Diszel. The route is 80% dirt roads, cart tracks and trails, offering runners varied terrain and exceptional views. There are five different distances, and those up to 22 km can also be completed as hikes. The race welcomes participants with unique finisher medals, refreshment stations and a hot meal, while the organizers aim to make it an environmentally friendly, green event.
course_highlights: 80% dirt roads, cart tracks and trails
Beautiful views across the Balaton Uplands
Refreshment stations, including at wine cellars
additional: Every runner who starts receives a unique finisher medal. Refreshments are available along the route and in the start/finish area: water, cola, isotonic drinks, fruit, pretzels, wafers and lard spread on bread. A hot meal is served at the finish, with a meat-free option. The race is a “green” event, so participants should bring their own cup or bottle. Chip timing; the chip deposit is 1,000 HUF. At the awards ceremony, the top three women and men receive medals, trophies and gifts from sponsors. Online registration; refreshments and food provided; environmentally friendly event; registration fee; green approach.

description: The Teliholdfutam is a night running race in Esztergom, following a scenic route through Castle Hill, Víziváros and along the riverside cycle path. The race offers three distances: 4 km, 10 km and 15 km; the 15 km route also takes in Prímás Island. Runners must use a headlamp or another light source, as some sections of the course are unlit. The event is organised by the Esztergom Futóművek Amateur Sports Association and is also a points-collecting event in the Ötpróba program.
course_highlights: Route through Esztergom’s Castle Hill, Víziváros and riverside cycle path
15 km distance passing through Prímás Island
Cobblestone sections and unlit stretches of cycle path
additional: A working headlamp or other light source is mandatory. The participant limit is 200 per distance. The event is part of the Ötpróba program, where the 4 km distance earns 1 point, the 10 km distance 2 points and the 15 km distance 3 points. For online entries, the invoice is sent as an attachment to the confirmation email; for on-site entries, it is sent within 5 days after the race. T-shirt sizes and an ECO entry option without a T-shirt, with an old medal, are available. Race details include course conditions, entry information and event rules; the event is also part of the Ötpróba program.

name: Na hoľu

description: Na hoľu is an ITRA-certified vertical kilometer event held on Kráľova hoľa in the Horehronie region. Runners start from the village square in Šumiac, and the route follows the blue hiking trail directly to the summit of Kráľova hoľa. The event is a qualifying race for the 2024 Skyrunning World Championships and offers quality support, including refreshments and medical services. Registration is open until 1 July 2026, with a participant limit. The entry fee includes a commemorative item and refreshments.
course_highlights: A 5.2 km route with 1,035 m of elevation gain
Start at the village square in Šumiac; finish at the summit of Kráľova hoľa
The course is marked with colored ribbons on trees along the blue hiking trail
additional: Race check-in is from 7:00 to 9:30 behind the primary school building, or, in case of bad weather, inside the Šumiac municipal office. Competitors under 15 must be accompanied by a legal guardian. The organizers provide transport for dry clothing to the finish. Refreshments are available at Predné sedlo and at the finish. Mandatory equipment includes hiking gear and a bottle containing at least 0.5 l of fluids. Protests may be submitted by 13:00 with a deposit of EUR 50. The event also includes regional outdoor activities and emphasizes support for hiking and sport in the Horehronie region.

name: Špačinský trojuholník
organizer: Obec Špačince, Bežecký klub 2001 Špačince, Základná škola s materskou školou v Špačinciach, Dobrovoľný hasičský zbor Špačince
price_range: 10 € štandardne, 5 € pre miestnych, zadarmo pre obyvateľov
description: The Špačinský Triangle is a running race held in the village of Špačince in Trnava District. The race starts at 17:00 in the village centre, by the Primary School with Kindergarten. Men compete in an overall category regardless of age, and women aged 40 and over compete. The organisers are the Municipality of Špačince, Bežecký klub 2001 Špačince, the Primary School with Kindergarten in Špačince, and JDS Špačince. The entry fee is €10, except for village residents, who can enter for free.
course_highlights: Start in the centre of Špačince, by the Primary School with Kindergarten
Categories for men regardless of age and women aged 40 and over
Organised in cooperation with local institutions and the running club
additional: Village residents can enter for free. Men compete in an overall category regardless of age, while women are classified from age 40. The start is in the village centre, by the Primary School with Kindergarten. Course terrain details are not specified; the race takes place in the village centre. Registration is probably required.

name: Trail Relay Banská Štiavnica – Visegrád – štafety
location: Atletická dráha, Banská Štiavnica, Banská Štiavnica, Slovakia

description: The Banská Štiavnica–Visegrád Trail Relay is a unique 220 km relay race connecting two historic royal towns through the natural beauty of the Štiavnica Mountains and Danube–Ipoly National Park. The race is open to teams of 3, teams of 4 to 8, and teams of 6, with categories for experienced runners and larger teams. The route runs mainly along hiking trails and through nature reserves, offering a chance to discover the region’s cultural and historical landmarks and natural beauty in Slovakia and Hungary. The organizers emphasize building good-neighborly relations and promoting the region.
course_highlights: The route passes through the Štiavnica Mountains and Danube–Ipoly National Park
It passes historic and natural sites such as Drégely Castle, Burdov National Nature Reserve, Esztergom Basilica and the Danube Bend
220 km divided into 18 stages with varied ascents and descents
additional: The route is divided into 18 stages with varied ascents and descents, passing through nature reserves and historic sites. Categories include ULTRA for experienced runners and a solo category for individuals, introduced in 2025. Registration takes place online, where the team captain creates a team after registering. The race offers various categories, including ultra, mixed, Nordic walking and individual categories; registration is open from February to March 2026. The route follows hiking trails and natural paths, emphasizing the experience and connection between the two countries.

name: Predeal Forest Run
description: Predeal Forest Run is a mountain running event held in Predeal, Brașov, on July 11, 2026. The event offers five trail-running routes suitable for all fitness levels, from beginners to experienced runners, with distances ranging from 13 km to 38 km. The routes pass through forests, mountain trails, and areas with spectacular scenery, offering a complete mountain-running experience. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and active running community, making it an excellent opportunity to discover the beauty of the Piatra Mare Mountains.
course_highlights: 100% trail-running routes through forests and along mountain trails
Challenging climbs, including more than 500 m of elevation gain over 4 km on K24
Spectacular scenery at Poiana Stanei Pietricica, Vf. Piatra Mare, and Cabana Garbova
additional: The event includes five races: K13 Cros, K24 Semimaraton, K32 Piatra Mare, K38 Maraton, and Family Run (non-competitive). The start is at the base of the Clăbucet ski slopes. The routes are marked with yellow tape bearing the red Predeal Forest Run logo and are supported by volunteers. Cut-off times and aid stations are set for the competitive races. The race kit will be announced later. Participants can register in various race categories, and the event promotes a social cause. Registration details and rules are available on the official website.

name: Legendele Nemirei
description: Legendele Nemirei is a mountain running race held in Slănic Moldova, offering spectacular routes through cool forests and along the ridges of the Nemira Massif. Participants enjoy a well-marked course featuring wild natural scenery and alpine challenges, suited to experienced runners. The event is appreciated for its careful organization, dedicated volunteers, and friendly atmosphere, making it a memorable experience for mountain running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Routes through shady forests and alpine areas with wild natural scenery
90% tourist-trail marking, with additional signage in difficult sections
Significant elevation changes, with spectacular climbs and descents
additional: The routes include a marathon, half marathon, and cross-country race, with positive elevation gains ranging from 700 m to 2400 m. The start is in the Central Park of the Slănic Moldova resort. The routes are 80–90% runnable, with sections of forest road, alpine trails, and rugged terrain. The organizers recommend mountain experience and appropriate equipment. There is also a children’s race to encourage running in nature. The event also includes routes for children, with an emphasis on ecotourism and community involvement, and offers information about registration, accommodation, and routes.

name: Cozia Mountain Run
description: Cozia Mountain Run is a mountain running competition held in the Cozia Massif, on the left bank of the Olt River, in the spa resort of Călimănești-Căciulata. The event, organized by the Pegas Triatlon Club Association with the support of local authorities, promotes mountain running, local traditions, and humanitarian fundraising. Participants take on three challenging, unmarked mountain routes that require mountain experience and skills. The atmosphere is friendly and energizing, and after the race all runners are invited to lunch at Turnu Monastery.
course_highlights: Unmarked mountain routes with significant elevation gain (e.g. 30 km with 2,000 m of elevation gain)
Routes passing through villages, alpine pastures, wooded areas, and mountain ridges
Routes including sections with fixed ropes and rough terrain, requiring mountain experience
additional: Race bibs are distributed in two sessions: Friday evening and Saturday morning. The Cozia (30 km) and Stănișoara (21 km) routes start at 08:00, while the Turnu route (4 km) starts at 09:00. There is an 8-hour time limit for the Cozia and Stănișoara routes. The children’s race takes place at Turnu Monastery Camping, starting at 16:00, and registration for children is free. After the race, all participants are invited to lunch at Turnu Monastery after the Holy Liturgy. Mountain routes, an 8-hour time limit, participants over 18 years old, an emphasis on running and hiking, and the promotion of local natural and cultural attractions

name: HAAS MARATON VÁLTÓ
organizer: Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület
description: The HAAS Marathon Relay is a traditional relay race organized by the Tata Mass Sports and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Association. The race combines the excitement of relay running with the beauty of nature, giving participants the chance to test their strength on varied terrain around Tata. The event has a welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere and offers an enjoyable experience for spectators as well as runners. It is open to sports enthusiasts and amateur runners alike, and is an important event in local sports life.
course_highlights: Relay race on varied terrain around Tata
Nature-close course with forest and agricultural sections
Welcoming, friendly race atmosphere
additional: The race is organized by the Tata Mass Sports and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Association, which supports several sports. The race is part of Sprint Running Club events, and traditionally several divisions take part in organizing it. Maps and past results are available on the website, but no specific prices or start times are listed on the page provided. In addition to the relay race, the event offers other sporting activities; detailed registration and participation information is available on the organizer’s website.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 6. kolo
description: The Bratislava 2-Mile Run is a regular 2-mile race organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team at the Kuchajda swimming pool complex in Bratislava. The race is open to a wide range of categories, including children, juniors, women, men and veterans. Registration takes place on site from 9:30, and the race starts at 10:00. The event also includes a competition for the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team Perpetual Cup, with runners scored according to their performances and participation in individual rounds.
course_highlights: Course distance: 2 miles (3.218 km); children’s race: approximately 200 m
The course runs through the Kuchajda swimming pool complex in Bratislava
Check-in and registration are by the volleyball court
additional: Registration takes place on site from 9:30. The race starts at 10:00. Categories: children (13 and under), juniors, women, men, female veterans and male veterans. The Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team Perpetual Cup competition awards points based on participation and performance. In the event of a tie, the best time adjusted by a coefficient and shoe size determine the winner. The races take place at Kuchajda, with on-site registration by the volleyball court; categories include children, juniors, women, men and veterans. The race is part of a series of 12 races in 2025.

name: Žaškovský minimaratón
description: The Žaškov Mini Marathon is a traditional running race that has been held in the village of Žaškov in Orava for 55 years. The course runs mainly along forest roads and village streets, covering approximately 12.4 km with around 600 m of elevation gain. Runners are warmly welcomed by local residents of all ages, creating a friendly, family atmosphere. The mini marathon is part of the Šípsko - Fatranské behy series and is suitable for all running enthusiasts who want to enjoy the beauty of Orava’s nature and the spirit of sport.
course_highlights: A 12.4 km course with approximately 600 m of elevation gain
Runs along forest roads and the streets of Žaškov
Part of the Šípsko - Fatranské behy series
additional: The course previously ran through Dierová; it was later changed because the footbridge over the Orava River was closed. Runners are welcomed by local residents, and spectators include people of all ages, including older residents. The race is part of a series of several running events in the region. The races include various distances from 100 m to 12 km, with categories for children, young people, and adults. The event also features historical results and photo galleries. The races take place in the village of Žaškov by the Orava River, with registration from 9:30 and the start from 11:00.

name: Cyrilometodský beh Kolonickým vrchom – Memoriál Jozefa Chomaniča
location: Športovo-rekreačný areál Bejvoč, Kolonica, Snina, Slovakia

tiers.label: tier_2

description: The Cyril and Methodius Run over Kolonický vrch – Jozef Chomanič Memorial is a running event held at the Bejvoč sports and recreation complex in Kolonica, Snina District. The race offers categories for children and adults, including several age groups for men and women. The children’s races start at 13:30 and the adults’ race at 15:00. The event is held in memory of Jozef Chomanič and gives runners of all ages the opportunity to test themselves in a beautiful natural setting.
course_highlights: The race takes place at the Bejvoč sports and recreation complex in Kolonica
Several age categories for men and women, including children
Children start at 13:30; adults start at 15:00
additional: Categories: children; Men A (under 39), B (40–49), C (50–59), D (60+); Women E (under 39), F (40+); J. Chomanič Memorial for men and women. Contacts: Pavol A. Dubovský (var@kozmos.sk), Kamila Chomaničová (tel. 0902 587 389). Registration is available online or on-site. The race is part of a memorial event and offers various age categories.

name: Domašská desiatka na Eve
location: Domaša pri Vranove nad Topľou, Vranov nad Topľou, Prešov, Slovakia

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 18 € pre online prihlásených a pri zaplatení na účet

description: Domašská desiatka na Eve is a traditional running race held in the Domaša recreation area, Eva, near Vranov nad Topľou. The race offers 5 km and 10 km courses, which are part of the Vranov nad Topľou District Road Running Championships. Runners can enjoy a course with refreshment stations and, after finishing, receive a race pack with a medal, food and a drink. The organizers provide medical services. The race takes place in open traffic, and each participant runs at their own risk.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Domaša recreation area, Eva
There are 3 refreshment stations on the 5 km course and 6 on the 10 km course
Vranov nad Topľou District Road Running Championships over 5 km and 10 km
additional: Registration takes place on race day from 7:00 to 9:45 in the Domaša recreation area, Eva, near Pizzeria Palermo. Each runner must wear their non-transferable race number attached to the chest. After the last runner finishes, at approximately 12:15, refreshments are available at the finish (food, a large Kofola or a large beer). Category winners receive prizes and symbolic trophies. The course is 90% asphalt and 10% unpaved. The race takes place on 5 July 2026. Registration is available online or on site for a higher price.

name: Treska Trail
description: Join an adventurous hiking tour from Kežman Mountain Houses to the summit of Treska on Kopaonik. This short 650-meter trail leads to an impressive peak at 1,622 meters above sea level, with beautiful panoramic views of the surrounding mountains and valleys. The trail is well marked and suitable for all guests. The ascent takes about 30 minutes, offering a chance to enjoy nature and take photos. Organized tours with transport to the trailhead are available to all accommodation guests.
course_highlights: A 52-meter ascent from 1,570 m to 1,622 m above sea level
Panoramic views of Pančićev Vrh, Radočelo, Golija, and the surrounding mountains
The trail is well marked and safe for hiking
additional: Transport to the trailhead is arranged in the host’s van for accommodation guests. The return trip takes about 30 minutes in total.
