The tour is available only to guests of Kežman Mountain Houses. Participants can expect a guided tour, a short walk with spectacular views, a steep ascent, and a well-marked trail.

name: 48. Trka oko Avale
description: The Around Avala Athletics Race is a traditional event organized by the Athletics Veterans Association of Serbia. The race takes place in Avala’s beautiful surroundings and brings together runners of different ages and fitness levels. It offers an opportunity for sportsmanship and to promote athletics among veterans and recreational runners. The start and finish are at an attractive location, and the course offers both a challenge and the chance to enjoy nature.
course_highlights: Course around Mount Avala
Natural surroundings and woodland scenery
Race suited to veterans and recreational runners
additional: Participants can expect races over various distances, including a half marathon, with the possibility of scoring points toward national and international series. Registration is open to a large number of competitors, and the event is supported by local sponsors and the community.

name: Stâna de Vale Trail Race
description: Stâna de Vale Trail Race is a mountain running competition held amid the spectacular scenery of the Carpathian Mountains, at the Stâna de Vale resort in Bihor County. The event is part of the EMA Off-Road Running 2026 circuit and offers races for all levels, from beginner routes to demanding mountain ultramarathons. Participants can enjoy well-marked routes, full support along the course, and a friendly post-race atmosphere. The race weekend also includes an 8 km vertical race, a classic 11 km race, and a long 33 km race with significant elevation gain.
course_highlights: A 33 km mountain route with 1,500 m of positive elevation gain, featuring technical sections and panoramic views
An 11 km route suited to beginners and intermediate runners, through forests and gentle hills
An 8 km vertical race with 1,100 m of elevation gain, featuring a continuous, demanding climb
additional: The event takes place on 10–11 July 2026, with race-pack collection at Hotel Iadolina, Stâna de Vale. The Vertical 8K starts on Friday at 10:00, while the 33 km and 11 km races start on Saturday at 08:30 and 09:30. The organizers provide a post-race meal and a party after the awards ceremony. Participation in the EMA circuit requires a valid license for the 35–79 age category. The routes are on mountain terrain, and the event includes timing. Participants can choose between two distances to suit their fitness level.

name: Jadovnički Ultramaraton 2026
description: Jadovnik Ultramarathon 2026 is a unique trail event in western Serbia, bringing together nature lovers and fans of endurance and extreme races. It takes place on July 10 and 11 in Prijepolje, with the start and finish at the Cultural Center Plaza. All courses are new and do not repeat those from the previous edition, and the races cater to different fitness levels and runner categories. Participants receive a race packet with a T-shirt, promotional materials, and a finisher’s medal, and the organizers also provide support with accommodation and meals.
course_highlights: Three races of different distances: Maxi (60.9 km), Midi (24.8 km), Mini (14.6 km)
The courses are entirely new and do not repeat those from the previous ultramarathon
Time limits: Maxi 12h, Midi 7h, Mini 5h
additional: The race packet includes a T-shirt (size guaranteed for entries paid by June 20, 2026), promotional materials from the Prijepolje Tourist Organization, finisher’s medals for everyone who completes the race, and medals and trophies for category winners. Free accommodation is available in the gymnasium of “Valter” Elementary School (sleeping bags are required). The organizer reserves the right to make course adjustments, with timely notice. Participants can expect details about registration, medals, T-shirts, and timing on the official platforms. The event also includes services such as timekeeping and event promotion.

name: VII. Csillagok útján… éjszakai futás
description: The 7th Csillagok útján… night run is a unique running experience at Balatonboglár’s Platán Beach, where runners and walkers are welcomed on July 11 in a summer setting on the shores of Lake Balaton. The new venue offers a wider start-finish corridor, a firm surface throughout, and full street lighting along the route. Participants can choose from 3.5, 7, and 10.5 km distances, while walking and a 500-meter children’s distance are also available. The event warmly welcomes all ages and running levels to experience the magic of running at night together.
course_highlights: Balatonboglár’s Platán Beach in a beautiful lakeside setting
A wide start-finish corridor and a firm surface throughout
Street lighting along the entire route for a night-running experience
additional: Walking is also available on the 3.5 km distance, and children can test their strength over 500 meters. Street lighting along the entire route supports safe night running. The new venue offers a wider start-finish corridor and a firm surface. The event is part of the summer events on Lake Balaton, and the organizers aim to increase interest in active leisure activities in the region.

name: DRÁVA FÉLMARATON
location: Barcs, Városháza, Barcs, Somogy County, Hungary
description: The Dráva Half Marathon is a traditional 21-kilometer race between Barcs and Heresznye, held for the fifth time. Runners from several counties take part, and men and women compete in separate categories. The course is varied, and record times have been set in previous years, reflecting the race’s competitive nature and popularity. The event is organized by the local Dráva Running Club and the Heresznye municipality, creating a friendly yet competitive atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: 21-kilometer course between Barcs and Heresznye
Varied route that has seen record times
Runners from six counties take part in the race
additional: The event includes several sports, including running, hiking, and cycling, and the races are usually held in July between Barcs and Heresznye.

name: KÖCSI-TÓ FUTÓVERSENY
description: The Köcsi Lake running event is a traditional race with a friendly, family atmosphere, held near Balatonalmádi-Káptalanfüred, in the scenic surroundings of Köcsi Lake. Everyone who wants to run or walk is warmly welcome to enjoy the natural setting and the community sporting experience. The event is organized by the Marathon Mass Sports and Environmental Protection Association, which is committed to sport and environmental protection. The race offers several distances, so everyone can find a challenge that suits them.
course_highlights: A nature-rich course around Köcsi Lake
A friendly, community atmosphere
Several distances for different age groups
additional: Results are available for the 1 km, 6 km, and 12 km distances, broken down by age group. The event is organized by the Marathon Mass Sports and Environmental Protection Association, which also supports several health and environmental projects. Photos are available for participants on the website. Multiple distances for children and adults, refreshment facilities, the opportunity to swim at the beach, finisher medals.

name: Nízkotatranská stíhačka
description: The Low Tatras Chase (NTS) is an individual ultra-trail race with a main 98 km course from Telgárt to Donovaly via the main ridge of the Low Tatras, and a half-distance course finishing at Čertovica. The race is a qualifying event for the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc and is ITRA-certified. It is organised by the civic association Time Out - OZ in cooperation with STS HIKING and Slovak Ultratrail. NTS offers a challenging mountain course with beautiful views and challenges for experienced trail runners.
course_highlights: The 98.5 km main course follows the main ridge of the Low Tatras from Telgárt to Donovaly
The 49 km half-distance course finishes at the Čertovica mountain pass
Challenging mountain terrain with beautiful views and checkpoints
additional: Participant check-in takes place on Friday, 10 July 2026, from 18:00 to 22:00 at ZŠ Telgárt, where the briefing will also be held. The race starts on Saturday, 11 July 2026, at 06:00 in Telgárt. The organiser provides baggage transport (drop bags). The participant limit is 200. Qualification requirements must be met to enter the main course. Checkpoints and refreshments are provided during the race. NTS is part of Slovak Ultra Trail and is ITRA-certified. The race is intended for experienced ultramarathon runners, with online registration available subject to meeting the qualification criteria. The event also includes a shorter 49 km course, and takes place on 11 and 12 July 2026.

name: Rozbehni Majerovce
description: Rozbehni Majerovce is a running event held in the village of Majerovce, Vranov nad Topľou District, in front of the Municipal Office. The races offer categories for children and adults, with main races of 5 and 10 km. The children’s races start at 09:15 and the main race at 10:15. Organizer Martin Folenta and the Municipality of Majerovce warmly invite runners of all ages to enjoy a pleasant day of sport.
course_highlights: The races take place in the village of Majerovce, in front of the Municipal Office
The main adult race distances are 5 km and 10 km
Separate categories for children, with their own start
additional: The children’s races start at 09:15, and the main race begins at 10:15. Categories are divided by age and gender, including men and women in different age groups. On-site registration is available for a higher entry fee. The races start at 09:15 and 10:15; the course likely follows local roads, and registration is available online and on-site.

name: Beh Rajeckou dolinou KL Auto
location: Námestie SNP Rajecké Teplice, Rajecké Teplice, Slovakia
description: Beh Rajeckou dolinou KL Auto is a running event in the picturesque setting of the Rajec Valley, offering a mix of paved and dirt roads. The route runs mostly along dirt roads, with approximately 20% paved surfaces, creating an enjoyable and varied running experience. The event is known for its excellent organization and friendly atmosphere, attracting runners of all levels. The start is at SNP Square in Rajecké Teplice. The organizer is Ján Valúch Jr., who is available for information and support.
course_highlights: The route is 20% paved roads and 80% dirt roads
Start at SNP Square in Rajecké Teplice
Picturesque setting of the Rajec Valley
additional: The entry fee is €12 for online registration and €20 on site. The organizer is Ján Valúch Jr., who can be contacted by phone at 0904 255 310 or by email at valuch.jan@gmail.com. The event is part of a sports day in Rajecké Teplice, with a beautiful route and a great atmosphere.

name: Beh malý Caesar
location: Námestie SNP, Rajecké Teplice, Žilina, Slovakia
description: The St. Andrew’s Run and the Little Caesar Children’s Run are traditional events in Rajecké Teplice, bringing a sporting and family-friendly atmosphere to SNP Square. The St. Andrew’s Run is a 4.5 km road race with online registration, while the Little Caesar Children’s Run is for children aged 1 to 9 and is free of charge. The event also includes a competition for the most beautifully decorated children’s stroller, adding to the experience for participants and spectators alike. The event takes place in the afternoon, with check-in and the start on the square.
course_highlights: A 4.5 km road course for the St. Andrew’s Run
Children’s categories for ages 1–3, 4–6, and 7–9
A competition for the most beautifully decorated children’s stroller on the square
additional: Check-in for the St. Andrew’s Run is from 14:30 to 16:30, with the start at 17:00. Check-in for the Little Caesar Children’s Run starts at 14:00 in the lobby of the Municipal Office. Places in the children’s run are limited to 150. The event takes place at SNP Square in Rajecké Teplice. The children’s run is open to all age groups, registration is available online or on site, and the event is suitable for the whole family.

name: Jadovnički ultramaraton
description: The Jadovnik Ultramarathon was first organized by the Jadovnik Citizens’ Association on the mountain of the same name. The race aims to highlight the beauty and rich flora and fauna of Mount Jadovnik, which has so far been little known to the public. This ultramarathon offers runners a unique opportunity to experience the challenge and special appeal of running in unspoiled nature. The organizers hope to preserve and promote the mountain through sport and community.
course_highlights: The course runs through Mount Jadovnik, rich in flora and fauna
The race takes place in unspoiled nature with a distinctive mountain setting
A unique opportunity to discover a lesser-known mountain in Serbia
additional: Participants must carry mandatory equipment. The race is limited to 100 runners, and the route includes forest roads and paved sections.

name: LÁZBÉRCI SRI CHINMOY MARATON
location: Lázbérci Természetvédelmi Terület, Lázbérc, Borsod-Abaúj-Zemplén, Hungary
description: The Lázbérc Sri Chinmoy Marathon is a nationally organized running race in Hungary, held in the spirit of peace philosopher Sri Chinmoy. The race traditionally offers the experience of running close to nature and gives participants a unique opportunity to experience physical and spiritual harmony. Runners can test their strength and endurance on varied terrain in a picturesque setting. The race has a friendly, intimate atmosphere, and all running enthusiasts are warmly welcome.
course_highlights: Varied terrain close to nature
Picturesque surroundings in the Lázbérc landscape
An event held in the spirit of peace philosopher Sri Chinmoy
additional: The event will take place in 2026, and the organizers aim to bring together the community of peace and running.

name: Bančanská desiatka
description: The Bančanská Ten is a traditional running race in the village of Banské, in Vranov nad Topľou District, held in front of the Cultural Centre in Banské. This popular sporting event has a long history and attracts a record number of participants each year. The race is known for its challenging uphill course and beautiful surroundings, and is organized by Športový klub Banské. In addition to the main race, uphill time trials and other accompanying events are held.
course_highlights: Uphill race in the village of Banské – Mláčky
Traditional start in front of the Cultural Centre in Banské
Challenging course profile, with a new course record of 14:35 min
additional: The event is organized by Športový klub Banské, which has a long tradition dating back to 1985. It is held regularly, and in 2025 the 30th edition of the Bančanská 10/5 will take place. The event also includes the JANTEX Banské–Mláčky uphill time trials, which have their own history and categories. The race includes 10 km and a 5 km relay; registration is available online or on site. There is also a varied accompanying programme, including a bouncy castle and performances.

name: Malý Štrbský maratón
organizer: Obec Štrba, Obec Liptovská Teplička, Športový klub Štrba
price_range: 20,- € to 25,- € depending on registration date, free for some categories
description: The Malý Štrbský Marathon is a traditional running race held every year on the second Sunday in July in the village of Štrba beneath the Tatras. Runners can choose between two main distances—31 km and 10 km—on an asphalt road between Štrba and Liptovská Teplička. The event is part of the Tatry v pohybe project and attracts runners from several countries. The atmosphere in the square in front of the Cultural Centre is always lively and full of sporting spirit. The organisers are the Municipality of Štrba, the Municipality of Liptovská Teplička and Športový klub Štrba.
course_highlights: 31 km route on a third-class asphalt road from Štrba to Liptovská Teplička and back
Refreshment stations at kilometres 8, 12, 16, 20, 25 and 28
10 km route, introduced in 2021
additional: The total participant limit is 500, with priority given to the 31 km race (limit of 200) and the 10 km race (limit of 300). The race takes place without road closures, so extra caution is required. Medical services are provided by Tatranská horská služba, NsP Poprad and the local Red Cross. Runners take part at their own risk. The organiser provides transport from selected train services from Tatranská Štrba. The event includes 48 km, 10 km and children’s races; it is part of the East Slovak Youth Running League; registration has set deadlines and age categories; Nordic Walking is also part of the event.

name: LUSSONIUM TRAIL
description: Lussonium Trail is a trail running race among the hills of Paks-Dunakömlőd, offering wonderful views, challenging climbs and a friendly, family-like atmosphere. The race offers several distances for participants of all ages, with unique finisher medals that can be joined with the Feldwar Trail medal. The race headquarters are at the Lussonium Roman Ruins, where parking, toilets, a playground and a first-aid point are also available. The race is also a points-collection stop in the Ötpróba program, so participants can earn points and redeem them for rewards.
course_highlights: Wonderful views among the hills of Paks-Dunakömlőd
Challenging trail climbs
Impressive start and finish venue at the Lussonium Roman Ruins
additional: The race will be held with a minimum of 100 valid entries. Entries are accepted for a maximum of 400 runners, including no more than 100 preschool- and primary school-aged participants. Parking, toilets, a playground and a first-aid point are available on site. Finishers receive a unique medal that can be joined with the Feldwar Trail medal. It is also possible to register at a lower price without a medal. The race is also a points-collection stop in the Ötpróba program. Medals and refreshments await participants, and the event has a friendly atmosphere and is ideal for families.

name: Kordícky Extrém
organizer: Marathon Banska Bystrica, s.r.o., ON-POINT o.z.
description: Kordícky Extrém is a challenging mountain run through the picturesque surroundings of Kordíky in the Banská Bystrica District. The course is intended for runners seeking extreme challenges in nature, with significant elevation gain and technical sections. The event is part of the Marathon Tour series and offers a unique running experience in beautiful mountain scenery. The organizers welcome all runners who want to test their endurance and courage in this extreme terrain.
course_highlights: Mountain setting with significant elevation gain
Technically challenging sections on natural trails
Picturesque views of the surroundings of Kordíky
additional: Multiple categories and registration options, including online and in person. The event is accompanied by a large social gathering with food and entertainment.

name: Mesciské pancaky
location: Futbalové ihrisko, Mestisko, okres Svidník, Slovakia
description: Mesciské Pancaky is a running event in Mestisko, Svidník District, offering 5 km and 10 km courses with no age restrictions for men or women. The course is mostly asphalt, with sections on grass and a dirt road, providing runners with varied terrain. The race starts at the football pitch in Mestisko. Registration is available online or at the event venue.
course_highlights: Surface: 60% asphalt, 20% grass, 20% dirt road
Two categories: 5 km and 10 km, with no age restrictions
Start at the football pitch in Mestisko
additional: The categories are open to men and women regardless of age. The start is at the football pitch in Mestisko. The course combines asphalt, grass and a dirt road. The event is open to all age groups, and registration is available online or at the venue.

name: Behaj lesmi Veľká Fatra
location: Hrabovo, Národný park Veľká Fatra, Slovakia
description: Behaj lesmi Veľká Fatra is a trail race in Veľká Fatra National Park, offering runners unforgettable views of the Low Tatras, forest singletrack trails and special forest roads. The routes pass through the UNESCO-listed site of Vlkolínec and also include a cable car and Sidorovo. The race is part of the international UTMB Index Races, where runners earn points based on their performance and race distance. Three routes of varying distances and elevation gain are available, suitable for runners of different levels.
course_highlights: Unforgettable views of the Low Tatras
Forest singletrack trails and special forest roads
The route passes through the UNESCO-listed site of Vlkolínec
additional: The course includes 150-metre Conti Speed Sections marked with Continental flags. Runners can earn points toward the UTMB Index Races based on their performance and race distance. The routes have different elevation gains: 730 m over 18 km, 405 m over 11 km and 267 m over 5 km. The routes are mostly on soft natural surfaces. The race is part of a series supporting environmental and charitable projects, with details about registration, entry fees and accompanying activities available on the official website.

name: Maraton Bate Toaca
description: Maraton Bate Toaca is an annual mountain race held in the Durău area, NT, and is part of the Carpathians Circuit. The event offers two main courses: the 18 km Dochia Race, with approximately 1500 m of elevation gain, and the 31 km Bate Toaca Race, with approximately 2700 m of elevation gain. The courses pass through spectacular scenery, including Cabana Dochia, Vf. Lespezi, and Vf. Toaca, offering runners an authentic and challenging mountain experience. The organizers provide a friendly atmosphere and good logistics for participants.
course_highlights: Mountain courses with significant elevation gains (1500 m and 2700 m)
Spectacular scenery in the Durău area, including Vf. Toaca and Cabana Dochia
Marked courses with various symbols (red stripe, yellow triangle, red cross, red dot)
additional: The courses are well marked with different symbols and include climbs and descents on stairs at Vf. Toaca. The Bate Toaca Race is part of the Carpathians Circuit. The organizer is Asociația SPORT.NATURA Piatra Neamț. Telephone contact is available for logistics and the secretariat. The event also includes results and rules from previous editions, as well as information about registration and participation.

name: BUILA TRAIL RACE Discover Oltenia de sub munte!
description: Buila Trail Race 2026 is a mountain running event organized by the Sport fără Limite Vâlcea Association, promoting the beauty of Buila-Vânturarița National Park. The event takes place on July 18, 2026, in Bărbătești, Vâlcea, and offers a range of races for all ages and fitness levels. Participants can choose from children’s races, cross-country races, and mountain courses of 11, 18, and 36 km, all featuring spectacular scenery and authentic mountain challenges.
course_highlights: Mountain routes in Buila-Vânturarița National Park
Spectacular scenery and protected nature
A range of events: children’s races, an 11 km cross-country race, and 18 km and 36 km courses
additional: The event promotes ecotourism, nature, and local culture, offering an opportunity for trail running and mountain hiking enthusiasts.

name: BURDUF CHALLENGE Alergăm pentru brânză și colibe!
price_range: semi-maraton 200 Lei, cros 175 Lei, cursele copiilor 50 Lei
description: Burduf Challenge is a mountain running race held in Râu Sadului, Sibiu, on 18 July 2026. The event features three races on scenic subalpine routes with significant elevation gain, for adults as well as children and teenagers. Participation supports the Țara Colibelor project through a donation included in the entry fee, and after the race runners are invited to a brunch featuring local products. The event promotes ecotourism and the preservation of mountain cultural heritage in the Cindrel and Lotrului Mountains.
course_highlights: Scenic subalpine routes with elevation gains ranging from +30 m to +1000 m
14 km cross-country race with +900 m elevation gain and 21 km half marathon with +1000 m elevation gain
Routes for children and teenagers with modest elevation gain, adapted to age
additional: Race bib pickup is from 06:30 to 07:30, the technical briefing is at 07:45, the adult race starts at 09:00, and the children’s race starts at 11:00. Hydration stations are available every 5 km along the route. Parking is available at the school in the village centre and in the Beberani area, approximately 100 m from the start. After the race, participants are invited to a brunch featuring local products, and the entry fee includes a donation of 50 lei to support the Țara Colibelor project. mountain routes, online registration, donation included, post-race brunch

name: FUTABUDA a Dunakanyarban
description: FUTABUDA in the Danube Bend is a self-funded, nonprofit running race taking place in Dunabogdány on Sunday, July 19, 2026, at 10:00. The race offers two challenges: 6.1 km with 205 m of elevation gain and 14 km with 356 m of elevation gain. Runners receive a unique metal finisher’s medal, and top finishers are awarded prizes in age-group and overall categories. The race is part of the Ötpróba series but is independent of it, and registration allows for on-site changes. Places are limited to a maximum of 200 participants.
course_highlights: 6.1 km distance with 205 m of elevation gain
14 km distance with 356 m of elevation gain
Unique 60 × 60 mm metal finisher’s medal
additional: On-site registration is also available for an increased fee. The distance can still be changed before the start, but only participants who do not switch distances during the race will be included in the results. There is no time limit. When registering, participants must provide their year of birth, chosen distance, and, if they have one, the number of a race bib brought from home. Participants without a race bib will receive a paper bib. Competitors’ names will appear in the start and results lists, and photos and videos taken during the event may be used on the website. Two distances, elevation gain, prizes, age-group categories, unique metal finisher’s medals, online and on-site registration, limited capacity (200 participants).

name: FUTABUDA
description: FUTABUDA is a running race held in the Danube Bend, starting at 10:00 a.m. on Sunday, July 19, 2026, at the Kisoroszi Ferry Port in Dunabogdány. The race offers two distances, 6.1 km and 14 km, with significant elevation changes that challenge runners. Participants who finish receive a unique metal finisher’s medal, and the top finishers receive awards. The race is part of the Ötpróba series, but is an independent event. Registration is available online or by email, and on-site registration is also possible for a higher fee.
course_highlights: 6.1 km distance with +/- 205 m elevation change
14 km distance with +/- 356 m elevation change
Unique 60 x 60 mm metal finisher’s medal for those who finish
additional: When registering, participants must provide their name, year of birth, chosen distance, and any preferred bib number. The chosen distance can still be changed before the start, but only runners who do not change distance during the race will be included in the results. There is no time limit. The race is a non-profit, self-funded event, with a limit of 200 participants. Awards will go to those who break the men’s and women’s course records, the overall 1st–3rd-place finishers, and the 1st–3rd-place finishers in each age group. On-site registration is available for a higher fee. Bibs can be collected at the venue, or after 9:30 a.m. in the case of advance bank transfer. Participants can look forward to medals, prizes, and awards in various categories. Registration is available online and on-site, offering a varied experience depending on weather conditions.

name: YOUNG RUN Nestlé
location: Námestie J. C. Hronského, Prievidza, Prievidza, Slovakia
description: YOUNG RUN Nestlé is a running event in Prievidza offering 21 km, 10 km and 5 km races. Competitors are divided into categories by age and gender, and children’s relay events are also available. The races start at J. C. Hronský Square, with different start times depending on the distance. The event is organised by YOUNG RUN, Nestlé and the City of Prievidza, providing a quality sporting experience for all age groups.
course_highlights: 21 km, 10 km and 5 km courses in the centre of Prievidza
Categories for different age groups, including juniors and veterans
Children’s relay races with circuits of 2 x 5 km and 2 x 2.5 km
additional: Race start times: 8:00 for 21 km, 8:15 for the TRUE circuit and relay, 9:20 for STARTIN, and 9:55 for children. Categories are divided by age and gender, with specific birth years. The organiser provides the contact telephone number +421915574850. The event also includes VIP zones, online timing, support for people with disabilities, and 600 participant medals.

name: Ipelský Beh
location: Lučenec - Kalonda, Hrádza na Ipli, Lučenec, Slovakia
description: Ipelský Beh is a running event held in Lučenec - Kalonda, on the embankment of the Ipeľ River. The course runs mainly on grass and includes a 100-metre section of a disused railway line. The race is open to various age categories for men, women and young people, including Nordic walking. The organizers, the city of Lučenec, the municipality of Kalonda and OZ-Novohrad, warmly invite runners of all levels to take part in this traditional event.
course_highlights: Course surface is mainly grass
A 100-metre section of a disused railway line
Location on the embankment of the Ipeľ River in Lučenec - Kalonda
additional: Online registration is available until 18.7.2025 at the reduced entry fee of €13. On-site entry is €18, subject to availability. Categories are divided by age and gender, including Nordic walking for men and women. The organizer is Marian Duzbaba (tel.: 0907 146 181). The race is held in various categories, including Nordic walking, with online registration available and races on different courses, including a 10 km course and a 6.5 km asphalt course. The event is part of the region’s sports calendar and is suitable for all age groups.

name: Boogie To The Van 8k fun run
Trail race Kopaonik 2026
description: Trail Race Kopaonik is a traditional event that brings together trail-running and nature enthusiasts in Kopaonik National Park. With three courses of different lengths—7 km, 15 km and 24 km—the race gives both beginners and experienced runners the chance to enjoy beautiful forest and meadow scenery, fresh mountain air and pleasant temperatures. In addition to the race, participants can enjoy a music programme, organised walks and a children’s race. The organisers provide fully marked courses, electronic timing, T-shirts, medals, refreshments and medical assistance.
course_highlights: The Kopaonik 7K course passes through the Crvene Bare area and by the Markov Kamen picnic site
The Kopaonik 15K course goes over Gobelja peak, Meka Presedla and Likina Česma
The Kopaonik 24K course has 900 m of elevation gain and a time limit of 6 hours
additional: All courses start in Dolina sportova at 10:00. Course time limits are: 7K – 3 hours, 15K – 4 hours, 24K – 6 hours. Refreshment stations and medical assistance are available on the courses. Participants who register by 6 July 2026 receive the official race T-shirt. Chip-based electronic timing, online results and certificates are available. The race is individual; registration is online only via njuko.com. Race-day registration is not available. Entry includes electronic timing, finisher medals, refreshment stations, medical assistance and GPS navigation. Register via njuko.com; on-site race-day registration is not available.

name: GAJA-VÖLGY TRAIL
description: Gaja Valley Trail is a trail-running event organised by the Gaja Valley Association for the second time on 25 July 2026 in Fehérvárcsurgó, near Károlyi Castle. Runners and hikers can choose from three different distances. The focus is not on competition, but on the joy of exercise, a shared community experience and being close to nature. The event aims to promote running at every level, from beginners to experienced runners, in a pleasant summer woodland setting. The start and finish are at the Károlyi Castle Visitor Centre, while the sound of Gaja Stream and the quiet of the valley create a special atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: A route featuring the castle, reservoir and the babbling Gaja Stream
Scenic woodland trails in Gaja Valley
The Károlyi Castle Visitor Centre is the start and finish venue
additional: Gaja Valley Trail is not a race and has no timing, so beginner, amateur and recreational runners can all take part. Every participant receives a finisher’s medal. The event offers a friendly community atmosphere, a healthy lifestyle and an experience close to nature. Alongside trail running, the event also features hikes and cycling challenge tours. The venue is easy to reach, and the varied terrain is rich in natural features.

name: GULYATERELŐ FUTÓVERSENY
location: Tápiógyörgye Falumúzeum, Béke utca 2, Tápiógyörgye, Hungary

name: Dobra Run a Dobrá dvojka
description: Dobra Run and Dobrá dvojka is a running event in Domaša, Vranov nad Topľou District, offering 7 km and 2 km courses. The race is suitable for various age groups of men and women, including children. It is organized by Matore s.r.o. Humenné and BAMM Bratislava. Participants can look forward to a pleasant atmosphere and the opportunity to compete in different age groups. Entry fees are available online or on site, while places remain.
course_highlights: 7 km and 2 km courses suitable for various age groups
Men’s and women’s age categories for ages 18 and over
The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Domaša
additional: Entry fees can be paid online or on site, while places remain. Categories are divided by age and gender, including children’s categories. The event is organized by Matore s.r.o. Humenné and BAMM Bratislava. Contact person: Ing. Dušan Matanin, tel.: 0905 271 190. The race takes place in summer, with the option to register in advance or on site, and is suitable for all age groups.

name: Night city run Piešťany
description: Piešťany Night City RUN is a traditional night run held at Námestie Slobody in Piešťany. Participants can take part in the 10 km race, which runs through the city and offers the unique atmosphere of a night run under the auspices of the City of Piešťany. The event is open to various age categories, and all participants receive a commemorative medal. Electronic timing is provided, and the results are ceremonially announced in the evening after the run.
course_highlights: A night run through Piešťany with the atmosphere of running beneath streetlights
Start and finish at Námestie Slobody
Electronic timing provided by SunBell s.r.o.
additional: Registration takes place from 16:30 to 19:45 in the building of the School of Physiotherapy, Rehabilitation and Balneology. Parking is available at Aupak and at the Park-and-Ride Car Park on Nálepkova Street. The first 100 participants receive the lowest entry fee. After the race, there is a raffle and the ceremonial announcement of results at 21:45. Participants aged 15 and over may race independently; younger participants need the consent of a legal guardian. The event is open to all runners, including children, who can participate for free. A medal and refreshments are provided, and the use of a headlamp during the run is recommended.

name: Extrém maratón Košice – Furča
description: The Košice–Furča Extreme Marathon is a challenging running race organized by the O5 Bežecký klub Furča Košice. The race takes place in the pleasant surroundings of Furča, where runners can enjoy the challenges of the course and the atmosphere of a traditional marathon. It is intended for endurance runners seeking a more extreme experience over the marathon distance. The organizers provide quality conditions and support for all participants.
course_highlights: Challenging course in the surroundings of Furča
Traditional marathon with an extreme character
Organized by the O5 Bežecký klub Furča Košice
additional: The marathon starts at 10:00. Information about course certification is available on the website. Registration for the 2026 Furča Marathon is closed. The course is intended for experienced runners; registration is possible until race day. The event includes an ultramarathon over challenging terrain with significant elevation gain.

name: Cer Night trail
description: Cer Night Trail is a night race held on Mount Cer, known for its beautiful natural scenery and challenging trails. The race brings together trail-running enthusiasts who enjoy running through forests and mountain terrain beneath the starry sky. The event is part of the Cer Trail race series, which promotes community, perseverance, and a love of nature. Cer Night Trail gives runners the opportunity to experience the magic of night trail running in the unique setting of Mount Cer.
course_highlights: A night race through the forests and mountain terrain of Mount Cer
Challenging trails with natural obstacles and beautiful views
A sense of community and support among runners
additional: Cer Night Trail is part of the Cer Trail race series, which also includes Cer Winter Trail and Cer Ultra Trail. The race is a member of the UTMB and ITRA communities. The Instagram profile promotes the values of community, support, and runners’ strength, especially that of women. Photos and videos from previous races are available on the Instagram profile.

name: MONORERDEI FUTÓFESZTIVÁL
location: Makkos Park, Monorierdő, Pest County, Hungary
description: The Monorierdő Running Festival is a friendly, family-oriented running event held every year in Makkos Park in Monorierdő. Participants can choose from several distances, and the course starts and finishes in Makkos Park. A special feature of the event is a live-music refreshment station, where the band "The Little Pea" energizes the runners twice. The event aims to promote the joy of sport and exercise, and everyone is warmly welcome to join the running community.
course_highlights: The race starts and finishes in Makkos Park
Live-music refreshment station featuring the band "The Little Pea"
A choice of distances to suit runners' preferences
additional: The railway station is just 200 metres from the event centre, making the venue easy to reach by train. Participants are advised to choose a train that will get them there in time to collect their race numbers. The event is part of the Ötpróba series. Online registration is available until July 18, and other sports and leisure events are also offered in connection with the races.

name: Beh na chatu pod Chlebom, mem. J. Morgoša
organizer: BS TATRAN Turany, LK NÁDEJ Turany
description: The Run to the Chata pod Chlebom, J. Morgoš Memorial, is a mountain running race held in the areas of Turany, Šútovo and Zajacová. The course is 3.1 km long with an elevation gain of 680 metres and runs along mountain roads and trails. The race is part of the Turčianska Running League 2025 and is open to various age categories for men and women. The organizers are BS TATRAN Turany, the town of Turany and LK NÁDEJ Turany. The race offers a challenge for runners who enjoy demanding mountain terrain.
course_highlights: 3.1 km course with 680 m elevation gain
Mountain roads and trails
Race in the mountain areas of Turany - Šútovo - Zajacová
additional: Categories: Juniors, Junior Women, Men under 40, Men under 50, Men over 50, Men over 60, Men over 70, Women under 35, Women over 35, Women over 50. The race is part of the Turčianska Running League 2025. Mountain terrain, with registration available online or on site, and categories for different age groups.

name: Bucovina Ultra Rocks
description: Bucovina Ultra Rocks by UTMB invites you to explore the wild heart of the Eastern Carpathians, one of Europe’s last authentic wilderness regions. With six races ranging from a fast 15 km run to a 114 km challenge, the routes cross rocky ridges, UNESCO-protected old-growth forests, medieval shepherd settlements, and impressive natural landscapes such as Moara Dracului Gorge and Pietrele Doamnei. Expect steep climbs, technical trails, and authentic mountain conditions, with every kilometer offering a unique experience in the European wilderness.
course_highlights: Routes through Slătioara Forest, a UNESCO candidate
Steep climbs and technical trails in the Carpathian Mountains
Spectacular natural landscapes: Moara Dracului Gorge and Pietrele Doamnei
additional: The Ultra Rocks race (114 km) starts just before midnight in Câmpulung Moldovenesc. The route includes an initial loop through the town, followed by stretches through wilderness and checkpoints with facilities such as Live Cooking. The event takes place in the Ultra Trail Village at the Central Plateau in Câmpulung Moldovenesc, next to City Hall. Multiple mountain race distances, technical trails, the location in Romania, and details about registration and rules are available on websites and social media.

name: SEMIMARATON TARA DE PIATRĂ
description: The Țara de Piatră Half Marathon is a running race taking place on July 26, 2026, in the Avram Iancu area, Câmpeni, Alba, Romania. Participants can choose from three races of different distances, running along routes that pass through the Apuseni Mountains’ historic and natural landscapes, imbued with the spirit of their ancestors. The start is scheduled for 8:00, and transport to the start line is provided by coach. Race kits can be collected on Saturday and on Sunday morning before the start. The event offers an authentic and energizing experience for runners of all levels.
course_highlights: Historic route along Avram Iancu’s road
Water stations at km 5, 12.5, 17.5, and 20
Total ascent of 178 m and total descent of 332 m on the 22 km course
additional: Coach transport from 7:00 from the center of Câmpeni to the start line; race kits can be collected on Saturday between 14:00 and 20:00 and on Sunday until 07:00; water stations along the route; meeting and registration from 05:30 to 07:30 at the Avram Iancu Statue in Câmpeni. Participation includes multiple starts, transport to the start with partner Arieșul SA, race-kit collection, and an artistic and traditional program as part of the event.

name: FAGARAS ROCKS!
organizer: A C U M - Asociația Copiii universului Magic și ACS Sport Verde
description: Făgăraș Rocks! is a mountain running event offering a unique experience on spectacular trails in the Făgăraș Mountains, with majestic scenery and impressive panoramas. The routes total approximately 184 km, include multiple peaks above 2,500 m and more than 50 km of running at altitudes above 2,000 m, and are run in semi-autonomous conditions. The event includes several races of varying distances, for experienced runners as well as younger participants and amateurs, with a friendly atmosphere and related activities for participants and their families. The organizers provide facilities such as aid stations, medical assistance, a hot meal on the course, finisher medals, and cash prizes for the mountain races.
course_highlights: Approximately 184 km of marked routes in the Făgăraș Mountains
4 peaks above 2,500 m and 15 peaks above 2,200 m
50 km of running at altitudes above 2,000 m
additional: Participants receive a personalized race bib (non-personalized bibs after July 15), live satellite tracking for #TheWildTruth, a hot meal on the course for #TheWildTruth, engraved stone finisher medals, a superlight technical shirt for the first 300 entrants in the main races, ITRA & UTMB points for finishers, Q&A sessions and themed workshops, aid and hydration stations, medical assistance, photo albums with selfie identification, parking for 360 cars, massage tents, and post-race feedback. Multiple route categories, information about camping and parking; the event includes an ultra and a skyrace.

name: Fagaras Rocks ~ 2026
organizer: ACUM - Asociația Copiii universului Magic și ACS Sport Verde
description: Făgăraș Rocks! is a mountain running event held in semi-autonomous format, offering a unique experience on spectacular trails in the Făgăraș Mountains, with majestic landscapes and impressive panoramas. The routes total approximately 184 km, reach peaks over 2,500 m, and include 50 km of running at elevations above 2,000 m. The event features several races of varying distances and difficulty levels, for experienced runners as well as younger participants and amateurs. Participants receive a comprehensive registration package, with services and amenities designed to make the experience complete and safe.
course_highlights: Approximately 184 km of marked trails in the Făgăraș Mountains
4 peaks over 2,500 m and 15 peaks over 2,200 m
50 km of running at elevations above 2,000 m
additional: The participation package includes a personalized race bib (for registrations by July 15), live satellite tracking for the #TheWildTruth race, cash prizes for the mountain races, a hot meal on the course for #TheWildTruth, a stone-engraved finisher medal, a superlight technical singlet for the first 300 registrants in the main races, ITRA & UTMB points for finishers, Q&A sessions and themed workshops, medical assistance, refreshment and hydration points, parking for 360 cars, massage tents, and post-race feedback. The event includes camping and parking, along with details about the competition schedule, and offers an opportunity to experience a mountain adventure and discover the area’s natural beauty.

name: CSERNYE TRAIL
description: Csernye Trail is a trail running race that will be held for the sixth time in Bakonycsernye in 2026. Starting from the area beside the sports field, runners can choose from various distances that pass through varied terrain, forests and hills. The organizers promise excellent event management and an enjoyable running experience, while participants can admire the natural beauty of the Bakony. The race is family-friendly and recommended for both beginners and experienced runners.
course_highlights: Trail running on varied forest and grassy routes
Beautiful views of Bakonycsernye and the surrounding area
Various distances, including a half marathon on strictly off-road terrain
additional: Toilets, washbasins and showers are available at the race center. Parking is available on the grassy area beside the football field. A technical T-shirt or singlet can also be ordered at registration for a fixed price of 4600 HUF. Places are limited: a total of 300 runners can enter the three longer distances, with a separate limit of 100 for the Fun Run. Registration for the race runs from March 12 to July 30, 2026. The race starts at 09:00 on August 1, 2026. Race packs can be collected at the venue or at the Cultural Center between 07:00 and 08:30. Detailed routes and schedules are available on the official website.

name: ORFŰI TÓ – SHOW FUTÁS
location: Orfűi tó és strand nagyparkoló, Orfű, Baranya, Hungary
description: The Orfű Lake Show Run is a traditional running race organized by the Melitta Recreation Sports Association, held around the large car park by Lake Orfű and the beach. During the race, participants must run once or twice around Lake Pécs on public roads, clockwise, not on the promenade. The event is family-friendly, and everyone takes part at their own risk. Both professionals and amateurs are welcome. The event is held with the support of Barta Textilház and offers valuable prizes to runners, not only based on their finishing times.
course_highlights: 6.2 km lap around Lake Pécs on public roads
12.4 km distance, running twice around Lake Pécs
The race takes place on public roads, not on the promenade
additional: Timing and an awards ceremony are provided only for the running races, and the top finishers receive trophies. Other prizes are awarded by drawing, giving every participant an equal chance. The event also offers family activities, and children can enjoy well-equipped playgrounds at the venue. Participants run at their own risk. The venue is around the large car park by Lake Orfű and the beach. The event takes place on August 3, 2024.

name: TATAI MINIMARATON ÉS FÉLMARATON - Tata, Váralja út 13,5-21km. eredmények
Bear Foot Poľana
price_range: € 1 - € 40 (podľa vlny registrácie a dostupnosti na mieste)
description: BEAR FOOT POĽANA 2026 is a mountain race in the wild and unique Poľana Mountains, the highest and best-preserved volcano in Central Europe. The race offers two main courses: 24 km with 1,300+ metres of cumulative ascent and 10 km with 600+ metres of ascent. The course passes through popular hiking destinations such as Bystrô Waterfall, the Celtic hillfort of Kaľamárka and the summit of Predná Poľana, while runners enjoy the beauty of deep forests, mountain streams and pastures. The race is part of the Slovak Skyrunning Association league and is limited to 150 runners per course.
course_highlights: 24 km course with 1,300+ m of cumulative ascent, passing Bystrô Waterfall and the Celtic hillfort of Kaľamárka
10 km course with 600+ m of ascent, starting and finishing at Horský hotel Poľana
The course combines hiking trails, forest roads and mountain meadows
additional: Race check-in is open from 7:30 to 9:30; late registration is not possible. Bells or small bells must be used throughout the entire course. There are three refreshment stations at 4.4 km, 10 km and 15 km. The entry fee includes refreshments during and after the race, a unique race bib, a participant pack and timing. The limit is 150 runners per course. The race includes a 24 km course with more than 1,300 m of ascent, is part of the Slovak Skyrunning League, has limited registration and takes place on 1 August 2026.

name: Porubska 11-ka
description: Porúbska 11-ka is a running race held in the village of Porúbka in Bardejov District. It features gently rolling, hilly to flat terrain at an elevation of 196 m. The course passes through the Carpathian region, offering a combination of flat sections and hills, ideal for runners looking for an enjoyable run surrounded by nature. The race is organized by the municipality of Porúbka and is part of local sporting activities with a tradition and a strong community spirit. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the region.
course_highlights: Gently rolling, hilly to flat terrain
Elevation: 196 m
The route passes through the Carpathian region
additional: The race takes place on August 1, 2026; registration is available via Google Forms; the routes run through the countryside around Porúbka; the event is supported by the local community and a passion for sport.

name: Island Gladiator Slovakia
description: Island Gladiator Slovakia is an OCR race that will test your strength, endurance and determination in Slovakia’s authentic natural environment. The course runs through meadows, forests, streams and hills, with various technical sections and obstacles such as walls, crawling, pulling, balancing and carrying weights. The race is open to men and women, beginners and experienced athletes, with a 3-hour time limit. Every participant receives an official T-shirt, a medal, a race pack and electronic timekeeping. Island Gladiator is not just a competition, but a challenge to overcome yourself and become a stronger gladiator.
course_highlights: The course runs through meadows, forests, streams and hills
Technical sections with obstacles such as walls, crawling, pulling, balancing and carrying weights
A 3-hour time limit to complete the course
additional: Every participant receives an official T-shirt, a unique medal, electronic timekeeping, a race pack with a surprise from the partners, refreshments and food at the finish or on the course. Failing to complete an obstacle means a penalty of 20 burpees or a penalty lap. Outside assistance is allowed only with the organizers’ consent. The race starts at 09:00 in timed waves. Registration is available through their website, and early-bird discounts are also available.

name: Mogoșa Everesting
organizer: Asociația Club Sportiv de Alergare Montană Maramureș
price_range: 140 Lei - 220 Lei, cu reduceri pentru copii și juniori

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Copii și juniori sub 18 ani 120 Lei

description: Mogoșa Everesting is a mountain running competition taking place on August 1, 2026, at Lake Mogoșa, Maramureș, Romania. Participants can compete individually or in teams, completing laps on the mountain course to reach a total elevation gain equivalent to an Everesting challenge. The event is organized by the Maramureș Mountain Running Sports Club Association and offers a challenging, community-oriented experience, with categories for juniors and teams. Entry fees are affordable, and registration is open until available places are filled.
course_highlights: Mountain course with Everesting-style elevation gain
Option to compete individually or in teams
Scenic location at Lake Mogoșa, Maramureș
additional: Participants can compete individually or in teams (minimum 5 members). Team rankings are determined by adding together the number of laps completed by all team members. Entry fees are non-refundable. Registration confirmation is emailed immediately after payment is processed. An official T-shirt and partnerships to support participants are available. Endurance cycling event, with a schedule on July 31 and August 1, 2026; entry fees, rules, and results are available on the website.

name: MOGOȘA EVERESTING
organizer: Asociația Club Sportiv de Alergare Montană Maramureș
description: Mogoșa Everesting is a mountain running competition taking place on August 1, 2026, in Mogoșa, Maramureș. Participants can compete individually or in teams, with team rankings based on the total number of laps completed by all members. The event is organized by the Maramureș Mountain Running Sports Club Association and offers an authentic mountain running experience focused on effort and team spirit. Entry fees are affordable, and there is a special category for children and juniors under 18.
course_highlights: Mountain running on a multi-lap course
Team rankings based on the total number of laps completed
Individual and team participation (minimum 5 members)
additional: Participants receive a race kit. After July 26, registration is subject to availability. Teams must have at least 5 members officially registered under the same team name. Registration confirmation is sent by email immediately after payment is processed. Entry fees are non-refundable. Participation includes a kit and official T-shirt. The event has multiple categories and takes place on mountainous terrain with repeated climbs; entry fees vary depending on the date.

name: LATERAL Mures 24H ~ 2026
description: Lateral Mures 24H is an endurance sports event organized by the Mureș Runners Association, held in the heart of nature on the Cornești Plateau in Târgu Mureș. The competition includes 24-hour MTB and trail running events, both individual and team, as well as a 12-hour running race and a one-lap 10.5 km race. The course is an approximately 10.5 km loop with 215 m of elevation gain, mostly through the forest, marked clearly during the day and with reflective signs at night. The event promotes team spirit, endurance, and a passion for outdoor activity.
course_highlights: 10.5 km trail course with 215 m of positive elevation gain
Mostly through the forest on the Cornești Plateau
Marked with visible tape during the day and reflective signs at night
additional: The event includes 24-hour individual MTB and trail running events, as well as four-member relay teams, an individual 12-hour run, and a one-lap 10.5 km race. The time limit for completing a lap is 2 hours for MTB and 3 hours for running. Participants can store their personal equipment in tents in the start/finish area. Rankings are based on the distance completed within the allotted time. The event features multiple categories and prizes for the top finishers, and takes place in the natural setting of the Cornești Plateau in Târgu Mureș.

name: Tura Licuricilor ~ 2026
description: The 11th edition of Tura Licuricilor is a running event held in Franz Joseph Park in Timișoara on August 1, 2026, starting at 20:30. The event is part of the Alergotura series, which promotes running as a lifestyle and supports the local sports community. Participants can enjoy a pleasant outdoor run in an urban natural setting, suitable for runners of all levels. The organizers provide support and motivation to encourage people to take up running and get involved in the community.
course_highlights: Route through Franz Joseph Park, Timișoara
Night event starting at 20:30
Friendly atmosphere and an active running community
additional: The event is part of the Alergotura series, which gives club members free access to Politehnica Timișoara’s running base and organizes team-building activities. No information was found about participation fees or online registration for this edition. The event also includes weekly runs and other sports activities in Timișoara, promoting health and social connections in the community.

name: Night Challenge Fruška Gora 2026
location: Restoran Na Vencu, Fruška Gora, Novi Sad, Serbia
description: The Night Challenge on Fruška Gora is a sports and recreational event for hikers, runners, and nature lovers. It takes place on three routes of different lengths: Fan Hiking (7 km), Hobby Trail (11 km), and Sport Trail (19 km). The start is at 9 p.m. by the Na Vencu restaurant, and participants have a limit of 4 hours and 15 minutes to complete the route, giving even the slowest runners enough time to finish. The event offers a unique opportunity to enjoy Fruška Gora at night.
course_highlights: Three routes: 7 km, 11 km, and 19 km
9 p.m. start by the Na Vencu restaurant
Time limit: 4 hours and 15 minutes
additional: The routes have a time limit of 4 hours and 15 minutes, allowing even the slowest participants to finish. The event is intended for hikers, runners, and lovers of nature and Fruška Gora. It features trails for different fitness levels, suitable for both hikers and runners. The event promotes an active, healthy lifestyle in nature.

name: 6. NIGHT CHALLENGE FRUŠKA GORA 2026
location: Spomenik Sloboda, Iriško venac, Fruška gora, Serbia
description: The 6th Night Challenge Fruška Gora 2026 is a night OCR race held in the unspoiled nature of Fruška Gora, starting at the Freedom Monument at Iriški Venac. Competitors can choose between two courses, 7 km and 13 km, which run through dense forest and natural obstacles, including unique water obstacles at Lake Ledinci. The race combines adrenaline-fueled obstacles with beautiful scenery and ends in an atmosphere of community and celebration at the end of the season. This event is part of the Invictus OCR League and is intended for everyone who wants to test their limits and enjoy sport and nature.
course_highlights: Courses through the dense forest of Fruška Gora
Water obstacles at Lake Ledinci
A night race requiring a headlamp, with an adrenaline-fueled journey through the dark
additional: The start and finish are at Iriški Venac, by the “Na Vencu” restaurant. A headlamp is mandatory for the night race. The competition is part of the Invictus OCR League, with scoring at three locations. Every competitor receives a medal at the finish. The race is adapted to different fitness levels. The event is part of a challenge combining obstacle races and trail races, offering a unique experience in the nature of Fruška Gora.

name: KERESZTÚRI ÖNTÚLSZÁRNYALÁS FESZTIVÁL
description: The Keresztúri Self-Transcendence Running Festival is a friendly, family-oriented race that combines being close to nature with the spirit of self-transcendence. The race takes place in Keresztúri Forest, near Budapest, and offers challenges over several distances, including 5.2 km, 10.5 km, half marathon, 31.6 km and marathon, as well as the special Yes, I can! event. The event is organised by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team, which has supported running enthusiasts since 1977. The aim is for every participant to experience camaraderie in sport and the joy of going beyond their limits.
course_highlights: A nature-filled running route in Keresztúri Forest
A forest nature trail and running loop, with short sections on roads
The Yes, I can! event consists of hourly starts, one lap at a time, with each lap covering 5,274 m
additional: On-site registration is available on race day between 6:30 and 7:30. The entry fee does not include a T-shirt, but a commemorative technical T-shirt can be ordered in advance. The Yes, I can! event consists of 6 laps, with one lap starting every hour; the lap starting at 13:00 is devoted to self-transcendence. Participants support one another in completing the race; starting late results in disqualification. Several distances are available, and on-site registration is also possible. Detailed information about fees and T-shirts is available on the organiser’s website.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 8. kolo
description: The Bratislava 2 Mile Run is a regular running race organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team at the Kuchajda swimming pool complex in Bratislava. The race covers 2 miles (3.218 km), with categories for children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. Registration takes place on site from 9:30, and the race starts at 10:00. The event is part of a race series in which runners earn points toward a perpetual trophy based on their performances and participation in individual rounds.
course_highlights: A 2-mile (3.218 km) course
Registration and start by the volleyball court at the Kuchajda complex
Categories for children, juniors, women, men, and veterans
additional: Registration takes place on site by the volleyball court from 9:30. The competition is for the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team Perpetual Trophy, with points awarded based on performances and participation. In the event of a tie on points, the best time decides, followed by shoe size. Children have a separate category with a shorter course of approximately 200 m. The race takes place on a public road in Kuchajda; registration is also available on site, and the start is scheduled for 10:00. The event also includes a children’s category with shorter distances.

name: Malý Kavečianský maratón
organizer: TJ Mladosť Kavečany a MÚ MČ Košice - Kavečany
price_range: 21 km: 15,- € online, 20,- € na mieste; 7 km: 12,- € online, 17,- € na mieste; zadarmo pre ženy nad 60 rokov a mužov nad 70 rokov
description: The Malý Kavečianský Marathon is a running event in Kavečany near Košice, offering 21 km and 7 km routes, as well as children’s races. The race starts at the football stadium and is open to a wide range of categories, from children to veterans. It is organized by TJ Mladosť Kavečany together with the Košice-Kavečany Municipal District. The event is suitable for runners of different ages and ability levels, with affordable entry fees and online registration available.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the football stadium in Kavečany
21 km and 7 km routes suitable for different age groups
Children’s races start at 9:10
additional: Women over 60 and men over 70 can enter for free. Categories include children’s, pupils’, youth, overall, and age-group categories for men and women. Children’s races start at 9:10. The route includes town streets and the football stadium; online registration is open until 1.8.2025; all categories start at 9:00.

name: JAZZFŐVÁROS-FUTÁS
description: The Jazz Capital Run takes place in Kecskemét at the Benkó Zoltán Leisure Centre, offering a running experience as a sporting complement to the jazz festival. Traditionally, the event puts the joy of running and the sense of community first, and is open to all ages and types of runners. It is not only a sporting event but also strengthens the local community, while participants can enjoy exercising in beautiful surroundings and fresh air. The organisers also value charity, so the run is an opportunity to support a cause.
course_highlights: The run takes place beneath beautiful trees in a pleasant natural setting
The race is a sporting companion event to the jazz festival
The run is also a community and charity event
additional: The event is open to everyone, and community activities and charity initiatives accompany the run. Runners can enjoy exercising in pleasant natural surroundings and fresh air. Participants can choose from several distances and register online or on site. Participants receive a T-shirt bearing the event logo, as well as a snack and mineral water at the finish. Festival programmes are free for runners.

name: Východniarska

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Poplatok za štart jedného účastníka je 70 EUR

description: Východniarska is a mountain ultra trail and long-distance hike for individuals, following on from the popular Východniarska Stovka. The route runs through the eastern part of the Slovak Ore Mountains, mostly across the Volovské Mountains, and offers a challenging 85 km run with +4200 m of elevation gain. The start is in Kluknava and the finish in Kysak, with a 22-hour time limit. The event is open to the public for participants aged 18 and over, and requires registration and payment of the entry fee.
course_highlights: 85 km route with +4200 m of elevation gain
Crossing the Volovské Mountains in the Slovak Ore Mountains
Checkpoints and aid stations along the route, with time limits
additional: Race-pack collection is on Thursday in Košice from 16:00 to 20:00, and on Friday, 7 August 2026, from 18:00 to 23:00 at Kaštieľ hotela Biela dáma Čierny rytier. Before the start, participants can sleep in the gym at the Primary School in Kluknava; bring your own sleeping mat and sleeping bag. A drop bag can be sent to the aid station at Vyšný Klátov (56 km). Drop bags must be handed in on race morning by 8:30 at the gym of the Primary School in Kluknava. Kluknava is accessible by train and bus; arriving by train in Margecany and taking a bus from there to Kluknava is recommended. The course is 85 km long, with a 22-hour time limit. Mandatory equipment includes a thermal blanket, GPS device and personal cup, among other items. Drop bags can be sent to the 56 km point. The start is in Kluknava and the finish in Kysak. Participants can sleep in the gym, and travel to Kluknava is possible by train or bus.

name: Hámorská dvadsiatka
location: Obecný úrad Remetské Hámre, Remetské Hámre, Slovakia
description: Hámorská dvadsiatka is a traditional running race organized by the municipality of Remetské Hámre. Despite the cancellation of the last two editions due to the Covid-19 pandemic, the organizers are looking forward to bringing the event back and welcoming a large turnout of runners. The race takes place in the beautiful natural surroundings of the Vihorlat Mountains, which offer attractive routes for sports enthusiasts.
course_highlights: The route passes through the natural surroundings of the Vihorlat Mountains
Beautiful views and tourist attractions in the area
Organized by the municipality of Remetské Hámre, with a long-standing tradition

name: Rajecký maratón
location: Námestie SNP, Rajec, Žilina District, Slovakia
description: The Rajec Marathon is a traditional running race organized by the Rajec Marathon Club, held in the picturesque surroundings of Rajec and the surrounding area. Runners can expect a challenging course with elevation gain and beautiful natural scenery that will test their endurance and fitness. The event has a friendly, family-oriented atmosphere, reflected in its side events and the hospitality at the finish. In addition to the marathon, a half marathon, relay, cross duathlon, and the popular Rajec Borošovec are also held. The Borošovec is a cross-country classic with more than 200 meters of elevation gain.
course_highlights: A course with more than 200 meters of elevation gain
The Rajec Borošovec cross-country classic, 14.1 km long
Natural scenery in Rajec and the surrounding area
additional: The Rajec Borošovec is part of the events that kick off the running season in the Rajec Valley. After the races, participants are served goulash and homemade cakes. The Rajec Borošovec course is dry and fast, with possible obstacles such as fallen trees. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere and also attracts younger runners and juniors.

name: Rajecký In-line polmaratón
description: The Rajecký In-line Half Marathon is a competitive inline skating race held in Rajec at SNP Square. The course runs from Rajec to the village of Čičmany and back, with the finish at the marathon turnaround point in Čičmany. Skaters must wear a helmet throughout the race and return their rented timing chips at the finish. The organizer provides refreshments, changing rooms and showers, as well as free transport back to Rajec for inline skaters. The final finish straight is reserved for runners, so participants must follow the organizer’s rules.
course_highlights: The course runs from Rajec to Čičmany and back
The race is held in the right-hand lane
The final finish straight on the square in Rajec is reserved for runners
additional: Skaters must wear a helmet during the race and attach their race number to their right thigh. Rented timing chips must be returned at the finish. Refreshments (sandwiches) are provided at the square in Rajec upon presentation of the race number. Changing rooms and showers are in the gym on Lipová Street. A minibus for transporting personal belongings will be at the start area from 8:00 to 8:30. Inline skaters must take the free bus back from Čičmany to Rajec and must not enter the start and finish area designated for runners, or they risk disqualification. The race is limited to 120 participants; registration depends on the payment date and includes different fees depending on the registration period.

name: Rajecká štafeta
description: The Rajecká Relay is a running event organized by Maratón klub Rajec and held at SNP Square in Rajec. It is a relay race that forms part of the Rajecký Marathon and gives athletes the opportunity to compete in teams. The organizer provides bib numbers, timekeeping, and full support for participants during the race. The event is suitable for runners of different ability levels and promotes community spirit and enthusiasm for sport in the region.
course_highlights: Relay categories for men, women, and mixed teams
Held at SNP Square in Rajec, in the scenic surroundings of Žilina
Registration is subject to a fee, with prices ranging from 90 to 120 euros depending on the registration date
additional: The organizer processes participants’ personal data in accordance with the GDPR and personal data protection legislation. Registration takes place online via the organizer’s website. Participants receive their bib numbers at check-in, and their results are published on the official websites and sports portals. Relay race; registration fees increase closer to the event date; terrain details not specified.

name: Rajecký detský beh
location: Námestie SNP, Rajec, Žilina District, Slovakia
description: The Rajecký Children’s Run is a running event organized by Maratón klub Rajec, held at SNP Square in Rajec. It is aimed at children and underage runners, with an emphasis on safety and responsibility: a parent or legal guardian must sign for them to participate. The event is part of a wider running program in Rajec and gives young runners the opportunity to experience the atmosphere of a race in a pleasant urban setting.
course_highlights: The race takes place at SNP Square in Rajec
For children and underage runners
Safety is supported by a parent or legal guardian’s signature
additional: Children and underage participants must bring a signed declaration from a parent or legal guardian. Participation will not be permitted without it.

name: Retezat Mountain Run
description: Retezat Mountain Run is a mountain running competition held in the Râușor area of Hunedoara, offering four races of varying difficulty and distance, from the Easy Run to the Marathon. The routes cross the wild and hard-to-reach landscapes of Retezat National Park, with aid stations in spectacular natural settings, including Bucura glacial lake. The event is organized by a non-profit association dedicated to mountain conservation and involves a team of volunteers and professionals to ensure safety and the smooth running of the race. Participants enjoy an authentic mountain running experience, with cash and in-kind prizes, as well as a friendly, festive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Mountain routes with significant elevation gain, up to 3340 m D+ for the marathon
Aid stations in remote areas accessible only on foot or by air
The route passes by Bucura glacial lake, the largest glacial lake in Romania
additional: Registration and race-kit distribution take place on Friday between 15:00-23:00 and Saturday between 6:00-9:00 at Apres Ski, at the base of the ski slope. There is a technical briefing and a Pasta Party before the race. Mandatory equipment includes mountain running shoes and a windstopper/rain jacket. The routes are marked and monitored by volunteers, and runners must manage their own nutrition and hydration between aid stations. It is recommended that participants leave their cars in the car park at the end of the paved road; the competition area is a 10-minute walk away. Various distances, extensive logistical support, online registration available, an event with a long tradition and recognition in the mountain community.

name: ALERG ÎN DUMBRAVĂ
description: Alerg în Dumbravă is a social, sporting and charitable event that promotes outdoor running and a healthy lifestyle. It takes place in Homu Forest, north of the village of Glogoveanu, Dâmbovița County. The event includes marathon, half-marathon and cross-country races dedicated to the memory of local figures, offering an experience immersed in nature on accessible trails and dirt roads. Recreational activities such as Latin dancing and a campfire add to the atmosphere, creating a warm and welcoming community. Now in its seventh edition, the long-running event also supports an important social cause by helping Mia’s Children Association.
course_highlights: Easy trails and dirt roads through Homu Forest
Varied scenery, from old-growth forest to colorful agricultural fields
No asphalt or concrete, making the routes ideal for natural running
additional: The event includes children’s races “In Memoriam” Professor Liviu Marinescu, Latin dancing and a campfire (weather permitting). Participants must send proof of payment of the entry fee by email or WhatsApp. The fee can also be paid by bank transfer or Revolut. The routes are accessible, with no major difficulties and no asphalt or concrete. The event is dedicated to the memory of local figures and supports Mia’s Children Association. Routes include a half-marathon (21 km), cross-country race (10 km) and children’s races (4.2 km), with staggered starts and social and cultural activities.

name: Retezat Mountain Run ~ 2026
location: Rausor, Retezat Mountains, Hunedoara County, Romania
description: Retezat Mountain Run is a mountain running competition held in the Retezat Mountains, with courses climbing to the summit of Mount Retezat. The event offers four races of varying difficulty and distance, from the 8.5 km Easy Run to the nearly 40 km Marathon, with over 3,300 m of elevation gain. The courses cross wild landscapes, with aid stations in hard-to-reach areas, and the event is organized with the help of dedicated volunteers and mountain authorities. The event continues the tradition of Retezat Marathon, with a new team and a long-term continuity plan.
course_highlights: Mountain courses with significant elevation gain, up to 3,340 m D+ for the marathon
Aid stations in wild areas accessible only on foot or by air
The marathon course passes by Bucura glacial lake, the largest in the country
additional: Registration and race-kit distribution take place Friday from 15:00 to 23:00 and Saturday from 6:00 to 9:00 at Apres Ski, at the base of the Râușor ski slope. A technical briefing and a Pasta Party are held before the race. Mandatory equipment includes trail-running shoes and a windproof/rain jacket. The courses are marked and monitored, and runners must manage their own nutrition and hydration between aid stations. It is recommended to leave your car in the parking area at the end of the paved road, a 10-minute walk from the start. Courses have significant elevation gain and difficult mountain terrain, with limited support in some areas; mountain weather conditions should be taken into account.

name: SZUFLA FUTÓFESZTIVÁL
description: The SZUFLA Running Festival is a traditional community running event organized by the Enthusiastic Team of Szigethalom Ultrarunners every second weekend in August. The 2026 event, the 20th anniversary festival, will take place in Tököl Park Forest and features a variety of distances, including an ultramarathon, relay, half marathon, shorter races, and hiking. The event has a welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere, with plenty of activities for children as well as runners. Its aim is to promote sport and support the local community, with particular emphasis on helping people with disabilities.
course_highlights: A 6.178 km loop course in Tököl Park Forest, with 30 m of elevation gain
A 52 km relay race for teams of 2–4 runners
Aid stations every 3 km with a generous selection of refreshments
additional: The event uses chip timing. The chip deposit is 2,000 HUF, refundable at the finish or available to donate to charity. Starts are staggered, and on-site registration opens at 7:00 on race day. Activities for children include face painting, glitter tattoos, a creative corner, and a bouncy castle. The event closes at 15:00, which is also the time limit. Aid stations are located every 3 km and offer a generous selection of refreshments. Online and on-site registration are available. Events include ultrarunning, a half marathon, and shorter distances. The festival puts community and a love of sport at its heart.

location: Lókút Sportközpont, Bem utca, Lókút, Hungary
