name: Beh na Kráľovu studňu
location: Motorest Javorina Lenartov, Lenartov, Bardejov, Slovakia
description: The Run to Kráľova studňa is a traditional uphill race held in the picturesque village of Lenartov, near the historic Kráľova studňa, a meeting place of three kings. The course passes through beautiful natural surroundings and offers a unique mountain-running experience, rich in history and views. The event is part of the local running league and attracts runners from across the region. The organizers create a friendly atmosphere and welcome all participants, regardless of ability.
course_highlights: An uphill race in mountainous terrain around Kráľova studňa
A historic meeting place of the Hungarian and Polish kings
Beautiful views and natural scenery around Lenartov
additional: The race is part of the East Slovak Uphill Running League. The event has a long tradition: the 14th edition was held in 2025 and the 13th in 2024. The atmosphere is friendly, and all runners are welcome, including the oldest participants. Refreshments and a cultural program are provided nearby after the race. The course includes asphalt, forest and mountain sections; registration is available online or on site. The event is part of the 2025 Easterners’ Uphill Running League.

name: Maratonul Nordului Teioasa Trail
description: The Maratonul Nordului Teioasa Trail is a trail running race held in northern Romania, offering participants an authentic experience amid spectacular scenery. The event promotes health, community, and adventure, bringing passionate runners together in a remarkable natural setting. The courses are designed to showcase the beauty of the area and the spirit of northern Romania.
course_highlights: Spectacular courses through northern Romania
Running amid nature and authentic scenery
An event bringing together nature and community spirit
additional: Online registration is open until 1 August 2026. Those whose registrations are confirmed by 20 June are guaranteed the official race T-shirt in their race kit. The organizer will decide whether race-day registration will be permitted and will announce this in advance. Trail running, spectacular courses, outdoor event scheduled for 9 August 2026

name: Ultra Race Romania

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Avans de 500€ urmat de 5 rate lunare de 475€ fiecare

description: Ultra Race Romania is a unique long-distance running race covering 250 km over 6 stages, in a self-sufficient format, exploring the unspoiled wilderness, culture, and history of the Siriu area in Buzău. Participants will tackle a challenging route in the Carpathian Mountains, with legendary landscapes and places steeped in local stories and mysteries. After finishing the race, runners are invited to stay for two days to discover Romania’s traditions, cuisine, and famous tourist attractions, such as Peleș Castle and Bran Castle. The event emphasizes the experience of a lifetime, lasting friendships, and the joy of being part of this extraordinary adventure.
course_highlights: A 250 km route split into 6 stages in the Carpathian Mountains
Legendary places such as Lake Vulturilor and Cașoca Waterfall
Wild landscapes and local mysteries in the Buzău area
additional: The race is self-sufficient, with tent accommodation during the 6 stages. Medical assistance, water at checkpoints and camps, hot meals, bus transportation before and after the race, finisher medals, and T-shirts are provided. After the race, a 2-day cultural tour of Brașov, Bran, and Sinaia is organized, with hotel accommodation and meals included. SPOT satellite live tracking is available for competitors. Participants must be prepared for wilderness conditions, with mandatory equipment and strict safety rules; the event also includes a cultural excursion after the race.

name: Oltenia Forest Run
description: Oltenia Forest Run is a running and orienteering competition held in the wooded area of Băile Govora, for running and orienteering enthusiasts of all ages. The running course is marked and suited to participants in good enough health to undertake physical exertion. The event promotes respect for the environment and participant safety, and provides a race kit with a race bib and a gift. It combines sport and nature and is suitable for children, young people, adults, and veterans.
course_highlights: Marked running course through wooded areas
Orienteering section for all age categories
Compliance with environmental protection and safety rules
additional: The race kit contains a race bib to be worn visibly and a gift. Registration is available online via a form or on site, subject to availability. Participants must follow environmental protection rules during the race. Trail running and orienteering in forest terrain; online or on-site registration (limited places); event in August 2026, with prizes and certificates for participants.

name: Chminianskonovovesský beh
location: Futbalové ihrisko OŠK Chminianska Nová Ves, Chminianska Nová Ves, Prešov, Slovakia
organizer: ThLic. Mgr. Pavol Uličný a obec Chminianska Nova Ves
description: The Chminianska Nová Ves Run is a traditional running race organized by the municipality of Chminianska Nová Ves and ThLic. Mgr. Pavol Uličný. The race takes place at the OŠK Chminianska Nová Ves football field in the Prešov District and offers categories for men, women, and youth across different age groups. It is a community sporting event that promotes an active lifestyle and enthusiasm for sport in the region.
course_highlights: The race takes place at the OŠK Chminianska Nová Ves football field
Categories for men, women, and youth, grouped by age
Organized by the municipality of Chminianska Nová Ves and Pavol Uličný
additional: The race takes place on August 15, 2026, with the start at 18:00. Registration is on site. Refreshments and food will be provided after the race.

name: Runica Nevoľné
location: Futbalové ihrisko, Nevoľné, Žiar nad Hronom, Slovakia
organizer: Marathon Banska Bystrica, s.r.o., ON-POINT o.z.
description: Runica Nevoľné is a running event held at the football pitch in Nevoľné, Žiar nad Hronom District. The race offers a unique experience in the heart of Slovakia, where runners can enjoy a pleasant atmosphere and high-quality organization. The course is suitable for runners of different levels, and the event is part of the Marathon Tour running series. The organizers welcome all runners who want to enjoy a sporting experience in a beautiful setting.
course_highlights: The course runs around the football pitch in Nevoľné
Pleasant surroundings in Žiar nad Hronom District
Part of the Marathon Tour running series
additional: Registration is available online and in person. The event takes place at the football pitch in Nevoľné and also includes a mountain trail and a children's run.

name: Štafetový beh 345 km od Tatier k Dunaju Jasná – Bratislava
location: Demänovská dolina, Jasná, Liptovský Mikuláš, Žilina, Slovakia
description: The Tatras to the Danube Relay is the largest relay race in Slovakia, with a course length of 345 km. Teams of 6 or 9 to 12 members start in Jasná in the Low Tatras and run nonstop through day and night, finishing on the Danube embankment in Bratislava. The course is predominantly paved, with approximately 3,990 metres of elevation gain and 4,870 metres of descent. Runners complete 36 stages of varying length and difficulty; in a 12-member team, each runner completes three stages. The race challenges team spirit and endurance amid Slovakia’s beautiful scenery.
course_highlights: Course length: 346 km, with approximately +3,990 m of elevation gain and -4,870 m of descent
95% of the course is paved, on class II and III roads
36 stages, 7 to 12 km long, with varying levels of difficulty
additional: Teams may have 6 or 9 to 12 members. In a 12-member team, each runner completes 3 stages, with 8–10 hours between stages, covering approximately 30 km in total over two days. The organizer provides detailed stage information, including maps, elevation profiles and written descriptions for runners and support vehicles. The team captain registers as a user and represents the entire team. The race runs nonstop, day and night. The course is 345 km, starts in Demänovská Valley, is a nonstop team relay, and takes place in August 2026. Registration is divided by category and deadline, with different fees.

name: SÁRKÁNYFUTÁS
organizer: Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület
description: The Dragon Run is an exciting running race organized by the Tata Mass Sports and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Association. It is a trail running event on a varied and challenging route that combines being close to nature with the thrill of sport. The event has a friendly atmosphere, is open to all age groups, and fosters a sense of community among runners. The race takes place in Súr, Hungary, and the organizers place great emphasis on smooth event management and participant satisfaction.
course_highlights: Trail running on a varied route close to nature
Challenging sections and varied terrain
A friendly race with a strong community atmosphere
additional: The race is part of the county running race series, with trail running and trail categories over various distances.

name: Jazerný maratón
description: The Jazerný Marathon is a running challenge held in Košice, in the Nad Jazerom neighbourhood, offering distances from 5 to 42 km. The race follows a 2.5 km stretch along the Hornád River embankment, with a high-quality asphalt surface and minimal elevation gain, making it suitable for runners of all levels. The event has a 15-year history and is ideal for anyone looking for a fast and enjoyable run in nature close to the city. The organisers welcome all runners who want to test themselves over different distances.
course_highlights: A 2.5 km loop along the Hornád embankment
High-quality asphalt surface
Minimal elevation gain, ideal for a fast run
additional: Choose a distance from 5 km up to the full marathon distance of 42 km. The course runs along the embankment with minimal elevation gain, allowing for a fast and comfortable run. The event takes place on 16 August 2026. Online registration is available, and the race is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners.

name: Cestou Grófa Júliusa Andrássyho
description: The Run Along the Route of Count Julius Andrássy takes place in Trebišov near the Municipal Cultural Centre and offers various categories, including running, a summer walk, cycling, Nordic walking, and a virtual race. The start is scheduled for August 21, 2026, at 16:15 for children and 16:25 for the main category. The event is suitable for all ages, including children up to 7 years old and older children up to 13 years old. The organizer is Ing. Michal Majcher, who ensures a pleasant atmosphere and well-organized races.
course_highlights: Start and finish near the Municipal Cultural Centre in Trebišov
Several categories, including running, walking, cycling, and Nordic walking
A virtual race as a new option for participants unable to attend in person
additional: The entry fee is paid on site. Categories include children up to 7 years old, children aged 8–13, the main category, a summer walk, cycling, Nordic walking, and a virtual race, with the option to purchase a medal. The event includes several categories, including children’s and virtual races. Registration is available on site, and the course is located around the cultural centre in Trebišov.

name: GLS NIGHT CROS CHALLENGE Start la muzeul în aer liber din Dumbrava Sibiului
description: GLS Night Cross Challenge is a night running race with a 10-year tradition in Sibiu, held in Dumbrava Sibiului. The event offers a unique running experience on specially prepared outdoor trails surrounded by nature, promoting a healthy and active lifestyle. Participants can enjoy a friendly yet challenging atmosphere, ideal for amateurs and athletes of all levels. The organizers emphasize pushing personal limits and the joy of running as a community.
course_highlights: Night course in Dumbrava Sibiului, outdoors
Running on natural terrain with forest scenery
Event with a 10-year tradition in Sibiu
additional: Marked and illuminated course, races for children, prizes and medals for participants

name: GLS Night Cross Challenge ~ 2026
location: Muzeul în aer liber din Dumbrava Sibiului, Sibiu, Romania
description: Night Cross Challenge powered by GLS is the most beautiful night cross-country race in Romania, reaching its 12th edition in 2026. The event takes place at the Dumbrava Sibiului Open-Air Museum, offering participants a unique running experience on marked courses after dark. Adult races are available over 4.5 km and 9 km, as well as children’s races over 500 m, 1,000 m and 1,300 m. The competition is open to all age categories from 5 to 75 years, with prizes for the open category winners in the 9 km race.
course_highlights: Fully marked night course at the Dumbrava Sibiului Open-Air Museum
Adult race distances: 4.5 km and 9 km; children’s distances: 500 m, 1,000 m and 1,300 m
The races start after dusk, with the children’s races beginning at 20:00
additional: The maximum number of participants is limited: 150 in the children’s races, 300 in the 4.5 km race and 300 in the 9 km race. Race kits are handed out after signing a declaration of personal responsibility, which will be sent by email and must be brought signed when collecting the kit. Prizes are awarded for first, second and third place across the 22 men’s and women’s categories. The event includes outdoor trail races and prizes for the top performers, and takes place at locations such as the Open-Air Museum, the Zoo and Astra Museum. Registration is online, and the event promises an experience full of energy and fun.

description: Keszthely Kilometers is a traditional running race on the shores of Lake Balaton, taking place on August 22–23, 2026, in the rear park of Festetics Palace. Participants can choose from several distances, from 3 km to the half marathon, and compete individually or in a relay. There are also children’s races for the youngest runners, with different distances for each age group. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, and its lakeside setting offers runners a special experience.
course_highlights: Held on the shores of Lake Balaton, in the rear park of Festetics Palace
Distances from 3 km to the half marathon, with individual and relay events
Children’s races by age group in a family-friendly program
additional: The race office is on site by Lake Balaton, at the pier, where runners can collect their race numbers and register on the day. A separate registration desk is available for the children’s races. Runners are advised to arrive early because of traffic restrictions and parking difficulties. The children’s races cover different distances by age group, and the youngest participants may run accompanied by a parent. The awards ceremony takes place after the races. Multiple distances, children’s and adult races, relay races, on-site registration, parking and traffic restrictions, start times subject to weather

name: Rusínska 100 a 66
description: Rusínska 100 and 66 is a late-summer ultrarun and long-distance hike starting and finishing in the town of Stropkov. The routes run through the Ondavská Highlands in Zemplín County and continue into Šariš County via the town of Svidník, crossing the region of Rusyn villages and following the border with Poland. The R100 route partly passes through the Eastern Carpathians Protected Landscape Area. The event is part of the Slovak Ultratrail League, is ITRA-certified, and is included in the ITRA National League. It is organised by o.z. Klub bežcov Stropkov, which provides warm hospitality and high-quality organisation.
course_highlights: Routes run through the Ondavská Highlands and the northern part of the Low Beskids
Passage through the Eastern Carpathians Protected Landscape Area
A region with historic religious buildings, lookout towers and cultural monuments
additional: The event takes place on 23–24 August 2025. Rusínska 100 and 66 are part of the 11th edition of the Slovak Ultratrail League. The routes are intended for ultrarunners and long-distance hikers and pass through challenging terrain rich in history and natural beauty. The organisers and volunteers provide warm hospitality and quality support for participants. The routes run mainly along forest and trail paths, with several sections of asphalt; registration is open from 1 May to 20 September 2025; the event highlights the region’s natural beauty and historic landmarks.

description: The Modrý Kameň Castle Chestnut Run is a running event held in the park in front of the entrance to Modrý Kameň Castle. The race offers various categories, including a 5 km fun run for children and juniors, a 10 km main race for adults, and 5 km Nordic walking. The course follows asphalt, meadows, forest trails and field roads, providing a varied and enjoyable running experience. The event is organized by the Town of Modrý Kameň in cooperation with the Bežci VK civic association. The children’s start is at 10:00, and the adults’ start is at 11:00.
course_highlights: The course follows asphalt, meadows, forest trails and field roads
The event takes place in the park in front of the entrance to Modrý Kameň Castle
Various categories, including fun runs, junior races and Nordic walking
additional: A 50% discount on the entry fee is available for participants aged 60 and over. On-site registration is available at least 30 minutes before the start of the main race and Nordic walking, with an additional €17 entry fee. The course includes asphalt, meadows, forest trails and field roads; categories are available for children, recreational runners and competitive runners; starts are at 10:00 and 11:00.

description: The Čachtice Half Marathon is a traditional half-marathon race taking place on 22 August 2026 in the village of Čachtice. The course runs mainly on asphalt along the streets of Čachtice to Višňové and Hrachovište, with a short section on a forest road. The course is gently undulating, with a maximum elevation gain of up to 90 metres. The start is in the square in Čachtice, and the finish is in the grounds of Čachtice Primary School. Refreshment stations are provided at several points along the course.
course_highlights: Asphalt surface with a short section on a forest road
Gently undulating course with a maximum elevation gain of up to 90 m
Refreshments at 6 km, 10.5 km, 12 km, 15 km and at the finish
additional: The maximum number of half-marathon runners is 250; the relay is limited to 10 teams. The relay is a separate category for teams of 3–4 runners. Race-day registration takes place from 06:30 to 08:30 in the grounds of Čachtice Primary School. Cash prizes are awarded for 1st–3rd place in the categories, and a raffle is held based on race numbers. Online registration is available until 20 August 2025. The maximum number of participants is 250, and the race has several checkpoints with refreshments.

name: Forbaský beh pomoci
location: areál Ščava, Forbasy, okres Stará Ľubovňa, Slovakia
description: The Forbasy Charity Run is a charitable running race held at the Ščava grounds in Forbasy, Stará Ľubovňa District. This event has a voluntary entry fee and supports helping others and solidarity. Runners can enjoy a pleasant atmosphere while contributing to a good cause. The organizer is Valer Kuffa, who is available to provide information and support to participants.
course_highlights: The race takes place at the Ščava grounds in Forbasy
Charity run with a voluntary entry fee
Pleasant atmosphere and support for a good cause
additional: The entry fee is a voluntary contribution; details at https://www.behpomoci.sk/fbp-2025/dobrovo%C4%BEn%C3%BD-pr%C3%ADspevok. Organizer: Valer Kuffa, tel.: +421 949 765 543. Race categories for different age groups; registration via voluntary donation.

description: Lukačovská 5 is a running race held at the football pitch in Lukačovce, Humenné District. The event features a 5 km main race and children’s races, with categories for men and women, as well as a non-competitive Nordic Walking category. The organizer is the Municipality of Lukačovce, which provides a welcoming atmosphere and high-quality race organization. The children’s races start at 10:00, and the main race starts at 11:00.
course_highlights: A 5 km race in the pleasant surroundings of the football pitch in Lukačovce
Categories for men and women, plus a non-competitive Nordic Walking category
Main race limited to 80 participants
additional: The children’s races start at 10:00 and the main race at 11:00. The main race is limited to 80 participants. The organizer is the Municipality of Lukačovce, represented by Ing. Martin Sabol, Mayor. Contacts: Ing. Martin Sabol (Race Director, tel.: 0948 922 600) and Adrián Turik (tel.: 0948 228 212). The event also includes children’s categories. Registration is available online or on site, and the surface is probably flat, suitable for runners of all levels.

name: Harhovská desiatka
price_range: 10 € za hlavnú trať, 5 € za 3,5 km pretek
description: Harhovská desiatka is a running event in Spišský Hrhov, offering a 10 km course and a shorter 3.5 km course for recreational and beginner runners. The race is divided into several age categories for men and women, including a special category for residents of the municipality of Spišský Hrhov. The event is organized by the municipality of Spišský Hrhov, and the start is in front of the Municipal Office. The entry fee is paid at registration and is €10 for the 10 km course and €5 for the 3.5 km course.
course_highlights: 10 km course for advanced runners
3.5 km course for recreational and beginner runners
Start in front of the Municipal Office in Spišský Hrhov
additional: The entry fee is paid at registration on race day. Categories are divided by age and gender, including a category for residents of Spišský Hrhov. The 10 km course is certified by the Slovak Athletic Federation. The race takes place in summer, and registration is available online and on site.

name: Brezovský letný beh
location: Športové ihrisko, Rimavské Brezovo, Bardejov, Slovakia
description: Brezov Health Run is a traditional running race in the village of Brezov, Bardejov District, offering a route along paved roads, dirt roads and forest roads. The race is open to men and women, including youth aged up to 15 and over 15. The organizers have prepared two registration categories with a large and a small package, allowing participants to take part in this sporting event in pleasant surroundings by the Municipal Office in Brezov. The race is suitable for runners of various age groups and ability levels.
course_highlights: Course surface: paved road, dirt road, forest road
Start location: by the Municipal Office in Brezov
Categories: men/women, youth aged up to 15 and over 15
additional: The course includes paved, rural and forest roads; the race is open to men, women and youth; registration is subject to a fee

name: Behaj lesmi Čičmany
price_range: €17 - €24 per race, discounts for multiple registrations
description: Behaj lesmi Čičmany is a running race set in the picturesque Slovak folk village of Čičmany. The course winds through the Strážov Mountains, with beautiful scenery, untouched forests, and expansive meadows. The race is part of the Behaj lesmi series and is included in the UTMB Index Races, giving it international recognition and ranking. Choose from several distances, including the 20 km long course with 718 m of elevation gain, the 11 km Lesnícka course with 380 m of elevation gain, and a short 5 km course. The race also features a special Conti Speed Section, where the fastest runners can win valuable prizes.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Strážov Mountains, with up to 718 m of elevation gain on the 20 km distance
The race takes place in the authentic Slovak folk village of Čičmany, known for its painted wooden houses
The course includes a 150-metre Conti Speed Section, with prizes for the fastest runners
additional: Participants can transfer their registration and change their entry fee online through their SportID profile. The course features a Conti Speed Section with prizes for the fastest runners. The race is included in the UTMB Index Races, allowing participants to earn points toward the international trail-running rankings. The race is included in the UTMB Index, GPX files are available to download, categories are offered for different age groups, and registration is online.

name: 2X2 Race
price_range: 500,00 lei (X1 Race), 250,00 lei (X2 Race), 350,00 lei (2X2 Race)
description: 2X2 Race is an extremely technical and challenging mountain ultramarathon, held entirely above 2,000 m in the Făgăraș Mountains, Romania. The main 45 km course with 4,200 m of positive elevation gain passes over Romania’s two highest peaks, Moldoveanu and Negoiu. Two other races, X1 Race (26 km, 2,400 m D+) and X2 Race (18 km, 1,900 m D+), are also highly technical and intense, intended for runners with mountain experience. Participation is limited and subject to experience requirements to ensure competitors’ safety given the high physical and mental demands.
course_highlights: Entire course above 2,000 m in the Făgăraș Mountains
Passes over Moldoveanu (2,544 m) and Negoiu (2,535 m)
Significant elevation gain: 4,200 m D+ for 2X2 Race, 2,400 m D+ for X1 Race, and 1,900 m D+ for X2 Race
additional: Race kits can be collected at Cabana Salvamont Bâlea Lac on August 23 between 18:00 and 22:00, with collection on Saturday morning possible in exceptional circumstances. Participants must present their ID card and complete a declaration of responsibility. Race entries cannot be transferred, but the kit may be collected by another designated person. Limited number of competitors: 200 for each race. The race follows the principle of total self-sufficiency, with no aid stations provided along the course (except for the aid stations for 2X2 Race). Trail ultramarathon, registration at Cabana Salvamont Bâlea Lac, kit collection on August 23, technical high-altitude mountain terrain

name: Via Transilvanica Maraton
description: Via Transilvanica Marathon 2026 is a sporting event celebrating Romania’s unique nature and heritage, held along the Via Transilvanica route. The marathon offers a 39.3 km challenge with 1,292 m of elevation gain, crossing forest roads, villages, and panoramic landscapes. Participants can enjoy a friendly atmosphere, well-organized checkpoints and hydration stations, as well as activities for children. The event is organized by the Țășuleasa Social Association, which promotes volunteering and respect for nature.
course_highlights: 39.3 km route with 1,292 m of elevation gain
Checkpoints and hydration stations with water and snacks every 5–10 km
Panoramic landscapes and passages through the villages of Ciosa and Lunca Ilvei
additional: The 2026 edition T-shirt can be purchased as an add-on during registration. The event also includes races for children, with a special 1 km race supported by volunteers and entertainers. The marathon has 5 checkpoints and hydration stations, and visiting all of them is mandatory for the race to be validated. Participants can purchase T-shirts and other merchandise. The event also includes activities for families and children, promoting a healthy lifestyle and a connection with nature.

name: CROS DONATON
location: Muzeul Etnografic al Transilvaniei, Cluj-Napoca, Cluj County, Romania

name: Tara Extreme Skymarathon – 5. kolo Nacionalne serije u planinskom trčanju
description: Tara Extreme Skymarathon is a challenging mountain running race held on the beautiful and demanding trails of Tara National Park. The race is part of the National Mountain Running Series and brings together competitors who want to test their physical and mental limits on demanding terrain with significant elevation gain. The start and finish are in Mitrovac, the traditional location for this event. During the race, participants can enjoy spectacular views and Tara’s wild natural scenery.
course_highlights: Trails with significant elevation gain of up to 3150 meters
The beautiful, wild nature of Tara National Park
Three different courses: SkyTrail (10 km), SkyRace (24 km), SkyMarathon (44 km)
additional: The race takes place in Mitrovac, with the start and finish at the same location. There are three courses with different distances and elevation gains: SkyTrail (10 km, 700D+), SkyRace (24 km, 1700D+), SkyMarathon (44 km, 3150D+). The race is known for its difficulty and for testing competitors’ limits. The organizers thank the competitors, volunteers, and sponsors for their support.

name: Tara Extreme Skychallange
location: Planinarski dom u Rastištu, Tara, Serbia
organizer: Udruženje Tara Ultra i PK Tara
description: Tara Extreme SkyChallenge is a unique skyrunning race held in the heart of Tara National Park, starting and finishing at the mountain lodge in Rastište. The event features three different technically demanding and physically challenging courses designed for experienced mountain runners. Sports and recreational activities for all ages are also organized as part of the event, making it appealing to a wider audience. The courses are certified to ISF, ITRA, and UTMB standards, and the race is part of the PSS National Mountain Running Series.
course_highlights: Technically demanding and physically challenging courses in Tara National Park
Three races of different distances and elevation gains: 46 km with 3300D+, 24 km with 1700D+, and 10 km with 700D+
Start and finish at the mountain lodge in Rastište
additional: Registration opens on February 1, 2026. The courses are certified to ISF, ITRA, and UTMB standards. The race counts as the 5th round of the PSS National Mountain Running Series. Sports and recreational activities for all ages will be organized in the start/finish area. The competition includes three races of different distances and difficulty levels, focusing on technically demanding and physically challenging terrain. In addition to the races, sports and recreational activities for all ages will be organized in the start/finish area.

name: Minimaratón
location: Atletický štadión na Štiavničkách, Banská Bystrica, Slovakia
organizer: Marathon Banska Bystrica, s.r.o., ON-POINT OZ, Minimaratón OZ
description: The Minimathon is a unique running event exclusively for families with children, held at the Štiavničky athletics stadium in Banská Bystrica. The event offers various age categories, from the youngest runners to older children, including mothers with strollers. The course is tailored to the age groups, with 400 m and 200 m loops. Alongside the sporting experience, there is an accompanying programme featuring activities for children and opportunities to meet athletes. Every participant receives a commemorative race bib, a medal and refreshments after finishing.
course_highlights: Course for children born in 2011–2020 and mothers with strollers – 400 m loop
Shortened 200 m course for children under 5
SNP Athletics Stadium in Štiavničky – a beautiful track and setting
additional: Online registration is available until 22.8.2026; in person on 21.8.2026 at Europa SC and on 23.8.2026 at the stadium from 8:00. The entry fee is non-refundable and cannot be transferred to the following year. Refreshments and medical services are provided after the finish. There will be no bag storage or changing rooms. At 11:50, a prize draw for valuable prizes will be held for everyone who finishes. Terrain: athletics stadium; online and in-person registration; medals and prizes for participants; 11th anniversary edition; accompanying programme including an aircraft flyover and family activities

name: Beh na boso Tatry
location: Golfový rezort Black Stork, Veľká Lomnica, Slovakia
description: Beh na boso Tatry is a running event in the beautiful surroundings of the Black Stork Golf Resort in Veľká Lomnica. Participants can choose between non-competitive runs for children and adults and a competitive 5 km run. The course follows mown grass and runs over paths and pebbles, giving it a cross-country character. The event is suitable for all age groups and offers a pleasant atmosphere in the Tatras. It is organised by OZ Beh na boso Tatry, which ensures the event runs smoothly.
course_highlights: The course follows mown grass
Sections over paths and carpet-covered pebbles
A cross-country course in the surroundings of the Black Stork Golf Resort
additional: The non-competitive runs start at 9:30, and the competitive 5 km run starts at 10:30. Categories are divided by age and gender. The non-competitive runs are 250 m for children up to 12 years old and 1 km for children and adults. The course includes mown grass, paths, pebbles and cross-country terrain. Registration is also available on site. The event supports charitable activities and offers refreshments and activities for children.

name: Underdogs
description: Underdogs - The Backyard Ultra is a unique endurance race set in the beautiful landscape of Brebu, Dâmbovița County, Romania. Participants run a 6.8 km course in repeated loops, with a start every hour, until only one competitor remains in the race. This competition tests runners’ physical and mental limits, offering an intense, community-oriented experience where every step is a challenge and a story of resilience. Founded on Lazarus Lake’s concept, the race brings together ultra-running enthusiasts in an adventurous setting built on mutual support.
course_highlights: A 6.8 km course run once every hour
Spectacular scenery in the Brebu area, Dâmbovița, Romania
A continuous format that lasts until only one runner remains in the race
additional: The race consists of 6.8 km loops, with a start every hour, and continues until only one runner remains. Community is central to the event, and the organizers provide participants with support throughout. Registration is open after July 21 if places are still available; volunteers and sponsors are welcome.

name: BUDAI NIGHT TRAIL
location: Sportcsarnok, Kamilla utca 1-3, Telki, Pest County, Hungary
description: The Budai Night Trail is an exciting trail running race held at night on the scenic forest trails of the Buda Hills. Participants run with headlamps, enjoying a unique experience in the dark across varied terrain. The race offers two challenging distances, 13.5 km and 17.3 km, with significant elevation gain. The event has a friendly, intimate atmosphere, and the start is in Telki, at the Sports Hall.
course_highlights: Night trail running on the forest trails of the Buda Hills
Headlamp running across varied terrain
Marked route with significant elevation gain (490 m+ and 527 m+)
additional: Start times: 19:30 for the 17.3 km distance and 20:00 for the 13.5 km distance. Race-pack pickup: 18:00–19:15 (M distance), 18:00–19:45 (S distance). Cutoff times: 23:00 (S distance), 23:30 (M distance). Registration is online only; on-site registration is not available. The participant limit is 600 across the two distances. The race takes place outdoors in the dark, with headlamps, offering participants a unique experience.

name: MOVE SZOMBATHELY SUNSET RUN
description: The MOVE Szombathely Sunset Run is a unique evening and night running race held in Szombathely’s main square, offering children and amateur runners alike the opportunity to take part. The sunset and the atmosphere of the city centre give the race its special character, making for a pleasant and motivating running experience. The event aims to make running accessible to all age groups while also providing a shared community experience.
course_highlights: Run in Szombathely’s main square
Evening atmosphere after sunset
Distances suitable for children and amateurs
additional: The race is special because it is an evening and night run, something that has not previously been held in Szombathely. The organisers also share training tips for the 6 km distance, highlighting the importance of gradual progress and training 3–4 times a week to complete it successfully. Night running race, venue: Fő tér, Szombathely; starts at 17:00 and 19:00.

description: SUHANJ! 6 is a charity running race that supports people with disabilities and helps fund the nonprofit work of the SUHANJ! Foundation. The race takes place at the Margaret Island Athletic Centre, where participants run as many laps as possible in 6 hours on a flat, accessible 3.5 km loop. The race starts at midnight, and participants are guaranteed to see the sunrise. You can enter individually or in teams of 2–10, with unlimited relay changes allowed. The Éj Félmaraton (Midnight Half Marathon) also starts at midnight and takes place on the SUHANJ! 6 course; it is limited to 200 participants.
course_highlights: A 3.5 km-long, completely flat, accessible loop
2,500 metres of paved path along Margaret Island’s central road
A 400-metre synthetic track loop at the Margaret Island Athletic Centre
additional: Bib pickup is available August 25–29, 08:00–20:00, at SUHANJ! Fitness (6 Tátra Street, District XIII, Budapest). Headlamps are mandatory until dawn during the race. Using your own cup or bottle at the refreshment stations is recommended. The race centre has changing rooms, showers, toilets, baggage storage and a dedicated refreshment zone. Before the race, from 22:00 to 23:00, the SUHANJ! Handbike Grand Prix for athletes with mobility impairments takes place on the MAC track. After the race, participants can enjoy breakfast and a charity raffle. Completing the race supports the work of the SUHANJ! Foundation. Participation requires online registration; the programme also includes a course map, breakfast and a raffle.

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: The Törökbálint Handicap is a friendly, loop-based running race held in Dióskert, Törökbálint. Runners complete the half-marathon distance in four laps, but they can also choose to run fewer laps. The entry fee is voluntary: 500 Ft per lap, which helps cover the costs of the race. Every participant receives an apple, hot tea, mulled wine and a commemorative medal. The top three men and women receive a special medal. The awards ceremony takes place at 12:00.
course_highlights: The course is located in Dióskert, Törökbálint
The half-marathon consists of four laps, but runners may choose to run fewer
Friendly race with a voluntary entry fee of 500 Ft per lap
additional: Registration takes place at the venue. Every participant receives a commemorative medal, and the top three men and women receive a special medal. Apples, hot tea and mulled wine will be provided. The awards ceremony is at 12:00. Participants may run fewer laps.

description: Sports Club Rohals warmly invites you to the 16th edition of the Run Through Novoveská Huta, taking place in Novoveská Huta. Adults can take on a new 12.2 km course to Vojtechova samota and back, the same for women and men. A 5 km course is also available for those who prefer a shorter distance. Children and young runners will compete on shorter courses through the streets of Huta, grouped by age category. After the race, participants can refuel with goulash; children can enjoy a small theatre performance, and adults will be entertained by the band 3násť ciest.
course_highlights: The new adult course goes to Vojtechova samota (Šadroň) and back
The adult course is 12.2 km and is the same for women and men
Short courses for children through the streets of Novoveská Huta, grouped by age category
additional: Registration for school-age participants is from 11:30 to 12:45, and for juniors and adults until 14:45. Participants may start in only one category. Goulash will be provided after the race; children can enjoy a small theatre performance, and adults will be entertained by the band 3násť ciest. Adult categories compete for points in the Spišská Nová Ves District Running League. 12.2 km and 5 km courses, categories for different age groups, registration on the day of the event, activities for children and adults.

name: OSLEA RUN
description: Oslea Run is a mountain-running competition held in the Retezat and Vâlcan Mountains, in the area of the Oslea, Paltina and Piatra Iorgovanului massifs. Organized by Clubul Alpin Valea Jiului, the event continues the local tradition of mountain running, offering four daytime races that showcase spectacular routes amid nature, where Retezat and Domogled-Valea Cernei National Parks meet. Participants enjoy an authentic outdoor experience, with challenging routes and impressive scenery. The event also includes a children’s race, as well as related social and cultural activities.
course_highlights: Spectacular mountain routes in the Retezat and Vâlcan Mountains
Routes through nature where two national parks meet
Four main races and a children’s race
additional: Race kits can be picked up from 16:00 to 22:00 on the day before the event and from 7:00 to 8:00 on race day. The Scorota route starts at 8:00, while the Paltina, Oslea and Șarba routes start at 9:00. All participants who finish within the time limit receive a finisher’s medal and a limited-edition cap. There are support stations along the route and at the finish, individual timing with online results, access to a wine tasting and a traditional dinner, an ambulance at the start/finish, and access to workshops and a social area with a campfire and live music. The event takes place on mountain and nature trails, with accommodation available in the Valea Iarului area and other facilities for participants.

name: Oslea Run ~ 2026
description: Oslea Run is a mountain running competition held in the Retezat and Vâlcan Mountains, in the area of the Oslea, Paltina and Piatra Iorgovanului massifs, organized by Clubul Alpin Valea Jiului. The event continues the tradition of mountain running in the area, offering four daytime races that showcase spectacular routes surrounded by nature, where Retezat and Domogled-Valea Cernei National Parks meet. Participants enjoy an authentic outdoor experience, with prizes, race kits and related activities such as tastings and socializing.
course_highlights: Spectacular mountain routes in the Retezat and Vâlcan Mountains
Aid stations and individual timing with online rankings
Access to Retezat National Park and traditional culinary experiences
additional: Race kits can be collected between 16:00 and 22:00 on the day before the race and between 7:00 and 8:00 on race day. Starts are scheduled for 8:00 for the Scorota route and 9:00 for the Paltina, Oslea and Șarba routes. Participants receive a limited-edition cap, a finisher medal, aid stations along the route, individual timing, wine tasting, access to the campsite and a traditional dinner. Practical first-aid courses and photography exhibitions are also organized. Prizes are awarded to the top three in the men's and women's open categories, as well as in the age categories. The race is 26 km long, with approximately 2,000 metres of elevation gain, and is recognized as a landmark trail-running event in Romania. Participation includes access to accommodation areas and information about the race kit.

description: Iskra Avala Night Trail is a night trail race held on 29 August 2026 on Mount Avala. The race starts at 20:30 in front of the Avala Tower, and runners will enjoy the unique atmosphere of a nighttime adventure with headlamps required. In addition to the race, a race village with food, drinks, and music will be set up in the start and finish area. The race is open to runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers, with awards for the top male and female finishers in both distances.
course_highlights: Night race on Mount Avala, starting in front of the Avala Tower
Two distances: 6 km and 10 km
Race village with food, drinks, and music in the start and finish area
additional: Headlamps are required. The total number of participants is limited to 500. Race packs can be collected in Belgrade ten days before the race. Entry fees are non-refundable but may be gifted. Changing and leaving belongings is at participants’ own discretion. Distances of 6 km and 10 km, headlamps required, limit of 500 participants, start at 20:30, in Belgrade, race village for visitors

name: Dunavske Čarolije 2026
description: Dunavske Čarolije is a unique event in Čortanovci that combines running, cycling, orienteering, water jumping, hiking, films, music, and volleyball. This festival of sport and entertainment brings together participants of all ages and offers a variety of activities on the banks of the Danube. The atmosphere is friendly and family-oriented, with a rich program lasting throughout the day. Everyone is invited to join and enjoy the charms of the Danube and sporting challenges.
course_highlights: Running and cycling along the banks of the Danube
Orienteering and water jumping
Hiking and outdoor sports activities
additional: The event also includes film screenings, live music, and volleyball matches, creating a rich and varied program for participants and visitors. Registration is open for the Inđija Trejl 08 trail race, which is part of the Dunavske Čarolije event series, with the possibility of early registration discounts.

description: The Nyakvágó Marathon is a challenging trail-running race in the Kiskunság region, near Ballószög. It offers the marathon distance, but in tougher conditions. Distances include 14 km, 22.5 km and 42 km, as well as a mountain-bike race. The course runs through natural surroundings on agricultural dirt roads, with aid stations every 4–5 kilometres. The event aims to promote an active lifestyle and bring the local community together. Competitors must protect the environment and follow the rules; mountain bikers are required to wear helmets.
course_highlights: Natural terrain, agricultural dirt roads and woodland sections
Aid stations every 4–5 kilometres with water, fruit and glucose tablets
Red cinder running track for the children’s races, with no elevation gain
additional: Refreshments are provided every 4–5 kilometres, including water, glucose tablets and fruit; alcoholic refreshments are available at the finish. Wearing a helmet is compulsory for mountain biking. T-shirts can be ordered until August 10 and cost 5,000 HUF. The race runs on agricultural dirt roads, and participants must observe traffic rules. Competitors must protect the environment; littering will result in disqualification. The event includes chip timing, various running and cycling races, and hikes, giving participants the opportunity to explore the natural scenery and take part in sports.

description: The UFÓ Ócsa Run is a popular city race held in Ócsa, around the Egressy Gábor Leisure Centre. The event offers several distances, including 10.5 km and 21 km races that pass through the town’s landmarks. The race uses a unique chip timing system, and places are ranked by gun time. With an informal, family-friendly atmosphere, age restrictions and a limited number of places, the event welcomes runners.
course_highlights: Urban setting, with a route passing Ócsa’s landmarks
10.5 km loop, completed multiple times on the longer distances
Varied terrain: asphalt, dirt road and cellar row
additional: The race uses a unique chip timing system that records both net and gun time. Placings are determined by gun time. The race is limited to a maximum of 550 participants. Residents of Ócsa receive a discount on the entry fee, which must be verified with a proof-of-address card. Registration is free for anyone born in 1960 or earlier. The race is part of the Ötpróba points-collection program, and participants can support the local community and promote physical activity at the event.

description: Draždiak Run is a running event held in Bratislava, in the Veľký Draždiak area of Petržalka. Participants can expect routes along gravel and hiking paths, suitable for different age groups and ability levels. The event includes children’s races, 5 km races for adults, Nordic walking, and a family run with a dog. It is organised by the Športová Nadácia Kotrmelec, which provides a welcoming atmosphere and high-quality organisation.
course_highlights: Surface: gravel path and hiking trail
Start location: beach by the Barracuda buffet, Veľký Draždiak, Petržalka
Races for children, adults, Nordic walking, and a family run with a dog
additional: The children’s races start at 10:00. Categories include a children’s race, a 5 km race for men and women in different age categories, 5 km Nordic walking, and a 1.8 km family run with a dog. The entry fee for children is lower than for adults. Online registration is available until 21 August at a discounted price, followed by more expensive online registration until 4 September 2025, and finally on-site registration at the highest price, if capacity has not been reached. Online registration until 21 August 2026; start at 10:00. The route includes gravel, grass, and asphalt sections, with various categories including the family run and Nordic walking.

name: Beh pod Sninským kameňom
location: Rekreačná oblasť Sninske rybníky, Snina, Slovakia
description: The Run Beneath Sninský kameň is a running event in the Sninské rybníky recreational area in Snina, offering races for children and adults. The courses run on asphalt and unpaved roads, with children’s distances ranging from 50 to 600 metres depending on age. The main race starts at 16:30 and is divided into men’s and women’s age groups. The event is organised by BehajmeSpolu o.z. in cooperation with the city of Snina. The entry fee is €15 for online registration and €20 on site.
course_highlights: Surface: asphalt and unpaved roads (10%)
Sninské rybníky recreational area – OMW Snina
Multiple age categories, from children to seniors
additional: The children’s categories are scheduled to start at 15:00, and the main category at 16:30. Categories are divided in detail by age and gender, including juniors and several men’s and women’s age groups. The event includes children’s races from 50 m to 600 m and a 6,000 m main race. The children’s start is also listed as 15:30, and the main race as 16:30.

name: Vrancea Montană Run
description: Vrancea Montană Run is a mountain-running event held in the Vrancea Mountains, in the commune of Păulești, offering an authentic nature experience for runners of all levels. The competition includes two main races: an 11 km cross-country race with approximately 350 m of elevation gain and a 21 km half marathon with 550 m of elevation gain. Both follow varied, unprepared routes combining forest roads, trails, and rugged terrain. The event is organized by the Vrancea Montană Association with the support of Păulești Town Hall and promotes respect for the natural environment and fair play among competitors. Participants also contribute to a worthy cause by supporting the rehabilitation of Romania’s wildlife.
course_highlights: 11 km cross-country race with approximately 350 m of elevation gain and a 2.5-hour time limit
21 km half marathon with approximately 550 m of elevation gain and a 4-hour time limit
Unprepared routes marked with tape, colored spray paint, and signs, crossing wilderness areas and forest roads
additional: The routes are not closed to traffic, and participants must observe traffic rules. Each race has a time limit: 2.5 hours for the cross-country race and 4 hours for the half marathon. The organizers provide mountain-running training guides. The first 350 participants received free registration at previous editions. The start and finish are on the plateau next to the Păulești Mountain Rescue Base. Mountain routes with 350 m D+ of elevation gain for the cross-country race and 550 m D+ for the half marathon; online registration and results; event supported by Păulești Town Hall.

name: Maratonul Olteniei
location: Parcul Zăvoi, Râmnicu Vâlcea, Vâlcea County, Romania
description: Maratonul Olteniei is a multi-sport event featuring running, MTB, and Hyathlon Sprint, held in Zăvoi Park in Râmnicu Vâlcea. The event promotes team spirit and the joy of being together, emphasizing connections between participants and shared motivation. It is a celebration of sport and nature, with a strong tradition and a dedicated community. Participants enjoy varied courses and a friendly atmosphere that encourages performance and socializing.
course_highlights: Running, MTB, and Hyathlon Sprint courses in Zăvoi Park
An event for sociable athletes, with an emphasis on motivation and connection
A friendly atmosphere and support for nature and sustainability
additional: In-person races in Râmnicu Vâlcea on 30–31 August 2026, and a virtual race available anytime, anywhere for participants around the world.

name: Avala noćna trail 2026
location: Platou ispred Avalskog tornja, Avala, Beograd, Serbia

description: Iskra Avala Night Trail is a night trail race taking place on August 29, 2026, on the plateau in front of the Avala Tower in Belgrade. The race starts at 8:30 p.m. and offers a unique nighttime experience on Mount Avala, with a race village for entertainment before, during, and after the race. Participants can choose between two distances, 6 km and 10 km, and a headlamp is required. The race is open to runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers, with prizes for the top finishers in the men’s and women’s categories at both distances.
course_highlights: Night race on the plateau in front of the Avala Tower
Two distances: 6 km and 10 km
Race village with food, drinks, and music in the start and finish area
additional: A headlamp is required. The total number of participants is limited to 500. Race packs can be collected in Belgrade ten days before the race. Entry fees are non-refundable, but entries can be gifted. Changing and storage of belongings are self-service. The race pack includes a T-shirt. Use of a headlamp is mandatory. The number of participants is limited to 500.

name: EMU 6 DAYS RACE / GOMU 6 DAYS WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP
description: The EMU 6-Day Race, also known as the GOMU 6-Day World Championship, is one of the world’s most prestigious multi-day ultramarathon events, held in Balatonfüred. During the race, participants run for six days, testing their endurance and perseverance. The race is traditionally the pinnacle of multi-day ultrarunning, and world records have been set there. Competitors face a unique challenge that tests both physical and mental strength.
course_highlights: Six days of continuous running on the Balatonfüred course
Venue for world records in multiple categories
A challenging multi-day ultramarathon
additional: The event focuses on setting multi-day ultramarathon records; details of the race and the type of terrain have not been specified.

name: Z Ľubotína na hrad Plaveč
description: The Run from Ľubotín to Plaveč Castle is a traditional running race that starts in the village of Ľubotín, by the multifunctional building. The race offers categories for men, women, juniors, Nordic walking, and a 4 km hobby run. The main race starts at 17:30, and the children’s categories start at 16:30. The organizers are the municipalities of Ľubotín and Plaveč, welcoming runners of all ages and ability levels. The race is ideal for those who want to run in beautiful surroundings, finishing at Plaveč Castle.
course_highlights: Start in Ľubotín by the multifunctional building
Finish at the historic Plaveč Castle
A route suitable for hobby runners and Nordic walkers
additional: The children’s categories start at 16:30, and the main category starts at 17:30. Categories are divided by age and gender, including Nordic walking and a 4 km hobby run on an asphalt road. Residents of Ľubotín and Plaveč, women over 60, and men over 70 can enter for free. A discounted €20 entry package is available for participants who also take part in the Jastrabské Vŕšky Run 2025. The event includes categories for different age groups, including juniors and Nordic walking, with online and on-site registration and discounts available for early registration. The program also includes a children’s run and races on an asphalt course.

name: SÜMEG TRAIL
location: Kisfaludy tér, Sümeg, Veszprém County, Hungary
description: The Sümeg Trail running race is a major sporting event in the city of Sümeg, attracting running enthusiasts for the fifth year. The race offers a challenge across four distances, which participants can complete in the city’s distinctive and beautiful surroundings. The event also features a range of sports activities and health screenings, so alongside the running, visitors can enjoy yoga classes, meditation, and other forms of exercise. Sümeg Trail is a lively community event that promotes sport and a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: The distinctive and beautiful course in Sümeg
Four distances: sweet, gourmet, spicy, and strong challenges
Sports activities and health screenings in the courtyard of the Memorial House
additional: On race day, the program will also include morning yoga, a warm-up, health screenings, singing bowl meditation, skill games, jiu-jitsu training, and performances by local dancers. The event will also offer environmental and cultural activities, and the venue will showcase the natural beauty of the surrounding area.

name: Marathon Chopok
description: The Chopok Marathon is a challenging mountain race in the beautiful Low Tatras, testing your abilities on a variety of surfaces and terrain. The race takes place on September 5, 2026, starting at 7:00 from Srdiečko and finishing on Chopok at an elevation of 2,004 m above sea level. There are two main courses: the 43 km SkyMarathon Chopok with 2,600 m of elevation gain, and the shorter 21 km Sky Race Jasná Trail with 1,400 m of elevation gain. Relay teams are also available on the long course. The route runs along both the southern and northern sides of Chopok, including the main ridge, and offers beautiful views and varied terrain.
course_highlights: A 43 km course with 2,600 m of elevation gain through the Low Tatras on the southern and northern sides of Chopok
Crossing the main ridge over varied surfaces that make footwear choice important
Finish on Chopok at an elevation of 2,004 m above sea level, with the option of a quick cable-car ride
additional: The long course offers a relay option for teams of four or fewer, with legs of approximately 10–11 km. The race is included in the Slovak Skyrunning Association’s 2026 calendar. The courses are unchanged from previous editions, allowing participants to compare performances. Spectators can watch runners from several points along the course. A trail race with relay-team options; starts at 07:00 and 10:00; part of the Slovak Skyrunning Association’s calendar; the route runs from Srdiečko to Chopok and back.

name: Kokava Trail
location: Kokava nad Rimavicou, Banská Bystrica, Slovakia
description: Kokava Trail is a certified trail race starting and finishing in Kokava nad Rimavicou, with routes through the Veporské vrchy and Stolické vrchy mountain ranges. There are two distances: the main course is 78 km with +3330 m of elevation gain and an 18-hour time limit; the shorter Pasiečky Trail is 23 km with +1200 m of elevation gain and a 7-hour limit. The varied route consists of 45% meadows, 45% forest trails and 10% asphalt. It has no difficult technical sections, but includes several steeper descents and climbs. Runners will find six aid stations along the course. Winners in the Men, Women, Men 50+ and Women 50+ categories receive medals and prizes during the awards ceremony at the cultural centre.
course_highlights: Varied terrain: 45% meadow, 45% forest and 10% asphalt
+3330 m of elevation gain on the 78 km main course
6 aid stations along the course
additional: Mandatory equipment includes a thermal blanket, a headlamp with fresh batteries, a charged mobile phone with an activated SIM card, a GPS device with the race route (a power bank is mandatory when navigating by phone), a reflective vest or bands, at least 1.5 l of fluids, a personal cup or wide-mouth bottle, ID and a clearly visible race number. The first three finishers in the Men, Women, Men 50+ and Women 50+ categories are awarded. The route has no difficult technical sections, but includes several steeper descents and climbs. There are 6 aid stations along the course. Two distances: 78 km and 23 km; mandatory equipment; certified course; mountain terrain; online registration; part of the Slovak Ultra Trail League

name: Prešov Running Series 3. kolo
description: The 3rd round of the Prešov Running Series is part of a series of running events taking place in Prešov during 2026. The event is open to all ages and running abilities, from beginners to professionals. The courses are designed to bring the community together, promote a healthy lifestyle and make running enjoyable. The entry fee includes timing, a medal, refreshments and an accompanying programme. Children who are members of the Prešov Running Team can run for free.
course_highlights: Courses for runners of different abilities, from beginners to professionals
An event on Hlavná Street in Prešov with a community atmosphere
An accompanying programme and refreshments for all participants
additional: The entry fee includes a bib with a chip, timing, a medal, refreshments, an accompanying programme, medical services, race organisation and photographs. On-site registration is possible subject to capacity, but early online registration is recommended. Participants are advised to collect their race bibs the day before at OC Novum. Children who are members of the Prešov Running Team can take part for free after paying the annual membership fee. The series includes three races at different locations in Prešov, with themes from fantasy, history and sport; registration is compulsory; maps, medals and children’s categories are available; a raffle is also part of the event.

name: 6 hodinovka pod Šarišským hradom
description: The 6-hour race beneath Šariš Castle is an endurance running event held in Veľký Šariš, Prešov District. The race is open to both individual runners and relay teams, with categories divided by age and gender. The entry fee is the same for all runners, and the event offers a chance to test your endurance in a six-hour run in the beautiful surroundings beneath the castle. The organizers, Gejza Sabanoš and Ondrej Fedor, ensure the event runs smoothly.
course_highlights: The race takes place around historic Šariš Castle, with beautiful views of the surrounding landscape
The event offers different categories, including relay races
A six-hour endurance challenge for runners of all levels
additional: The race includes various categories and relay options. The course is set around the castle, but details about the terrain are not specified.

name: Ozorovská dvanastka
description: Ozorovská Dvanástka is a running race held in Malé Ozorovce, offering courses for both children and adults. The race is organized by OZ Zorovčan in cooperation with the municipality of Veľké Ozorovce. Runners can compete in the 6 km and 12 km races, with categories based on age and gender. The children’s race starts at 9:00 and the adults’ race at 10:00. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a welcoming atmosphere near the cultural centre.
course_highlights: The course runs through Malé Ozorovce, with parking in front of the cultural centre
Two main distances: 12 km and 6 km, with categories based on age and gender
Children’s race starts at 9:00; adults’ race starts at 10:00
additional: Race categories include children’s categories and age groups for men and women in the 12 km race (Men A up to 39, B 40–49, C 50 and older; Women F up to 39, G 40–49, H) and a 6 km race for men and women. The race takes place on 5 September 2026, with starts at 9:00 and 10:00. The course includes local roads. Registration is available online or on site.

name: Horský kros Gerlach
description: The Gerlach Mountain Cross is a traditional uphill mountain race that starts in the village of Gerlachov and runs through the Velická Valley to the Sliezsky dom mountain hotel. The course is 8,400 metres long with an elevation gain of 879 metres, and runners tackle a rocky trail and sections of asphalt road. The event is suited to runners who enjoy challenging mountain terrain and beautiful views of the High Tatras. The race also includes children’s runs, and participants can purchase an entry option that includes original Gerlach Mountain Cross socks.
course_highlights: 8,400 m course with an elevation gain of 879 m
Rocky trail and sections of asphalt road
Finish in front of the Sliezsky dom mountain hotel
additional: The maximum capacity is 200 runners. The time limit at the Velický Bridge (5.7 km) is 1:30. Refreshments are provided on the course and at the finish, along with transport of belongings to the finish and a post-race meal. The children’s races (100–500 m) are not timed; every child receives a medal and a sweet. Entry with HKG socks is available for €7. The race takes place in mountain terrain. Registration is available at the municipal office, and children’s races are also included.

description: Run for the Tatras is a running event held in the picturesque surroundings of Štrbské Pleso in the High Tatras, below the Tatras Tower observation tower. The races offer a children’s start at 14:00 and an adults’ start at 16:00. The course follows natural terrain along the lakeshore and cross-country ski trails. Categories are divided by age and gender, allowing runners of different age groups to take part. The event is organised by Barbora and Slavomír Ogurčák in cooperation with the civic association Žiť Tatry, who ensure a welcoming atmosphere and high-quality organisation.
course_highlights: Natural terrain along the shore of Štrbské Pleso lake
Štrbské Pleso cross-country ski trails
Picturesque High Tatras setting below Tatras Tower
additional: Children’s start at 14:00; adults’ start at 16:00. Categories by age and gender. Organised by Barbora and Slavomír Ogurčák in cooperation with the civic association Žiť Tatry. The course is on natural terrain, running around the lake and along the cross-country ski trails. The course is on natural terrain, running around the lake and along the ski trails; registration from 15.3.2025 to 4.9.2025; categories for different age groups

name: Veľatský lesný beh
description: Veľaty Forest Run is a traditional running event organized by the civic association OZ Stopa in the village of Veľaty. The race takes place at the FK Veľaty sports field and offers courses of various lengths for men and women aged 15 and over, with children’s races held directly on the football pitch. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, voluntary entry fee in the form of a donation, and refreshments. Volunteers assist runners throughout the day, and results are timed, with winners announced and prizes awarded.
course_highlights: Courses through the forest around Veľaty, measuring 6 km, 11 km, and 16 km
Children’s races on the FK Veľaty football pitch
Changing rooms, showers, and toilets at the starting venue
additional: Online registration is available until 4 September 2024. After that, registration is available at the starting venue until 9:30. The entry fee is voluntary, in the form of a donation to OZ Stopa. Results are announced and prizes awarded after the last runner finishes. Parking is available in designated car parks, with directions provided by the organizers. The race is run according to athletics rules, and participants take part at their own risk. Children run immediately after the main races start. The course includes forest, asphalt, and gravel sections; the races are open to all age groups; registration is available online or on site; refreshments and commemorative items are provided.

name: CugiRace
location: Poiana cu Goruni, Cugir, Alba County, Romania
description: CugiRace is a mountain running competition held in Poiana cu Goruni, Cugir, offering races for all fitness levels: an ultramarathon, half marathon, 10 km cross-country race, and children’s race. The varied routes feature significant elevation changes, providing a challenging and scenic experience in the Cugir Mountains. The event promotes outdoor exercise and a healthy lifestyle, and is intended both for experienced runners and for those looking to make the transition to ultramarathon running. The atmosphere is friendly, supported by careful organization and dedicated volunteers.
course_highlights: 69.4 km ultramarathon with +2730 m of elevation gain
23.9 km half marathon with 918 m of elevation gain
10 km Silviu Pîclișan Cross-Country Race, held in memory of Cugir runner Silviu Pîclișan
additional: Staggered starts: Ultramarathon at 07:00, Half Marathon at 09:00, Cross-Country Race at 09:30, Children’s Race at 12:00. Multiple refreshment points along the routes. Technical briefings are held before the starts. After the competition, a Gulaș Party and award ceremonies for all races are organized. Cut-off times and safety rules are communicated and enforced. The routes include trails, forests, hills, and areas with beautiful natural scenery. Mountain routes, a trail-running event, various races for different levels, promotion of outdoor exercise.

description: StruguRUN is a unique running competition set among the vineyards and historic scenery of Odobești, Vrancea. The event offers three races for all levels: the Half Marathon, the Cross-Country Race, and the Popular Race, each featuring spectacular routes through vineyards and forests and along the Milcov River. Participants can enjoy an authentic experience that combines sport, nature, and local traditions in a friendly, energizing atmosphere.
course_highlights: Popular Race (5 km) on an accessible route through the forest and along the Milcov River
Cross-Country Race (12 km, +500 m elevation gain) with challenging climbs through the vineyards of Crama Sârba Odobești
Half Marathon (22 km, +850 m elevation gain), combining mountain running with vineyard and historic scenery
additional: Race pack pickup and participant registration take place between 07:30 and 09:30. The starts are staggered: Half Marathon at 10:15, Cross-Country Race at 10:30, and Popular Race at 10:40. The awards ceremony takes place at 13:30, and the event officially closes at 14:30. The start location is in Odobești’s recreation area, with parking available. You can travel by train to Focșani station and then take local transport or a taxi. Participation is by donation, and the event includes prizes for the fastest participants and for those who demonstrate team spirit and perseverance. Full course routes and details are available on the official website.

name: 41. Wizz Air Budapest Félmaraton
location: Budapest, Pázmány P. rakpart, Budapest, Hungary
description: The 41st Wizz Air Budapest Half Marathon is Hungary’s largest half marathon and will take place in Budapest on September 6, 2026. The race follows a beautiful and varied route through some of Budapest’s most scenic areas, with more than ten thousand fellow runners taking part. The course is fast and scenic, and the atmosphere is electric, with music points and enthusiastic spectators cheering on the runners. The half marathon is an ideal distance for both beginners and experienced runners, with a unique finisher’s medal waiting at the finish line.
course_highlights: Fast course through some of Budapest’s most scenic areas
Varied, scenic route
Fun music points and enthusiastic crowds of spectators
additional: Registration is currently open only for the individual 21.1-kilometre race, but the 10 km, pairs and trio events will be available soon. Online registration is available exclusively with card payment at nevezes.futanet.hu. A BSI account registration is required to enter. The unique finisher’s medal can be collected at the finish line. Advice is available on preparing for warm weather, hydration and race preparation, and virtual participation is also an option.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 9. kolo
description: Beh 2 míle Bratislava is a regular 2-mile running race organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team at the Kuchajda swimming pool complex in Bratislava. The race is open to the general public, including children, juniors, women, men and veterans, who are divided into categories. Registration takes place on site by the volleyball court from 9:30, and the start is at 10:00. The event is part of a race series in which runners earn points toward the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team Perpetual Trophy based on their performance and age.
course_highlights: Course distance: 2 miles (3.218 km); children run approximately 200 m
The course is at the Kuchajda swimming pool complex in Bratislava
Check-in and start by the volleyball court
additional: Registration takes place on site from 9:30. The start is at 10:00. Categories: children (13 and under), juniors, women, men, female veterans and male veterans. Competitors vie for the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team Perpetual Trophy, with points awarded according to age coefficients and number of participations. In the event of a tie, the best time and shoe size decide. The race is part of a series held at Kuchajda in Bratislava, with on-site registration available. Races are held in various categories, including children, juniors, adults and veterans, and aim to promote a healthy lifestyle and community.

name: Dukelský beh mieru
description: The Dukla Peace Run is one of the oldest and most significant running events in Slovakia, held every year on the first Sunday in September. The course runs from Dukla to the centre of Svidník and is 19 kilometres long, descending from 479 m above sea level at the start to 244 m above sea level at the finish. Runners follow a historic route associated with the Carpathian-Dukla Operation, commemorating the victims and the struggle for peace in 1944–1945. The event has a rich history and deep emotional significance, bringing together competitive runners and amateurs.
course_highlights: A 19 km course from Dukla to Svidník
Start at 479 m above sea level, finish at 244 m above sea level
A historic route associated with the Carpathian-Dukla Operation
additional: Registration for 2026 is still being prepared. The course is known for its historical significance and the challenge it poses to runners following the route once traversed by soldiers during the Carpathian-Dukla Operation. The event also features accompanying running categories such as the Great Run for Health and the Small Run for Health. The course is approximately 19 km long, starting at Dukla Pass and finishing in Svidník’s pedestrian zone. The event also includes short races and inline skating races; online registration is open until August 2025.

name: Sighișoara 10K
organizer: Asociația Părinților din „Clubul Sportiv Școlar” Sighișoara
price_range: 100 lei (Early Bird), 150 lei (normal), 180 lei (Last Minute), 119 lei (tricou tehnic)
description: Sighișoara 10K is a running race offering a unique experience through the heart of the medieval citadel of Sighișoara, combining sport with the discovery of the city’s historic treasures. The event includes 10K and 5K races, a children’s race, and an Up Stairs challenge, and is open to all age groups and fitness levels. Participants can enjoy a vibrant, energetic course, cash prizes, and a raffle for all runners. The race is held in memory of Dr. Stelian Larga, a cardiologist and citizen actively involved in the city’s sporting and cultural life.
course_highlights: Course through the medieval citadel of Sighișoara, with unique historic scenery
Start and finish in Piața Cetății, the city’s central square
Accessible, dynamic course for all levels, including an Up Stairs race
additional: All participants in the 5K and 10K races are automatically entered into the prize raffle. The race kit includes a race number, timing chip, and products provided by sponsors. The technical T-shirt can be ordered as an add-on during registration for 119 lei. Kit pickup is recommended on Saturday, 6 September, but is also possible on race morning. There are 5 age categories for the 10K and 7 categories for the 5K. Cash prizes and medals are offered by the main partner, AS World Cargo. Appeals may be submitted to the designated jury members within 15 minutes after finishing. The course includes areas of the city’s historic centre, with the chance to win cash prizes and medals, as well as the option to purchase a personalised technical T-shirt.
