description: Ciucaș X3 is a mountain running event organized by the Ciucaș Ploiești Tourism and Mountaineering Club, promoting outdoor activity and mountain sports. A variety of races, from a short vertical race to an ultramarathon, take place in the Ciucaș Mountains, offering challenges for amateurs, professionals, and children. The event has a tradition spanning more than 16 editions and supports the sustainable development of the local community. Participants can experience spectacular mountain scenery and varied trails, with a friendly atmosphere and professional organization.
course_highlights: Varied mountain trails: Babeș Vertical, 3.8 km with +624 m elevation gain
A 21.6 km half marathon and an 8.8 km cross-country race in the Ciucaș Mountains
The Ridge, a 38.5 km race for experienced runners
additional: Race kits can be collected before the races. The event includes children's races (Kids Race) with separate starts. There are checkpoints and refreshment stations along the routes. The detailed start schedule is available on the website. Registration is open from April 15 to August 20, 2026, giving participants the opportunity to prepare for an unforgettable mountain experience.

name: Vlasina 2026
description: The Vlasina Triathlon of Self-Transcendence is a traditional race held at beautiful Lake Vlasina near Vladičin Han. Participants can choose from the Olympic, Sprint, Super Sprint, Super Kid, and Mini Kid triathlons, which are suited to different ages and levels of ability. The race is known for its atmosphere of self-transcendence and the support provided by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team, which promotes sport and spirituality. Every participant receives a race number, a certificate, and a finisher’s medal.
course_highlights: The race takes place on the shore of Lake Vlasina, surrounded by beautiful natural scenery
Distances for different age groups, from the Mini Kid to the Olympic triathlon
Changing rooms close to the start and finish
additional: Registration is complete only from the date the entry fee is paid. Exceptions allowing payment when collecting the race pack must be approved in advance. International participants may pay when collecting their race pack due to difficulties making payments from abroad. A changing room is provided close to the start and finish. Participants compete at their own risk. Participation includes various competition categories, registration information, water conditions, drafting rules, and accommodation suggestions in the area.

name: European Masters Off Road Championships
description: The 2026 Râșnov European Masters Off-Road Running Championships brings together masters athletes from across Europe to compete in the heart of the Carpathian Mountains. The event takes place in the historic town of Râșnov, offering a technical trail-running course alongside Transylvania’s rich cultural heritage. This competition is a unique opportunity for masters athletes to test their skills on challenging and picturesque terrain.
course_highlights: Technical trail-running course in the Carpathian Mountains
Picturesque scenery and Transylvanian cultural heritage
Historic location in the town of Râșnov, Romania
additional: The event takes place from 10 to 13 September 2026. The organizers published the first edition of the event program when registration opened. The competition is organized in collaboration with the Local Organizing Committee (LOC). Registration is open, with an early-bird discount available before 10 August 2026. The event includes trail and mountain-running races, with course, rules, and logistics details available in the official event manual.

name: 36. BorsodChem Bódva-völgyi Maraton
description: The 36th BorsodChem Bódva Valley Marathon is a traditional running race held in and around Edelény. It offers a range of distances, so every runner can find a suitable challenge. The event has a friendly, family-like atmosphere and provides professional RFID chip timing. Participants can enjoy the natural beauty of the Bódva Valley and its varied terrain.
course_highlights: A range of distances, from 500 m to the marathon
Varied terrain close to nature in the Bódva Valley
Professional chip timing (RFID, HuTag)
additional: Registration takes place on korido.hu, where automatic confirmation and SimplePay card payments are also available. Race bibs are handed out with safety pins. The event offers several distances and race categories, so every member of the family can find a suitable option. Several distances are available, but the sources do not provide exact details or entry fees.

name: III. Pannonhalma Decem Futás 5 / 10
description: The 3rd Pannonhalma Decem Run is a friendly and varied running race set in the picturesque surroundings of Fenyvesalja in Pannonhalma. The race offers two distances, 5 and 10 kilometers, for running enthusiasts to enjoy the natural surroundings and clearly marked routes. The event aims to provide a motivating and enjoyable sporting experience for all ages, while participants discover the beauty of the local landscape. The race is part of the Ötpróba series, a recreational sports program encompassing multiple sports and events.
course_highlights: 5 and 10 km distances around Fenyvesalja in Pannonhalma
Varied terrain close to nature
Clearly marked and safe route
additional: Participants receive a medal, gifts, and refreshments at aid stations. The venue is easy to reach, and the community experience is a key focus.

name: XI. Moonlight Run
description: The XI Moonlight Run is an atmospheric running race in the town of Szob, taking place on September 12, 2026. Participants receive timing, a race bib, and a unique finisher’s medal. Refreshments are available on the course and at the finish, where runners are also welcomed with traditional bread spread with lard and onions. The event takes place under medical supervision, and the organizers prioritize the experience of taking part.
course_highlights: The start and finish are in the town of Szob
Refreshments on the course and at the finish
A unique finisher’s medal for every participant
additional: Medical supervision is provided at the race. Runners are welcomed at the finish with traditional bread spread with lard and onions. Every participant receives a unique finisher’s medal. Refreshments are available on the course and at the finish. Participants receive a certificate, and refreshments are provided at the finish; the event is conducted in Hungarian.

The event offers several distances, so every runner can find a suitable challenge. The race traditionally welcomes entrants with significant early-bird discounts and takes place in a friendly, family-like atmosphere. Its aim is to promote sport and strengthen the community, while participants enjoy varied courses and the beauty of the Paks surroundings.
course_highlights: Runners can choose from 7 km, 14 km, 21 km, and 32 km distances
The race takes place in the city of Paks, around the ASE sports hall
Varied terrain and scenery offer a challenge for every runner
additional: Race-day registration is available in person only. The ATOM100 challenge is part of ATOMfutás, which is a series of several races, but no separate entry is required; you only need to register in the Atomfutás entry system to obtain an ATOM ID. Extreme obstacle race, family activities, refreshment stations, music-filled atmosphere, health-promotion activities

name: BRUTÁLATOM
location: ASE sportcsarnok, Paks, Tolna County, Hungary
description: BrutálATOM is a challenging running race organized by the Atomerőmű Sports Club in the city of Paks, near the ASE sports hall. The race offers runners several distances, including options for children and adults at different difficulty levels. The event is traditionally held in mid-September and offers participants a unique experience through its location and organization. The event’s patron is Olympic champion Dr. Antal Kovács, further enhancing the race’s prestige.
course_highlights: Distances: 1.5–2 km kids’ race, 4–4.5 km light, 8–9 km classic
Start and finish beside the ASE sports hall, GPS coordinates: N 46 37.038, E 18 50.133
Separate awards for girls and boys in every distance
additional: Race bib pickup is available on September 11 from 16:00 to 18:00 and on September 12 from 07:00 to 16:00 at the event center. Warm-ups are scheduled for three times: 14:15, 14:45, and 15:45. The awards ceremony is at 18:00. Online registration and on-site payment are available from 2026.09.01 at 14:00. Participants must select and confirm their distance in the registration system. The course is a varied obstacle course. Online and on-site registration are available, and registration is also possible on race day. The event includes a children’s race, chip timing, refreshment stations, outdoor showers, and changing facilities.

name: MOONLIGHT RUN
location: Szent László templom, Szob, Nógrád, Hungary
description: MOONLIGHT RUN is a special night race in the town of Szob, taking place on September 12, 2026. The start and finish are at St. Ladislaus Church, and participants receive a unique finisher’s medal. Refreshments and medical supervision are provided during the event, and runners are welcomed at the finish with traditional bread with pork fat and onions. The race is organized by Proathlon Bt., with support from the local municipalities.
course_highlights: A new 6 km distance at Moonlight Run
Start and finish at St. Ladislaus Church in Szob
Refreshments on the course and at the finish, with medical supervision
additional: Timing, a race bib, and a unique finisher’s medal are provided. Runners are welcomed at the finish with traditional bread with pork fat and onions. Medical supervision and refreshments are available on the course and at the finish. Traditional Hungarian snacks and refreshments are available to race participants; the event offers a community experience and an opportunity to be active for all ages.

description: The Lučenec City Night Run is a nighttime race along illuminated streets in Lučenec, covering a distance of 4.5 km. The event is open to the general public, including juniors and adults, with categories by age and gender. It is organized by the City of Lučenec and OZ Novohrad and takes place by the Synagogue, with electronic timing and chip technology. The start is scheduled for 19:30. Runners can expect a commemorative medal, a race number, refreshments and an accompanying program.
course_highlights: Illuminated streets of Lučenec at night
Course distance: 4.5 km
Electronic timing with chip technology
additional: Race check-in is on 15.9.2025 from 17:00 to 19:00 by the Synagogue. The race is limited to 350 participants. The entry fee includes a commemorative metal medal, a race number bearing the event logo, a collage of photographs sent by email, medical services, refreshments and a show program. The race takes place with traffic partially restricted and at participants’ own risk. Registration is available online and on-site. The maximum number of participants is 350. Medals, race numbers, photographs, medical care and refreshments are also included.

name: Školáčik detský beh
description: Školáčik Children’s Run is a running event for children in various age categories, held in Lučenec by the synagogue. It is organized by the City of Lučenec and OZ Novohrad. The races are for boys and girls aged 3 to 15 inclusive, including children with disabilities. The entry fee is symbolic and encourages children to take part in sports activities in the pleasant surroundings of the city.
course_highlights: Races for children aged 3 to 15 in various age categories
Running courses adapted to children’s ages and abilities
Held in the centre of Lučenec by the synagogue
additional: The entry fee is €5 for online registration by 12.9.2025, and €7 on site if places are available. Categories are divided by age, from 3 to 15 inclusive, and include children with disabilities. The event is organized by the City of Lučenec and OZ Novohrad. Contact person: Marian Duzbaba, tel: 0907146181. Children in various age categories, online and on-site entry fees, location: Lučenec, synagogue.

name: Beh okolo Lysej
location: Lysá pod Makytou, Púchov District, Slovakia
description: Beh okolo Lysej is a traditional running race in the village of Lysá pod Makytou, with various categories for children, juniors, women and men according to age. The race takes place by the cultural centre and is organised by Bežecký klub Lysá pod Makytou. The children’s start is at 11:00, categories E, women and juniors start at 12:30, and men start at 13:00. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the region.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the village of Lysá pod Makytou by the cultural centre
Multiple age categories, from kindergarten children to veterans over 70
Starts are scheduled by category: children, juniors, women and men
additional: The children’s start is at 11:00, categories E, women and juniors start at 12:30, and men start at 13:00. Categories are divided by age, from kindergarten children to veterans over 70. The organiser is Bežecký klub Lysá pod Makytou. The race probably takes place on natural or mountain terrain; registration details are not specified; event date: 12 September 2026

name: Behaj lesmi Topoľčianky
description: Behaj lesmi Topoľčianky is a night trail race in the beautiful wine-growing region of Topoľčianky, taking place on 12 September 2026. Runners can enjoy routes passing by Topoľčianky Castle and Hrušov Castle, with forest trails and an atmosphere under the stars. The race is part of the Behaj lesmi series and is included in the international UTMB Index, adding to its prestige. There are two main distances—11 km and 22 km—and the course also features the Conti Speed Section, where runners can win a valuable prize.
course_highlights: Routes pass through a wine-growing region with views of Topoľčianky Castle and Hrušov Castle
Forest trails with soft surfaces, ideal for trail running
A night run under the stars with the marked Conti Speed Section speed segment
additional: The race includes the Conti Speed Section, a 150-metre speed segment where participants can win a tyre voucher and a running shirt. The night-time event offers a unique atmosphere and experience. The routes are 80% soft surface and 100% fresh air. The event is part of the Behaj lesmi series, which includes multiple events across Slovakia and the Czech Republic. The race offers several distances, including a children’s race, with prices from 5 EUR when purchasing 7 or more races. There is also an entertainment programme for children, registration outside Terminovka.sk, and the option to take part in the night run.

name: Marina Liptov RUN
organizer: Olympijský klub Liptova a rezort Marina Liptov
description: Marina Liptov RUN is a sports and recreational event in the beautiful setting of the Marina Liptov resort near Liptovská Mara. This unconventional run combines nature and quality services in harmony with the four elements—fire, water, earth and air. Runners can enjoy a peaceful and inspiring setting, with views of the surrounding countryside and the opportunity to relax at the resort after the run. Marina Liptov is an ideal place for athletes and families looking for an experience in nature.
course_highlights: The route runs through a natural setting near Liptovská Mara
Beautiful views of the surrounding countryside, meadows, mountains and forests
A peaceful, harmonious setting inspired by the four elements of nature
additional: Marina Liptov offers accommodation, wellness facilities, water activities, a boathouse and a marina, which runners can enjoy before or after the race. The resort is open daily from 09:00 to 19:00. Hiking, cycling, skiing and fishing are available nearby. The course is a 9 km trail, subject to possible changes. Registration is available online or on site, and technical and medical support is provided.

The race is open to all age groups and ability levels, offering a pleasant atmosphere and the chance to enjoy sport outdoors. It is organized by Záhrada Pohybu, which provides quality facilities for sport and recreation.
course_highlights: The race takes place on the grounds of the Garden of Movement in Lemešany
A course suitable for all ages and ability levels
Pleasant natural surroundings with a pump track and playground
additional: The race is part of the Lemešany Running League, which includes four rounds in 2024, with discounted prices available for those who enter all of them. The event is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners, with registration available online or on site.

description: The Run for Paws Autumn Special is a running event in Kavečany, Košice, near Hrešná Cottage, organised by the Union for Mutual Assistance of People and Dogs (UVP). The race is open to various categories, including women, men, children and runners with dogs, including shelter dogs. The course is 5 km long and offers a pleasant autumn atmosphere in nature. Registration is available online at a reduced price and on-site at a higher price. The event supports dog adoption and brings runners and animals together in a friendly setting.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through the natural surroundings of Kavečany, near Hrešná Cottage
The option to run with a dog, including a dog adopted from a shelter
Categories for women, men, children under 15 and runners with dogs
additional: Categories include women, men, children under 15 and runners with dogs, including shelter dogs. The entry fee is €10 for online registration by 19.9.2025, and €15 on-site. The event is organised by the Union for Mutual Assistance of People and Dogs (UVP). The start is at Hrešná Cottage in Kavečany, Košice. This outdoor event is suitable for dogs and their owners, with an emphasis on charitable purposes and a community atmosphere.

name: Night run Michalovce
organizer: Mesto Michalovce, TAZS Michalovce, MSKS Michalovce, Fitko Michalovce, R M s.r.o.
description: Night Run Michalovce is a nighttime running race held at Námestie osloboditeľov in Michalovce. The race offers three distances: 10 km, 5 km and 3 km, suitable for different age groups and ability levels. The adult race starts at 19:00, and the children’s races begin at 17:00. The organizers are the City of Michalovce, TAZS Michalovce, MSKS Michalovce, Fitko Michalovce and R M s.r.o. The race is open to the general public and offers a chance to enjoy a sporting atmosphere in the city at night.
course_highlights: A night run in central Michalovce, at Námestie osloboditeľov
Three distances: long 10 km, middle 5 km and short 3 km
Categories for all age groups, including children’s races
additional: You can also pay the entry fee by card on site. The race has age- and gender-based categories, including junior, men’s and women’s categories. The children’s races start at 17:00. The event starts at 19:00 for adults and 17:00 for children. Online registration is available and is subject to fees and deadlines; registration details and deadlines are available on the official website.

description: The Run to Choč is a unique running event in the heart of Orava that will test your fitness as you race to the summit of Veľký Choč. The route follows marked hiking trails and climbs steadily, offering beautiful views and the natural surroundings of the Choč National Nature Reserve. The event is for anyone who loves running, sport and nature and wants to enjoy a memorable atmosphere, refreshments and prizes. The run is also held in memory of Jožo Čajka, a sportsman and big-hearted friend.
course_highlights: Climb to the summit of Veľký Choč along the green and red hiking trails
Refreshments at the Drapáč meadow and at the summit of Choč
Cut-off time at the Drapáč meadow: 1 hour 15 minutes
additional: The maximum number of starters is 250. Registration is available online until 6 September 2023, or on race morning from 7:30 in Vyšný Kubín. The entry fee includes refreshments on the course, lunch and a commemorative gift. The route is marked with coloured ribbons; taking shortcuts will result in disqualification. The first three finishers in each category receive prizes and cash awards, including bonuses for breaking the course record. The race is part of a mountain-race series. Registration is available online and on site; refreshments and a finisher’s gift are included. The race is organised within Choč National Park and is open to runners of all levels.

description: Woodrocks Trail Run is a mountain running event held in the village of Petriș, offering three scenic courses for runners of all levels. The 6 km Green Course is ideal for beginners, with shady trails and gentle hills. The 15 km Blue Course offers an invigorating experience with moderate climbs, while the 35 km Pink Course is a thrilling adventure with 1,600 meters of elevation gain across rugged terrain and picturesque ridgelines. The event focuses on the joy of running in nature and supporting environmental education through the EcoStuff Romania Association.
course_highlights: Green Course: 6 km, shady trails, moderate climb, suitable for beginners
Blue Course: 15 km, hills with shady trails and invigorating climbs
Pink Course: 35 km, 1,600 m of elevation gain, rugged terrain and picturesque ridgelines
additional: Race kits can be picked up on race day at the race office by showing an ID document; race numbers are also assigned there. Participants must wear their number visibly on their gear throughout the race. Recommended equipment includes trail running shoes and a rain jacket. The start is at Woodrocks, with parking along the road, on the grass where possible. Age categories are 15+ for the Green Course, 16+ for the Blue Course, and 18+ for the Pink Course, with special conditions for minors. Courses feature rugged terrain and forest trails; the start and parking are along the roadside, and registration and kit pickup take place on event day.

description: The Dragomirna Marathon is an annual competition held in the Dragomirna Beech Forest Reserve in Suceava. It offers a unique running experience in nature, combining picturesque scenery with a friendly atmosphere and professional organization. The event includes several races, from a full marathon to a half marathon and a cross-country race, catering to both experienced and amateur runners. Participants receive race kits and prizes, and the organizers promote an active community involved in supporting sport and the environment.
course_highlights: A route through the Dragomirna Beech Forest Reserve, featuring outstanding natural scenery
Various races: marathon, half marathon, cross-country race, and children’s races
Professional organization, with race kits and guaranteed prizes

Registration options are available for volunteers and event supporters. name: AIUD GREEN RUN by DP World
organizer: DP World, Primăria și Consiliul Local Aiud, Asociația Dr. Brendus Gyula Egyesület
description: Aiud Green Run by DP World is a sporting event that promotes a healthy, environmentally friendly lifestyle, giving participants the opportunity to run on scenic routes surrounded by nature and authentic Transylvanian landscapes. The event includes a 21 km half-marathon, an 8 km cross-country race, and a 2 km family run, suitable for all experience levels. The routes are designed to challenge and inspire runners while offering a friendly atmosphere and a memorable experience in the municipality of Aiud. The start is near Aiud Citadel, and the event is organized in partnership with Aiud City Hall and the Dr. Brendus Gyula Egyesulet Association.
course_highlights: The 21 km half-marathon route passes through Transylvanian natural landscapes and the authentic atmosphere of the municipality of Aiud
The 8 km cross-country race includes part of the half-marathon route in the Pădurea Poligon area, with panoramic views of the municipality of Aiud
The 2 km family run promotes an active and healthy lifestyle for all ages
additional: Race kits can be collected in the days leading up to the event and on race day at Aiud City Hall and the start area. The official warm-up takes place from 08:30 to 08:50. Fun and educational activities for children are held from 08:00 to 13:00 in the start/finish area. The half-marathon and cross-country race share a start at 09:00 near Aiud Citadel. Routes through nature, registration details, and other information are available on the website; the event takes place in natural and forested areas of Aiud.

The event officially begins at 09:00, with the 23 km race starting at 09:45, the 12 km race at 10:15, and the 1.6 km race at 13:00. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 14:00. The organizer reserves the right to change the schedule up to September 20, 2026. The event also includes the 23 km race, with special conditions for minor participants, and is expected to take place in temperatures of 16–18°C. Rules for multiple races and details about registration and participants’ responsibilities are provided.

organizer: ASCOTID (Asociația Copiilor și Tinerilor Diabetici - Mureș)

description: ASCOTID Trail Race is an annual trail running competition held in the Cornești Plateau area of Târgu Mureș. The event promotes physical activity for all age groups and was initiated by the Mureș Association of Children and Young People with Diabetes (ASCOTID). The courses include a half marathon, 10 km and 5 km races, as well as races for children and families, offering an accessible yet challenging experience due to the elevation changes. Participants can enjoy beautiful natural surroundings and a friendly atmosphere, with a social and health-focused purpose.
course_highlights: Trail course in the Cornești Plateau area, the highest point in the city
Approximately 584 m of elevation gain for the half marathon and 256 m for the cross-country race
Various events: 21 km half marathon, 10 km race, 5 km race, and races for children and families
additional: Online registration is open until 14 September 2026. After this date, registration is available only on the day before or on race day, without a participation kit. The entry fee can be paid by bank card or bank transfer, and registration is validated within 3 working days after payment is confirmed. Participants may transfer their place to another competitor if they withdraw. Changing events is possible for an additional fee of 50 lei until 16 September 2026. The children’s and family events have short distances and adjusted time limits. Online registration is open until 15 September 2024, with on-site registration possible after that date; the event includes several race categories, and details about fees and registration procedures are available on the website.

name: „Alerg Pentru Tine” Trail Run
description: Alerg Pentru Tine Trail Run is a charitable sporting competition held in the picturesque forests of Bucovina, in the Sucevița area. The event aims to support palliative care patients at Sf. Luca Sucevița and Sf. Mc. Zenovie Dr. Suceava hospitals, bringing joy and fulfilling the dreams of people going through difficult times. Participants can choose from three moderately challenging races, suitable for both experienced and less experienced runners, and are encouraged to run with heart and determination for a noble cause. The routes offer spectacular views of the Sucevița Valley and the local monastery, and the atmosphere is one of solidarity and community support.
course_highlights: Routes through the forests of Bucovina, with views of the Sucevița Valley and the monastery
Steep climbs on Dealul Furcoi, continuing along the Obcina ridge
Checkpoints, hydration, and food stations along the route
additional: The event offers three races: 20 km, 9 km, and a children’s race. The routes are moderately challenging, with checkpoints and hydration stations. The time limit for the 9 km race is 2.5 hours. Participants are encouraged to run regardless of experience, and registration closes 4 days before the event. A closing ceremony is organized for all participants. Participation includes multiple race distances, online registration, and a festive closing event with music and traditional food.

name: ALBA IULIA CITY RACE Aleargă în cealaltă capitală!
location: Alba Carolina, Alba Iulia, Alba County, Romania
description: Alba Iulia City Race is a major athletic event held in the heart of the Alba Carolina Citadel, giving participants the opportunity to run through a remarkable historic setting. The competition includes several races, from a half marathon and a 10 km cross-country race to fun runs and children’s races, promoting a healthy lifestyle and a running community. The event is a festival of running, combining a passion for sport with exploration and appreciation of local values. The organizers focus on providing a complete experience, with personalized race kits, hydration stations, electronic timing, and attractive prizes.
course_highlights: Routes through the Alba Carolina Citadel, a restored and iconic historic monument
Star Transmission Half Marathon (21 km) and Star Assembly Cross-Country Race (11 km)
Support stations along the route with water, energy drinks, and fruit
additional: The race kit includes a personalized race bib, a personalized technical shirt for the main races and a cotton shirt for the Family Run, electronic chip timing, hydration stations along the route, a refreshment pack at the finish, metal and wooden finisher medals, cash and equipment prizes, official photographs, a DJ at the event, surprise prize drawings, an ambulance for emergencies, and a post-race recovery workout. Multiple race distances are offered, including a half marathon, 11 km, 5 km, a 2.7 km Family Run, and a Kids Race; the event includes activities promoting health and tourist exploration of the city and the Alba Carolina Citadel.

name: POROLISSUM TRAIL
location: Castrul Roman Porolissum, Moigrad, Sălaj, Romania
description: Porolissum Half Marathon is a mountain running event taking place on September 26, 2026, in Moigrad, Sălaj County. The main 23 km course offers a spectacular experience, starting and finishing at the heart of history, the Porolissum Roman Fort. The event also includes 12 km and 1.6 km races, welcoming both advanced runners and enthusiasts of nature and history. The organizers offer a friendly yet challenging atmosphere, with race-kit pickup available in the days before the event and on race day.
course_highlights: A spectacular course starting and finishing at the Porolissum Roman Fort
Mountain running amid historic and natural scenery
Multiple races: 23 km, 12 km, and 1.6 km for different levels of fitness
additional: Race kits can be collected on Friday, September 25, from 15:00 to 20:00 at the Sports Hall of Avram Iancu Sports High School in Zalău, and on Saturday, September 26, from 07:30 to 11:30 in the start area at the Amphitheatre in the Porolissum Roman Fort. The event officially begins at 09:00, with the 23 km race starting at 09:45, followed by the 12 km and 1.6 km races. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 14:00. The organizer reserves the right to change the schedule until September 20, 2026. The event includes multiple race categories, with registration information and rules available on the official website.

name: TRASCĂU TRAIL RUN
description: Trascău Trail Run is a mountain race offering three events: a marathon, a half marathon, and a cross-country race, set amid the picturesque landscapes around Rimetea, Alba. Participants will explore the natural beauty of the Trascău Mountains on routes featuring challenging climbs, forests, gorges, and spectacular viewpoints. The event focuses on the experience of running in nature, combining physical challenges with storybook scenery and local heritage. The organizers provide hydration and refreshment stations, medals for those who finish within the time limit, and prizes for the top competitors.
course_highlights: The marathon route passes through the Plaiului Gorges Geological Reserve and Huda lui Papară Cave
The half marathon includes the steep climb up Piatra Secuiului and a section along Creasta de Cocoș
The cross-country race offers an accessible mountain experience, with peaceful scenery in the forest near the Ardeșcheia massif
additional: Registration is free for people with disabilities. Places are limited: 100 for the marathon, 250 for the half marathon, and 200 for the cross-country race. Race kits are distributed in Cluj-Napoca and Rimetea in the days before the race. There are technical briefings for each event before the start. Medals are awarded only to those who finish within the time limit. Participants are automatically entered into the raffle held after the awards ceremony; attendance is required for the draw. Marathon, half-marathon, and cross-country routes, mountain and cultural scenery, event in September 2026

description: The Župa Wine Run is a unique sports and wine event held in the beautiful landscape of Župa, a renowned wine region in central Serbia. The race brings together wine and sports enthusiasts on a course that passes vineyards, mountains, and cultural and historical landmarks such as the medieval town of Koznik. Participants enjoy tastings at aid stations and receive an official T-shirt, a finisher’s medal, and other souvenirs. The event promotes the area’s rich traditions and natural beauty. The race starts at 12:00, and race packets can be collected until 11:00.
course_highlights: The course runs through Župa’s vineyards and gentle slopes
Views of the surrounding mountains of Kopaonik, Željin, Goč, and Jastrebac
Passes by the medieval town of Koznik
additional: The entry fee includes tastings at the aid stations and mini fair, an official race T-shirt, a race bib, a finisher’s medal, a gift bag, a souvenir, and catering at the aid stations and finish. Race packets can be collected until 11:00 on race day. Participation includes tastings, a race T-shirt, a medal, souvenirs, and catering. Registration is available online until August 31, 2026. The event takes place among the vineyards and natural scenery of Župa, with the race starting at 12:00 and race packets available for collection until 11:00.

name: ESZTERGOM FÉLMARATON
location: Kis-Duna sétány, Esztergom, Komárom-Esztergom County, Hungary
description: The Esztergom Half Marathon is a running event with a variety of distances, held across Esztergom’s historic districts, including Castle Hill, the Watertown district, and the riverside cycle path. Individual and relay runners can choose from several distances, and shorter races are organized separately for children. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere and also serves as a points-collection stop in the Ötpróba program, allowing participants to earn points and rewards. The event’s patrons include the mayor of Esztergom and well-known athletes, adding to its prestige.
course_highlights: The course has a mixed surface, with cobblestone and asphalt sections.
The course runs through Esztergom’s Castle Hill, Watertown district, and riverside cycle path.
The relay consists of three laps, each approximately 7 km long.
additional: Children’s races are free, but registration is required. The first relay runner may also compete in the individual half marathon. The event is a points-collection stop in the Ötpróba program; participants can earn points by completing the distances. The relay exchange zone is located in the start/finish area in front of the Basilica. Distances: half marathon, 14 km, 7 km, relay, children’s races; terrain: mixed surface; registration online and on-site; the event is part of the Ötpróba program.

name: HÍRÖS FÉLMARATON
description: The Hírös Half Marathon is a traditional running event in Kecskemét, taking place on September 27, 2026, at the Benkó Center. The event offers several distances, including 0.3 km, 1 km, 3 km, 7 km, 14 km, 21 km, and 42 km, so runners of all ages and abilities can find a suitable option. The event aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and provide a shared community sports experience. Participants receive a custom finisher medal, and qualified first-aid providers are on hand during the race. Race bibs can be collected on race day and beforehand.
course_highlights: Distances from 0.3 km to 42 km, with individual and relay events
Time limits: 2 hours 45 minutes for 21 km and 5 hours 45 minutes for 42 km
Start times: the marathon at 9:00 and the 300 m race at 10:45
additional: Race bib pickup is available on race day and beforehand, on September 27 from 15:00 to 17:00. The entry fee includes participation in the course finish event and a pre-race pasta party. Race bibs must be worn visibly and may not be exchanged. Qualified first-aid providers will be on standby during the race. Participants can collect their race pack, attend the pasta party, receive finisher medals, and visit local attractions.

description: The Wink-Intretech KapuvárRun 2026 will be held for the fifth time in Kapuvár, in Eszterházi Park. The course is completely flat and runs along city streets, attracting more and more runners from Hungary and abroad each year. The event aims to share the joy of community and exercise, with a friendly atmosphere and togetherness at its heart. The experience continues after the finish, with awards and a large event tent where spectators can comfortably cheer on the runners.
course_highlights: A completely flat course along city streets
Race center with a large event tent and a start-finish gate
A shared community experience and mass-participation event atmosphere
additional: The race center will be in a large event tent on the grassy area in front of the municipal building, where the start-finish gate is also located. Part of the course is closed to traffic, and refreshments are provided. Participants receive custom iron medals and certificates. Personalized finisher ribbons bearing the runner’s name can be ordered for the marathon, half-marathon, and ultramarathon distances. The race uses disposable-chip timing, except for the BabyRace distance. Multiple distances, an urban course, a community event, online registration available, venue: Eszterházi Park.

name: BERLIN MARATON

tiers.label: tier_1

description: The BMW BERLIN-MARATHON is one of the world’s largest and most popular marathons, taking place in Berlin on September 27, 2026. The race is famous for its record-breaking, exceptionally flat course, which passes many of the city’s most beautiful landmarks. Thanks to its diversity and the city’s unique energy, the event offers a special experience not only for professional runners but also for running enthusiasts. The race is part of the Abbott World Marathon Majors series, and participants can choose from a range of options, including charity running, inline skating, and the Generali 5K.
course_highlights: One of the flattest marathon courses in the world, with minimal elevation gain
The course passes many of Berlin’s most beautiful landmarks, including the Brandenburg Gate
15 refreshment stations along the course, as well as BRITA water refill stations
additional: On race day, clothing and valuables cannot be checked in at the start area, but every finisher receives a warm, reusable poncho free of charge at the finish. Clothing check can be booked for €5, but in that case no poncho is provided. Race packets can only be collected in person at the MARATHON EXPO, with photo ID and a start card. Participants receive a 4-day public transport ticket for the duration of the event. Runners can also place their own refreshments on the course with advance registration and labeling. The Generali 5K starts on September 26 at 10:00. The start is at Potsdamer Platz, and the finish is on Straße des 17. Juni, beyond the Brandenburg Gate. Inline skating, a 5 km run, and charity options are also available at the event. Details about registration, race day, and fundraising options can be found on the official website.

name: Mariatálsky štvanec
description: Mariatálsky štvanec is a traditional running race set in the beautiful surroundings of the Little Carpathians, offering a range of disciplines for recreational and competitive runners. The event takes place in the village of Marianka and has a family-friendly atmosphere, culminating in a beautiful sunset. You can compete in the 6 km, 10 km and 15 km races, in three-person teams in the 3×6 km relay, or in the children’s Beh Záhoráčik races. The start and finish are at the football field, and the races are run according to the rules of the Slovak Athletic Federation.
course_highlights: The courses run through the beautiful natural surroundings of the Little Carpathians
A family-friendly atmosphere with the children’s Beh Záhoráčik races
A beautiful sunset marks the highlight of the event
additional: Race-day registration and bib collection are available at the TUI branch in the BORY MALL shopping centre. The number of adult participants is limited to 500, and the number of children to 400. There is no limit on the number of teams. Time limits are 1 hour for 6 km, 1 hour 30 minutes for 10 km, 2 hours for 15 km and 1 hour 30 minutes for the 3×6 km team race. The event includes several courses, categories for adults and children, and relays; online and on-site registration; chip timing; refreshments and medals. The total participant limit is 900.

name: MTBIKER Kylof Ľubietová
description: MTHIKER Kylof Ľubietová is a running race that brings together history, nature and a great atmosphere in the picturesque heart of Slovakia. There are three races: a 4.3 km hobby race for beginners and young runners aged 13 and over, a 10 km main race for competitive and recreational runners, and 850 m children’s races for children aged 6 to 12. The course features climbs and beautiful views of the Low Tatras. Runners can compete for cash prizes and valuable prizes. After the finish, participants can enjoy traditional granadír and receive an original medal as part of the Marathon Tour.
course_highlights: 4.3 km hobby course with a scenic loop and a climb
10 km course with views of the Low Tatras and a mining trail
850 m children’s races in the centre of Ľubietová
additional: The children’s races start from 9:30, with start times determined by age category; the hobby race starts at 10:40 and the main race at 10:30. Every participant receives an original Marathon Tour medal. Granadír is served at the finish. The fastest runners receive vouchers and a trophy, while the overall 10 km winners also receive cash prizes. Everyone who finishes is entered into a draw for experience prizes such as a parachute jump or a sightseeing flight. Trail running, registration, family event, historical themes, beautiful views

name: Gréta Run
location: Koliba Gréta, Liptovská Sielnica, okres L. Mikuláš, Slovakia
description: Gréta Run is a traditional running race in the picturesque surroundings of Kvačianska Valley and Liptovská Sielnica, offering courses of various lengths for children and adults. The race follows the yellow hiking trail and the embankment, finishing at Koliba Gréta, where refreshments and a cultural programme await participants. The event also includes a rich programme of activities for families and children. It is organised by the Liptov Olympic Club, which provides quality technical and medical services.
course_highlights: 7.4 km course from Kvačianska Valley along the yellow trail to Koliba Gréta
15 km course from Koliba Gréta through Kvačianska Valley and Prosiecka Valley and back to Koliba Gréta
3 km course along the embankment to Liptovská Sielnica and back
additional: The first 200 registered participants will receive a race pack with goulash, spaghetti, a T-shirt and a medal. Runners in the 7.4 km race will be transported to the start by bus at 15:30. After the race, goulash and the results announcement will take place at Stodola Gréta, followed by a concert. Changing rooms and toilets are available at Koliba Gréta. The organiser is not responsible for personal belongings or baggage. Discounted accommodation is available on site. Course sections run from Kvačianska Valley and Koliba Gréta; registration is available online or on site. The entry fee includes goulash, a medal, refreshments and other services. The race offers several categories, including children’s and veterans’ categories, with prizes for the winners.

description: Šamorín Running League 2026 – Round 5 is a running event organized by 3klub Šamorín in cooperation with the town of Šamorín. The race takes place in the pleasant surroundings of Pomlé Forest Park in Šamorín and is open to various age groups, from preschoolers to adults. The children’s categories start at 10:00, and the main race begins at 10:30. The event offers a chance to take part in the league and enjoy a sporting atmosphere in a community setting.
course_highlights: Races in the natural surroundings of Pomlé Forest Park
Categories for children and adults
Children’s races start at 10:00; the main race starts at 10:30
additional: Categories: Preschoolers (0–6 years), Younger pupils (7–10 years), Older pupils (11–15 years), Adults (women, men). The event is organized by 3klub Šamorín o.z. in cooperation with the town of Šamorín. Organizer contact: Juraj Nagy, tel.: 0905 984 190. Routes on paved and forest paths; categories from preschoolers to adults; no performance or age limit.

description: Crosul Arenelor is a unique running event in Bucharest, taking place on a 10-kilometer course between two iconic arenas: Stadionul Național Arcul de Triumf and Arena Națională. The race runs in one direction, with no turns, along some of the capital’s most beautiful streets, offering a fast and smooth experience. The event also includes a 2 km Family Run and a wheelchair race, and is open to all running enthusiasts. The organizers focus on creating an energizing atmosphere, with cheering points along the course and a complete race kit for runners.
course_highlights: A 10 km course measured and certified by World Athletics
Start at Stadionul Național Arcul de Triumf and finish at Arena Națională
Refreshment and hydration points at km 1.8, 5 and 7.5
additional: Race kits can be collected at Running Expo, Arena Națională, VIP terrace, on Friday 19 September from 16:00 to 20:00, Saturday 20 September from 10:00 to 20:00, and on Sunday 21 September in the morning for participants from outside Bucharest/Ilfov. The complete kit includes a technical T-shirt, products and services from partners, a finisher medal, and the opportunity to be included in the rankings and prize awards. The course has refreshment and hydration points at km 1.8, 5 and 7.5, offering water, isotonic drinks, fruit and glucose. The minimum age for participation is 14; minors must be accompanied by an adult. The event includes social causes, volunteering opportunities, and distribution of the race kit at the finish. The course is prepared with participants’ safety and comfort in mind.

name: Buzău 21k
description: Buzău 21k is the first half marathon in Buzău County, organized by the Buzău Community Foundation and taking place on September 27, 2026. The event brings the local community together to promote exercise, health, and charity, offering a vibrant running experience in the heart of the city. The course starts at Buzău Athletics Stadium, crosses Crâng Park, and continues along the city’s main boulevards and streets, creating an atmosphere full of energy and joy. Buzău 21k is more than a sporting competition; it is a call to action for exercise and community involvement.
course_highlights: Course starts at Buzău Athletics Stadium
Passes through Crâng Park and along the city’s main boulevards and streets
A vibrant event in the heart of Buzău
additional: The Sport Expo for race-kit collection takes place on Saturday, September 26, from 10:00 to 20:00. There is a time limit for completing the first lap of the 21k race, with a cutoff time of 10:30. The awards ceremony takes place from 14:00 to 15:00 on race day. The event includes children’s races and activities promoting health and community involvement.

name: Rajac 2026
description: Kosidba na Rajcu is a traditional event held since 1892, on the first Sunday after Petrovdan. It brings together mowers dressed in traditional peasant attire who compete in hand-mowing grass on prepared plots. In addition to the competition, the program includes an exhibition of mowing tools, folk performances, and cultural activities, creating a unique atmosphere and preserving folk tradition.
course_highlights: Hand-mowing grass on plots measuring 20 × 6 meters
Mowers dressed in traditional peasant attire
International team competition in hand-mowing grass
additional: The competition takes place on plots measuring 20 × 6 meters, which the mowers cut in two swaths. Mowing is judged on speed and quality, and the winner receives an award. Mowers must bring their own mowing equipment and wear the required traditional attire. The program also includes an exhibition of tools, folk performances, and a concert by a brass band. Events include traditional activities, hiking tours, and trail-marking courses, with a focus on preserving and promoting the natural and cultural values of Rajac.

name: JÁSZFÉNYSZARUI FUTÓFESZTIVÁL
distance_verbose: 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1500 meter, 1 km, 0.6 km, 0.3 km
organizer: Petőfi Sándor Művelődési Ház és Könyvtár Jászfényszaru
description: The 7th Jászfényszaru Running Festival is a recreational running event held at Szentcsalád Square in Jászfényszaru. It offers distances for several age groups, from preschoolers to adults, on paved roads and short dirt sections. The quarter-marathon features chip timing, refreshment points, and medals. All distances are free. The event aims to promote community sport and running, and is held in memory of István Maróti.
course_highlights: A mostly paved route with short dirt sections
Several distances for age groups from preschoolers to adults
Refreshment points and chip timing on the quarter-marathon distance
additional: On-site registration is available on race day from 13:00 and closes 15 minutes before each race starts. Quarter-marathon finishers receive a finisher’s package and a medal. The top three finishers in each age group and gender category receive medals. Bibs must be worn visibly on the front. Each participant may enter only one distance. Medical supervision is provided. The event offers several distances on paved and dirt roads, with online and on-site registration. The organizers provide medical supervision and refreshment points.

name: MAPEI TIHANYI FÉLMARATON (XI.)   .
location: Club Tihany, Tihany, Veszprém County, Hungary
description: The MAPEI Tihany Half Marathon is a traditional running race held for the 11th time in Tihany, offering a range of distances for everyone from beginners to experienced runners. The race stands out for the beautiful panoramas of the Balaton Uplands and its challenging, varied terrain, which takes in some of the peninsula’s most scenic areas. Many runners choose the half marathon as their first, as the course and its spectacular sections make for an unforgettable experience. The event is family-friendly, with a Baby Run for the youngest participants. Runners in every distance receive a finisher’s medal, refreshments and a running T-shirt.
course_highlights: The half-marathon route takes in some of Tihany’s most scenic stretches and varied panoramas, including the shore of Lake Balaton and the northern tip of the peninsula.
The 12 km route is the “Tihany Loop,” offering a challenge with elevation changes and varied terrain.
The 3 km and 5 km routes are easy-to-complete paved courses, ideal for beginners and those returning to running.
additional: All distances include a finisher’s medal and a running T-shirt. The 3K starts at 11:00, and the 5K, 12K and 21K start at 12:00; the 21K has a wave start. The 400-metre Baby Run takes place at the race centre, with refreshments at the finish. Age-group awards are presented, and participants under 18 need a parental consent form. Field sizes are limited to 1,500 participants, except for the Baby Run. The race follows paved roads on the Tihany Peninsula, with varied elevation and panoramic views. Distances: 400 m, 3 km, 5 km, 12 km and 21 km. The race takes place on October 3, 2026, at Club Tihany.

name: MVM Sopron Félmaraton
location: Városi Stadion, Káposztás u. 4., Sopron, Hungary

name: Jarabský polmaratón
description: The Jarabský Half Marathon is a unique mountain trail race in the Low Tatras, covering 22.1 km. It offers a challenging course full of climbs, descents, and technical terrain. The race is for trail-running and active-outdoor enthusiasts, who can enjoy beautiful views and the atmosphere of a running community ranging from professionals to recreational athletes. The event has been held since 2015 and embodies the spirit of a friendly running gathering, “Go Around Jarabá Your Way.” In 2025, it is part of the Slovak Skyrunning League, underscoring its quality and challenge.
course_highlights: The course runs through unspoiled nature, forests, and mountain trails
Challenging trail terrain with climbs and descents
Beautiful views of the central ridge of the Low Tatras
additional: The course features true Sky Race elements and has been part of the Slovak Skyrunning League since 2025. The race is for a broad community of runners, from professionals to recreational athletes. In the past, the course has been adjusted several times depending on the weather; its current length is 22.1 km. The event has a friendly atmosphere and grew out of an informal, untimed running gathering. A challenging mountain trail with 1,240 m of elevation gain, online registration, aid stations, course marking, medical support, and technologies to improve the experience.

name: U.S.Steel Family Run – Minimaratón
description: The U. S. Steel Family Run - Mini-Marathon is a running event in Košice that is part of the traditional International Peace Marathon. Runners of all ages are welcome, with no age limit. The event follows the rules of World Athletics and the Slovak Athletics Association, and the organizers ensure thorough preparation and organization. The start and finish are located on Hlavná Street in Košice, making for an attractive city run.
course_highlights: The course runs through the center of Košice along Hlavná Street
The event is suitable for all ages, with no age limit
Organized according to the rules of World Athletics and the Slovak Athletics Association
additional: It is not possible to transfer a start entry to the following year. A start entry may be transferred to a new participant under certain conditions. Registration and payment of the entry fee are checked online through the runner's account. Registration is open to everyone interested, and participants can look forward to a friendly atmosphere and the chance to take part in a short but dynamic run in the heart of Košice.

name: Last Man Standing
description: Last Man Standing is a unique endurance and strategy race, where each 6.7 km lap must be completed within a maximum of one hour. Participants start running at the top of every hour, and those who fail to finish in time or withdraw are eliminated. The race continues until only one runner remains, testing competitors’ physical and mental limits. The event is part of Zalău Ultra Trail, a platform that brings sport, community, and nature together.
course_highlights: Set course of 6.7 km per lap
Each lap must be completed within a maximum of one hour
Immediate elimination for finishing late or withdrawing
additional: The race is run in hourly laps, with each lap starting at the next fixed hour after the previous one ends. It is a test of mental and physical endurance, where the opponent is time, the course, and your own mind. The event includes distances such as 12.5 km, 24 km, 44 km, and 103 km, promoting solidarity and respect for nature.

description: Veverița Night Run is a nighttime mountain-running race in Bucovina, held in the town of Vatra Dornei. The event offers two moderately difficult races, 12 km and 22 km, on routes consisting mainly of mountain trails, with sections through forests and open meadows. The start and finish are at the base of the Veverița ski slope, and the route reaches Vârful Diecilor at an elevation of 1,301 meters. Participants must be prepared for nighttime mountain running and bring suitable equipment, including a headlamp and mobile phone.
course_highlights: Moderately difficult route with 95–100% mountain trail
80% forest and 20% open meadows on both races
The route reaches Vârful Diecilor, elevation 1,301 m
additional: Participants must carry a mobile phone with a fully charged battery and a headlamp with spare batteries. Equipment for adverse weather conditions is required, such as a long-sleeved shirt or waterproof shell. There are hydration points and two feeding points, at the start and at Vârful Diecilor. Medical assistance is provided by mountain rescuers; no ambulance is stationed at the start/finish. The entry fee is non-refundable in the event of withdrawal. Registration is valid once payment has been confirmed. Minors must provide a statement from a parent or guardian. Mountain, nighttime, hydration and feeding points, mountain rescue assistance, strict participation rules.

name: Harvest Run
description: Harvest Run is a community sports event that promotes a healthy lifestyle through running and is open to all ages and fitness levels. The event takes place in Vladimirescu, Arad, and includes races for children, families, and recreational or experienced runners. Each edition supports social causes, turning running into an act of solidarity and support for the community. Participants enjoy a friendly, inclusive atmosphere, with courses suited to all ages and performance levels.
course_highlights: Varied courses: half marathon 21 km, sprint 10 km, super sport 5 km, family race 1 km, and children’s races
An event for all ages, from 6-year-olds to adults and families
Location in Vladimirescu, Arad, with an active community and support for social causes
additional: The community gathers every Tuesday at 19:00 for group training at Harvest Arad Church. The event supports social and educational projects, including initiatives for children and teenagers from disadvantaged backgrounds. It includes various race categories and has a charitable purpose, supporting social and community causes.

name: Crosul Regina Maria
location: Sala Sporturilor Horia Demian, Cluj-Napoca, Cluj County, Romania
description: The Queen Maria Cross is a running event held in Cluj-Napoca, bringing together the local running community for a competition full of energy and sportsmanship. The course starts in the area around the “Horia Demian” Sports Hall and offers participants an enjoyable experience with a friendly, well-organized atmosphere. The event is supported by official sponsors and partners, ensuring it runs smoothly and provides facilities for runners. It is an excellent opportunity for athletes of all levels to enjoy running outdoors and connect with other enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Start and race-kit pickup at the “Horia Demian” Sports Hall, side entrance facing the tram line
Accessible, well-marked urban course in Cluj-Napoca
Friendly atmosphere and support from the local running community
additional: Race kits are distributed at the “Horia Demian” Sports Hall, side entrance facing the tram line. Video footage of the previous edition is available to give you a sense of the atmosphere and course. The event is part of the IndividuALL Running Series and is supported by official sponsors and partners. The event takes place on outdoor routes along the banks of the Someș River, with race-kit pickup at the 'Horia Demian' Sports Hall.

name: Medzinárodný maratón mieru
description: The International Peace Marathon in Košice is a traditional running celebration held on 4 October 2026 on Hlavná Street. Organized by the Košice Marathon Club, it offers a marathon, half marathon and other events, with the start and finish located in the city centre. The event is known for its long history and high-quality organization, including the Slovak Half Marathon Championships. Runners can expect professional timekeeping and a rich accompanying programme.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Hlavná Street, between DoubleTree by Hilton and the Dargov department store
The Slovak Half Marathon Championships are part of the event
The course is certified according to World Athletics and Slovak Athletics Association rules
additional: The start and finish are on Hlavná Street in Košice. The organizer provides professional timekeeping. The Slovak Half Marathon Championships are also part of the event. Age groups and special categories for relay teams and handbikes are available. Registration is available online, and payment can be made by card, Google Pay, Apple Pay and registration code. The event includes various categories, including the marathon, half marathon, relay and inline events, with the option to register online and change the start or event within the specified deadlines.

name: Brașov Running Festival
description: Brașov Running Festival is a top road-running event that brings thousands of runners to Brașov, from amateurs to elite athletes, in an energetic atmosphere filled with music and fun. The festival features a variety of races, from a 5 km race for beginners and children’s races to tRUNsylvania 10K, the only road race in Romania certified with a World Athletics Elite Label. The event takes place on the streets of the Tractorul district in Brașov and offers a complete experience, with cheering zones, live performances, and TV broadcasts. It is a celebration of running that combines athletic performance with the joy of community.
course_highlights: tRUNsylvania 10K — the flagship race, certified with a World Athletics Elite Label
A variety of races: 5K Open, Wheelchair Race 5K, Kids Races, Fun Race 3K, Trail to Road
Cheering zones with live performances along the course
additional: Spectators can attend free of charge throughout the event. The tRUNsylvania 10K is broadcast live on national TV channels and online. All participants receive the official race shirt provided by technical sponsor Joma. A cloakroom is available for personal belongings, but bulky items are not accepted. Race bibs are personal and must be worn throughout the race. Includes an earlier 5 km race during the day, with courses of approximately 3.5 km in the Tractorul district of Brașov.

name: UVT Liberty Marathon
location: Bd. V. Pârvan 4, Timișoara, Timiș County, Romania
description: UVT Liberty Marathon is a running event held in Timișoara that promotes a healthy lifestyle and the freedom to discover yourself through movement. The event offers races for all levels, from children to experienced runners, with distances ranging from 200 meters to the full marathon of 42 km. The UVT Liberty Marathon community is dedicated to supporting and motivating participants to reach their potential and enjoy running in a friendly, energetic setting. The courses are designed to challenge and inspire, and the atmosphere is supportive and free-spirited.
course_highlights: A full 42 km marathon course for experienced runners
A 21 km half marathon for those ready to take on half the challenge
Fun runs and children’s races, with distances from 200 m to 1 km
additional: The event includes races for all ages and experience levels, with age categories from 4 years old through adulthood. Facilities include checkpoints, medical staff, and portable toilets. Training programs are available for the 5, 10.5, 21, and 42 km distances, created by an experienced university coach. The maximum time limit is 6 hours for the marathon and 3 hours for the half marathon. Participants can choose from several distances, including the marathon, half marathon, relay, and children’s races; the event promotes freedom and health in the community; registration and race details are available on the official website.

description: Mârzeşti Trail Run is an annual Cross Country running competition held in the Breazu area, Rediu commune, Iași County, with the start and finish in front of the forestry cabin in Mârzeşti Forest. The varied courses include wooded areas, meadows, and forest and agricultural roads, offering a unique running experience in nature, with flat sections, descents, and climbs. The event promotes outdoor sport and supports local social causes, offering a chance for runners to enjoy themselves and meet fellow enthusiasts. The half-marathon distance and the other races suit different training levels, and event arrangements include water stations and course marshals.
course_highlights: Courses combining forest roads, meadows, and agricultural roads
Varied terrain with flat sections, descents, and climbs
Water stations at km 3, 5, and 8.5, used twice for the half-marathon
additional: The courses are monitored by marshals and photographers, and traffic is not closed. The event supports local social causes through voluntary donations. Warming up before running is recommended. There are checkpoints 200 m from the start/finish for all races. Forest and meadow courses, Cross Country race, social involvement, promotion of nature and a healthy lifestyle

name: 41. SPAR Budapest Maraton® Fesztivál
description: The 41st SPAR Budapest Marathon® Festival is a running event held over an entire weekend, taking place on October 11 in Budapest. Participants can enter races ranging from 5 to 42.195 km, so everyone can find a challenge that suits them. The event aims to offer runners an unforgettable experience, from beginners to experienced marathoners. With the support of its chief patrons and patrons, the marathon is a true bucket-list challenge that takes runners past Budapest’s iconic landmarks.
course_highlights: A variety of distances, from 5 km to the full marathon (42.195 km)
A route passing Budapest’s iconic landmarks
A weekend-long running festival with events and activities
additional: The event features races over several distances on Saturday and Sunday, including pairs, relay, 30 km, 14 km, 10 km, minimarathon, relay and school relay events. The registration office provides contact details and several registration options (guest registration, school registration and corporate registration). The event’s chief patrons are the Mayor of Budapest and the Minister of Foreign Affairs and Trade. Runners can enjoy activities, prize draws and health advice throughout the weekend. Registration is open for distances from 5 to 42.195 km; registration has opened only for the individual marathon, with registration for the other events opening soon.

name: SPAR MARATON FUTÓFESZTIVÁL
description: The SPAR Budapest Marathon® Festival is a two-day running event taking place in Budapest on October 10–11, 2026. Participants can run past Budapest’s most beautiful World Heritage sites while enjoying the city’s panoramas and enthusiastic crowds. The festival celebrates running, with distances to suit everyone, from 5 km to the marathon. Participants will receive a unique finisher’s medal and race T-shirt, while a range of accompanying activities and musical experiences will make the weekend unforgettable.
course_highlights: A route passing World Heritage sites
Some of Budapest’s most beautiful panoramas and districts
Numerous bands and cheering spectators create an electrifying atmosphere
additional: Participants can choose from 18 different distances, from 5 km to the marathon, and can also enter in pairs or as part of a relay. The event features a range of accompanying activities, musical experiences, and enthusiastic spectators. Finishers receive a unique medal and race T-shirt. Contact details for the race office and the option to amend entries are also available. Distances: marathon, half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, relay, walking, family run, city tour, equal-opportunity run; schedule, start list, results, online registration, team and school registration, awards

tiers.label: tier_1

description: Javornícka stovka is a mountain ultramarathon and long-distance hike held in the Javorníky region. Runners cross challenging mountain terrain with several checkpoints and time limits. The event is intended for experienced runners seeking a challenge in beautiful natural surroundings. The start and registration are in Čadca, and the finish is in Lysá pod Makytou. The organizers emphasize safety, mandatory equipment, and medical assistance along the entire route.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain in the Javorníky with several checkpoints
Finish in Lysá pod Makytou
A generous 27-hour time limit, with several intermediate cut-off times
additional: Participant registration takes place at the House of Culture in Čadca on Matičné námestie on Friday evening and Saturday morning. The mass start is in Čadca at 07:00. The organizers provide baggage transport and drop bags at checkpoint K4. Medical assistance and safety are provided during the event. Accommodation is available in Čadca; participants can spend the night in the gym of an elementary school, where quiet hours are observed. The course consists of 80% forest roads, 5% asphalt, and 15% meadows. Mandatory equipment includes a headlamp, reflective elements, hydration, and a first-aid kit. Registration closed on 26 September 2025.

description: GARMIN Run through the Súľov Rocks is a traditional running race set in the beautiful surroundings of the Súľov Rocks, offering three courses of varying lengths and difficulty. Runners make their way through scenic countryside, with views of rock formations and ridge trails. Aid stations are also provided along the course. The event is suitable for a wide range of participants, including children, who have separate categories and start times. It is organized by the Slovak Cycling Club CYKLO TOUR Súľov - Hradná, which provides thorough preparation and support for participants.
course_highlights: The course passes through the scenic Súľov Rocks, with views of rock formations and ridge trails
Up to 850 metres of elevation gain on the longest, 17 km course
Three aid stations along the course, plus separate children’s categories with their own starts
additional: The participation limit is 1,200 runners for the main race and 350 children for the children’s race. The children’s race is free of charge. Registration is valid only after the entry fee has been paid. In-person registration and payment are available on the day before the race starts, provided the participation limit has not been reached. Children’s category starts take place between the main race starts. The course includes forest trails and short asphalt sections. Registration is available through the official websites. The event is known for its beautiful scenery and atmosphere.

name: Grand Prix – Cabaj-Čápor
price_range: 10 € online, 15 € na mieste, zadarmo pre deti a niektoré kategórie
description: The Grand Prix Cabaj-Čápor is a traditional cross-country race in beautiful natural surroundings, held in the village of Cabaj-Čápor, starting at Salaš Cabaj. Runners can choose from several distances, including 10 km, 3 km and children’s races of 600 m and 1,000 m. The event is suitable for anyone who wants to enjoy sport in nature, whether to compete or simply for the pleasure of running. Registration is open and participant numbers are limited, so it is advisable to sign up early.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in the natural surroundings of Cabaj-Čápor
10 km and 3 km races, plus children’s races of 600 m and 1,000 m
Start at Salaš Cabaj
additional: Race check-in begins at 9:00. Participant numbers are limited. Participants in the main and hobby races receive a finisher’s award. The event takes place on 10 October 2026. Online registration is available, and the race is suitable for all age groups and ability levels.

description: The Autumn Run of Michalovce Residents is a traditional running race in Michalovce, offering an opportunity for competitors of various age groups. The race takes place at the grounds of the 2nd Primary School at J. Švermu 6 and consists of a 400-metre children’s run and a 3-kilometre main run. The event is suitable for families and runners who want to enjoy the autumn atmosphere and sporting activities in a pleasant setting. The organizers provide refreshments and commemorative items for participants.
course_highlights: 400 m children’s run for children up to 9 years old
3 km main run consisting of 3 laps of 900 m each
Start and finish at the grounds of the 2nd Primary School, J. Švermu 6, Michalovce
additional: Competitors will receive commemorative items, and refreshments will be provided. Competitor check-in is from 08:00 to 09:15. The results announcement and medal awards are at 10:30. The children’s run (500 m) starts at 9:30, and the main run (3 km) at 9:45; on-site registration; categories for adults, children and seniors; the event is part of the autumn sports calendar.

name: Beh Myšľou
location: Archeoskanzene Nižná Myšľa, Nižná Myšľa, Slovakia
description: The Vyšná Myšľa Run is a running event organised by the Vyšná Myšľa Municipal Running Club and the Municipality of Vyšná Myšľa. The race takes place at the football field in Vyšná Myšľa, in Košice-okolie District. The children’s races start at 14:00 and the adults’ races at 16:00. Men and women can compete in various age categories, including a 2 x 3 km relay for pairs. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere for running in the village.
course_highlights: The race takes place at the football field in Vyšná Myšľa
2 x 3 km relay for pairs
Multiple age categories for men and women
additional: Entry fees are waived for Men E, Women I, members of BKO Vyšná Myšľa, residents of Vyšná Myšľa and children. The children’s races start at 14:00 and the adults’ races at 16:00. Race distances range from 350 m to 8 km. Registration is available online or on site, and the event is suitable for all age groups.

name: Beh za zdravie – Kuchajda
description: Run for Health - Kuchajda is a charity running event taking place on October 11, 2026, at Kuchajda in Bratislava. The event combines sport with support for health and the community, aiming to help disadvantaged people and organizations through physical activity. Participants can run, jog at an easy pace, or walk, in a wonderful atmosphere filled with inspiring stories and solidarity. Run for Health is open to all ages and fitness levels, while also supporting charity projects with a real impact.
course_highlights: Running event at Kuchajda in Bratislava
Supporting health and the community through sport
An opportunity to take part regardless of age or fitness level
additional: The event is a charity fundraiser supporting disadvantaged people and organizations. Children, adults, and older people can take part by running, jogging at an easy pace, or walking. The organizers offer the opportunity to volunteer and contribute to the success of the event. The event takes place at Kuchajda in Bratislava and supports health and socially disadvantaged groups. Registration details are not specified.

description: The Run Through the Streets of Krompachy is a traditional running race in the town of Krompachy, offering categories for children, youth, juniors, men and women in various age groups. The race takes place in front of the municipal office building and is organized by the Town of Krompachy and the Culture and Sports Commission of the Municipal Council in Krompachy. The starts are split between the children’s categories and youth at 9:30 and adults at 11:00. The entry fee is a symbolic €5, except for pupils, youth athletes and runners over 60. The race is suitable for the general public and supports sporting life in the region.
course_highlights: The race runs through the streets of Krompachy
Start and finish in front of the municipal office building
Categories for all age groups, from children to seniors
additional: The starts are at 9:30 for the children’s categories and youth, and 11:00 for adults. Categories are divided in detail by age and gender, including several age groups for men and women. The event is organized by the Town of Krompachy and the Culture and Sports Commission of the Municipal Council in Krompachy. The event takes place in October, with various categories and starts from 9:00; registration is possible by contacting the organizer. The course is likely urban and on roads.

name: Hercules Maraton
description: Hercules Marathon is a mountain running event held in the Cerna Valley, Băile Herculane, organized by Alternative Timișoara Sports Club. The competition includes Marathon (44 km) and Half Marathon (22 km) races on mountain trails crossing the Cerna Mountains and connecting the area’s 39 hamlets. It is one of the region’s first mountain marathons, offering an authentic trail-running experience amid spectacular natural scenery. The event is for runners passionate about mountain terrain and adventure.
course_highlights: Mountain trails crossing the Cerna Mountains
Connects 39 hamlets in the Cerna Valley area
Marathon (44 km) and Half Marathon (22 km) distances
additional: The routes pass through scenic areas and may include varied mountain terrain; registration details are not specified

name: Bucharest Marathon
description: The Raiffeisen Bank Bucharest Marathon is an iconic sporting event held annually in Bucharest, offering races for runners of all levels. The courses include the full marathon of 42 km, the half marathon of 21 km, the 10 km race, the popular race, and the 4x relay, all starting in Constitution Square. The event is known for its vibrant atmosphere, community support, and involvement in charitable causes. Participants can experience an urban course passing important landmarks of the capital, with hydration and support points along the way.
course_highlights: Urban course through Bucharest’s iconic landmarks
A variety of races: marathon, half marathon, 10 km, popular race, and 4x relay
Start and finish in Constitution Square
additional: Race kits are collected before the race at the designated location. The event includes hydration points and medical support along the course. Pacemakers are available for the main races. After the race, participants receive prizes and medals. The organizers support charitable causes through the registration of partner NGOs. The event includes charitable partnerships, exhibitions, and prizes for winners, with details about registration and kit collection available on the official website.
